domains.description: Downstream account-based engagement platform: contact- and account-level intent capture, anonymous-to-account identity resolution, engagement scoring, multichannel orchestration, account-based advertising, and 1:1 web personalization. Ingests ICPs and target account lists authored in Go-to-Market Planning and runs engagement against them. Bought by Marketing Operations; distinct from the planning shell (GTM-PLAN) and from campaign automation (MA).
domains.catalog_tagline: Know which accounts are in-market, then engage them across ads, web, and orchestration before competitors do.
domains.catalog_description: Turn your target account list into pipeline. Capture intent signals and resolve anonymous web traffic to real accounts, score engagement so you know who is heating up, and orchestrate multichannel plays across advertising, web, and outreach. Run account-based ad campaigns and personalize the website for named accounts, all governed by consent. Ingest the ICP and target lists your planning team authored and engage against them, so marketing spend lands on the accounts that matter.
domains.business_logic: Predictive and third-party intent scoring, anonymous-visitor to account identity resolution, account/contact engagement scoring models, programmatic ad bidding and audience activation, and AI-driven web personalization variant selection.

domains.description: Structured planning and orchestration for strategic and key accounts, relationship mapping (org charts, influence and sentiment tracking), white-space mapping (which products bought vs available), joint account plans, mutual close/onboarding plans, QBR automation, and key-account metrics. Distinct from CRM (transactional opportunity record), MA (programmatic engagement), and CPQ (quoting).
domains.catalog_tagline: Plan, run, and review your strategic accounts the way the best account teams do: map relationships, find white space, write joint plans, and close on QBR commitments.
domains.catalog_description: Give account teams a structured surface to plan against named key accounts: who decides, who buys today, and where the next opportunity sits. Relationship maps make the org chart and the political reality visible. White-space maps show every product an account has not bought yet on a per-business-unit grid. Account plans hold the named objectives and strategies the team will pursue this year, with a clean version history. Mutual action plans extend the plan to the buyer with shared milestones, owned roles on either side, and signed acknowledgments as work progresses. Quarterly business review templates and meeting workflows close the loop on every review: actions logged, commitments tracked, and last quarter's promises checked against this quarter's progress. Health and growth metrics roll up across the portfolio, key-account team assignments make staffing legible, white space identified by the planning workflow flows to sales engagement, and account-health decline flows to customer success. Built to sit on top of your CRM and customer-success systems rather than replace them.
domains.business_logic: Opportunity-graph rollups and white-space scoring across account hierarchies; coverage and influence maps over key-account org charts.

domains.description: CPA / tax-preparer practice operating platform: client and engagement management, workflow templates per service line (1040, 1120, 1065, audit, bookkeeping, advisory), recurring-task generation against tax-calendar deadlines, time and billing, engagement-letter and proposal management, secure client portal for document exchange, and capacity-vs-due-date analytics. Buyer is the CPA firm or tax-prep practice, solo to mid-size. IRS Pub 4557 and GLBA regulate the preparer; SOC 2 is commercially expected but voluntary.
domains.catalog_tagline: Run your accounting practice end to end: engagements, tax returns, and client billing in one workflow.
domains.catalog_description: Manage the full lifecycle of professional accounting work, from accepting a client engagement through preparing and filing tax returns to billing for the hours your team logs. Standardize recurring tax-season work, keep client documents and signatures in one secure place, and give clients a portal to share files and pay invoices.
domains.business_logic: Tax-calendar-driven workflow generation (Jan 31 1099/W-2, March 15 1120-S/1065, April 15 1040/1120, Oct 15 extensions, etc.), client-folder document-retention rules per IRS/state preparer requirements, engagement-letter e-signature chains with retainer-payment gating, capacity forecasting through tax season (timekeeper bandwidth vs filing deadlines), per-engagement workflow checkpoints with sign-off.

domains.description: Software market for operator-side reservation and operations management of tours, activities, attractions, rentals, and guided adventure trips. Covers real-time availability and capacity, online and counter booking, resource and guide scheduling, digital liability waivers, integrated payments, gift cards and refunds, customer communications and reviews, and optional distribution to online travel agencies. Distinct from Corporate Travel Management (the corporate buyer side of trip sourcing) and from Short-Term and Vacation Rental Management (lodging inventory): this domain owns the sale and delivery of a scheduled, capacity-limited experience and the people and equipment that fulfill it.
domains.catalog_tagline: Sell, schedule, and run your tours and activities: take bookings, manage availability and guides, collect waivers, and get paid, all in one place.
domains.catalog_description: Run your entire tour or activity business from one system. Publish your trips and experiences, show real-time availability online, and let customers book and pay from your website or at the counter. Prevent overbookings, assign guides and equipment to each departure, and collect signed liability waivers before guests arrive. Process payments, issue gift cards, and handle refunds and cancellations without juggling separate tools. Built for day-tour operators, attractions, rental shops, and guided-adventure outfitters alike, with optional distribution to online travel agencies when you want to reach more customers.
domains.business_logic: Real-time availability and capacity allocation across shared resources, overbooking prevention, seasonal and dynamic rate rules, guide and equipment assignment against availability, and channel-availability synchronization go beyond plain CRUD plus state workflows.

domains.description: Vertical operations platform for advertising, marketing, creative, PR, and media agencies. Combines agency-specific job/traffic management, time tracking with client rate cards, retainer accounting with burn-down, media buying (plans + insertion orders + commission), creative review/proofing, multi-rate billing (cost-plus, retainer, T&M, fixed fee), and per-job profitability. Distinct from PSA (services/consulting firms — no media/retainer/commission semantics), from WORK-MGMT (horizontal, no client-billing or media-buying), and from DAM (asset library only).
domains.catalog_tagline: Run your agency from estimate to invoice: client jobs, media buying, and creative operations in one place.
domains.catalog_description: Manage your agency's client work end to end. Open jobs and track them through traffic and delivery, capture time against client rate cards, and watch retainers burn down in real time. Plan and buy media by outlet and channel, reconcile spend against publisher invoices, and move creative from brief to approved deliverable, then bill clients on markup or cost-plus terms without re-keying a thing.
domains.business_logic: Multi-rate billing (cost-plus, fixed fee, retainer burn-down, T&M); media commission and markup (typically 17.65% gross-up or 15% media commission); per-job profitability rollups across time, materials, and media; retainer draw-down and replenishment; project-based revenue recognition under ASC 606; multi-currency client and supplier reconciliation.

domains.description: Machine-learning-driven event correlation, anomaly detection, and noise reduction for IT operations.
domains.catalog_tagline: Cut through alert noise and turn a flood of IT signals into a short list of correlated, root-caused issues your teams can act on before users feel the impact.
domains.catalog_description:
An AIOps platform sits across the high-volume telemetry your IT estate produces every second, metrics, logs, traces, events, and alerts, and uses machine learning and statistical analysis to find the few patterns that matter. Instead of paging on every threshold breach, it groups related signals into a single correlated incident, filters out duplicate and flapping alerts, and surfaces the probable root cause so responders start from an answer rather than a blank screen.

Operations and engineering teams use it to detect anomalies against learned baselines, suppress noise during planned changes, and receive early warning of predicted outages and capacity problems while there is still time to act. Correlated incidents and high-confidence predictions flow straight into incident and problem workflows, and suppression decisions flow back to the monitoring layer, so the whole operational loop stays in sync.

Behind the scenes, detection and prediction models are continuously retrained and watched for drift, keeping the signal accurate as the environment changes. The result is fewer pages, faster mean time to resolution, and a clearer picture of service health, so on-call teams spend their time fixing problems instead of triaging alerts.
domains.business_logic: Event correlation, deduplication, anomaly detection, and root-cause analysis: ML and statistical algorithms across high-volume telemetry.

domains.description: Invoice capture, matching, approval, and payment execution for accounts payable.
domains.catalog_tagline: Capture invoices, match them to POs and receipts, and pay suppliers on time without the spreadsheet shuffle.
domains.catalog_description: Accounts Payable Automation takes the manual grind out of paying suppliers. Invoices arrive by email, PDF, or supplier portal and are captured and read automatically, then matched line by line against the purchase order and goods receipt so clean invoices flow straight through and only real exceptions reach a human. Approvals route to the right people on policy, duplicate and fraud checks run before any money moves, and approved bills are grouped into scheduled payment runs across ACH, wire, check, and other methods. The result is faster cycle times, fewer late-payment penalties, captured early-payment discounts, and a clean audit trail your controllers and auditors can trust.
domains.business_logic: OCR/IDP for invoice capture, three-way match against PO and receipt, duplicate detection, and fraud rules — algorithm-heavy at the front of the workflow.

domains.description: Full lifecycle API design, gateways, developer portals, security, and monetization for internal and external APIs.
domains.catalog_tagline: Design, secure, publish, and monetize your APIs from one place.
domains.catalog_description: Run the full life of every API: author the contract, version it cleanly, and push it through gateways with the access, authentication, and rate-limit rules you need. Onboard the developers and partners who consume your APIs, give them a self-service portal and keys, and watch real usage with per-consumer call volumes, latency, and error rates. Catch breaking changes before they reach subscribers, hold deprecated versions to a sunset plan, and turn API traffic into a billable, governed product instead of an unmanaged back door.
domains.business_logic: Gateway data plane (request routing, transformation, auth, rate limiting, observability) — a high-throughput runtime. Developer portal and policy management are CRUD.

domains.description: Inventory and rationalization of the enterprise application landscape, including business capabilities, technology fit, and lifecycle.
domains.catalog_tagline: See every application you run, score what it is worth, and decide what to keep, fix, or retire.
domains.catalog_description:
Build one trustworthy inventory of the applications, interfaces, and technology platforms your organization depends on, with the business capabilities each one supports. Track every application through its full life from planned to retired, and keep owners, costs, and technical details in one place.

Once the landscape is mapped, score each application on cost, business value, and technical fit so you can rank the portfolio and act with confidence. Spot redundant or aging applications, plan migrations and retirements, and give leadership a clear, defensible view of where to invest and where to cut.
domains.business_logic: TIME (tolerate/invest/migrate/eliminate) scoring rules over portfolio attributes — a small declarative layer.

domains.description: Code-first managed runtime for deploying web apps, APIs, and background workers. Distinct from LCAP (low-code) and IPAAS (integration).
domains.catalog_tagline: Ship code-first apps to a managed runtime that builds, deploys, and scales without touching servers.
domains.catalog_description: Push your web apps, APIs, and background workers to a managed runtime that builds your code on every commit and deploys it for you. Promote a release from staging up to production, watch it roll out, and roll back a bad deploy without managing infrastructure. Spin up the databases, caches, and queues your app needs as attachable add-ons, scale instances up and down as traffic changes, and keep each environment isolated and reproducible. Teams get from commit to running app in minutes and stay focused on product instead of provisioning and patching servers.
domains.business_logic: Application runtime, autoscaler, build pipeline, networking, and storage abstractions — the platform IS the kernel.

domains.description: Requisition management, candidate sourcing, interview workflows, and offer management. AI-assisted matching and screening overlays are increasingly bundled.
domains.catalog_tagline: Hire faster with a connected pipeline from sourcing through offer acceptance.
domains.catalog_description:
Track every candidate from first contact through hire. Manage job requisitions, posting distribution, application intake, interview scheduling, scorecard collection, and offer generation in one connected pipeline.

When a candidate accepts an offer, the workflow hands off cleanly to onboarding so your new hire's first day doesn't start from a blank page. Built-in support for EEOC-compliant funnel analytics, requisition approval routing, and offer-letter version control.
domains.business_logic: Candidate matching and resume parsing ML — significant in modern ATS products; the rest is pipeline stages, scheduling, and offers.

domains.description: Planning, fieldwork, evidence, and issue tracking for internal and external audits.
domains.catalog_tagline: Plan, execute, and report internal audits from a risk-based plan through fieldwork, findings, and tracked remediation.
domains.catalog_description:
Run your internal audit function end to end. Build a risk-based annual plan, scope engagements, and assign teams, then carry out fieldwork with work papers and control tests that capture evidence as you go. When you raise a finding, route it for management response, agree on recommendations, and track follow-up actions to closure so nothing slips.

Produce review-ready reports for leadership and the audit committee, and keep a defensible trail of who tested what, when, and with what result. Sign-offs, locked work papers, and a clear status on every open issue give you confidence that the audit cycle is under control and that remediation is actually getting done.

domains.description: Storefront, catalog, cart, checkout, and order capture for B2C and B2B digital commerce. Distinct from OMS (post-order distributed fulfillment).
domains.catalog_tagline: Sell direct to consumers: catalog, checkout, and fulfillment in one commerce workflow.
domains.catalog_description: Run your direct-to-consumer storefront end to end. Publish products and promotions, capture carts and take payment at checkout, and get paid orders picked, packed, and shipped. Track every order from cart to doorstep, tie each one back to the shopper, and keep catalog, payment, and delivery status in one connected place.
domains.business_logic: Cart, promotion engine, search/merchandising ranking, and inventory-availability service: the runtime an e-commerce site depends on.

domains.description: Origination, onboarding, servicing, and case-management workflows for retail and commercial banking.
domains.catalog_tagline: Run the full banking back office from one workflow spine: open accounts, originate and disburse loans, clear KYC and sanctions checks, move money, and resolve customer disputes.
domains.catalog_description:
Banking Operations gives retail and commercial banking teams a single place to take a customer from application to active account and from loan request to funded disbursement. Front-line staff capture account and loan applications, route them through identity, beneficial-ownership, and AML review, and track each request through its approval, decline, or funding decision with a clear audit trail.

Payment and money-movement work is first class: initiate wire transfers, screen them for sanctions and threshold-reporting triggers, and post the resulting transactions to the right accounts with reconciliation built in. When something goes wrong, open and work banking cases for disputes, fraud claims, account errors, and complaints, with assignment, SLA, and resolution tracking.

Compliance is woven through the workflow rather than bolted on, so KYC reviews, sanctions hits, and suspicious-activity signals are captured as the work happens and are ready to hand to your risk and finance teams.
domains.business_logic: Risk-based decisioning rules (KYC, credit, AML) and fee/interest calculations; the rest is case management and journeys.

domains.description: Business impact analysis, continuity planning, and exercise execution for resilience.
domains.catalog_tagline: Know what would hurt most if it stopped, plan the recovery, and prove the plan works before you need it.
domains.catalog_description:
Build an organization that keeps running when something goes wrong. Start with a business impact analysis that maps each critical service to the processes, applications, people, and suppliers it depends on, then set the recovery time and recovery point targets that say how fast each one has to come back and how much data you can afford to lose. Turn those targets into continuity and disaster recovery plans with named owners, recovery strategies, and step-by-step runbooks, so the response is written down and approved instead of improvised under pressure.

Keep the plans honest. Schedule tabletop, walkthrough, and full-interruption exercises, capture the gaps and action items each one surfaces, and feed the findings back into the plans so they get stronger with every test. When a real disruption hits, activate the right plan, stand up the response team, work the call tree and mass-notification roster, log every decision and outbound message, and stand down cleanly with an after-action record that improves the next response.

Give leadership and auditors a defensible answer on resilience. Track plan currency and exercise coverage, evidence the controls that frameworks such as ISO 22301, DORA, and NIS2 expect, and connect continuity to the risks and compliance findings raised elsewhere so a critical risk automatically refreshes the continuity exposure it threatens.
domains.business_logic: Dependency mapping between business services, applications, and infrastructure is the modest algorithmic layer; the rest is plans, BIAs, and exercise records.

domains.description: Open enrollment, life-event handling, carrier connectivity, ACA compliance, and benefits decision support.
domains.catalog_tagline: Run open enrollment, life events, and carrier connectivity in one place.
domains.catalog_description: Benefits Administration gives HR and benefits teams a single workspace to design plan offerings, run annual open enrollment, capture employee elections and dependents, process qualifying life events, and keep insurance carriers and retirement record-keepers in sync. It tracks affordability and ACA reporting obligations so employees get the coverage they choose and the organization stays compliant without spreadsheet wrangling.
domains.business_logic: Eligibility rules that determine which benefits a worker can elect; declarative and well-suited to a rules engine.

domains.description: Employment background verification / pre-employment screening as a standalone market: order screening packages, run criminal, employment, education, identity, driving, drug, and watchlist components, adjudicate against an eligibility matrix, run the FCRA/EEOC adverse-action and compliance chain, and keep workers cleared post-hire with continuous monitoring, rescreening, identity, and right-to-work verification. Distinct from the recruiting-embedded screening step that an applicant-tracking module local-masters.
domains.catalog_tagline: Order, track, and adjudicate employment background checks with the FCRA adverse-action chain built in.
domains.catalog_description: Run employment background checks end to end. Build screening packages from criminal, employment, education, identity, driving, and drug components, then invite candidates to a portal to give consent and complete their checks. Adjudicate results against a configurable eligibility matrix, and when a result is disqualifying, walk the full pre-adverse and adverse action chain with disclosures, authorizations, summary-of-rights acknowledgements, and dispute handling. Keep workers cleared after hire with continuous monitoring, rescreening, identity verification, and right-to-work checks.
domains.business_logic: Adjudication rules engine that evaluates screening results against a configurable eligibility matrix; orchestration of third-party data-source retrieval and result aggregation across criminal, employment, education, and identity sources; continuous-monitoring alert generation against post-hire data feeds.

domains.description: Interactive data exploration, dashboards, governed self-service analytics, and embedded analytics. Distinct from observability (OBS) and process mining (PROC-MIN).
domains.catalog_tagline: Turn governed data into reports and dashboards your whole organization can explore, then deliver the answers to the people who need them on a schedule.
domains.catalog_description:
Business intelligence and analytics gives teams a self-service way to ask questions of their data without waiting on engineering. Analysts build saved queries against a governed semantic layer, assemble the results into reports and interactive dashboards, and publish them for the wider business to explore on their own.

Shared metric definitions keep everyone working from the same numbers, so a figure on a sales dashboard means the same thing as the one in a finance report. Content moves through a clear lifecycle, from draft to published to certified, and access controls decide who can view, edit, or share each artifact, including when something is shared outside the company.

Once content is live, subscriptions push reports and dashboard snapshots to inboxes on a recurring cadence, and failures or runaway queries raise signals that operations and cost teams can act on. The result is a single place to author, govern, and distribute analytics, turning raw data into decisions that the business can trust.
domains.business_logic: OLAP/analytics engine, semantic layer, and query optimizer — irreducible. The report-authoring UI is declarative on top.

domains.description: Modeling, governance, and publication of an organization's business processes and capabilities. Includes BPMN process authoring, business capability maps, value stream modeling, reference-framework consumption (APQC PCF, TOGAF, ArchiMate, eTOM, SCOR), process simulation, and stakeholder publication portals. Distinct from Process Mining (PROC-MIN, event-log analytics) and from Application Portfolio Management (APM, application-landscape rationalization), though all three increasingly converge.
domains.catalog_tagline: Design, document, and publish how your business actually runs.
domains.catalog_description: Map your end-to-end processes, capabilities, and value streams in one connected workspace. Author process models, keep a single source of truth for how work flows, and publish approved versions your teams can trust. Simulate changes before you commit to them and hand insights off to the teams that execute, improve, and govern the work.
domains.business_logic: Process simulation (Monte Carlo / discrete-event), BPMN execution semantics validation, framework-to-instance mapping (APQC PCF imports), and repository version-graph diff/merge.

domains.description: Light-tier facilities management; mid-market and SMB focus. Desk booking, simple space allocation, maintenance ticketing, visitor management. Typically lighter on utility tracking and lease accounting than IWMS.
domains.catalog_tagline: Run a smaller building without the enterprise overhead: book desks, reserve rooms, log fix-it tickets, and sign in visitors from one place.
domains.catalog_description: Give a lean facilities team the everyday tools to keep a workplace running without standing up a heavy enterprise platform. Employees book a desk or reserve a meeting room from a simple floor map, so people know where to sit and rooms stop double-booking. When something breaks, anyone can raise a maintenance ticket and watch it move from reported to scheduled to fixed, with the work tracked against the right space. Front-desk staff register visitors, print badges, and keep a clean record of who was on site and when. Space allocation stays light: see how desks and rooms are assigned, spot the floors that are crowded or empty, and right-size the layout from occupancy trends rather than guesswork. This is the mid-market and small-business tier of workplace management, focused on reservations and basic service workflow, and intentionally lighter on utility metering and lease accounting than a full enterprise workplace suite. It is built to get a single site or a small portfolio organized fast, then grow into deeper space and real-estate tooling if the need arrives.
domains.business_logic: Reservation engines and basic workflow.

domains.domain_name: Cap Table Management and Equity Administration
domains.description: Shareholder ledger, option-pool management, 409A valuations, RSU/option grant workflows, exit waterfall modeling, and ASC 718 stock-based compensation accounting. Primary buyer is the portfolio-company CFO, not the VC firm.
domains.catalog_tagline: Run your company's shareholder ledger, equity grants, and 409A valuations from one source of truth.
domains.catalog_description: Keep a single, accurate record of who owns what across founders, investors, and employees. Issue and approve stock and option grants, manage your option pool, and track vesting through to exercise. Order 409A valuations, account for stock-based compensation under ASC 718, model exit waterfalls to see what each shareholder receives, and process secondary transfers. Give employees a self-service portal to view and accept their equity, all kept consistent as your company raises rounds and grows.
domains.business_logic: 409A valuation calculation per methodology (income, market, asset, OPM backsolve); ASC 718 stock-based compensation expense recognition with Black-Scholes/lattice models; exit waterfall scenario modeling with multiple preferred-class participation rights; vesting acceleration logic (single-trigger, double-trigger); dilution modeling for new financing rounds.

domains.description: Cloud telephony, omnichannel routing, IVR, workforce engagement management, and AI agent assist for contact centers. Distinct from CSM (case-management business app).
domains.catalog_tagline: Run your contact center in the cloud: route every call, chat, and message to the right agent, capture and score interactions, and keep teams staffed and on target.
domains.catalog_description:
Bring every customer conversation onto one cloud platform. Calls, chats, emails, SMS, and social messages land in unified queues and route to the agent best suited to handle them, with self-service menus and AI assistance deflecting and speeding up the simple requests. Agents see the customer's history across channels as soon as the interaction connects, and wrap up each contact with a clear outcome code that feeds reporting and follow-up.

Behind the scenes you get the tooling to run the operation: live queue dashboards and service-level alerts, agent presence and availability tracking, and full interaction recording for quality and compliance. Supervisors review and score recorded interactions, coach agents on what to improve, and watch real-time metrics so they can shift staffing before service levels slip.
domains.business_logic: ACD/routing engine, IVR runtime, real-time analytics, and workforce engagement (recording, QM, WFM) — the platform IS the engine.

domains.description: Real-time identity resolution and unified customer profiles across marketing, service, and commerce data. Activates segments to downstream channels.
domains.catalog_tagline: Unify every customer signal into one resolved profile, then turn it into action.
domains.catalog_description: Bring behavioral, transactional, and identity data together into a single resolved customer profile. Build audiences from any attribute or event, score customers for value and risk, and activate those audiences to your marketing, ads, and sales tools, with consent respected at every step.
domains.business_logic: Identity resolution (probabilistic + deterministic stitching), segmentation evaluation, and activation throughput — the engine is the differentiator.

domains.description: Medical-device inventory, preventive maintenance, recalls, and clinical engineering workflows.
domains.catalog_tagline: Keep every medical device safe, maintained, and ready for patient care.
domains.catalog_description: Run one trustworthy register of the medical equipment in clinical use, from infusion pumps and ventilators to monitors and imaging systems. Schedule and prove preventive maintenance, manage calibration, and validate sterilization so equipment stays accurate and safe at the bedside. When a recall or adverse event hits, isolate affected units fast, drive the response to closure, and produce the evidence accreditors and regulators expect. Clinical engineering teams cut downtime, stay inspection-ready, and protect patients without drowning in paperwork.
domains.business_logic: Preventive-maintenance schedules and recall propagation for medical devices — mostly declarative rules over inventory.

domains.description: Authoring, negotiation, execution, and post-signature management of contracts.
domains.catalog_tagline: Draft, negotiate, sign, and track every contract from first draft through renewal in one place.
domains.catalog_description:
Manage the entire life of a contract without losing the thread. Author new agreements from a library of pre-approved clauses and templates, route them through legal and business review, and capture redlines as counterparties negotiate. When terms are settled, send for electronic signature and store the executed document in a searchable repository.

After signing, the work continues: track the obligations each contract creates, get ahead of due dates and renewals, and know the moment a commitment is satisfied, breached, or waived. Every contract stays current, every deadline stays visible, and the organization always knows what it has agreed to.
domains.business_logic: Clause-comparison and risk-detection ML during negotiation; the rest is repository, redlining workflow, and approvals.

domains.description: Authoritative record of configuration items and their relationships, underpinning ITSM and ITOM.
domains.catalog_tagline: Keep one trusted record of every server, application, database, and the connections between them, so changes and incidents can be reasoned about in minutes.
domains.catalog_description:
Build a single, authoritative picture of your IT estate. Bring infrastructure, applications, and the dependencies that tie them together into one place, organize it with a class model you control, and keep it current as the environment changes. When something breaks or a change is proposed, you can see exactly what it touches and what depends on it before you act.

The same trusted graph powers the work around it: map components up into the business services they support, capture point-in-time baselines to catch unauthorized drift, and give every record an owner who keeps it accurate. The result is faster, safer change, quicker incident diagnosis, and an estate you can stand behind at audit time.

domains.description: Inventory, ownership, lifecycle policy, permissions audit, external-sharing controls, sprawl detection, and stale-content remediation across enterprise collaboration suites (document libraries, chat workspaces, file-sync drives, group containers). Buyer is the collaboration-platform administrator (IT operations). Distinct from ECM (the underlying repository market) and from DSPM (data security posture).
domains.catalog_tagline: Inventory every workspace, enforce sharing policies, and clean up sprawl across your collaboration tenant.
domains.catalog_description: Discover every team site, channel, file-sync drive, and group container in your collaboration tenant. Run permission audits and external-share reviews on a schedule, archive workspaces that have gone stale, and automate provisioning so new workspaces ship with the right ownership and retention policy from day one. Catch oversharing before it becomes a data incident, surface broken or duplicated permission inheritance, and give business owners a path to attest to access without an IT ticket.
domains.business_logic: Collaboration-graph inventory crawling, ownership inference, sprawl detection, and external-sharing risk scoring over collaboration metadata.

domains.description: Compensation planning cycles, pay-equity analysis, bonus and incentive plans, market benchmarking, and equity administration.
domains.catalog_tagline: Run pay cycles, benchmark to the market, and reward your people with confidence.
domains.catalog_description: Plan and run compensation cycles end to end: set pay ranges from market data, propose merit increases and bonuses, grant equity, and give every employee a clear total-rewards statement. Calibrate awards against budget and pay-equity targets so spend stays fair and on plan, then route every change for the right approvals. Give your compensation team one place to design pay, defend it with data, and deliver it accurately.
domains.business_logic: Incentive calculation engine — quotas, accelerators, splits, draws — typically a dedicated calc layer with regulatory implications.

domains.description: Virtual agents, chatbots, and voice bots for customer and employee self-service.
domains.catalog_tagline: Deploy virtual agents that resolve customer and employee questions across chat and voice, around the clock.
domains.catalog_description: Conversational AI lets you stand up self-service assistants that understand what a person is asking and carry the conversation through to a resolution. Teams author bots, intents, and dialog flows once, train them on real utterances, and publish them to every channel a customer or employee uses, from web chat and messaging apps to voice. At runtime each conversation is captured turn by turn, intents are detected and scored, and unresolved or sensitive requests are handed off to a live agent with full context. The result is faster answers, lower contact volume in the service center, and a transcript trail that feeds analytics, compliance, and continuous improvement. Buy this when you want to deflect routine inquiries, give support and operations teams a way to build and govern automated conversations without deep engineering, and keep human agents focused on the cases that genuinely need them.
domains.business_logic: NLU/LLM stack, dialog management, intent/entity extraction, and tool-use orchestration — the model is the product.

domains.description: Product configuration, guided selling, pricing, discount approvals, and quote generation.
domains.catalog_tagline: Build accurate, on-brand quotes fast: configure the product, apply the right price, and route discounts for approval without leaving the deal.
domains.catalog_description: Configure-price-quote turns a complex product line and pricing playbook into a guided selling motion your reps can run in minutes. Sellers assemble valid configurations, pull the correct price and bundle, and apply discounts that route through the right approvers automatically, so deals move faster and margins stay protected. When a quote is accepted it hands a clean, approved draft straight to contracting, billing, and the rest of revenue, with no rekeying and no surprises. The result is shorter quote cycles, fewer pricing errors, and proposals that look professional every time.
domains.business_logic: Product-configuration constraint solver, pricing engine (rule-based + algorithmic discounting), and proposal generation — irreducible algorithmic core.

domains.description: Sales force automation, opportunity and pipeline management, account/contact management, and B2B/B2C customer lifecycle. Distinct from CSM (post-sale service) and MA (marketing).
domains.catalog_tagline: Turn every prospect into a tracked relationship: capture leads, work deals through the pipeline, and keep one trusted record of every account.
domains.catalog_description:
Customer Relationship Management gives your sales team one place to find every customer, contact, lead, and deal, and to move each one forward with confidence. Capture leads from any source, score and qualify them, then convert the best into contacts, accounts, and live opportunities without losing a thread.

Run the deal from first touch to close on a pipeline you control: define your stages and exit criteria, see amount, probability, and close date at a glance, and log every call, email, and meeting against the right account so nothing falls through. Built-in assistance drafts follow-ups, summarizes account history, and surfaces the next best action so reps spend more time selling and less time on data entry.

When a deal closes, the customer record is ready to hand off to the teams who fulfill, bill, and support it, so the relationship keeps moving long after the sale.
domains.business_logic: Forecasting, opportunity scoring, and lead-scoring ML models — invoked from an otherwise CRUD-and-workflow surface.

domains.description: Case management, omnichannel engagement, and self-service for external customer support.
domains.catalog_tagline: Capture every customer issue, triage it across channels, and resolve it fast against the support level the customer is owed.
domains.catalog_description:
Customer Service Management turns inbound questions, complaints, and incidents into tracked cases your team can route, prioritize, and close. Capture cases from email, chat, phone, and social in one queue, then let triage and AI-assisted classification put each one in front of the right agent with the right context.

Resolve faster with a knowledge surface that suggests answers as agents work and lets them publish proven fixes back for self-service. Bind every case to the entitlements and service levels the customer has paid for, so response and resolution clocks reflect real contractual commitments and breaches are visible before they happen.

Close the loop with satisfaction capture on every interaction, feeding retention and health signals back to the teams that own the relationship.
domains.business_logic: Skills-based routing and next-best-action recommendations are the only non-CRUD layer; both are increasingly handled by ML models invoked from declarative rules.

domains.description: Contingent-workforce sourcing, staffing-supplier management, rate cards, contingent timesheets, and worker-classification compliance. Used by procurement and HR jointly.
domains.catalog_tagline: Source contingent workers through approved staffing suppliers, manage rate cards, and reconcile timesheets and invoices end-to-end.
domains.catalog_description: Manage the full contingent-workforce cycle, requisitions, supplier distribution, candidate submissions, worker assignments, timesheets, and invoices, in one system. Approve rate cards by role and region; classify each worker against IR35, California AB5, and EU Platform Work rules; and feed approved timesheets to payroll and project accounting automatically. Procurement and HR run it jointly: procurement governs the supplier panel, HR governs the worker classification.
domains.business_logic: Rate-card refresh recomputes accrued cost across all active timesheets when a rate row supersedes; worker-classification engine applies IR35 / California AB5 / EU PWD precedence rules per engagement, producing a typed classification record that downstream payroll and AP-AUTO rely on for withholding rules.

domains.description: Herd-level dairy operations: individual-cow lifecycle (calving, lactation cycles, dry-off, culling), parlor management, milk-quality testing, somatic-cell-count tracking, breeding and reproduction records, feed rationing, and FDA Grade A milk regulation compliance. Buyer is the dairy farm operator (large grazing or confined operations) or dairy cooperative member. Workflows are fundamentally different from beef / swine.
domains.catalog_tagline: Run the dairy by the cow and by the tank: track every animal through her lactation, capture every milking, and keep milk quality and feed cost under control from one record.
domains.catalog_description:
Manage the herd one cow at a time. Follow each animal through her whole working life, from heifer to first calving, through each lactation cycle, into dry-off, and on to a culling decision when the time comes. Breeding events, pregnancy results, and health treatments all hang off the individual cow record, so the next action and the withdrawal status are never a guess.

Capture what the parlor and the tank produce. Pull per-session milking yields straight from the parlor or robot, roll them into each lactation, and turn finished milk into bulk shipments ready for pickup. Test the milk that leaves the farm for somatic cell count, bacteria, butterfat, protein, and antibiotic residue, and hold a shipment when a result or an active treatment says it should not ship.

Keep the economics honest. Formulate total-mixed rations by group, log what actually goes in the mixer, and tie feed cost back to milk income so income-over-feed-cost is something you can see, not estimate. Quality results, treatment withdrawals, and shipment records line up to support FDA Grade A and animal-care obligations without a separate paper trail.
domains.business_logic: Lactation-cycle stage tracking and dry-off scheduling, somatic-cell-count threshold escalation, reproduction window / heat-detection algorithms, parlor / AMS (automatic milking system) telemetry ingest, milk-meter reconciliation, ration formulation, cull-decision scoring, FDA Grade A milk record audit trail.

domains.description: Centralized storage, taxonomy, rights management, and distribution of brand and creative assets (images, video, design files).
domains.catalog_tagline: Give every team one trusted home for approved photos, video, and brand files, so the right asset is always easy to find, share, and use on brand.
domains.catalog_description:
Digital asset management gives marketing, brand, and creative teams a single, organized library for the photos, videos, logos, and design files the business produces and depends on. Instead of hunting through scattered drives, inboxes, and folders, people upload assets once, tag them, and find them again in seconds through search, categories, and curated collections.

Built into that library is the control the brand needs: assets move through review and approval before they go live, usage rights and model releases are tracked against each file, and version history keeps the latest approved cut front and center. When an asset is ready, teams generate the right size and format for each channel and share it through expiring, watermarked links or push it straight to the websites, stores, and partners that need it.

The payoff is speed and consistency at once: creative work gets reused instead of recreated, every channel ships the approved version, and brand and legal stay confident that what goes out into the world is current, licensed, and on brand.
domains.business_logic: Image and video transforms (resize, format conversion, watermark), irreducible but commodified by cloud media services.

domains.description: Unified lakehouse-class platform combining storage, pipelines, governance, semantic modeling, analytics, and ML/AI lifecycle under one runtime. Distinct from point-solution data integration (DI), data catalog/governance (DCG), MDM, BI, and data quality (DQ), those domains are features of a Data and AI Platform, not standalone replacements for it.
domains.business_logic: ELT/streaming pipeline execution (Spark, Flink, Beam); ML training and inference runtimes; vector indexing and similarity search; semantic ontology resolution mapping physical data to business concepts; declarative semantic layers (dbt-style); feature engineering and feature store; LLM orchestration with RAG and tool-use; fine-grained policy evaluation for row/column-level access; code-first transforms in SQL/Python/Scala; operational apps backed by the ontology layer (Foundry-style).

domains.description: Metadata management, data discovery, lineage, business glossary, and stewardship workflows for the enterprise data estate.
domains.catalog_tagline: Find, trust, and govern every data asset across the enterprise from one place.
domains.catalog_description: Crawl and catalog your data sources, trace lineage end to end, run a shared business glossary, classify and certify assets, route data-access requests through policy, and publish governed data products. This is the metadata-and-governance layer that sits over the data estate so people can discover the right data and use it within the rules, without filing a ticket for every question or losing track of what is sensitive.
domains.business_logic: Lineage extraction, automated tagging, and profiling, the metadata harvesting layer beneath the catalog UI.

domains.description: Asset, capacity, power, cooling, and floor-plan management for physical data centers and edge sites.
domains.catalog_tagline: See, power, cool, and plan every rack in your data centers from one live model, so you never run out of space, power, or cooling by surprise.
domains.catalog_description:
Data center infrastructure management gives facilities and IT infrastructure teams a single, authoritative model of the physical estate: every site, rack, and cabinet, the power chain that feeds them, the cooling that keeps them within range, and the cables and ports that connect them. Instead of spreadsheets and tribal knowledge, you get a live register of what is installed, where it sits, and how much headroom is left.

Operators track power from the incoming circuit through distribution units and uninterruptible supplies down to the outlet, monitor temperature and humidity from cabinet-level sensors, and map physical connectivity port by port and cable by cable. When a circuit overloads, a cooling unit fails, or an environmental threshold is breached, the event is captured and routed to the teams and systems that need to act.

On top of the asset and telemetry layer sits capacity planning: forward-looking projections of power, cooling, space, and bandwidth per site and zone. Planners use that headroom view to schedule growth, justify build-outs, and negotiate colocation with confidence, while changes to the physical layer flow out to the configuration database and downstream operations so the rest of IT stays in step.
domains.business_logic: Power, cooling, and capacity calculations across racks and rooms; physical-asset register and workflow form the larger surface.

domains.description: Endpoint and synthetic monitoring of the employee or customer digital experience: device health, application responsiveness, and SaaS reachability.
domains.catalog_tagline: See the digital experience your people and customers actually get, before they file a ticket.
domains.catalog_description: Digital Experience Monitoring tells you whether the apps, devices, and SaaS your workforce and customers rely on are fast, available, and frustration-free. It runs synthetic checks from the locations that matter, captures real session telemetry, scores endpoint and application responsiveness, and flags friction and anomalies the moment they degrade the experience. Use it to catch slowdowns proactively, route the right signal to incident and operations teams, and prove that reachability and responsiveness meet the bar your business expects.
domains.business_logic: Endpoint-agent runtime, synthetic transaction generation, and correlation across user / device / app / network signals: code-dominant data plane.

domains.description: Bulk and streaming data movement, ELT/ETL, and replication for analytical workloads and data warehouses/lakehouses. Distinct from iPaaS (transactional app integration).
domains.catalog_tagline: Move data from every source system into your warehouse and lakehouse, on schedule and ready to analyze.
domains.catalog_description: Your analytics are only as fresh as the pipelines feeding them. This is where you connect to the source systems your business runs on, pull their data in batch or as a continuous change stream, reshape it into the models your analysts query, and land it in the warehouse or lakehouse where it gets used. You configure a source once, pick what to sync and how often, and the platform keeps the destination current, retrying on failure, tracking each run, and adapting when an upstream schema changes so a new column does not silently break a downstream report. The payoff is trustworthy, timely data without a standing team of engineers hand-coding extracts. Pipelines run unattended, failures surface as alerts you can act on, and the lineage of every load is recorded so you can prove where a number came from and how stale it is.
domains.business_logic: Streaming and ELT runtimes, change-data-capture engines, and schema-evolution handling — the platform IS the kernel.

domains.description: Automated identification of IT infrastructure and the mapping of components into business services.
domains.catalog_tagline: See every device, cloud resource, and service before you can manage it.
domains.catalog_description: Discovery scans your networks, cloud accounts, and directories to find the IT you actually run, then fingerprints each asset and maps how components connect into the business services they support. It turns blind spots into a normalized, reconciled inventory that feeds your CMDB, asset management, and operations tools, so teams stop guessing what exists and start acting on a trusted source of truth.
domains.business_logic: Scanning, fingerprinting, and credentialed inspection across networks, cloud APIs, and agents (code-dominant collection plane).

domains.description: Detects and blocks unauthorized disclosure of sensitive data (PII, PCI, IP, source code) from leaving the organization perimeter via email, USB, cloud uploads, chat, web, and removable media. Classifies content at rest and in motion; applies policies (block, quarantine, mask, watermark, alert). Complementary to DSPM (which discovers data at rest); DLP enforces at the egress point.
domains.catalog_tagline: Stop sensitive data from leaving your organization, and respond fast when it tries to.
domains.catalog_description:
Catch confidential and regulated data before it walks out the door across email, web, endpoints, cloud apps, and chat. Define the rules that say what counts as sensitive, watch every egress path in real time, and block, quarantine, or coach users the moment a violation happens.

When something slips through, work the incident from detection to closure in one place: triage what happened, hold the artifact for review, grant time-boxed exceptions where the business genuinely needs them, and keep an auditable trail for regulators. Turn a flood of alerts into a managed queue your security team can actually clear.
domains.business_logic: Content-scanning engine orchestration (regex / dictionary / statistical / ML pattern detection in files, streams, USB device traffic); policy evaluation on mixed criteria (user role, destination, device, network context); incident creation and remediation workflows; SIEM/SOAR integration for alerting.

domains.description: Profiling, cleansing, standardization, matching, and ongoing monitoring of data fitness for purpose.
domains.catalog_tagline: Find and fix the data quality problems that break decisions, before they reach a dashboard, a model, or a customer.
domains.catalog_description:
Make your data trustworthy and keep it that way. Profile your tables to learn what is actually in them, write the rules that define acceptable state, and run those rules on every load so cardinality bounds, format patterns, referential integrity, and statistical thresholds are checked the moment data lands. When a rule breaks, raise an incident, route it to the owner, track root cause and remediation, and close the loop, so a bad batch becomes a worklist item instead of a silent corruption that surfaces three reports later.

Monitor fitness continuously across the dimensions that matter: completeness, uniqueness, validity, timeliness, consistency, and accuracy. Roll the dimension scores up into scorecards that show direction and trend, set quality SLAs with hard thresholds, and get alerted the instant a metric breaches or recovers. Catch the silent failures that fixed rules miss by flagging anomalies in volume, freshness, and distribution before downstream consumers notice.

Give every team a shared, defensible answer to a simple question: can I trust this data? Feed quality signals to the catalog so assets carry a health flag, open tickets in the service desk when an SLA is breached, and hand clean, profiled, monitored data to the analytics and AI platforms that depend on it.
domains.business_logic: Profiling, matching, anomaly detection, and data observability, the algorithmic plane the workflow sits on top of.

domains.description: Discovers sensitive data across cloud data stores (object storage, data warehouses, managed databases, SaaS apps), maps data lineage and access paths, identifies over-privilege and toxic combinations (PII + over-permissive policy), scores risk posture, prioritizes remediation. Discovers and secures at rest; DLP enforces at egress.
domains.business_logic: Data classification ML (sensitivity scoring, PII/PHI detection); multi-cloud connector orchestration and SaaS API pagination at scale; risk-scoring rules combining sensitivity + access breadth + public-internet exposure; templated and custom remediation workflows requiring authorization checks.

domains.description: Web content management, personalization, customer portals, and headless content delivery for branded digital experiences.
domains.catalog_tagline: Build, personalize, and orchestrate every page, audience journey, and experiment across your digital properties.
domains.catalog_description:
Run your websites, microsites, and customer portals from one place. Author pages and reusable content, then publish them across multiple sites and brands with a clear review and approval flow.

Tailor what each visitor sees with rule-based personalization, segments, and A/B testing, so the right message reaches the right audience. Guide people through multi-step journeys and self-service portals, and keep everything in sync with your marketing, commerce, and customer data systems.
domains.business_logic: Personalization and recommendation engines, A/B testing infrastructure, and search ranking; the content-management side is CRUD.

domains.description: Maintenance, work order, and lifecycle management for physical plant, equipment, and infrastructure.
domains.catalog_tagline: Keep plant and equipment running. Plan preventive maintenance, dispatch work orders, and track every asset from commissioning to retirement.
domains.catalog_description:
Enterprise Asset Management gives maintenance and reliability teams one place to run the physical side of the business: the machines, lines, and infrastructure that production depends on. Build an asset register that captures each piece of equipment, its hierarchy of components, and its full history from commissioning through retirement, then drive upkeep from preventive-maintenance schedules tied to runtime hours, meter readings, and condition data so failures are caught before they stop the line.

Work flows through a single work-order lifecycle. Requests become planned jobs, jobs get scheduled and assigned to crews, technicians execute and close them out in the field, and every labor hour, part, and inspection result lands back on the asset record. Safety and compliance steps such as lockout/tagout and calibration are built into the same flow, so the audit trail is a byproduct of getting the work done rather than a separate chore.

EAM sits at the center of operations. It receives capital projects as new assets to maintain, reacts to production downtime and schedule changes with the right maintenance windows, and feeds completed work, asset costs, and retirement events back to finance, manufacturing, and compliance. The result is higher uptime, longer asset life, lower maintenance spend, and a defensible record of how every asset has been cared for.
domains.business_logic: Preventive-maintenance scheduling rules driven by meter readings, runtime hours, or condition data. Mostly declarative but benefits from a calculation engine for asset risk and maintenance intervals.

domains.description: Software market for scaling agile delivery across many teams, programs, and portfolios: program-increment and release-train coordination, epic-to-feature backlog hierarchy, cross-team dependency management, agile roadmaps, OKR-to-delivery alignment, and flow analytics. Bought by the engineering and agile-transformation office (release-train engineers, VP Engineering, the agile PMO). Distinct from SPM (top-down CIO/EPMO investment planning), from generic work management (not framework-aware), and from the value-stream delivery toolchain (which builds and ships code rather than planning it).
domains.catalog_tagline: Plan and coordinate agile delivery across every team, program, and portfolio in one place.
domains.catalog_description: Bring scaled-agile delivery under one roof. Model the full delivery hierarchy from portfolio epics down to features, stories, sprints, and release trains, and plan each program increment with your teams. Map and resolve cross-team dependencies before they block delivery, keep agile roadmaps and release plans current, and connect OKRs to the work that achieves them. Live flow and velocity analytics show where delivery is on track and where it is stuck, so release-train engineers and delivery leaders can steer in real time. Built for organizations running multiple teams or trains that need coordinated, framework-aware planning rather than a generic task board.
domains.business_logic: Beyond declarable CRUD: cross-team dependency-health computation, velocity and flow rollups across the release-train and program-increment hierarchy, what-if PI planning, and OKR-to-delivery alignment scoring.

domains.description: Document repositories, records management, workflow, and information governance for internal unstructured content. Distinct from DXP (external/customer-facing).
domains.catalog_tagline: Store, classify, and retain every document with built-in workflow and audit-ready compliance.
domains.catalog_description: Enterprise Content Management gives you one trusted home for every document. Capture content from any source, version it safely with check-in and check-out, and route it through review and approval before it goes live. Apply retention schedules, legal holds, and full audit trails so the right records are kept, the rest are disposed of on time, and you can prove both whenever you are asked. Find what you need in seconds and control who can see it, all the way from first draft to final disposition.
domains.business_logic: Full-text search and OCR; the rest is repositories, taxonomies, retention rules, and approval workflows.

domains.description: Operational system-of-record for workplace safety (incidents, hazards, risk assessments, corrective actions), occupational health and industrial hygiene, audits and inspections, and environmental compliance (permits, emissions, chemical and safety data sheets). Satisfies OSHA, EU-OSHA, ISO 45001 and ISO 14001 obligations at the establishment level. Operationally upstream of corporate sustainability disclosure (supplies incident and environmental data) and a peer to food-safety management (same safety-management-system archetype, occupational and environmental rather than food-specific).
domains.catalog_tagline: Keep your people safe and your sites compliant: log incidents, control hazards, run inspections, and stay ahead of OSHA and environmental rules.
domains.catalog_description: Capture every injury, near-miss, and hazard the moment it happens, then drive each one to a closed corrective action. Run job hazard analyses and risk assessments, schedule and complete inspections and audits, and track the training and contractor qualifications that keep your sites compliant. Manage chemicals and safety data sheets, monitor industrial-hygiene exposures and occupational-health records, and keep environmental permits, emissions, and OSHA logs audit-ready. One place to prove your safety and environmental programs are working, from the shop floor to the regulator.
domains.business_logic: Incident-investigation workflows, OSHA recordability determination, serious-injury-and-fatality and leading-indicator analytics, exposure-limit and sampling calculations against occupational exposure limits, corrective-action escalation, and permit-condition and emission-limit monitoring go beyond the JsonLogic-declarable slice.

domains.description: Bundled fund formation, administration, light cap-table, and LP portal as a single architectural product targeting solo GPs and 1-5 partner microfunds. Architecturally bundle-only (components not separately purchasable). Competes against the assembled point-solution stack at order-of-magnitude lower price. Recognized as a distinct market via the 5-criterion bundle-as-market test (see SKILL.md rule #2 amendment 2026-05-23).
domains.catalog_tagline: Stand up a fund or a single-deal vehicle in days, then run capital calls, investor onboarding, and your LP portal from one place built for solo and small-team managers.
domains.catalog_description:
Launch a fund or special purpose vehicle without stitching together a stack of separate tools. Form the legal entity, file what the regulators expect, open the bank account, and put your subscription documents in front of investors, all from a single workspace shaped for a manager running lean.

Once the vehicle is live, run the day-to-day. Issue capital calls and track who has funded, onboard limited partners with the verification checks built in, and keep a simple cap table of who owns what across the vehicle. For deal-by-deal raises, spin up a vehicle per opportunity, collect investor commitments, and close.

Give your investors a clean experience. They see their commitments, capital-call notices, and documents in one portal instead of a thread of emails. The result is a fund or syndicate that runs end to end, from formation through ongoing operations, at a fraction of the cost and effort of assembling the pieces yourself.
domains.business_logic: Simplified fund-formation workflow (entity setup + EIN + banking onboarding); single-fund, single-class waterfall (no European-tier catchup complexity); KYC orchestration for small LP bases; SPV scaffolding with templated docs. Deliberately less complex than FUND-ADMIN, which is the value engineering.

domains.description: Software market for curating brand content and broadcasting it to employees, who reshare it to their own personal social networks to extend organic reach, strengthen employer brand, and drive social selling. Tracks each employee share, gamifies participation with points and leaderboards, scores advocate influence, generates internal newsletters of shareable content, and attributes resulting clicks, reach, and pipeline back to revenue. Distinct from Social Media Management (brand-owned channels and external influencer programs), Employee Communications and Intranet (internal-only news and announcements), Frontline / Deskless Worker Communication (internal deskless comms), and Employee Experience and Engagement (engagement and pulse surveys). The advocate is an employee resharing externally, not a brand channel and not an internal audience.
domains.catalog_tagline: Turn your employees into your most trusted social channel: curate content, make sharing one click, and measure the reach and pipeline it drives.
domains.catalog_description: Give your team a steady stream of approved, on-brand content and let them share it to their own LinkedIn, X, and Facebook networks in a single click, with ready-to-post copy they can personalize. Reward participation with points, badges, and leaderboards, surface your top advocates, and send each person a tailored newsletter of what is worth sharing this week. See exactly what every share earned in clicks, reach, and earned media value, and connect that activity to the pipeline and revenue it influenced. Built for marketing and communications teams who want authentic employee reach without chasing people for screenshots.
domains.business_logic: Advocate influence scoring and reach / earned-media-value computation over per-share engagement; share-to-pipeline attribution modeling; gamification point and leaderboard ranking engines; AI content recommendation and personalized share-copy generation for each advocate.

domains.description: Engagement and pulse surveys, 360 feedback, lifecycle (onboarding, exit) listening, and action planning. Distinct from HRSD case management.
domains.catalog_tagline: Listen to your workforce continuously and turn what you hear into action that managers actually take.
domains.catalog_description: Run engagement, pulse, lifecycle, and 360 feedback programs from one place. Build your question library, schedule listening cadences, and collect responses under anonymity protections your people trust. Scores roll up into the drivers that explain how teams feel, so leaders see what is working and where to focus. Hand each result to the manager who owns it as a concrete action plan, then track follow-through to closure. The full listen-and-act loop sits in a single workflow: ask, understand, act, and measure whether the action moved the needle.

domains.description: FP&A: budgeting, rolling forecasts, driver-based modeling, scenario planning, workforce planning, and management reporting. Sits above the GL.
domains.business_logic: Planning, modeling, and consolidation engines (multi-dimensional cubes, allocation, currency translation, eliminations); the calc kernel is the product.

domains.description: Environmental, social, and governance data collection, disclosure, and reporting.
domains.catalog_tagline: Measure your footprint, hit your targets, and report with confidence.
domains.catalog_description: Turn raw operational data into a defensible sustainability record. Pull in activity data and utility readings, apply the right emission factors, and calculate Scope 1, 2, and 3 emissions down to the facility. Set reduction and net-zero targets, track them against live metrics, and run the initiatives that close the gap. When reporting season arrives, prepare disclosures to each framework you answer to, from CSRD and ISSB to GHG Protocol, keep the audit trail your assurance provider needs, and score the suppliers that drive your value-chain footprint. One place to manage the numbers, the commitments, and the evidence behind every claim you publish.
domains.business_logic: Emissions calculation engine (Scope 1/2/3, conversion factors, allocation rules), regulated and irreducible; the data-collection side is workflow.

domains.description: Legally-binding electronic signature capture, identity verification, and audit trails for digital agreements.
domains.catalog_tagline: Send agreements out for legally binding electronic signature, verify who is signing, and capture a tamper-evident audit trail for every transaction.
domains.catalog_description:
Electronic signature software lets your teams prepare a document, route it to the right people in the right order, and collect legally binding signatures without printing, mailing, or chasing paper. A single signing package moves through a clear lifecycle, from draft to sent to completed, so everyone can see exactly where an agreement stands and what is still outstanding.

Before a signature is accepted, signer identity can be verified through methods such as email authentication, one-time passcodes, knowledge-based questions, or government ID checks, which raises the legal weight of the result. Once all parties have signed, the platform seals the document and produces a certificate of completion that records who signed, when, and from where, giving you defensible evidence if an agreement is ever questioned.

Because signing is a step inside larger business processes, completed agreements flow straight into the systems that need them, such as contract repositories, HR records, and sales operations, while the signing platform remains the system of record for the signature event itself. The result is faster turnaround, fewer errors, and compliance with electronic signature frameworks such as the ESIGN Act, UETA, and eIDAS.
domains.business_logic: PKI and crypto kernel for signature creation, timestamping, and validation, small in surface area but irreducible and regulated.

domains.description: Receipt capture, expense entry, policy enforcement, corporate card reconciliation, travel-booking integration, and reimbursement.
domains.catalog_tagline: Turn employee spending into clean, policy-checked, reimbursable records from receipt to repayment.
domains.catalog_description: Manage the full life of a business expense, from the moment money is spent to the moment it is reimbursed. Capture receipts and card charges, itemize them into reports, and check every line against your spending policy before it reaches an approver. Route reports for review, reconcile corporate card activity, and handle travel and per diem alongside everyday expenses. When a report is approved, the right amounts flow on for posting and repayment. Give employees a fast, simple way to get paid back, and give finance a trustworthy, audit-ready picture of where the money went.
domains.business_logic: Policy engine (per-diem caps, currency, category limits) and OCR for receipt extraction — both increasingly declarative or ML-based.

domains.description: Direct-to-consumer (CSA shares, online farm stores, farmers market POS) and farm-to-wholesale (chefs / restaurants / food hubs) commerce platforms for small and mid-scale farms. Provides purpose-built CSA share customization, route optimization for DTC delivery, farmers-market POS reconciliation, and wholesale catalog / order management for the smallholder operator. Captures the small-organic / regenerative / direct-to-consumer segment of the food system.
domains.catalog_tagline: Sell every harvest direct, from CSA shares to the farmers market stall to wholesale chefs, on one farm-built platform.
domains.catalog_description: Run direct-to-consumer and farm-to-wholesale sales for a small or mid-scale farm without stitching together generic e-commerce, spreadsheets, and a card reader. Manage CSA memberships and weekly share customization, take payments at the market stall, route your own deliveries, and capture B2B orders from restaurants and food hubs, all tied back to what the field will actually yield. You see members, market days, wholesale buyers, and harvest forecasts in one place, so you can plan plantings against demand, cut packing-day chaos, and get paid across every channel you sell through.
domains.business_logic: Route optimization for DTC delivery (mapping/routing integration), CSA share customization with swap / pause rules and dietary substitutions, farmers-market POS reconciliation across multiple market days, wholesale-pricing-tier management, payment-plan / installment scheduling, harvest-projection-to-available-shares planning, food-hub multi-farm producer-payout splits.

domains.description: General ledger, accounts payable/receivable, fixed assets, period close, multi-entity and multi-currency consolidation, and revenue recognition. The accounting system of record.
domains.catalog_tagline: Run your financial accounting backbone end to end, from posting transactions to closing the books and reporting results you can stand behind.
domains.catalog_description:
Bring every financial transaction into one ledger and keep it accurate, auditable, and ready for reporting. Record journal entries, maintain your chart of accounts and cost centers, manage multiple legal entities and currencies, and run a controlled period close so the numbers are trustworthy when leadership and auditors need them.

Go beyond the general ledger to manage the accounting that surrounds it: capitalize and depreciate fixed assets, reconcile cash and bank activity, recognize revenue under current standards, and match intercompany activity across entities. Every sub-ledger posting flows into the same controlled close, giving finance a single source of truth and a faster, cleaner month end.
domains.business_logic: Consolidation, allocation, multi-GAAP translation, and period-close orchestration: the regulated calc kernel inside an otherwise transactional ledger.

domains.description: Visibility, allocation, optimization, and accountability for cloud spending across business units.
domains.catalog_tagline: See, allocate, and optimize cloud spend before it surprises you at month-end.
domains.catalog_description:
Turn an unpredictable cloud bill into a cost line every team can read and own. Pull raw spending from every cloud account into one normalized view, then attribute it by tag, account, team, product, or unit so finance, engineering, and product owners all see the same number and agree on what caused it. Catch anomalies the moment a service starts overspending instead of discovering it on the invoice, and forecast where the next billing cycle is heading.

The practice closes the loop from visibility to action. Set budgets per team or product that raise an alert before a threshold is crossed, and act on rightsizing, idle-resource cleanup, and commitment-purchase recommendations that lower the bill without slowing delivery. Unit-economics views tie spend back to the business, so cost per customer, per transaction, or per workload becomes a metric leaders can manage rather than a mystery they absorb.
domains.business_logic: Unit-cost allocation, anomaly detection, rightsizing recommendations, and commitment optimization. Algorithm-led; the rest is reporting.

domains.description: Preventive-maintenance scheduling (mileage / engine-hours / time triggers), vehicle work-order management, parts inventory and consumption, mechanic/shop assignment, warranty tracking, and DOT/DVIR inspection workflow. Distinct from EAM (vehicles are mobile assets with telematics triggers; EAM targets fixed plant) and from FSM (FSM dispatches technicians to customers; this dispatches mechanics to internal vehicles).
domains.catalog_tagline: Keep every vehicle on the road and control what each mile costs to maintain.
domains.catalog_description: Run your whole maintenance operation from one place. Schedule preventive service so it lands before a breakdown does, turn driver reports and inspection findings into tracked repairs, and dispatch the right mechanic to the right shop. Keep parts on the shelf when you need them and off the books when you don't, and recover every dollar of warranty and recall coverage you are owed. See cost per mile and uptime by vehicle so you know when to keep fixing and when to replace.
domains.business_logic: PM-schedule generation from telematics triggers (engine hours, mileage thresholds, DTC codes), parts BOM matching to vehicle make/model/year, warranty-claim eligibility computation, mechanic-skill matching to work-order type, DVIR-defect-to-work-order routing.

domains.description: Umbrella for the operational management of vehicle fleets: vehicle inventory and lifecycle, driver assignment, fuel and expense tracking, dispatch, utilization analytics, and regulatory compliance (DOT/IFTA). Cross-industry buyer (logistics, last-mile delivery, field service, public sector, construction, utilities, rentals). Two sub-domains: TELEMATICS (the GPS/ELD/dashcam data layer) and FLEET-MAINT (preventive maintenance, work orders, parts).
domains.catalog_tagline: Run your whole fleet from one place: every vehicle, every driver, and every fuel dollar, with DOT and IFTA compliance built in.
domains.catalog_description: Know what you own and how hard it works. Track each vehicle from the day you acquire it through every assignment, repair, and resale, and see at a glance which units earn their keep and which are costing you money. Put the right driver in the right vehicle, keep licenses and medical cards current, and stay on top of pre-trip and post-trip inspections so nothing rolls out unsafe. Watch fuel and charging spend in real time, catch exceptions before they add up, and turn raw mileage and fuel data into the DOT, IFTA, and IRP filings auditors ask for. Whether you run delivery vans, service trucks, or heavy rigs, you get one clear view of cost, safety, and compliance across the entire fleet.
domains.business_logic: Vehicle utilization scoring (idle vs productive time), fuel-card transaction matching against vehicle assignments, mileage-vs-IFTA-jurisdiction allocation, route-to-job assignment optimization, regulatory-compliance scoring (DOT, FMCSA, IFTA).

domains.description: Records, plans, and analyzes farm operations: field mapping, crop planning, planting/application records, harvest tracking, equipment telemetry, yield analytics, work-order assignment, and ag-input inventory. Distinct from generic ERP because operations are weather / soil / season-bound and depend on satellite-imagery, IoT-sensor, and machinery-telemetry feeds (ISOBUS, CAN-bus, John Deere Operations Center API).
domains.catalog_tagline: Run the whole farm from one record: map every field, plan each season, log every operation, and turn it into yield and profit insight.
domains.catalog_description:
