Bring spatial field maps, season crop plans, and day-to-day operations into a single source of truth so you always know what was planted, sprayed, and harvested on every acre. Capture planting passes, chemical and fertilizer applications, and harvest yields as you go, then reconcile them against input stock and machinery activity without chasing paper or spreadsheets.

Use that record to author site-specific application maps, watch input levels before you run out, and answer the questions that move margin: which fields earned their keep, where inputs were over- or under-applied, and how this season compares to the last few. The same trail gives you defensible application and harvest evidence when a buyer, auditor, or regulator asks.
domains.business_logic: Variable-rate prescription generation from soil / yield zones, NDVI / satellite-imagery analytics for crop-health scoring, machinery telemetry normalization (CAN-bus, ISOBUS, JD Operations Center API), weather-driven scheduling, agronomic recommendations (planting / spray timing windows), yield-zone clustering.

domains.description: End-to-end traceability of food products through the supply chain: lot / batch genealogy, FSMA-204 critical-tracking-event (CTE) capture and key-data-element (KDE) reporting, supplier-document management, recall execution, and provenance / origin verification. Buyer is the food manufacturer, distributor, or grower-shipper subject to FSMA 204 (Jan 2026 enforcement) and equivalents (EU 1169/2011, Canada SFCR). Regulatory tailwind is the primary demand driver. Differs from generic Supply Chain Visibility by SKU-lot-level granularity and regulator-prescribed event capture.
domains.catalog_tagline: Trace every lot from origin to shelf, prove provenance, and execute recalls in hours instead of days.
domains.catalog_description:
Capture the critical tracking events and key data elements that food safety rules require, so any lot can be traced forward to its customers and backward to its source on demand. When a problem surfaces, identify every affected lot from the genealogy graph, notify the right consignees, place stock on hold, and file the required regulatory submissions from one place.

Keep supplier certifications, origin claims, and provenance documents current and verifiable, with expiry and renewal tracking so a lapsed certificate never slips through. Respond to regulator and trading-partner trace requests within the mandated window, and turn day-to-day production records into an audit-ready traceability trail.
domains.business_logic: FSMA-204 CTE / KDE event capture and rule conformance, recall-execution workflow (notify → hold → consolidate → report → reconcile), supplier-document OCR / parsing / expiry tracking, lot-genealogy graph traversal, blockchain anchoring, audit-trail integrity.

domains.description: Mobile-first operations platform for non-desk workers who have no corporate email or workstation: broadcast messaging and acknowledgment, task and checklist execution, shift-swap conversations, microlearning, and recognition delivered through a single branded app, kiosk, or shared device. Bought by store, plant, and field operations rather than internal communications or HR. Consumes the workforce's employees from HCM and shifts from Workforce Management, and hands work back to those systems. Distinct from Employee Communications and Intranet (office-comms publishing platform, internal-comms buyer), Workforce Management (owns the shift record and swap approval), Retail Store Operations (retail-only task execution), and Employee Experience and Engagement (survey listening, not broadcast or recognition).
domains.catalog_tagline: Reach, task, and recognize your frontline workforce from one mobile app, no corporate email required.
domains.catalog_description: Connect every deskless worker on the floor through a branded mobile app, kiosk, or shared device. Broadcast targeted announcements and confirm who has read them, push tasks and checklists that workers complete and submit from their phones, and let teams swap shifts, finish bite-size training, and recognize each other in the same place. Built for store, plant, warehouse, and field staff who never had a work email, with handoff back to scheduling and store operations.
domains.business_logic: Audience targeting and supervisor-cascade routing to workers without unique work email; mandatory-read acknowledgment tracking; multilingual content delivery under union and works-council content rules; offline-tolerant task submission sync from shared and personal devices.

domains.description: Dispatch, scheduling, mobile work order, and parts management for on-site service technicians.
domains.catalog_tagline: Schedule, dispatch, and complete on-site service work while keeping equipment, contracts, and customer commitments in sync.
domains.catalog_description: Field service management runs the full loop from a service request to a closed visit. Dispatchers match the right technician, parts, and time slot to each job; technicians work the route, capture what happened on site, and close out the work order. The installed-equipment record, preventive-maintenance schedules, and service contracts stay current so the next visit starts with full context. Teams that adopt it cut travel and idle time, hit service-level commitments, and turn every completed visit into accurate billing and a cleaner equipment history.
domains.business_logic: Routing and dispatch optimization under technician skill, parts, SLA, and travel constraints, operations-research solver at the core.

domains.description: Food-safety management systems: HACCP plan development and audit, hazard analysis, CCP (critical-control-point) monitoring, food-fraud / VACCP / TACCP analysis, GFSI scheme certification audits (SQF, BRC-GS, FSSC 22000, IFS), allergen control, sanitation verification, environmental monitoring program (EMP), and recall management. Buyer is the food manufacturer subject to FSMA Preventive Controls Rule and (for export) GFSI-equivalent certification. Heavy overlap with Food Traceability on recall execution and supplier-document management; FSQM is the broader safety-system-of-record while Traceability is the lot-genealogy / CTE-capture specialist.
domains.catalog_tagline: Keep food safe from receiving to release with one connected food-safety program.
domains.catalog_description:
Run your entire food-safety and quality program in one place. Build and approve HACCP and preventive-control plans, monitor critical control points in real time, and act on deviations before product ships. Manage allergen controls, sanitation cycles, and environmental monitoring, then capture the records that prove control.

When something goes wrong, open an incident, drive corrective action, and escalate to recall in a few clicks. Walk into certification audits with evidence already organized, score and segment your suppliers by risk, and stay ahead of the obligations that regulators and retail customers expect you to meet.
domains.business_logic: HACCP plan rule conformance and CCP deviation escalation, GFSI audit-prep checklists with score forecasting, environmental-monitoring trend analytics (Listeria / Salmonella positives mapping), allergen-changeover validation, supplier-risk scoring, recall traceback.

domains.description: Fund accounting, capital calls, distribution waterfalls, LP onboarding (KYC/AML), partner capital account (PCAP) statements, and LP-facing reporting for private capital funds (VC, PE, private credit, real estate).
domains.catalog_tagline: Run private-capital funds end to end: onboard LPs, call and distribute capital, keep the partner ledger, and report to investors on one system.
domains.catalog_description:
Private-capital fund administration is the operational backbone of a GP. It takes a fund from first close through its full life: onboarding limited partners with KYC and AML checks, recording their commitments, issuing capital calls and tracking the cash that comes back, running the distribution waterfall when the fund returns money, and keeping the partner capital accounts that every investor relies on.

This domain unifies the work that is otherwise scattered across spreadsheets and disconnected tools. Fund accounting, capital activity, and LP reporting all read from the same commitment record and the same general ledger, so a capital call, the cash that funds it, and the resulting change to an LP's account stay in agreement without manual reconciliation.

The payoff is accuracy where it counts most and speed where LPs notice it. Waterfall math and partner capital account statements are produced from the underlying transactions rather than rebuilt by hand each quarter, close cycles shorten, and the audit trail behind every number is always available when investors, auditors, or regulators ask.
domains.business_logic: European/American/hybrid waterfall calculations with catchup, clawback, and hurdle rates; multi-class equity allocations; PCAP statement generation; GAAP/IFRS partnership accounting; multi-currency consolidation.

domains.description: Integrated risk management spanning policy, controls, risk assessment, and compliance evidence.
domains.catalog_tagline: Run risk, compliance, policy, and audit on one connected register so nothing falls through the cracks.
domains.catalog_description: Bring enterprise risk, controls, policies, regulatory obligations, attestations, and audit issues into a single governed workspace. Identify and score risks, map them to the controls that mitigate them, test those controls on a schedule, and capture the evidence that proves it. Publish policies, drive attestation campaigns, track obligations against frameworks like SOX, ISO 27001, SOC 2, and NIST CSF, and open remediation plans the moment a control fails. Teams get a defensible, always-current view of their compliance posture and a clean audit trail instead of scattered spreadsheets and last-minute scrambles.
domains.business_logic: Risk aggregation (Monte Carlo, qualitative-to-quantitative mapping) and control-effectiveness scoring; control libraries and assessments are CRUD.

domains.description: Cross-functional annual go-to-market planning owned by Sales Operations and RevOps: market segmentation, ICP and named-target-account-list authoring, planning-grade account scoring, territory carving and quota allocation, sales-capacity and coverage modeling, strategic channel-mix, what-if scenario modeling, and the plan-lock and downstream push to Sales, Marketing, and Finance. Authors the ICPs and target account lists that ABM-PLATFORM later engages against, and the territory and quota design that Sales Performance Management executes. Launch orchestration moved to Product Marketing Management; engagement (intent, ads, web personalization) moved to ABM-PLATFORM.
domains.catalog_tagline: Plan your year. Decide where to play, how much capacity to invest, and which segments to lead with, then push the locked plan to Sales, Marketing, and Finance.
domains.catalog_description:
Go-to-Market Planning runs the cross-functional planning that decides how you enter and grow markets. Define your ideal customer profile, carve segments, score and tier accounts, draft territories and quotas, and model capacity-to-coverage against your revenue targets.

Run what-if scenarios across geographies, channels, and segments, then layer launch orchestration on top: sequence product launches, gate on readiness, and coordinate the cross-functional motion from product marketing through Sales, Marketing, Support, and Success.

When the plan locks, push the artifacts downstream: territories to sales performance management, target accounts to CRM and marketing automation, and capacity numbers to Finance. Built for Sales Ops and RevOps teams who own the annual go-to-market motion, partnering with Marketing Ops, Product, and Finance.
domains.business_logic: Territory carving optimization, quota distribution algorithms, capacity modeling against revenue targets and seller productivity benchmarks.

domains.description: Inventory, lifecycle, and disposal management of physical IT hardware assets.
domains.catalog_tagline: Know every device you own, where it is, and what it costs.
domains.catalog_description: Build a single trustworthy register of laptops, desktops, servers, network gear, and mobile devices. Track each asset from purchase through deployment, repair, and retirement, manage warranties and spare parts, and run secure, evidenced disposal at end of life. Cut surprise spend, satisfy audits, and refresh hardware on a plan instead of in a panic.

domains.description: Patient scheduling, care coordination, and clinical workflow management for providers.
domains.catalog_tagline: Run the patient front office and clinical floor on one record: schedule visits, document encounters, place orders, coordinate care, and route referrals.
domains.catalog_description: Healthcare Patient Operations gives provider organizations a single workflow spine for the work that happens around every visit. Front-desk teams book and confirm appointments and manage no-shows; clinicians capture encounters, place lab, imaging, and medication orders, and sign clinical notes; care coordinators build and track care plans for chronic conditions and transitions of care; and referral managers route patients to specialists and chase the authorizations that keep care in-network. Because every record carries protected health information, the platform enforces HIPAA-grade access, immutable signed documentation, and a clear audit trail. Buy this to cut scheduling leakage, speed documentation, close referral loops, and give every member of the care team a shared, real-time view of what each patient needs next.
domains.business_logic: Patient scheduling optimization (provider availability, room constraints, payer rules) is the meaningful algorithmic layer.

domains.description: Core HR system of record covering worker data, organization and position management, self-service, and lifecycle workflows. The HRIS / system-of-record layer of the HR stack.
domains.catalog_tagline: Run the single source of truth for your workforce, from the employee record to org structure, positions, and the full hire-to-retire lifecycle.
domains.catalog_description:
Human Capital Management is the system of record for your people. Maintain every worker's core profile, employment contracts, and the org structure they sit in, then drive each change through a governed workflow: hiring, transfers, promotions, leaves of absence, and offboarding. Self-service lets employees and managers raise and track their own changes while HR retains approval control.

Because the worker record is authoritative, the lifecycle events you record here ripple cleanly downstream: a new hire provisions access and payroll, a termination recalls assets and closes accounts, a promotion updates compensation. You define jobs and positions once, plan headcount against them, and keep compliance evidence in step with the regulations that apply to your workforce.
domains.business_logic: Org-chart and headcount calculations, FTE roll-ups, and span-of-control analytics: calc layer over master HR data.

domains.description: API-first content platforms and headless CMS for omnichannel content delivery, decoupled from presentation.
domains.business_logic: CDN and rendering pipeline (delivery, caching, image processing) sit beneath the API — the application surface itself is content models and entries.

domains.description: Employee case management, knowledge, journeys, and document management for the HR function.
domains.catalog_tagline: Give employees one place to ask HR questions, get answers, and track every request to resolution.
domains.catalog_description:
Run employee HR support as a single service experience. Employees raise questions and requests from a self-service portal, find answers in a curated knowledge base, and watch their case move from intake to resolution without chasing anyone.

Behind the scenes, incoming cases are triaged and routed to the right HR specialist, escalated across payroll, benefits, access, and other teams when needed, and resolved against documented service levels. Approvals, assignments, and reopen handling are built into the workflow so nothing slips between stages.

As cases resolve, the knowledge base grows from real questions, deflecting future requests and freeing HR teams to focus on the cases that genuinely need a human.

domains.description: Small-shop persona bundle for HVAC service businesses (5-30 technicians). Single-install deployable covering customer accounts and contacts (CRM), service dispatch and field execution (FSM-DISPATCH-OPS), installed equipment register and PM cadence (FSM-INSTALLED-BASE), recurring maintenance agreements (FSM-SERVICE-CONTRACTS), quote-to-invoice (CPQ + SUB-MGMT), and parts inventory (HAM). Larger organizations deploy the full modules and skip the starter.
domains.catalog_tagline: A ready-to-run home-services starter that takes an HVAC job from customer call to scheduled visit and invoice.
domains.catalog_description: This starter packages the field-service essentials a heating and cooling service business needs on day one. It bundles the customer and contact record, the installed equipment at each site, work orders and field visits, service contracts, and the quote-to-invoice path so a small team can book a call, schedule a technician, complete the job, and bill it without stitching tools together. It is a fast on-ramp to field service for trades operators who want the core workflow working immediately and can grow into the full modules later.

domains.description: Capture, classification, extraction, and validation of structured and unstructured documents.
domains.catalog_tagline: Turn the documents flowing into your business into clean, structured data your systems can act on.
domains.catalog_description: Intelligent Document Processing takes in documents from any channel, sorts them by type, and pulls the key fields, tables, and signatures out of each one, then checks the results against your business rules before handing clean records to the systems that need them. Confidence-rated extractions move forward on their own when they are clearly correct, while anything uncertain drops into a human review queue so a person can confirm or fix it in seconds. Teams train the underlying models on labeled samples, watch accuracy in production, and retrain when results start to drift, so the pipeline keeps getting more hands-off over time.
domains.business_logic: Document classification, key-value extraction, table extraction, and validation ML — the entire product is the model.

domains.description: Joiner-mover-leaver workflows, access reviews, segregation-of-duties, and entitlement governance.
domains.catalog_tagline: Govern who has access to what across every system, from the first day on the job to the last.
domains.catalog_description:
Identity governance gives security and IT teams one place to control the full lifecycle of access. When someone joins, moves, or leaves, the right entitlements are granted, adjusted, or revoked automatically, so nobody keeps access they no longer need.

Business owners review and certify access on a schedule, segregation-of-duties rules catch toxic combinations before they become audit findings, and a single entitlement catalog keeps every grant traceable. Provisioning connectors push approved changes out to downstream systems and pull back proof that they landed.

The payoff is faster onboarding, cleaner audits, and far less standing risk: access stays current, every decision is recorded, and compliance evidence is a query away rather than a fire drill.
domains.business_logic: Segregation-of-duties engine, certification ML for outlier detection, and access analytics. The rest is joiner/mover/leaver workflow.

domains.description: First notice of loss, adjudication, settlement, and recovery workflows for P&C and life insurance.
domains.catalog_tagline: Take every claim from first notice of loss through settlement, payment, and recovery in one place.
domains.catalog_description: Handle the whole claim from the moment a loss is reported. Capture first notice of loss, verify coverage against the policy, assign the right adjuster, and keep the case file complete as the investigation unfolds. Set and adjust reserves, adjudicate the coverage decision, agree the settlement, and disburse payment with a clean audit trail at every step. Screen for fraud early, open a special investigation when the indicators warrant it, and pursue subrogation and salvage to recover what is owed. Claims teams cut cycle time and leakage, treat claimants fairly and consistently, and stay ready for state and federal claims-handling scrutiny.
domains.business_logic: Adjudication rules engine, fraud detection, and reserve calculations: the irreducible insurance kernel; FNOL and case workflow are declarative.

domains.description: Detects, investigates, and mitigates risk posed by trusted insiders (employees, contractors, partners). Scores user behavior for risk, correlates anomalous data movement and policy-violation signals into prioritized alerts, runs insider-threat investigations with file-lineage forensics and evidence collection, and monitors departing-employee exit risk. Consumes data-egress signals from Data Loss Prevention, sensitive-data context from Data Security Posture Management, and employment status from Human Capital Management; hands high-risk cases to HR and Legal. Distinct from DLP (which enforces content egress at the perimeter) and DSPM (which secures data at rest): insider risk is the human-centric case-and-investigation discipline that fuses those signals around the person.
domains.catalog_tagline: See, investigate, and contain insider risk before trusted users cause a breach.
domains.catalog_description: Spot the people-shaped risks your perimeter tools miss. Score every user's behavior, surface anomalous data movement and risky activity as prioritized alerts, and turn the noise into a clear case queue. Investigate with file-lineage forensics and a full activity timeline, collect defensible evidence for HR and Legal, and keep a close watch on departing employees during their highest-risk window. Pull in egress signals, sensitive-data context, and employment status automatically, so analysts spend their time on real threats instead of stitching data together.
domains.business_logic: Behavior-based risk scoring models over multi-source activity (endpoint, email, file, cloud, identity), anomaly detection against per-user baselines, indicator-of-compromise correlation, and file-lineage reconstruction. These ML and correlation engines sit beyond the JsonLogic-declarable CRUD and state-workflow slice.

domains.description: Modern intranet platforms, internal news and announcement broadcasting, targeted employee communications, frontline / deskless worker engagement, federated employee search, and onboarding / journey orchestration. Buyer is Internal Comms or HR. Distinct from Knowledge Management (knowledge artifacts), Workstream Collaboration (chat), HR Service Delivery (case management), and Employee Experience (engagement listening / surveys).
domains.catalog_tagline: Reach every employee, from HQ to the shop floor, with one connected internal communications platform.
domains.catalog_description: Publish company news, target announcements by department or location, and reach desk-based and frontline workers across web and mobile. Track readership, manage editorial calendars, and run multi-step journeys for onboarding, change initiatives, and policy rollouts. Connect employee directories, surface knowledge across collaboration tools, and let teams amplify approved content on social channels.
domains.business_logic: Audience targeting algorithms, content personalization, federated search ranking across employee directories and content sources.

domains.description: Platform-agnostic inventory, accountable ownership, recertification, content lifecycle, quality and accessibility governance, and improvement planning over content held in an organization's existing intranets. The accountability layer over the intranet platform(s) already in place, not a publishing platform itself. Distinct from Employee Communications & Intranet (the publishing platform), Web Content Operations & Governance (external / customer-facing audience), and Collaboration Governance (Microsoft 365 container and tenant governance).
domains.catalog_tagline: Know what is in every intranet, who owns it, and whether it is still true, without replacing the intranet you have.
domains.catalog_description: Map every page, hub, library, and form across the intranets you already run, then make someone accountable for each one. Assign owners and review cadences, run recertification cycles so content gets confirmed current or flagged stale, and turn what you find into a prioritized improvement backlog. Connect SharePoint, Viva, Staffbase, Simpplr, or WordPress as governed sources and govern them from one place. Built for the digital-workplace and internal-comms teams who inherit stale, abandoned, unowned content nobody trusts. It is an accountability layer over your existing intranets, not another intranet to migrate to.
domains.business_logic: Cures the intranet ghost town by giving organizations a platform-agnostic system of record for what content exists, who is accountable for it, and whether it has been recertified, without forcing a rip-and-replace of their existing intranets.

domains.domain_name: Investor Relationship and Deal Flow Management
domains.description: Relationship-intelligence CRM and deal-pipeline software for investors (VC, PE, family offices). Tracks founders, executives, deals, portfolio companies, and LP relationships with auto-network inference from email and calendar metadata.
domains.catalog_tagline: See who in your network can open the next door, run every deal from first meeting to close, and keep your investor relationships warm in one place.
domains.catalog_description:
Turn the relationships your team already has into deal flow. The system reads the email and calendar trails your people generate and builds a living map of who knows whom and how strongly, so when you want to reach a founder or a fund you can see the warmest path in and route the introduction to the right colleague. Founders, executives, co-investors, and advisors all live in one network directory instead of scattered across personal inboxes.

Move every opportunity through a pipeline the whole team can see. Source deals, run diligence, draft and circulate the investment memo, take it to the committee, issue the term sheet, and mark the close or the pass, each stage with the right approvals attached. Per-deal staffing and committee votes stay on the record, so nothing depends on one partner's memory.

Manage the capital side with the same discipline. Track limited partners from first research through soft circle to a firm commitment, hand the relationship cleanly to fund administration when an LP commits, and keep the people who back you informed across the life of the fund. The payoff is more warm introductions that convert, a pipeline leadership can actually trust, and investor relationships that compound instead of decay.
domains.business_logic: Email and calendar metadata graph-mining for relationship strength scoring; founder and executive ownership graph reconciliation across deal stages; warm-introduction path computation.

domains.description: SMB and mid-market multi-location stock control, lot and serial tracking, reorder rules, ABC classification, and stock-movement reconciliation. Distinct from WMS (warehouse execution: picking, packing, wave planning) and from SCP (demand forecasting, MRP).
domains.catalog_tagline: Know exactly what you have, where it is, and when to reorder.
domains.catalog_description: Run accurate multi-location stock control without the weight of a full warehouse or planning suite. Track every item, lot, and serial number across warehouses, branches, and bins; let reorder rules and ABC classification tell you what to buy before you run out; and keep the books honest with cycle counts, stock transfers, and movement reconciliation. Built for growing businesses that have outgrown spreadsheets but are not ready for enterprise WMS or MRP, so your team commits accurate promise dates, avoids dead stock, and closes the month with inventory that ties out.
domains.business_logic: Reorder-point calculation (on_hand + on_order, safety_stock vs reorder_point), ABC-XYZ classification using rolling demand variability, lot and serial cost-layering (FIFO, LIFO, weighted-average) at issue time, available-to-promise reservation logic, kit explosion at order time.

domains.description: Cloud-native iPaaS for integrating SaaS and on-prem applications via prebuilt connectors and flows.
domains.catalog_tagline: Connect your cloud apps, on-premise systems, and event streams and keep data flowing between them without writing custom integration code.
domains.catalog_description:
An integration platform lets teams build, run, and monitor the automated flows that move data between business applications, databases, and event streams. Instead of hand-coding and maintaining brittle point-to-point integrations, builders assemble flows from a library of prebuilt application connectors, map fields from one system to another, and set the triggers and schedules that decide when each flow runs.

Once a flow is published it runs on its own: it picks up new records and events, transforms them to match the target system, and delivers them with retry logic that recovers from transient failures. Every execution is captured as a run record with status, timing, and error detail, so teams can see exactly what moved, what failed, and why, and can replay or fix a flow with full audit history.

Webhook subscriptions let outside systems push events in the moment they happen, and managed credentials with rotation keep every connection secure as it ages. The result is faster delivery of new integrations, fewer manual data-entry tasks, and reliable, observable data movement across the whole application landscape.
domains.business_logic: Integration runtime executing connectors, transformations, error handling, and event delivery at scale — code-dominant by definition.

domains.description: Cross-domain starter kit for small and mid-sized IT teams. Embeds lightweight shells of the records a small IT shop manages: the helpdesk (optional), the hardware register, the SaaS application and renewal tracker, and the contract register. The renewal/contract spine (asset_contracts + saas_subscriptions) is required; hardware, SaaS apps, helpdesk, and on-prem licenses are optional. domain_id NULL; hosts ITSM, HAM, SMP, ITAM, SAM. Replaces the helpdesk-plus-spreadsheets reality; budget stays in the general ledger.
domains.catalog_tagline: Run your whole IT shop from one place: tickets, devices, SaaS renewals, and contracts, without the spreadsheets.
domains.catalog_description: One place to manage IT for a small team. Track the hardware you own and who has it, every SaaS app and when its subscription renews, and the contracts behind them, so nothing slips through a spreadsheet and no renewal catches you off guard. Add a lightweight helpdesk for tickets and requests if you do not already run one, or keep the one you have. Start with the renewal and contract essentials and turn on the device, SaaS, and helpdesk pieces as you need them. Built for IT teams that have outgrown spreadsheets but do not need a full enterprise IT suite.

domains.description: Umbrella domain covering hardware, software, cloud-cost, and enterprise-asset management.
domains.catalog_tagline: Know every asset you own, what it costs, and where it is in its life, across hardware, software, SaaS, and cloud.
domains.catalog_description: Manage your entire technology estate from one place. Track every asset from purchase through deployment, transfer, and retirement, and keep a single record of the contracts, leases, warranties, and support agreements that govern them. Reconcile the inconsistent ways each feed names the same hardware and software so your inventory is clean and trustworthy. Roll the whole portfolio up into total-cost-of-ownership and position reporting that finance, procurement, and IT can all act on, so you renew on time, cut waste, and prove what you have when audit or compliance asks.
domains.business_logic: Normalization tables (the same hardware/software model expressed inconsistently across feeds) are the small irreducible kernel — they require maintained reference data, not a runtime engine.

domains.description: Monitoring, event management, and operational control of IT infrastructure and services.
domains.catalog_tagline: Watch every server, network, and service in one place, catch problems before users feel them, and keep capacity ahead of demand.
domains.catalog_description:
Bring monitoring, event management, and capacity planning together so your operations team works from one live picture of the infrastructure. Collect signals from across the estate, turn raw events into meaningful alerts with the policies you control, and cut through the noise so the team chases what actually matters instead of every blip. When something breaks, the alert is already correlated to the affected service and routed to the people who can fix it.

The same operational data keeps you ahead of growth. Track utilization over time, see where headroom is running out, and forecast when you will need more before a resource is exhausted. Automate the routine recovery steps and scheduled work that used to page someone at 3 a.m., so the team spends its time on the problems that need judgment, not on the ones a runbook can handle. The payoff is fewer outages, faster recovery, and infrastructure spend that tracks real need.
domains.business_logic: Event management, capacity calculations, and topology-aware impact analysis, engine-led; service-mapping master data is the smaller part.

domains.description: Workflows for managing IT requests, incidents, problems, changes, and knowledge in support of internal business users.
domains.catalog_tagline: Run a responsive IT service desk that resolves incidents, fulfills requests, and ships changes without breaking the business.
domains.catalog_description:
IT Service Management gives your service desk one place to capture, route, and resolve everything your workforce throws at it: outages, password resets, new-laptop requests, recurring problems, and risky changes. Tickets follow a clear lifecycle from intake to closure, with priority routing, approvals, and SLA timers built in, so nothing slips and the right person always owns the next step.

The suite spans incident, request, problem, change, knowledge, and service-level management, plus an agent workspace that pulls the full picture together. Self-service portals and a curated knowledge base deflect routine work, while problem and change workflows keep the underlying environment stable. The result is faster resolution, fewer repeat issues, and a measurable service experience your users and auditors can both trust.
domains.business_logic: Ticket classification, deduplication, and priority routing benefit from ML, but the underlying workflow remains state-machine driven.

domains.description: Workplace booking, space optimization, real-estate management, and visitor handling.
domains.catalog_tagline: Book the desk, reserve the room, and prove the space is working.
domains.catalog_description: Run the hybrid workplace end to end: a single registry of sites, buildings, and floors that every booking flow rides on, self-service desk and meeting-room reservations with check-in and no-show recapture, a facilities service desk for workplace tickets, and occupancy analytics that turn badge and booking signals into space-utilization reporting. The payoff is a workplace employees can navigate without friction and a real-estate footprint leaders can right-size with evidence instead of guesswork.
domains.business_logic: Space-optimization algorithms (occupancy planning, stack diagrams, scenario modeling) for real-estate teams; the rest is reservations and workflow.

domains.description: Enterprise platform for modeling, storing, querying, and reasoning over typed business objects via formal ontologies (OWL / RDF / SHACL) or labeled property graphs. Includes ontology authoring, inference, SPARQL/Cypher querying, virtual-graph federation, and operational-app affordances on top of the graph store. Buyer: enterprise architect / CDO / life-sciences R&D lead. Primary JTBD: build AI agents, operational apps, and complex analytical queries on top of a unified semantic model. Distinct from MDM (master-data orchestration without ontology engine), from DATA-AI-PLAT (broader scope including pipelines / lakehouse / ML), and from a plain graph database (KGP adds reasoning, ontology governance, and ontology-mapped operational-app affordances).
domains.business_logic: OWL reasoning (RDFS, OWL-EL, OWL-RL, OWL-DL); SHACL constraint validation; SPARQL 1.1 query optimization with federation across remote endpoints; virtual-graph projection of relational/JSON sources as RDF; named-graph access control; hybrid vector+symbolic search for RAG; embedding generation and similarity over graph neighborhoods; provenance and lineage tracking; rule-based inference engines beyond OWL.

domains.description: Authoring, governance, and retrieval of organizational knowledge for internal and external audiences.
domains.catalog_tagline: Capture, organize, and govern your organization's know-how, then surface the right answer wherever people and assistants ask for it.
domains.catalog_description:
Turn scattered tribal knowledge into a single trusted corpus. Authors draft articles, route them through review and approval, publish them to the audiences that need them, and retire what is out of date, with every revision tracked so you always know what changed and who approved it.

Organize the corpus with categories and taxonomies, group related material into curated collections, and gather reader feedback so the articles that fall short get flagged and fixed. See what people actually search for, where the answer was found, and where the search came up empty, so the gaps become a worklist instead of a guess.

Feed the same governed corpus to help centers, support agents, and AI assistants, so self-service deflection, agent answers, and retrieval-augmented assistants all draw from one reviewed source of truth instead of stale copies scattered across teams.
domains.business_logic: Search and RAG retrieval over the knowledge corpus, vector embeddings, ranking, and relevance models. Authoring, versioning, taxonomies, and access workflow are the CRUD majority.

domains.description: Production Kubernetes distributions with day-2 operations, multi-cluster management, and integrated CI/CD.
domains.catalog_tagline: Run production Kubernetes clusters and the workloads on them, with day-2 operations and fleet-wide control.
domains.catalog_description: Stand up production-grade Kubernetes clusters, size and scale their node pools, and keep them patched, upgraded, and healthy through their whole life. Roll out applications as workloads and packaged releases, install the operators and service meshes they depend on, and wire in the pipelines that build and deploy into the cluster. Manage many clusters as one fleet instead of hand-tending each one. Get reliable container infrastructure with the upgrade, backup, and recovery routines built in, so platform teams ship and operate workloads without assembling the platform from scratch.
domains.business_logic: Kubernetes control plane, scheduler, networking (CNI), storage (CSI), and node lifecycle — distributed systems infrastructure.

domains.description: Visual and model-driven development of custom enterprise applications with managed runtime.
domains.business_logic: Runtime, compiler, and visual modeler — the entire platform is code. The end-user app surface is whatever the customer builds; the LCAP itself is platform.

domains.description: Lessee lease accounting and administration: bringing every operating and finance lease onto the balance sheet under ASC 842 and IFRS 16. Covers right-of-use asset and lease liability recognition, lease classification (finance vs operating under ASC 842; single lessee model under IFRS 16), amortization and liability schedules, modification and remeasurement accounting, journal-entry generation into the general ledger, and quantitative and qualitative disclosure reporting, with an administration layer for lease records, critical dates, and documents. Distinct from the real-estate and workplace view (which treats leases as occupancy records, not an audited subledger) and from commercial real-estate operations (landlord-side CAM, escalations, and the leasing pipeline). The accounting kernel is a certification-grade financial-compliance surface owned by the office of the controller.
domains.catalog_tagline: Audit-ready ASC 842 and IFRS 16 lease accounting from contract to disclosure.
domains.catalog_description: Put every lease on the balance sheet with the right right-of-use asset, lease liability, and amortization schedule, then generate the journal entries, disclosures, and audit trail your external auditors will accept. Classify finance versus operating leases under ASC 842 or run the single lessee model under IFRS 16, handle modifications and remeasurements without rebuilding spreadsheets, and track critical dates and lease documents in one place. Built for the controller's team to stay compliant and close on time across the whole lease portfolio.
domains.business_logic: Amortization and lease-liability schedule generation (effective-interest unwinding, straight-line operating-lease cost plug), lease classification tests (ASC 842 five criteria; IFRS 16 single lessee model), modification and remeasurement re-calculation (discount-rate reassessment, index and rate true-ups, scope changes), impairment of right-of-use assets, and parallel ASC 842 / IFRS 16 schedule computation where both bases are reported. The disclosure maturity analysis and weighted-average rate and term rollups are computed, not declarative.

domains.description: Law-firm operational platform: matter management (case lifecycle, parties, key dates, deadlines), timekeeper time capture and billing (ABA UTBMS task codes), IOLTA trust-account ledgering, conflict-of-interest checking across matters and adversaries, client intake, engagement letters, and matter-scoped document management. Buyer is the law firm (solo to mid-size). Vendor unconstrained by formal certification, the attorney carries all regulatory weight under ABA Model Rules and state bar ethics.
domains.catalog_tagline: Run your whole law firm in one place, from client intake and conflict clearance through matters, billable time, trust accounting, and court deadlines.
domains.catalog_description:
Manage every matter across its full life, from the first intake conversation and conflict check to the day the file is closed and archived. Track the people involved, the key dates that cannot be missed, and the documents tied to each case in one shared workspace.

Capture billable time against standardized task and expense codes, build prebills your partners can review, and send invoices in the electronic-billing formats your clients require. Keep client funds in separated trust ledgers with three-way reconciliation, automatic transfers when fees are earned, and the exception reporting your state bar expects.

Clear conflicts before you take on a new client, generate engagement letters from templates, collect retainers, and calendar court deadlines from jurisdiction rules so statutes of limitations and filing dates are never left to memory.
domains.business_logic: Conflict-of-interest checking via graph-search across matters, parties, and adversaries; IOLTA trust-account ledger with three-way reconciliation (bank vs ledger vs client-balance), per-state retention rules; ABA UTBMS task/expense coding on time entries; legal-billing exception rules (block billing, fee-split agreements); statute-of-limitations and key-date alerting per matter type.

domains.description: Software that manages physical and digital library collections, member services, circulation, acquisitions, cataloging, and discovery for public, academic, special, and school libraries.
domains.catalog_tagline: Run your library: catalog every title, lend every item, serve every patron.
domains.catalog_description: Manage the whole library operation from one system. Catalog books, journals, e-resources, and special collections, and keep authority headings clean. Run daily circulation: check out and check in items, place and trap holds, and assess or waive fines under your own loan rules. Register patrons, organize them by category, and issue cards. Order print and electronic materials, track serial subscriptions and e-resource licenses, and reconcile vendor invoices. Publish a searchable catalog for self-service discovery, and extend your reach through interlibrary loan with resource-sharing partners.
domains.business_logic: Bibliographic record matching against external authority files (Library of Congress, OCLC, VIAF), circulation rules engine (loan periods by patron-type and item-type, renewal limits, fine accrual, holds queue priority and trapping), Z39.50, SIP2, and NCIP protocol handling for self-check kiosks and resource sharing, MARC21 and BIBFRAME format translation and validation.

domains.description: Records, plans, and tracks beef, sheep, and mixed grazing-livestock operations: individual-animal records, mob (group) management, mob movements between paddocks and properties, weight gains with average-daily-gain tracking, breeding and calving records, treatment and medicine records with withholding periods, pasture allocation and rotational grazing planning, and the electronic-identifier traceability layer (EID / RFID ear tags, national identification scheme device numbers). Buyer is the small-to-mid grazing operation, station, ranch, or family farm. Distinct from Dairy Herd Management (milking, lactation, milk quality) and from the crop / whole-farm Farm Management Information System, though it shares the paddock and whole-farm substrate with the latter.
domains.catalog_tagline: Run your herd and your pastures from one place: animals, mobs, movements, weights, breeding, treatments, and grazing plans.
domains.catalog_description: Track every animal and every mob from birth or purchase through to sale, with weights and average daily gains, breeding and calving records, and treatment and medicine logs that keep your withholding periods straight. Move mobs between paddocks and properties, allocate pasture, and plan rotations against your stocking rate and carrying capacity. Capture electronic ear-tag reads in the yard and keep your traceability records audit-ready for the identification scheme in your region. Built for the grazier, station, or family farm that wants real records without the weight of a full enterprise system.
domains.business_logic: Beyond CRUD and state-based workflow: average-daily-gain and growth-curve computation from weight series, stocking-rate-versus-carrying-capacity grazing optimization, rest-period and rotation scheduling driven by pasture cover and rainfall, and withholding-period date arithmetic that gates sale and slaughter eligibility after a treatment.

domains.description: Course authoring, content delivery, compliance training, certifications, and learning paths for employees and extended audiences.
domains.catalog_tagline: Train your whole workforce and prove it, from first enrollment to audit-ready completion records.
domains.catalog_description: Run corporate learning end to end. Author and publish courses, deliver them online or in the classroom, and track every enrollment through to completion. Issue the certifications and badges that show who is qualified, and keep the evidence auditors and regulators ask for. Assign mandatory training automatically, chase overdue learners without manual follow-up, and feed completion signals to the HR, compliance, and identity systems that depend on them.
domains.business_logic: Learning-path recommendation engines; otherwise pure content, enrollment, and tracking records.

domains.description: Points/tiers, rewards programs, member portals, and partner ecosystems for B2C and B2B2C loyalty.
domains.catalog_tagline: Reward repeat customers with points, tiers, and personalized perks that grow customer lifetime value.
domains.catalog_description:
Turn one-time buyers into repeat customers by enrolling them in a loyalty program, building rich member profiles, and moving them up tiers as they engage. Set the rules for how members join, what counts toward their status, and what they unlock at each level.

Reward engagement the way you choose: award points for purchases and actions, publish a catalog of rewards members can redeem, and run the redemption workflow end to end. Layer on bonus-point promotions and partner coalitions so members earn and spend across more places.

Give members a self-service portal to check their balance, browse rewards, and track their progress, and use program analytics to see what drives retention. Connect the program to your commerce, customer, and marketing systems so loyalty data flows where your team already works.
domains.business_logic: Tier engine and points accrual/redemption rules — declarative but central to the product.

domains.description: Intake, matter management, and operational workflows for the in-house legal function.
domains.catalog_tagline: Run the in-house legal department as a service: take in requests, triage them into matters, and move legal work to close.
domains.catalog_description:
Legal Service Delivery gives the in-house legal team a single front door for the rest of the business. Employees and business units submit requests for advice, review, or representation through an intake portal; the legal team triages each request, decides whether to open a matter, route it to outside counsel, or answer it directly, and then tracks the work through to resolution. Matters carry their parties, key dates, budgets, and assigned counsel in one place, so nothing falls through the cracks and the team can see how much legal work is in flight at any moment.

Around the matter sit the operational workflows that legal teams live in every day: issuing and releasing legal holds, orchestrating ediscovery collection and production, recording legal advice with its privilege classification, engaging and managing outside counsel, and responding to inquiries from regulators within deadline. Court-bound matters get a docket that tracks filings, hearings, and trial dates against the calendar.

The value is faster, more consistent legal service with far less email and spreadsheet tracking. Leaders get visibility into demand, workload, cycle time, and outside-counsel spend, while the business gets a predictable place to ask for legal help and a clear answer on where each request stands.

domains.description: Email/SMS/cross-channel campaign orchestration, lead nurturing, and journey management. Includes B2B (account-based marketing) and B2C (consumer engagement) variants.
domains.catalog_tagline: Orchestrate marketing emails, nurture journeys, and lead scoring across email, SMS, push, and the web.
domains.catalog_description: Run your marketing across every channel from one place. Author and send email campaigns, build multi-step nurture journeys that reach people on email, SMS, push, and in-app, and capture new leads through hosted landing pages and forms. Score and prioritize those leads automatically so the best ones reach sales at the right moment. Connect what each contact does back into the next message they receive, so every touch builds on the last and your whole funnel keeps moving without manual handoffs.
domains.business_logic: Journey orchestration runtime, send-time and channel optimization, and segment evaluation at scale; campaign authoring is workflow.

domains.description: Software market for operating marinas, boatyards, and dry-stack facilities: slip, berth, mooring, and rack inventory and assignment; transient, seasonal, and waitlisted reservations; recurring slip contracts with metered electric and water billing; boater and vessel records; boatyard service, haul-out, and launch scheduling; and fuel-dock and ship-store point of sale. Serves marina operators, yacht clubs, municipal harbors, and dry-stack storage businesses. Distinct from long-term residential property management and from hotel property management systems.
domains.catalog_tagline: Run your marina end to end: assign slips and storage, take reservations, bill boaters and meter utilities, schedule the boatyard, and sell fuel, all in one place.
domains.catalog_description: Operate a marina, boatyard, or dry-stack facility from a single system. Lay out your docks, slips, moorings, and racks, then assign each vessel by fit and keep an accurate availability calendar across transient, seasonal, and waitlisted demand. Take reservations and transient bookings, manage boater and vessel records with insurance and registration on file, and bill on recurring contracts with metered electric and water charges. Schedule haul-outs, launches, and boatyard work orders, run the fuel dock and ship store, and keep owners and boaters informed automatically.
domains.business_logic: Slip-fit assignment matching vessel length, beam, and draft to berth dimensions and utilities; availability-calendar reconciliation across transient, seasonal, and waitlist demand to prevent double-booking of slips, moorings, and racks; metered-utility billing math turning electric and water sub-meter reads into invoice lines; seasonal, transient, and long-term rate and proration rules; fuel-dock inventory and pump reconciliation; and dry-stack launch scheduling against forklift and rack capacity.

domains.description: Authoritative golden records for shared entities (customer, supplier, product, asset) including matching, survivorship, and stewardship.
domains.catalog_tagline: Resolve duplicate records from every system into one trusted golden record for each customer, supplier, and employee.
domains.catalog_description:
Bring the scattered versions of each customer, supplier, and employee together into a single record everyone can rely on. Pull in records from every connected system, find the ones that point to the same real-world entity, and merge them with rules you control over which value wins per field. Route the uncertain matches to a data steward for review, so nothing gets merged by mistake and nothing slips through.

Once a golden record is set, it flows out to the systems that need it, keeping sales, service, HR, and analytics working from the same trusted facts. Tune your matching and survivorship rules as your data changes, track how each record was resolved, and handle data-subject and erasure requests cleanly across every place the record lives.
domains.business_logic: Matching and survivorship algorithms (deterministic + probabilistic), hierarchy management, and stewardship workflows — the irreducible kernel beneath any MDM hub.

domains.description: Lightweight semantic tier defining metrics, dimensions, and entity relationships once, then exposing them via SQL/REST/GraphQL/MDX/JDBC to any downstream consumer: BI dashboards, AI agents, embedded analytics, custom apps. Distinct from BI (no UI / dashboard surface), from DI (no data movement), from DCG (no broader governance scope), and from DATA-AI-PLAT (a feature within those platforms, sold separately by pure-play vendors). Buyer: analytics / data-engineering leader.
domains.catalog_tagline: Define your business metrics once and serve them to every dashboard, agent, and app.
domains.catalog_description:
Different teams compute the same metric in different places, and the numbers stop matching. A revenue figure in a finance dashboard disagrees with the one in a sales report, and nobody can say which is right. Every new dashboard, notebook, or AI agent re-implements the logic, so the drift only gets worse as you grow.

A metrics layer lets you define each metric and its dimensions once, in one governed place, and then serves that single definition to everything downstream. Analysts certify the trusted version, the layer caches and federates the heavy queries, and access policies control who sees which numbers at what grain.

The result is one consistent answer to every metric question, delivered over SQL, REST, and AI-native interfaces, with full lineage back to the source so you can always explain where a number came from.
domains.business_logic: Compilation of declarative semantic models into SQL query plans; multi-dimensional caching and aggregation with intelligent invalidation; query federation across warehouses and lakehouses; lineage propagation from physical sources to logical metrics; fine-grained access control at the metric/dimension level; AI-agent tool-use over the metric registry; natural-language-to-metric translation.

domains.description: Shop-floor execution, work-instruction delivery, and operator-case management for manufacturers.
domains.catalog_tagline: Run the shop floor in real time, from order release to the as-built record.
domains.catalog_description: Manufacturing operations turns released production orders into finished, traceable units. Schedulers sequence work across lines and cells, operators follow current work instructions step by step, and every build is captured as an as-built record with its lot and serial. Quality inspections gate pass, fail, and hold decisions at the point of build, downtime and stoppages are logged for live OEE, and shop-floor cases route operator escalations to the problem-solving team. The result is a connected floor where plant managers, supervisors, operators, and quality inspectors share one live view of what is being built, how fast, and at what quality.
domains.business_logic: MES execution loops (work-instruction delivery, andon, downtime capture) and SPC calculations bridge the IT/OT boundary.

domains.description: Top-down marketing planning, budget allocation across plans and campaigns, spend-to-plan reconciliation, and the marketing calendar for in-house marketing departments. Scoped tightly to the planning and budget kernel: the marketing plan hierarchy, plan-line budget allocation, committed and actual spend reconciled to plan, the campaign and content calendar, and plan-level performance measurement. Brand and creative assets are referenced from the asset repository rather than stored here; generic task and project work is referenced from the work-management layer; campaign execution is referenced from the marketing-execution layer. Sits upstream of execution and downstream of corporate finance.
domains.catalog_tagline: Plan your marketing, allocate the budget, and reconcile every dollar of spend back to the plan.
domains.catalog_description: Build the annual and quarterly marketing plan as a hierarchy of plan lines, then allocate budget top-down across plans, campaigns, and channels. Track committed and actual spend against every plan line so you always know what is left to spend and where it went. Lay the whole program out on a shared marketing calendar, route budget allocations and spend through approval, and measure plan-level performance and marketing ROI. Connects to your work-management tasks, your asset library, and your campaign-execution tools without duplicating them.
domains.business_logic: Budget allocation rollups across the plan-line hierarchy, plan-to-actual spend reconciliation (committed vs actual vs plan), forecast and scenario math on remaining budget, and approval-chain governance on budget allocations and spend.

domains.description: Ticketing, contracts, time tracking, billing, and resource scheduling built around the MSP business model: multi-tenant customer estates, recurring service contracts, block-hour and value-based pricing, and per-customer SLAs. Distinct from generic PSA (services-org variant for consultancies and agencies), different buyer, different competitive set.
domains.catalog_tagline: Run a profitable managed-services book: tickets, contracts, time, and billing in one place.
domains.catalog_description: Built for the managed-service provider business model, this brings together customer estates, recurring service contracts, block-hour and value-based pricing, per-customer SLAs, ticket handling, time capture, invoicing, and technician scheduling. Service desks resolve customer issues against contracted SLAs, time entries flow into billing, contracts drive recurring revenue, and dispatch keeps the right technician on the right job, all with clean separation between each customer's data.
domains.business_logic: Recurring contract billing with block-hour decrement, value-based pricing tiers, SLA timer pause/resume on hold, multi-tenant data isolation between customer estates, technician dispatch and scheduling optimization, time-entry approval routing.

domains.description: Spreadsheet-database hybrids letting non-developers model structured data, link records across tables, build forms/views/dashboards, and automate without code. Bought self-serve by citizen developers in marketing, ops, HR, and PMO; expands to enterprise via Business/Enterprise tiers. Distinct from LCAP (no managed app runtime, no environments/version pipeline, no compiled UI), from BI (no warehouse, no analytical semantic layer), and from work management (the data model is the buy reason, not the project view).
domains.catalog_tagline: Build a database without code. Model your data, capture it through forms, view it your way, and automate the rest.
domains.catalog_description:
Stand up a working database in an afternoon, no developer required. Design your own tables, add the field types your work actually needs, and link records across tables so related information stays connected. Your data structure is the product: shape it to match how your team works instead of bending your work to fit a rigid tool.

Give everyone a way to read and contribute. Switch the same data between grid, gallery, kanban, calendar, and timeline views, each filtered and sorted to the question at hand, and share any view with the people who need it. Collect new information through forms that write straight into your tables, so submissions land clean and ready to use.

Put the busywork on autopilot. Trigger actions when records change or on a schedule, send notifications to the right people, and keep your tables in sync with the other systems you rely on. The result is a single place where your team models, captures, works, and automates its operational data.
domains.business_logic: Spreadsheet-style formula fields with cross-table rollups and lookups; bidirectional sync engines that mirror records to/from external systems; automation actions that combine event triggers with conditional logic and external API calls; embedded AI for record summarization, classification, and generation.

domains.description: Network observability, flow analysis, path tracing, and SaaS/internet performance monitoring across WAN, LAN, and cloud.
domains.catalog_tagline: See how traffic flows, where paths break, and how your SaaS and internet performance look to real users, so you catch network trouble before it reaches the help desk.
domains.catalog_description:
Network performance monitoring and diagnostics gives operations teams a live picture of how the network is behaving end to end. It collects flow records and path traces, samples latency, jitter, loss, and throughput across links and application paths, and learns a baseline for what normal looks like so that real problems stand out from everyday noise.

When a metric crosses a threshold or a path degrades, the platform raises a network-specific alert with the affected path or flow and the baseline it broke, and walks that alert through acknowledge, resolve, and close. Topology snapshots and interface state keep the map of the network current, so an engineer can move from a symptom to the segment or device at fault in minutes instead of hours.

The same lens reaches past the edge of the corporate network. Synthetic and real-user checks measure how reachable and responsive SaaS applications are from the locations, networks, and carriers your people actually use, exposing internet and last-mile trouble that lives outside your own gear. Alerts open tickets in service management, anomalies feed event correlation and observability, and topology updates reconcile with the configuration database, so network insight drives the rest of the operations toolchain rather than sitting in a silo.
domains.business_logic: Flow analysis (NetFlow/sFlow/IPFIX), path tracing, BGP/route monitoring, and synthetic probes — stream-processing algorithms at scale.

domains.description: Unified metrics, logs, and traces for distributed systems, primarily targeting engineering teams.
domains.catalog_tagline: See what every service in production is doing, and know the moment it stops behaving.
domains.catalog_description:
Bring metrics, logs, and traces together so you can answer what is happening across your distributed systems without jumping between tools. Watch live dashboards, drill from a slow request into the exact trace, and search raw logs to find the root cause.

Set service level objectives, track error budgets as they burn, and group recurring errors so the right engineer is paged before customers notice. When something breaks, the signals that fired the alert are already in front of you, with a clean handoff to your incident and ticketing workflows.
domains.business_logic: Telemetry collection pipeline, trace analysis, log indexing at scale, metrics TSDB, and exemplar correlation — high-cardinality data infrastructure.

domains.description: Order capture, orchestration, and fulfillment across channels and inventory pools.
domains.catalog_tagline: Capture orders from any channel, route them to the right inventory node, and orchestrate everything from sourcing to returns in one place.
domains.catalog_description:
Take in orders from web, store, marketplace, and call center, then decide how each one gets fulfilled. Rate-shop and source every line against the inventory you actually have, split shipments when that is cheaper or faster, and commit a delivery promise the customer can count on. One view shows where each order is, what is allocated, and what still needs attention.

Run the omnichannel paths that buyers expect. Reserve stock for buy-online-pickup-in-store and curbside, hand pick lists to the right location, and keep the customer posted from confirmation to ready-for-pickup. When inventory shifts or an allocation fails, reroute the order instead of letting it stall.

Close the loop after the sale. Issue return authorizations, route items back to the right node for inspection and restock, and trigger the refund and credit so finance, support, and the storefront all stay in sync. The payoff is fewer split-cost surprises, faster fulfillment, and orders that follow through from capture to return without falling through the cracks.
domains.business_logic: Inventory allocation, sourcing/fulfillment rules, and split-shipment optimization — operations-research heavy.

domains.description: Orchestration of pre-boarding, Day-1, and 30/60/90 workflows for new hires, task lists, welcome experiences, documentation, e-signature, buddy assignments, and downstream provisioning coordination. Operates primarily as a downstream-trigger pattern: offer.accepted (ATS) and employee.created (HCM) drive journey instantiation, which then fans out events to ITSM (provisioning), IWMS (facilities), Payroll (activation), LMS (compliance training), HRSD (case escalation), and IGA (access provisioning), making it the textbook case for the cross_domain_handoffs analytic.
domains.catalog_tagline: Turn an accepted offer into a productive, welcomed employee by day one.
domains.catalog_description: Employee onboarding orchestrates everything that has to happen between a signed offer and a new hire who is set up, compliant, and engaged. It instantiates a structured journey the moment a candidate is hired or an employee record is created, then drives the pre-boarding, day-one, and 30/60/90 milestones from a single plan. Task lists are generated conditionally by role, location, and employment type, and the right work is routed automatically to IT for provisioning, to facilities for workspace setup, to payroll for activation, to learning for compliance training, and to identity for access. Document intake captures and validates new-hire paperwork, while welcome experiences and buddy pairings make the first weeks feel intentional. The result is a faster time to productivity, fewer dropped handoffs across departments, and an auditable record that every compliance step was completed on time.
domains.business_logic: Conditional task generation based on role, location, and employment type; cross-system orchestration to HCM, IGA, and Payroll.

domains.description: Mapping of important business services to people, processes, technology, and third parties, with tolerance setting.
domains.catalog_tagline: Map the services your customers depend on, set the limits you can never breach, and prove you can stay inside them when something breaks.
domains.catalog_description:
Run your business through the lens of the services that matter most to customers and to the market, not the systems that happen to support them. Identify your important business services, then map each one down to the people, processes, applications, data, and third parties it relies on, so you can see exactly what a single failure would take out and where the hidden single points of failure are.

For every important service, set an impact tolerance: the maximum disruption you are willing to accept before customers or the wider market are harmed. Test those limits against severe but plausible scenarios, from a key supplier going dark to a cyber outage or a data-center loss, and record whether each service stayed inside tolerance or breached it. Turn every breach and near miss into tracked remediation with owners and due dates, so the gaps close instead of resurfacing in the next test.

Give boards and regulators a clear, evidenced view of how resilient the organization really is. Maintain the self-assessment and reporting that rules such as DORA and NIS2 expect, link operational-resilience incidents back to the services and tolerances they threatened, and keep the dependency map current as the business changes, so resilience is a living posture you can defend rather than a document that ages on a shelf.
domains.business_logic: Mapping algorithms that propagate impact across the important-business-service graph; minor compared to the workflow surface.

domains.description: HR metrics, dashboards, workforce composition analysis, attrition prediction, and DEI analytics on top of the HR data stack.
domains.catalog_tagline: See your whole workforce in numbers: headcount, attrition risk, engagement, and pay equity in one analytics workspace.
domains.catalog_description:
People Analytics turns your HR, payroll, and talent data into decisions. Build headcount and attrition scorecards, slice the workforce by org unit, tenure, and performance, and watch the metrics that signal where the organization is headed.

Run engagement and pulse surveys, score flight risk with predictive models, and surface pay-equity and representation gaps before they become problems. Publish dashboards your HR business partners and leaders actually use, and push the insights that matter into talent, planning, and compensation work.

Start with workforce metrics, then layer in engagement listening, predictive modeling, and diversity analytics as your team grows into a data-driven people function.
domains.business_logic: Predictive models (attrition, performance, DEI) and benchmarking calculations — the analytics engines beneath the report layer.

domains.description: Gross-to-net calculation, statutory tax filing, garnishments, pay distribution, and multi-country payroll execution.
domains.catalog_tagline: Pay your people accurately and on time, with taxes filed and every paystub in their hands.
domains.catalog_description: Run the full pay cycle end to end: pull in hours, earnings, and deductions, calculate gross-to-net for every employee, and disburse net pay on schedule. File the statutory tax returns each jurisdiction requires, process court-ordered wage garnishments correctly, and post the resulting journal entries to your books. Give every employee a clear, accurate pay statement and keep a defensible record of how each amount was calculated.
domains.business_logic: Tax tables, gross-to-net calculation, garnishment logic, statutory filings, and country-specific compliance kernels: irreducible and continuously updated.

domains.description: Centralized merchandising master for product attributes, descriptions, digital assets, taxonomies, translations, and channel-specific syndication. Distinct from PLM (engineering record), MDM (cross-entity golden records), and the commerce-platform-native catalog (runtime storefront view).
domains.catalog_tagline: Enrich every product once, then publish it to every channel that sells it.
domains.catalog_description: Bring all of your product content into one trusted place: descriptions, attributes, variants, categories, translations, and the images and videos that sell each item. Move products through a clear enrichment workflow, from draft to enriched to reviewed and approved, so nothing reaches a shopper half-finished. Manage many languages and many channel-specific versions of the same product without duplicating work, and publish to marketplaces, storefronts, retailer feeds, and partner endpoints from a single approved master. When a destination rejects a listing, see why and fix it in one place instead of chasing errors across systems. The result is faster time to market, fewer listing errors, and consistent, on-brand product information everywhere you sell.
domains.business_logic: AI-driven attribute generation and translation, per-channel feed-shape validation (marketplace feeds, merchant feeds, GDSN datapools), golden-record survivorship across supplier data sources, locale-specific overrides, and approval workflows before publish.

domains.description: Manages the digital thread of a physical product from concept through engineering release, manufacturing handoff, service, and end-of-life. Holds engineering BOMs, CAD data vault, part masters, engineering change orders, revisions, requirements traceability, configuration and variant rules, and the as-designed to as-built to as-maintained chain. Distinct from PROD-MGMT (software product management) and from MFG-OPS (shop-floor execution).
domains.catalog_tagline: Run the digital thread of every product from concept to end of life.
domains.catalog_description: Hold the single source of truth for what a physical product is and how it changes over time. Author and release the part master, engineering BOM, and revisions; drive every change through a controlled change-order workflow with impact analysis and approval; keep CAD models and drawings in a managed vault; hand a clean manufacturing BOM and routing to the shop floor; trace requirements from definition through verification; and prove material and substance compliance for each market you ship into. Replace scattered spreadsheets and folder shares with a connected as-designed, as-built, and as-maintained chain that downstream manufacturing, procurement, and service teams can trust.
domains.business_logic: ECO impact analysis via where-used graph traversal across BOM trees, BOM rollup costing, configurator and option-and-variant resolution at order time, requirements traceability matrix computation, CAD geometry and viewable processing.

domains.description: Software market for product marketing: competitive intelligence and battlecards, go-to-market launch planning and coordination, messaging and positioning craft, and sales-enablement content. Bought by the Product Marketing lead, distinct from sales planning (GTM-PLAN) and product management (PROD-MGMT). Anchors the launch-orchestration and competitive-enablement surfaces no sales-planning or roadmap vendor masters.
domains.catalog_tagline: Run every product launch, win every competitive deal, and arm sales with the right message and content.
domains.catalog_description: Bring product marketing into one place: track competitors and ship battlecards your sellers actually use, plan and coordinate launches from kickoff to GA, craft the messaging and positioning that the whole company aligns on, and produce the sales-enablement content that closes deals. Run win/loss programs to learn why you win, and see which content and messaging move the needle. Stop scattering launches and competitive intel across docs and decks, and give the business one source of truth for how the product goes to market.
domains.business_logic: Competitive-intel relevance scoring and source de-duplication over ingested intel feeds; sales-enablement content engagement analytics and recommendation ranking; win/loss theme extraction and sentiment from interview transcripts; launch-readiness rollup scoring across cross-functional checklists.

domains.description: KPI collection from portfolio companies, valuation tracking, performance metric computation (IRR/MOIC/TVPI/DPI), and LP-facing performance reporting for private capital funds.
domains.catalog_tagline: Turn raw portfolio company data into LP-ready performance, valuations, and fund returns in one place.
domains.catalog_description: Run the full private capital monitoring cycle without stitching spreadsheets together. Collect KPI and ESG data from portfolio companies each reporting period, mark holdings to fair value with a defensible methodology trail, and compute fund and position returns (IRR, MOIC, TVPI, DPI) across vintages with public market equivalent benchmarking and J-curve normalization. Then package quarterly LP performance reports that tie every fund-level number back to the underlying marks. Built so investment teams, fund controllers, and investor relations work from one source of truth, close reporting cycles faster, and answer LP questions with confidence.
domains.business_logic: Time-weighted IRR/MOIC/TVPI/DPI computation across multi-vintage funds; PME (public market equivalent) benchmarking; J-curve normalization for early-stage funds; ASC 820 fair-value mark methodology.

domains.description: Data subject rights, consent, processing inventory, and privacy assessments.
domains.catalog_tagline: Handle data-subject requests, capture consent, and keep your processing inventory audit-ready.
domains.catalog_description: Run the privacy operations that keep you compliant with GDPR, CCPA/CPRA, and the privacy laws that follow them. Intake and fulfill data-subject access, correction, and deletion requests through a tracked pipeline that fans out to every source system and meets the statutory response clock. Capture and prove consent against the specific purpose it was given for, and honor withdrawals across the systems that rely on it.
