Maintain a living record of processing activities so you always know what personal data you hold, where it lives, who it is shared with, and on what legal basis. Author privacy and data-protection impact assessments, route them for sign-off, and log breaches with the notification timing regulators expect, so an audit or a regulator inquiry becomes a report you can pull rather than a fire drill.
domains.business_logic: Data-inventory discovery (scanning sources to map personal data) is the irreducible kernel; the workflow side (DSR, consent) is declarative.

domains.description: Channel partner portals, deal registration, MDF management, partner training, and indirect-revenue analytics.
domains.catalog_tagline: Run your channel program end to end: recruit and tier partners, register and protect joint deals, fund partner-led marketing, and score partner performance against revenue and growth targets.
domains.catalog_description: Partner Relationship Management runs the indirect-revenue motion on one surface. Onboard channel partners into tiered programs, give them a branded portal with role-based access, and operate the day-to-day workflows that hold a channel program together. Register and protect joint deals with conflict resolution when two partners chase the same prospect. Fund partner-led marketing through market development requests and claims with proof of spend, plus co-op fund accrual. Enroll partners in training and track certifications so the right partners stay enabled. Score every partner each quarter on revenue, growth, certification compliance, and fund utilization, then run quarterly business reviews against a shared joint plan. Track partner-influenced pipeline and surface co-sell signals so the team knows where a partner already has the account. Built for channel and partner teams, with clean handoffs to marketing for through-channel campaigns, to finance for fund settlement and partner-channel commissions, and to your CRM for registered opportunities and qualified partner referrals.

domains.description: Event-log-driven discovery, conformance, and enhancement of business processes.
domains.catalog_tagline: See how your business processes actually run: pull event logs from your ERP, CRM, and case systems, discover the real workflow, and pinpoint the bottlenecks, deviations, and rework that slow it down.
domains.catalog_description:
Process Mining turns the timestamps your systems already record into an honest picture of how work really flows. Pull event logs out of the source systems, validate them, and let discovery algorithms reconstruct the actual end-to-end process instead of the one drawn on a whiteboard.

From there the work is to find what to fix. Conformance checking compares the real flow against the reference model and flags every deviation, missing step, and out-of-order trace, with severity and root cause, so audit and operations teams can act on it. Variant analysis groups the distinct paths a process takes and shows which ones cost the most time, while bottleneck findings surface the high-wait steps and queue points that throttle throughput.

The output feeds the rest of the operation: discovered models and detected deviations flow to process design and automation teams, and the control logic mined from the logs is routed for analyst review and codification. The result is a defensible, evidence-based view of where each process leaks value and what it is worth to fix.
domains.business_logic: Event-log algorithms (alpha miner, heuristic miner, inductive miner), conformance checking, and performance analysis — academic algorithms made commercial.

domains.description: Durable execution and runtime orchestration of long-running business processes: an engine that deploys executable process definitions (BPMN and code-first), runs each as a stateful, fault-tolerant process instance with automatic retries, timers, signals, and compensation, drives human-task inboxes and case handling, and evaluates decision tables (DMN) at runtime. The market spans developer-centric durable-execution engines (Camunda, Temporal, Orkes Conductor, Flowable) and the orchestration runtimes inside Business Orchestration and Automation Technology suites. Distinct from Low-Code Application Platform (LCAP, which builds and deploys apps), Business Process Architecture (BPA, which models and publishes process blueprints), Robotic Process Automation (RPA, which drives UIs), and Process Mining (PROC-MIN, which analyzes the event logs this engine emits). This is the successor runtime category to the retired intelligent business process management suite market.
domains.catalog_tagline: Run your long-running business processes as durable, auditable workflows that never lose their place.
domains.catalog_description: Turn a process model into a running engine. Deploy each process definition, then launch instances that survive restarts, retry failed steps automatically, wait on timers and external events, and pick up exactly where they left off. Route the human steps to the right people's inboxes, manage flexible cases that do not follow a fixed path, and evaluate your decision tables in real time so the rules live in one place. Every step is recorded, so you always know which instances are running, stuck, or done, and you can prove what happened and when.
domains.business_logic: Durable state-machine execution: a persistent process-instance engine that advances tokens through BPMN gateways, handles timers, message and signal correlation, parallel and compensating branches, retry and backoff on failed jobs, and at-least-once job dispatch to distributed task workers. Plus a DMN decision engine evaluating hit policies over decision tables at runtime. These are general-purpose execution semantics that go well beyond declarative CRUD.

domains.description: Product discovery, customer-feedback aggregation, feature prioritization, roadmap planning, and release management for software products. Distinct from Strategic Portfolio Management (investment selection) and engineering issue tracking (delivery execution).
domains.catalog_tagline: Turn customer signals into a prioritized roadmap and ship features your users actually asked for.
domains.catalog_description: Capture feedback and feature requests, weigh them against business value, and decide what to build next. Plan releases, publish a roadmap your stakeholders can trust, and run beta programs to validate ahead of general availability. Track adoption and product metrics after launch so every release closes the loop back to the customers who shaped it.
domains.business_logic: Feedback aggregation and clustering, RICE / value-vs-effort scoring, dependency-aware release timeline computation.

domains.description: Application, review, issuance, inspection, and renewal of licenses and permits for governments.
domains.catalog_tagline: Take permit and license applications, issue and renew them, schedule inspections, enforce code, and bill regulatory fees in one civic-services workflow.
domains.catalog_description: Run the full licensing and permitting lifecycle for a government agency from a single workflow. Applicants submit permits and license applications, staff review and route them, and approved records are issued, tracked, and renewed on schedule. Field inspectors work scheduled inspections against each permit, and failed inspections open code-enforcement cases that carry through contest and resolution. Regulatory fees are assessed at each gated step and handed to finance for collection, while constituents follow their case from submission to approval. The result is faster turnaround, a defensible audit trail on every decision, and one connected record of every license, permit, inspection, and fee an agency manages.

domains.description: Resource planning and allocation, project accounting, project time and expense, project billing, and utilization tracking for services organizations.
domains.catalog_tagline: Run client work profitably from sold engagement to recognized revenue.
domains.catalog_description: Plan and staff billable engagements, track every hour and expense against the right project, and turn delivered work into invoices and recognized revenue. You get one connected place to scope projects, match the right people to the work, watch utilization and margin in real time, and bill milestones or time and materials with confidence. Forecast demand against available capacity, flag at-risk projects before they slip, and keep finance, delivery, and resourcing working from the same numbers.
domains.business_logic: Resource scheduling and revenue recognition (percentage-of-completion, milestone billing), calc-heavy but bounded.

domains.domain_name: Real Estate Brokerage and Agent Operations
domains.description: Lead capture, transaction management (offer→close), MLS syndication, commission splits, tour scheduling, and broker CRM for residential and commercial brokerages. Buyer is the brokerage / individual agent (per-seat pricing) or the franchise (enterprise pricing). Distinct from generic CRM (deal model is the property transaction, not the sales opportunity; commissions are split across cooperating brokerages by MLS rules).
domains.catalog_tagline: Run the brokerage from first lead to closed deal.
domains.catalog_description: Capture and nurture buyer and seller leads, publish listings to the MLS, schedule and track tours, and move every offer through escrow, contingencies, and closing. Calculate cooperating-broker and internal agent commission splits, keep state-mandated disclosures complete for compliance, and hand the closed transaction off to property management and accounting. Built for the way agents and brokers actually work a deal, not a generic sales pipeline.
domains.business_logic: Commission-split engines (listing-side vs buyer-side, franchise overrides, agent caps), MLS-rule conformance (timestamps, mandatory fields, photo limits), transaction-document compliance per state (disclosure forms, agency disclosures), brokerage trust-accounting (escrow).

domains.description: CRE leasing pipeline (LOI→executed lease), CAM (common-area-maintenance) reconciliation, rent escalations, stacking plans, market-comp data, and tenant relations for commercial landlords and asset managers (office, retail, industrial, mixed-use). Buyer is the CRE owner/operator or third-party property manager. Distinct from RE-PROP-MGMT (residential lifecycle is operationally different, shorter leases, simpler accounting, no CAM).
domains.catalog_tagline: Manage commercial leases, CAM reconciliations, rent escalations, and stacking plans across office, retail, and industrial portfolios.
domains.catalog_description:
Run the full commercial leasing pipeline in one place. Move deals from letter of intent through negotiation to an executed lease, underwrite tenant credit before signing, and track subleases and assignments as the head lease changes hands. Every lease term, option, and escalation lives in a single record your team can act on.

Reconcile common-area-maintenance charges and recurring rent escalations without the spreadsheet scramble. Build expense pools, apply gross-ups and audit caps, calculate annual escalations, and produce clean reconciliation statements your tenants can trust at year-end.

See your buildings the way asset managers do. Maintain stacking plans that show who occupies every floor, keep building certifications and green ratings current, and use market context to guide renewals, vacancies, and tenant relationships across the portfolio.
domains.business_logic: CAM-reconciliation engines (gross-up, exclusions, audit caps), percentage-rent calculations (sales-driven retail), escalation schedules (CPI, stepped, market-reset), tenant-improvement allowance amortization, free-rent abatement, stacking-plan optimization, rent-roll-to-NOI calculations.

domains.description: Fund accounting (carry, waterfall distributions), investor reporting (capital calls, statements), portfolio valuation (cap rates, DCF, NAV), acquisition underwriting, and NOI/IRR modeling for REITs, RE private-equity funds, and institutional asset managers. Buyer is the REIT or fund manager. Distinct from generic fund-accounting platforms by RE-specific asset modeling (cap rates, rent rolls, property-level cash flow) and partner accounting structures (LP/GP waterfalls).
domains.business_logic: Waterfall distribution calculations (preferred return, catch-up, carried interest tiers), capital-call apportionment by LP commitment, DCF valuation with cap-rate sensitivity, NOI normalization (one-time vs recurring), portfolio rollup with currency/entity translation, GAAP/IFRS lease-accounting at fund level.

domains.description: Tenant screening, rent collection, maintenance-request portal, leasing pipeline, vacancy marketing, and per-property general ledger for residential landlords (single-family-rental managers, multifamily operators, condo/HOA management). Buyer is the property-management firm or self-managing landlord. Distinct from REAL-EST/IWMS (corporate-tenant view); this is the landlord-of-residential-units view.
domains.catalog_tagline: Collect rent, screen tenants, dispatch maintenance, and account for each property, all in one residential-management platform.
domains.catalog_description: Run a residential portfolio (single-family rentals, multifamily buildings, condo associations) end to end. Market vacant units to listing sites, screen applicants against credit, criminal, and eviction history, draft and sign leases, collect rent (with prorations, late fees, and security-deposit accounting), and handle maintenance requests with vendor or in-house teams. Per-property general ledger feeds owner distributions and investor reporting, with built-in compliance for the Fair Housing Act, FCRA-regulated screening, and state-by-state landlord-tenant statutes.
domains.business_logic: Prorated rent calculation (move-in/move-out), late-fee assessment per lease terms, rent-escalation schedules (CPI, fixed %), security-deposit accounting (state-by-state holding-period rules), tenant-screening score composition (credit + criminal + eviction history), eviction-process timing per jurisdiction.

domains.description: Umbrella for corporate real-estate, workplace optimization, facilities management, and building operations. Two market tiers: IWMS (enterprise) and CAFM (mid-market) — modeled as sub-domains via parent_domain_id. Covers properties, leases, spaces, occupancy, maintenance, capital projects, and utility consumption (Scope 1+2 emissions source for ESG).
domains.business_logic: Space-allocation algorithms (occupancy optimization); utility-consumption analytics; lease-cost modeling and amortization (ASC 842 / IFRS 16); capital-project lifecycle workflows.

domains.domain_name: Real Estate Agent (solo / small firm bundle)
domains.description: Solo-agent and small-firm persona bundle. Single-install deployable for individual real estate agents covering lead capture and contact relationships (CRM-LEAD-MGT, CRM-ACCT-MGT), listing creation and MLS syndication, tour scheduling, transaction execution, disclosure handling (RE-BROK-AGENT-OPS), and contract reference (CLM-REPOSITORY). One module to install; larger brokerages deploy the underlying full modules and skip the starter.
domains.catalog_tagline: A working surface for the real-estate agent.
domains.catalog_description: Bring contacts, listings, and the documents behind each deal into one agent-facing workspace. Move leads forward, keep listing and transaction paperwork organized, and stay on top of every active deal from a single view that travels with the agent across the systems they already use.

domains.description: Attended (technician-initiated with end-user present) and unattended remote control of workstations and servers, with session recording, file transfer, privilege elevation, and NAT-traversal relay. Distinct from VDI (full virtual desktops), VPN (network-layer tunneling), and PAM (privileged-access management with credential vaulting).
domains.catalog_tagline: Take control of any workstation or server, with the privilege, recording, and file-transfer controls your auditors expect.
domains.catalog_description:
Connect to attended and unattended endpoints and operate them as if you were sitting in front of them. Start a session with end-user consent or reach an always-on device, traverse firewalls and NAT without opening inbound ports, transfer files both ways, and elevate to administrator rights only when the work demands it.

Every session is recorded and audited, so you can prove who did what, on which machine, and when. Retain that evidence for as long as your policy or regulator requires, and hand the right details to your service desk, billing, or compliance team automatically when the session ends.
domains.business_logic: Pixel-level remote desktop protocols over WebRTC and proprietary transports, NAT-traversal and relay infrastructure, end-to-end session encryption, multi-platform input injection (Windows/macOS/Linux/mobile), just-in-time privilege elevation, session recording and audit trails, concurrent-session brokering.

domains.description: Task management, labor scheduling, and store-associate workflows for retail.
domains.catalog_tagline: Run the store floor: dispatch daily tasks, audit execution, and staff the right hours in the right places.
domains.catalog_description:
Retail Store Operations is the daily operating rhythm of the sales floor. It pushes the work that has to happen in every store down to the right associate at the right time: shelf stocking, planogram resets, zone cleaning, opening and closing checklists, and safety walks, then tracks completion so district and store managers can see, store by store, whether the plan actually got done.

The same workflow runs the controls that keep a fleet of stores consistent. Operational and compliance audits, planogram compliance checks with photo evidence, and mystery-shopper assessments turn the in-store experience into scored, remediable records, while labor scheduling matches associate availability and coverage bands to forecasted demand so no shift is over- or under-staffed.

The payoff is execution you can prove: consistent merchandising and service across every location, fewer compliance and shrink gaps, and frontline accountability that holds up. The domain feeds completed tasks and published schedules into workforce time and labor, opens coaching and service follow-ups from audit and mystery-shopper findings, and escalates overdue checklists so nothing on the floor quietly falls through.

domains.description: AI-driven analytics on sales activity, deal signals, and customer conversations to produce pipeline health, forecast accuracy, deal scoring, and rep coaching insights. Combines conversation intelligence (call/email recording and transcription) with auto-activity capture and revenue forecasting. Distinct from SALES-ENG (outbound cadence execution) and CRM (system-of-record for opportunities).
domains.catalog_tagline: See every deal the way your best rep would. AI-driven pipeline analysis, deal scoring, and revenue forecasts from your team's calls, emails, and CRM activity.
domains.catalog_description:
Revenue Intelligence reads the signals your sales team generates every day, calls, emails, meetings, opportunity updates, and turns them into deal-level risk scores and an accurate roll-up forecast. Instead of reps hand-rolling pipeline reports, the system tells managers which deals are slipping, which are progressing on schedule, and where coaching attention pays off.

Conversation intelligence transcribes and tags every recorded call, surfacing competitor mentions, pricing objections, and next-step commitments. Auto-activity-capture removes the data-entry tax on reps and keeps the CRM clean. Coaching workflows close the loop, replaying calls against your playbook so enablement can spot patterns across the team.

Built for sales managers, RevOps, and enablement, sitting alongside your CRM rather than replacing it. Forecast accuracy is the headline metric; deal-coverage ratios and rep ramp velocity follow.
domains.business_logic: Conversation transcription and topic extraction, deal-risk scoring from activity signals, forecast roll-up models over CRM.

domains.description: Agent-based monitoring, patching, scripting, and automation of distributed Windows/Mac/Linux endpoints and servers across multi-tenant customer estates. Sold to MSPs (per-endpoint pricing) and increasingly to internal IT departments (per-technician pricing). Distinct from ITOM (no full-stack APM/infrastructure observability), UEM (limited mobile/MDM coverage), and ITSM (no human-process workflow engine).
domains.catalog_tagline: Keep every laptop, server, and device healthy, patched, and secure from one place, without sending anyone on-site.
domains.catalog_description: See the live health of every endpoint you manage, get paged the moment something crosses a threshold, and fix it remotely before anyone files a ticket. Push operating-system and third-party patches on a schedule that respects maintenance windows, and run trusted scripts across hundreds of machines at once. Whether you run an internal IT team or manage devices for many client organizations, you get a single operational view and the controls to act on it from anywhere.
domains.business_logic: Real-time agent telemetry ingestion at scale, threshold-based alerting with hysteresis and de-duplication, sandboxed script execution across heterogeneous OS (PowerShell, Bash, batch, Python), SNMP/WMI/ICMP network discovery, patch dependency resolution and rollback, agent self-update protocols, multi-tenant data isolation, NAT-traversal for remote control hand-offs.

domains.description: UI-level automation of repetitive, rule-based tasks across legacy and modern applications.
domains.catalog_tagline: Automate repetitive, rule-based work across your existing applications without changing the underlying systems.
domains.catalog_description: Software robots log in to the applications your team already uses and carry out the keystrokes, clicks, and data entry of high-volume manual processes, so people are freed from copy-and-paste work and routine swivel-chair tasks. You design a bot once by recording or mapping the steps of a process, then run it attended at a person's desk or unattended on a schedule. A central control surface deploys bots, queues their work, manages the credentials they use, and keeps a full execution trail of every run. The payoff is faster cycle times, fewer manual errors, and around-the-clock throughput on processes that would otherwise wait for a human, all without the cost and delay of rebuilding or integrating the legacy systems the work touches.
domains.business_logic: Bot execution VM, UI automation (screen scraping, OCR, computer vision), and orchestration runtime — code at every layer.

domains.description: End-to-end procurement workflows from sourcing through purchase order to payment.
domains.catalog_tagline: Run procurement end to end: source suppliers, raise requisitions, issue purchase orders, receive goods, and match invoices in one connected workflow.
domains.catalog_description:
Source-to-Pay is the operational backbone of corporate buying. It tracks the requisition, the purchase order, the goods receipt, and the supplier invoice as one connected chain of records, with approvals, three-way matching, and savings tracking layered on top. Buyers raise requisitions and route them through approval, sourcing managers run RFx events and award contracts, receivers post goods receipts against open orders, and accounts-payable specialists match invoices to orders and receipts before payment is released.

The value is control and speed across the whole buying motion: every dollar of spend is requested, approved, and reconciled against a negotiated price, exceptions are routed instead of stalling the line, and spend categories drive the routing so direct, indirect, services, and tail spend each follow the right path. Teams get a single audit trail from first sourcing event to final payment, fewer maverick purchases, and measurable savings captured at line-item granularity.
domains.business_logic: Tax/compliance determination, savings calculation, and contract-price compliance; the rest is requisition, PO, and invoice workflow.

domains.description: Outbound sales cadences, multi-channel sequencing, dialler, conversation intelligence, and rep productivity. Sits alongside CRM rather than replacing it.
domains.catalog_tagline: Reach more of the right prospects with structured outreach, and turn every call and email into coaching that lifts the whole team.
domains.catalog_description:
Run repeatable outbound motions instead of one-off emails. Build multi-step sequences that mix email, calls, social, and tasks, enroll the right prospects, and let timing and branching rules keep each rep on track so nobody slips through the cracks.

Connect with prospects faster using built-in dialing, tracked email with open and reply visibility, reusable templates, and prospect-facing scheduling that books meetings without the back-and-forth.

Record and transcribe calls and meetings automatically, surface what worked and what stalled, and feed scorecard-driven coaching so managers can ramp new reps quickly and help the whole team sell the way your best reps already do.
domains.business_logic: Conversation intelligence ML (transcription, sentiment, deal-risk signals) and dialler integration; sequencing and outreach are workflow.

domains.description: Territory design, quota allocation, sales-capacity planning, incentive compensation management (ICM), commission calculation, plan modeling, payee statements, and SPIF programs for the sales organization. Code is SALES-PERF rather than the analyst-standard SPM because SPM is already used in this catalog for Strategic Portfolio Management (the IT/agile-delivery flavor). Distinct from COMP-MGMT (broad employee compensation: pay equity, bonus, equity admin) and from EPM (finance-led planning).
domains.catalog_tagline: Plan, allocate, and pay your sales organization. Design territories and quotas, model commission plans, and run accurate commission statements every period.
domains.catalog_description:
Sales Performance Management runs the planning and pay side of your sales motion. Design territories and roll up quotas to match your go-to-market segments, then build commission plans with the rate tables, accelerators, draws, and SPIFs your sales leaders need to motivate the team.

Each period, every credited transaction flows into the engine, calculates commissions per plan, and posts a payee statement your sellers can audit. Sellers raise disputes against statements, finance signs off on commission expense, and the next plan cycle starts with clean territory and quota data.

Built for sales-ops and rev-ops teams who own quota strategy and commission accuracy, with finance partnering on commission expense (ASC 606 amortization) and HR partnering on payee eligibility.
domains.business_logic: Commission calculation engine over complex plan rules, retroactive adjustments, territory crediting, payout reconciliation.

domains.description: Discovery, normalization, entitlement reconciliation, and audit defense for software licenses.
domains.business_logic: Entitlement reconciliation engine (matching deployed installs against complex license metrics): the genuinely hard kernel of SAM.

domains.description: Detection, response, and remediation of security incidents, vulnerabilities, and threats.
domains.catalog_tagline: See the threat, run the response, and close the loop before it becomes a breach.
domains.catalog_description: Bring every security signal into one place so your team can triage alerts, investigate incidents, and coordinate the response from detection through containment and recovery. Correlate activity across your tools, keep a defensible record of what happened and what you did about it, and hit the regulator notification clock when an incident crosses the reporting line. Turn a flood of noise into prioritized cases your analysts can actually work, and shorten the time from first signal to fully contained.
domains.business_logic: Detection rules, correlation, ML-based anomaly detection, and high-volume log analytics — the SIEM/EDR core.

domains.description: Strategy-office software for defining strategic objectives, cascading them through the org, tracking strategic initiatives, running operating cadences (QBRs/MBRs), and maintaining traceability from execution back to strategy. Bought by Chief of Staff / Chief Strategy Officer / Strategy Office, distinct from HR-led Talent Management (performance reviews + goals bundled with HCM), from PMO-led Strategic Portfolio Management (IT/agile portfolio delivery), and from finance-led Enterprise Performance Management (budgeting).
domains.catalog_tagline: Turn strategy into measurable execution your whole organization can see.
domains.catalog_description: Define strategic objectives, cascade them from the boardroom down to team-level goals, and track the initiatives that deliver them. Run a disciplined operating cadence of quarterly and monthly reviews, keep a clear line of sight from daily execution back to strategic intent, and give leaders the rollups they need to course-correct before goals drift.
domains.business_logic: Weighted progress rollup across multi-level strategy hierarchies, AI-generated narrative summaries for executive reviews, anomaly detection on goal drift, and cross-initiative dependency impact analysis.

domains.description: Substrate layer for the worker-skill graph: ingests skill signals from learning, performance, and recruiting; runs inference and gap analysis against curated taxonomies and competency models; serves a canonical skill profile per worker to downstream talent, planning, and intelligence consumers.
domains.catalog_tagline: Give every team one trusted view of who can do what, with a living skills graph that learning, mobility, and planning all read from.
domains.catalog_description:
Build one source of truth for skills across your workforce. Curate a shared skills ontology and competency frameworks, then keep a current skill profile for every worker that other talent processes can rely on.

Let skills surface themselves. Pull signals from learning, performance, and recruiting, infer skills automatically, and combine them with self-ratings, assessments, and peer endorsements so each profile stays accurate without manual upkeep.

Turn skills into decisions. Compare people against role requirements, see where the gaps are, and feed clean skill and gap signals to learning, internal mobility, and workforce planning so the right people get to the right work.
domains.business_logic: Maintains the worker-skill substrate that other HR domains read from and write to: ingests skill signals from learning, performance, and recruiting, runs inference and gap analysis against curated taxonomies and competency models, and serves a canonical skill profile per worker to downstream talent, planning, and intelligence consumers. Goes beyond CRUD by running inference pipelines and proficiency-rollup logic that recompute profile state when contributing signals change.

domains.description: Cross-channel social media publishing, scheduling, engagement (unified inbox), listening, analytics, and influencer/advocacy programs. Distinct from MA (lifecycle marketing automation), CDP (customer data unification), and SALES-ENG (1:1 outbound sales engagement).
domains.catalog_tagline: Plan, publish, and schedule social content across every channel, then manage conversations, monitor brand mentions, and run influencer programs from one place.
domains.catalog_description:
Run your brands whole social presence from a single workspace. Draft posts, route them through approval, and schedule them across all your connected channels with a shared content calendar so teams stay aligned.

Reply to comments and direct messages from a unified inbox, assign conversations to the right person, and never lose track of a customer reaching out on social. Track what people are saying about your brand with listening topics and alerts, so you can catch issues early and act on emerging trends.

Discover and manage creator and influencer relationships from first outreach through active partnership, and tie published content and campaign results back to your broader marketing so you can see what social is actually driving.
domains.business_logic: Social listening sentiment classification, audience clustering, optimal posting-time prediction across channels.

domains.description: Discovery, optimization, lifecycle management, and renewal management for the company's SaaS portfolio. Distinct from classic SAM which focuses on installed software licenses.
domains.catalog_tagline: See every SaaS app your company pays for, cut wasted licenses, and never miss a renewal.
domains.catalog_description: Discover every SaaS application in use, sanctioned or not, see who owns each one, and track real usage against what you pay for. Reclaim idle licenses automatically, run renewals on a schedule instead of in a panic, and give employees a self-service catalog to request the apps they need. One place to manage your whole SaaS portfolio, from first sign-up to final offboarding.
domains.business_logic: Usage analytics and engagement scoring to identify under-utilized licenses; the rest is discovery, contracts, and renewal workflow.

domains.description: Playbook-driven automation of security operations workflows across alerts and case management.
domains.catalog_tagline: Turn your security team's repetitive response steps into automated playbooks so every alert gets handled fast, consistently, and with a full audit trail.
domains.catalog_description:
Give your security operations center a way to respond to alerts at machine speed instead of by hand. Build playbooks that capture how your analysts actually work, enrich an indicator, check it against threat intelligence, isolate a host, disable an account, open a case, and let the platform run those steps automatically the moment a qualifying alert arrives. The repetitive triage that used to consume an analyst's day runs in seconds, and the steps that genuinely need human judgment are the only ones that reach the queue.

Connect the tools you already own so a single response can reach across the stack. Playbooks call out to endpoint, network, identity, email, and ticketing systems through reusable connectors, gather the evidence, take the containment action, and write everything back to a security case so the incident has one timeline from first signal to closure. Analysts work the case, assign tasks, escalate when criteria are met, and track every action against the clock.

Measure and improve the whole response. Every run is recorded, so you can see how often a playbook fires, where it succeeds or fails, and how long containment takes, then tighten mean time to respond release after release. The same record gives leadership and auditors defensible proof that incidents were handled, escalated, and disclosed on time.
domains.business_logic: Playbook DSL runtime that executes orchestrated steps across security tools — the engine IS the product, even if individual steps are declarative.

domains.description: Cross-channel paid social ad campaign orchestration, dynamic creative optimization, ad-set budget reallocation, audience management, and social attribution / incrementality measurement across the Meta, TikTok, LinkedIn, Snapchat, and Pinterest ad platforms. Distinct from SMM (organic social publishing, scheduling, engagement, and listening), from MA (email / SMS lifecycle journeys), and from broader programmatic ad-tech / DSPs. Sits at the paid surface of social: it spends ad budget against social ad accounts, versions and optimizes creative, and ties spend to conversions, where SMM stops at organic reach. Flagship vendors are paid-social pure-plays (Smartly.io, Madgicx, Strike Social, Adsmurai) plus omnichannel performance leaders (Skai).
domains.catalog_tagline: Run paid social across Meta, TikTok, and LinkedIn from one place: orchestrate campaigns, optimize creative, and reallocate budget to what converts.
domains.catalog_description: Manage every paid social campaign across the major ad platforms without living in five ad managers. Structure campaigns, ad sets, and ads against your social ad accounts, build and sync audiences, and push spend where the returns are. Version your creative, let dynamic creative optimization test the combinations, and promote the winners automatically. Watch pacing and performance in real time, reallocate ad-set budgets on a ROAS and pacing signal, and tie spend back to conversions with attribution and incrementality testing so you know what actually drove revenue, not just what the platform reported.
domains.business_logic: Bid and budget optimization across ad sets, dynamic creative optimization (combinatorial generation and performance-weighted selection of creative variants), auto budget reallocation between ad sets on a pacing and ROAS signal, multi-touch attribution and incrementality / conversion-lift modeling, and pacing / anomaly detection on live spend. These are algorithmic decision loops over external ad-platform telemetry rather than declarative CRUD plus state workflow, which is why the JsonLogic-expressible share is moderate.

domains.description: Unified employee-initiated spend across corporate cards, expense reimbursement, vendor bill pay, and pre-spend approval, anchored on real-time card authorization and policy enforcement at the network layer. Distinct from EXPENSE (post-hoc reimbursement / reconciliation of bank-issued cards), S2P (sourcing-led enterprise procurement with three-way-match), and AP-AUTO (invoice OCR + match + payment).
domains.catalog_tagline: Give every team a card, a budget, and clear rules, then see and control company spend in real time.
domains.catalog_description:
Put company money in employees' hands without losing control. Issue corporate cards with built-in limits, route every purchase request through the right approver, and pay vendor bills on time, all under one set of spending rules.

Set policies once and let them enforce themselves: cards decline out-of-policy purchases at the moment of swipe, requests above a threshold wait for sign-off, and high-value authorizations escalate automatically. Finance sees committed and actual spend as it happens instead of weeks later in a reconciliation.

Close the books faster with transactions, approvals, and vendor payments captured as they occur and handed cleanly to expense, accounts payable, and the general ledger.
domains.business_logic: Real-time card-auth decisioning at the payment network (ms-latency decline based on MCC / vendor / amount / time / geography rules); ML-driven merchant categorization and receipt auto-matching; multi-currency FX and treasury netting; bill-pay routing (ACH / wire / card / check) with approval chains; spend anomaly detection.

domains.description: Top-down planning of investments, demand, resources, and agile delivery across portfolios.
domains.catalog_tagline: Plan where the organization invests next, balance demand against capacity, and track the value every initiative actually delivers.
domains.catalog_description:
Strategic Portfolio Management is where leadership decides which initiatives to fund, how to sequence them, and who works on them. Demand requests arrive, get scored on business value and risk, and the strongest candidates become funded initiatives grouped into portfolios that roll up to corporate strategy.

Resource and capacity planning is the engine: every initiative competes for the same people, budget, and time, so allocations are committed against capacity, what-if scenarios are modeled before a commitment is made, and roadmap items are scheduled with their dependencies and contingencies in view.

After the plan is set, the work is to keep it honest. Benefits are tracked against the case that justified each investment, portfolios are rebalanced when priorities shift, and dependency chains surface the blockers that put delivery at risk. The result is a single, defensible view of what the business is doing, why, and whether it is paying off.
domains.business_logic: Resource allocation, capacity what-if, and roadmap scenario modeling are the non-trivial engines; the rest is demand, project, and outcome records.

domains.description: Supplier onboarding, master data, performance, and relationship management.
domains.catalog_tagline: Onboard new suppliers, qualify them against your standards, and monitor performance and risk on one supplier record.
domains.catalog_description:
Run supplier onboarding from invite through KYC, banking, tax, and sanctions checks. Capture insurance, ISO, and SOC certifications with automatic expiry alerts so renewals never lapse.

Score supplier performance against delivery, quality, and SLA targets. Roll KPIs into tiered scorecards your category managers and finance teams share.

Assess supplier risk on financial, ESG, cyber, and operational axes. Escalate elevated scores to governance and procurement for re-qualification or replacement.
domains.business_logic: Supplier scorecard math (KPI roll-ups, weighted ratings), a calc layer over CRUD records.

domains.description: Software market for managing short-term and vacation rental properties: listing setup and distribution across booking channels and online travel agencies, reservation and guest management, dynamic nightly pricing, housekeeping and turnover coordination, and owner trust accounting. Distinct from long-term residential property management (lease-and-tenant shaped) and from hotel property management systems; serves individual hosts, professional short-term rental managers, and hospitality operators.
domains.catalog_tagline: Distribute listings across every booking channel, manage reservations and guests, automate pricing and turnovers, and account for each owner, in one short-term rental platform.
domains.catalog_description: Run a short-term and vacation rental business end to end. Publish and sync listings across the major booking channels from a single calendar, capture reservations and message guests in a unified inbox, and let dynamic pricing set the right nightly rate. Coordinate cleaning and turnovers between checkouts, collect payments, and keep guests and owners informed automatically. Owner trust accounting produces commission-based statements and payouts, with optional lodging-tax remittance and local permit tracking for regulated markets.
domains.business_logic: Dynamic nightly pricing (demand, seasonality, lead-time, and competitor-set rules), availability-calendar reconciliation across channels to prevent double-booking, channel-specific rate and fee mapping (cleaning fees, channel commissions, taxes), owner-statement commission math (management percentage and pass-through expense allocation), and occupancy/lodging-tax calculation and remittance per jurisdiction.

domains.description: Recurring billing, subscription lifecycle (upgrades, downgrades, suspensions), revenue recognition, and dunning for subscription and usage-based business models.
domains.catalog_tagline: Run the full subscription money lifecycle, from sign-up through billing, revenue, and recovery.
domains.catalog_description: Operate recurring revenue end to end. Activate and change subscriptions, generate and issue invoices on a schedule, rate metered usage, recognize revenue under modern accounting standards, and recover failed payments through dunning. Built for teams that need every billing event, state change, and revenue entry to stay auditable and tied to the customer record.
domains.business_logic: Revenue recognition under ASC 606/IFRS 15, proration, dunning logic, usage rating, and tax determination — regulated and irreducible.

domains.description: Buyer-side procurement of outsourced services from a firm under a statement of work: author the SOW, intake proposals, run the engagement, track milestones and deliverables, accept the work, and settle milestone-based invoices. The unit is the engagement and its deliverables from a firm, not an individual contractor as in contingent workforce. References the services firm as a supplier mastered elsewhere, the SOW or master agreement as a contract document mastered in contract lifecycle management, and rate cards where the work is rate-priced; masters the SOW engagement cluster itself.
domains.catalog_tagline: Buy outsourced services under a statement of work (SOW), then track milestones to acceptance and payment.
domains.catalog_description: Procure outsourced services from a firm under a statement of work, not headcount you manage day to day. Author the SOW, take in proposals, and stand up the engagement, then break the work into milestones and deliverables and track each one to acceptance. Settle on what was delivered with milestone-based invoices, handle change orders when scope shifts, and keep a clear record of who accepted what and when. The services firm stays your supplier and the SOW stays your contract; this is where you run the engagement in between.
domains.business_logic: Deliverable and milestone acceptance scoring, services-bid evaluation and supplier matching, and change-order impact assessment sit beyond the declarable CRUD and state-workflow slice.

domains.description: Multi-year strategic capacity planning: target headcount, skills, location, and cost over a 1-5 year horizon, with what-if scenarios (growth, reduction, restructure, geography shift, skill pivot, cost optimization) and labor-market overlay. Distinct from WFM (operational scheduling, time and attendance) and EPM (financial planning) although it produces a cost projection that EPM consumes. Operates upstream of ATS: SWP authorizes hiring (headcount.approved triggers requisition creation), making SWP and ATS co-masters of job_requisitions, the canonical multi-master Signal-1 example.
domains.catalog_tagline: Plan the workforce you will need years ahead: target headcount, skills, locations, and cost, modeled against every what-if.
domains.catalog_description:
Strategic Workforce Planning connects your business plan to the people who will deliver it. Build a multi-year picture of the workforce you need by role, skill, location, and level, then compare it to the workforce you have and see the gap before it becomes a crisis.

Model growth, reduction, restructure, geography shift, skill pivot, and cost-optimization scenarios side by side, overlay live labor-market data, and turn the chosen plan into approved headcount that flows straight into hiring. Project the fully loaded cost of every plan so finance can fold it into the budget, and reconcile plan against actuals as the year unfolds.

Start with demand and supply modeling, then layer in scenario planning, org design, and workforce costing as planning matures from a once-a-year spreadsheet into a continuous discipline.
domains.business_logic: Workforce supply/demand modeling, scenario planning across role taxonomies, skills-gap projection over time.

domains.description: Performance reviews, goals and OKRs, continuous feedback, succession planning, and career development. Often bundled into HCM suites but a strong standalone point-solution market exists.
domains.catalog_tagline: Grow, evaluate, and retain your people with one connected talent practice, from goals and reviews to succession and continuous feedback.
domains.catalog_description:
Run the full talent cycle in one place. Set and track individual goals, run performance reviews with self and manager assessments, and calibrate ratings across teams to keep them fair and consistent.

Spot and develop your future leaders. Place people on a performance-by-potential grid, build succession plans for critical roles, and capture each person's career aspirations so you can match them to internal moves.

Keep the conversation going all year. Capture kudos, one-on-one notes, and requested feedback that feed naturally into the next review, so recognition and coaching never wait for an annual cycle.
domains.business_logic: Calibration math (normalization of ratings across populations) and 9-box placement; otherwise pure forms and workflow.

domains.description: Operations and business support systems for service providers: catalog, order, inventory, billing.
domains.catalog_tagline: Run the commercial and operational backbone of a communications service provider: publish service offers, capture and provision orders, manage subscriptions, bill customers, and resolve service trouble end to end.
domains.catalog_description:
Telecommunications OSS/BSS is where a carrier turns network capability into a sellable, billable, supportable service. Teams define the product and service catalog, take customer orders, orchestrate provisioning across network inventory, activate and change subscriptions, and rate and bill usage, all on a single operational spine. When something breaks, the same spine opens and tracks trouble tickets through to resolution.

Buy into this market when manual order handling, fragmented billing, and disconnected provisioning are slowing time to revenue and frustrating customers. The payoff is faster order-to-activation, accurate convergent charging, fewer revenue leaks, and a clear, auditable trail from offer to invoice to support case.

It connects outward to incident management for service trouble, to finance for invoicing and revenue recognition, and to customer service for subscription changes and care, so the order, the bill, and the support history all stay in sync.
domains.business_logic: Rating engine and online charging system — high-throughput algorithmic kernel; the rest is catalog, order, and customer records.

domains.description: GPS tracking, ELD (electronic logging device) compliance, driver-behavior monitoring (harsh braking, speeding, cornering), video telematics (dashcam), and engine/vehicle sensor data ingestion. The connectivity-and-data layer for fleet operations; foundation for utilization analytics, maintenance triggers, and incident-claims evidence. Distinct from FLEET-MGMT (the workflow layer above) and from generic IoT platforms (this is vehicle-specific hardware-plus-software).
domains.catalog_tagline: See where every vehicle is, how it is driven, and whether it stays compliant, all from one connected view.
domains.catalog_description:
Connect your vehicles and the data flows in on its own: live location, completed trips, idling, geofence crossings, engine health, and driving behavior. You get one place to watch the whole fleet move and to spot the trucks, routes, and drivers that need attention today.

The same connected feed keeps you on the right side of the rules. Hours-of-service logs, video of harsh-driving moments, and per-driver safety scores let you coach proactively, prepare for audits without scrambling, and show insurers a fleet that is measurably safer. Less time chasing paperwork and phone calls, more time running the operation.
domains.business_logic: GPS-trace cleaning and trip-segmentation, ELD HOS calculation per FMCSA rules, driver-behavior-score composition from sensor events, near-miss / collision detection from dashcam AI, geofence event evaluation, IFTA-jurisdiction allocation from GPS traces.

domains.description: Authoring, execution, and tracking of manual and automated software tests.
domains.catalog_tagline: Plan, run, and track every test so releases ship with confidence.
domains.catalog_description: Give your QA and engineering teams one home for the whole testing effort. Author reusable test cases with clear steps and expected results, organize them into suites, and scope each release with a test plan that sets entry and exit criteria. Run manual and automated tests against the environments you target, capture pass, fail, blocked, and skipped outcomes with full logs, and turn failures into tracked defects that flow straight to the developers who own them. Tie every test back to the requirements it verifies so you always know your coverage, see release readiness at a glance, and stop shipping the surprises that erode customer trust.
domains.business_logic: Test runner orchestration (queuing, parallelisation, retry) is engine-like, but the test-management application itself is pure CRUD over cases, runs, and defects.

domains.description: Collection, curation, and operationalisation of indicators and adversary intelligence.
domains.catalog_tagline: Pull threat indicators and adversary intelligence from open and commercial feeds, curate them, then push the high-confidence signals straight into your detection stack.
domains.catalog_description:
Bring every threat indicator your team relies on into one curated catalog. Pull hashes, IP addresses, domains, URLs, and exploited CVEs from open feeds, commercial intelligence providers, and information-sharing communities, then normalize them across STIX, TAXII, and the formats each source uses, deduplicate the overlap, and score what is left by confidence and by how relevant it is to your environment. Track the actors, campaigns, and malware families behind the indicators, map the techniques they use to the MITRE ATT&CK framework, and write finished-intelligence reports your analysts, responders, and leadership can act on.

Turn that catalog into protection. Push high-confidence indicators directly into your SIEM, endpoint tooling, firewalls, and DNS controls for blocking and detection, and record a sighting every time your own telemetry matches a known indicator so you see who is being targeted and where. Manage priority intelligence requirements so collection stays focused on what leadership actually cares about, retract false positives quickly, and share back to the community in formats that respect Traffic Light Protocol handling.

Keep the program defensible. Show coverage against the requirements you set, evidence how indicators flowed from feed to block, and connect threat intelligence to the incidents, vulnerabilities, and risks it informs across the rest of your security operations.
domains.business_logic: Indicator correlation, enrichment pipelines, and adversary attribution: analytic substrate beneath a curation workflow.

domains.description: AI matching and recommendation layer that runs over skill profiles, roles, and opportunities to drive internal mobility, succession readiness, and skills-based hiring decisions. Owns the talent marketplace, the recommendation surfaces, and the audit trail of model inferences; defers person and skill mastership to HCM and SKILLS-MGMT.
domains.catalog_tagline: Match your people to internal opportunities, surface their next best move, and make skills-based talent decisions you can stand behind.
domains.catalog_description:
Open up internal mobility. Post gigs, projects, stretch assignments, and full-time internal roles in one marketplace, then let AI matching put each opportunity in front of the employees who fit it best.

Show every employee their next move. Generate personalized mobility recommendations, fit scores, and projected career paths from each person's skills and aspirations, so growth conversations start with real options instead of guesswork.

Decide with evidence, and keep the receipts. See org-wide skills heatmaps and gaps for workforce planning, and keep an auditable trail of every match and score the models produce so your talent decisions stay defensible.
domains.business_logic: Runs continuous AI matching, scoring, and recommendation workflows over skill profiles, roles, and opportunities to drive internal mobility, succession readiness, and skills-based hiring decisions that pure CRUD HR systems cannot produce. Owns the marketplace, the recommendation surfaces, and the audit trail of model inferences, while deferring person and skill mastership to HCM and SKILLS-MGMT.

domains.description: Onboarding, due diligence, and ongoing risk monitoring of vendors and third parties.
domains.catalog_tagline: Know who you do business with, prove they are safe before you sign, and catch the risks that surface after the contract goes live.
domains.catalog_description:
Third-Party Risk Management runs the full lifecycle of vetting and watching the vendors, suppliers, and service providers your organization depends on. Onboard a new third party, classify it by how critical it is and how much data or access it touches, then run the due diligence the tier demands: security questionnaires, document collection, certification checks, and a clear go or no-go before the contract is signed.

After onboarding, keep watching. Re-assess on a cadence set by the vendor's tier, ingest external security-rating and breach signals, and turn findings into tracked remediation that closes before the next review cycle or contract renewal. Escalate the third parties that drift into higher risk so the right reviewers in procurement, security, and compliance see them in time.

Built to give risk, procurement, and security teams one defensible record of every third party, the evidence behind each decision, and the open issues that still need to close. Maps to the frameworks regulated organizations answer to, including DORA's requirements for an information register of ICT providers and visibility into the subcontracting chain.
domains.business_logic: Risk scoring rules over questionnaire responses; typically rule-driven and expressible in a declarative engine.

domains.description: Software market for managing a corporate travel program end to end: policy-aware sourcing and booking of air, hotel, rail, and ground travel; trip and itinerary management; traveler profiles with loyalty, documents, and preferences; pre-trip approval workflows; and traveler duty-of-care monitoring. Distinct from post-trip expense reimbursement and from card-authorization spend control: this domain owns the pre-trip sourcing, the reservation, the journey, and the safety obligation, then hands the resulting charges and the trip record outward to the expense and spend domains.
domains.catalog_tagline: Book travel within policy, keep every traveler safe, and stay on top of the whole trip from one place.
domains.catalog_description: Shop and book flights, hotels, rail, and cars within your travel policy, route out-of-policy trips for approval, and give travelers self-service booking with their own profiles, loyalty numbers, and saved preferences. Every trip lives in one itinerary you can change, track, and reconcile, and unused tickets are tracked so credits never go to waste. When something goes wrong on the road, see where your travelers are, send alerts, and meet your duty-of-care obligations. Trip charges and records flow straight to expense and spend so finance never has to chase them.
domains.business_logic: Policy-aware shopping and fare-rule evaluation, GDS and NDC inventory arbitration across multiple content sources, pre-trip approval routing with out-of-policy exception handling, unused-ticket credit tracking and reapplication, and real-time duty-of-care risk monitoring that correlates traveler location against destination intelligence to trigger alerts.

domains.description: Modern device management across Windows, macOS, iOS, Android, and ChromeOS, including MDM, configuration, app distribution, and zero-touch provisioning.
domains.business_logic: Policy compiler, device-agent runtime, and OS-specific MDM protocol implementations — code-dominant; admin console is CRUD over policies and groups.

domains.description: Meter-to-cash, outage, work, and asset workflows for electric, gas, and water utilities.
domains.catalog_tagline: Run meter-to-cash, outage response, and field work for electric, gas, and water utilities from one operational backbone.
domains.catalog_description: Operate the full utility service lifecycle in one place: open and manage customer accounts and service connections, capture and validate meter reads, rate and issue bills, and keep cash flowing. When the grid goes down, declare and track outages, dispatch crews, and restore service while keeping customers informed. Plan and execute connect, disconnect, and field work against your network assets, and surface the reliability and revenue signals regulators and operations leaders depend on. Built for the operational reality of electric, gas, and water utilities so teams spend less time stitching systems together and more time keeping the lights, gas, and water on.
domains.business_logic: Meter-to-cash rating, outage prediction and crew dispatch, and demand-response calculations — utility-specific algorithmic kernels.

domains.description: Veterinary-clinic operational platform: animal-patient records, pet-owner relationship management, appointment scheduling (species/exam-type fit), examination notes, vaccination and reminder protocols, drug inventory and controlled-substance ledger, lab-results integration, in-clinic POS, and boarding/grooming scheduling. Buyer is the veterinary clinic or hospital, solo to multi-site. No HIPAA exposure (animals aren't covered entities); DEA Controlled Substances Act applies to e-prescribing modules.
domains.catalog_tagline: Run your whole veterinary practice, from the first appointment to the controlled-substance ledger, in one platform.
domains.catalog_description:
Bring clinical care, the front desk, and the pharmacy together so your team can focus on patients instead of paperwork. Keep animal-patient records, pet-owner relationships, and appointment schedules in one place, and turn preventive-care reminders into recurring visits.

Handle examinations, vaccinations, and diagnostics, bill clients at the point of care, and keep drug inventory and the controlled-substance ledger accurate and inspection-ready. Whether you are a single-doctor clinic or a multi-site hospital, the practice runs on one connected system.
domains.business_logic: Species/breed-specific weight-based drug-dosing calculations, DEA Schedule II–V controlled-substance ledger with reconciliation, preventive-care reminder protocols by species/breed/age, multi-pet household visit consolidation, lab-results trending across visits, boarding/grooming reservation overlap with exam appointments.

domains.description: Pre-registration, check-in, badging, and tracking of physical-site visitors.
domains.catalog_tagline: Pre-register every visitor, check them in fast at the door, and keep a defensible record of who was on-site, when, and why.
domains.catalog_description:
Invite visitors before they arrive and let them fill in their details, accept the agreements your site requires, and get screened ahead of time, so check-in at the front desk is a tap rather than a clipboard. When they walk in, verify them, print or push a badge scoped to where they are allowed to go, and notify their host automatically. Every step is timestamped, so the people watching the lobby always know who is in the building.

The same flow keeps you compliant and ready for an emergency. Non-disclosure acknowledgments and watchlist screening run as part of the visit instead of as a separate chore, host responsibility is recorded against each guest, and a live on-site roster is one click away when the alarm sounds. Sealed audit logs give security, facilities, and compliance teams a single trustworthy trail of every arrival and departure.

domains.description: End-to-end DevOps platforms covering source control, CI/CD, build, test, release, and value-stream analytics.
domains.catalog_tagline: Take code from commit to production on one connected platform, with full visibility into how fast and how reliably your teams ship.
domains.catalog_description:
A value-stream delivery platform brings source control, code review, continuous integration, build and artifact management, and release automation together so engineering teams can move a change from the first commit all the way to a running deployment without stitching together a chain of disconnected tools.

Developers open pull requests, automated pipelines build and test every change, signed artifacts are promoted through environments, and deployments roll out with the controls and rollback safeguards that release and compliance teams expect. Every step is captured as a record, so the path from idea to production is traceable end to end.

On top of that flow sits value-stream analytics: lead time for changes, deployment frequency, change failure rate, and mean time to restore. Engineering leaders use these measures to see where work slows down, prove the impact of process improvements, and keep delivery both fast and safe.
domains.business_logic: CI/CD execution graph runtime, artefact management, and policy enforcement; pipelines and projects are CRUD over this.

domains.description: Software market for measuring end-to-end software delivery flow across a heterogeneous toolchain the platform does not own: value-stream mapping, flow metrics (velocity, time, load, efficiency, distribution), bottleneck and constraint detection, DORA benchmarking, and software-delivery-to-business-outcome alignment. A tool-agnostic overlay that integrates the delivery toolchain to measure it rather than producing its artifacts. Distinct from the value-stream delivery toolchain (which builds and ships software) by measuring across tools it does not own, and from SPM (top-down investment planning) by observing actual flow bottom-up after work happens.
domains.catalog_tagline: See how work really flows across your whole delivery toolchain, and where it gets stuck.
domains.catalog_description: Get one honest view of software delivery across every tool your teams already use. Connect your planning, source, CI/CD, and service tools, map your value streams, and let the platform mirror the work items flowing through them. Measure flow velocity, time, load, efficiency, and distribution, surface the bottlenecks slowing delivery, and benchmark delivery performance with DORA metrics. Tie delivery outcomes back to business investment so leaders can see whether effort is going to new value, defects, or debt. Built as a tool-agnostic layer for organizations running a mixed toolchain that no single delivery platform can measure end to end.
domains.business_logic: Almost entirely derive-and-measure over mirrored upstream work items: flow-metric computation across the value stream, bottleneck and constraint detection, DORA rollups, and feature-vs-defect-vs-debt investment-mix analysis. The genuine declarable CRUD is limited to value-stream definitions, tool-connection configuration, and metric thresholds.

domains.description: Identification, prioritization, and remediation of security vulnerabilities across endpoints, cloud, and applications.
domains.catalog_tagline: Find every weakness across your estate, fix the ones an attacker would actually use first, and prove it stayed fixed.
domains.catalog_description:
Run a closed loop that turns a sprawling, noisy list of security weaknesses into a short list of fixes the right team actually completes. Discover what you own first, from endpoints, servers, and network gear to cloud workloads, containers, web apps, and source code, then scan it continuously so new exposures surface within hours instead of at the next quarterly review. Each scan produces findings tied to a specific asset and a specific vulnerability, deduplicated and tracked through their own lifecycle so a weakness opened today is the same record you confirm, remediate, and verify weeks later.

Not every finding deserves the same urgency, so layer risk on top of raw severity. Combine base severity scores with exploit-prediction signals, known-exploited and actively-attacked intelligence, asset criticality, and exposure to produce a ranked queue that answers the only question that matters at scale: what do we fix this week. Route the winners to the team that owns the fix as remediation work with due dates and ownership, and give the business a governed path to formally accept and time-box the risks it chooses not to fix yet.

Close the loop and keep it auditable. Re-scan to confirm fixes actually landed, reopen anything that regresses, and watch mean-time-to-remediate trend down by asset group, business unit, and severity. Hand auditors defensible evidence that scanning cadence, remediation timelines, and exception approvals meet the obligations that frameworks such as PCI-DSS, FedRAMP, and NIS2 expect, so vulnerability work stops being a spreadsheet fire drill and becomes a measured, repeatable control.
domains.business_logic: Vulnerability scanning engines (network, host, web, container, code), CVE matching, and risk scoring: the algorithmic surface is the product.

domains.description: Editorial workflow, content audit and inventory, accessibility scanning, content quality / brand-voice enforcement, technical SEO governance, broken-link monitoring, and content-lifecycle planning for external / customer-facing web properties. The people-and-process layer over DXP and HCMS. Buyer is Marketing or the Web team. Distinct from INTRANET (internal audience), DXP (the delivery platform), and DAM (the asset store).
domains.catalog_tagline: Govern every page on your public website from one place.
domains.catalog_description: Keep your customer-facing web content accurate, accessible, on-brand, and findable as your site grows. Audit and inventory every page, run accessibility and quality scans, catch broken links and technical SEO issues, and plan editorial work and content refreshes on a clear calendar. Route findings to the right owner, track remediation to completion, and prove conformance when legal or procurement asks. Built for the marketing and web teams who own the site, layered cleanly over your delivery platform and content store.
domains.business_logic: Accessibility (WCAG) scanning and scoring, technical SEO crawling, broken-link detection, brand-voice and content quality scoring.

domains.description: Time and attendance tracking, shift scheduling, absence and leave, labor forecasting, and labor-law compliance for hourly and shift-based workforces.
domains.business_logic: Demand forecasting and workforce-scheduling optimization solvers (mixed-integer programming or heuristics) — the algorithmic core of the product.

domains.description: Task, project, and workflow management for cross-functional work: assignments with owners and due dates, dependencies, statuses, dashboards, automations, and goal/OKR tracking. Bought by PMOs, BizOps, marketing, and any team running structured work that isn't engineering-specific. Distinct from SPM (top-down portfolio investment decision, CIO/EPMO buyer), from PSA (services billing/utilization for revenue-generating projects), and from dedicated software-engineering sprint tooling (developer-specific dev workflow).
domains.catalog_tagline: Run every team's projects, tasks, and goals in one place, from first request to finished work.
domains.catalog_description:
Bring structured work out of scattered spreadsheets and inboxes. Create projects, break them into assignable tasks with owners and due dates, map dependencies, and watch progress on boards, timelines, and dashboards that update as the work moves.

Set team objectives and key results, then connect them to the tasks that move them so progress rolls up automatically. Standardize repeatable work with templates, and let automations handle status changes, reminders, and routing.

Built for operations, marketing, and any team running cross-functional work that needs one shared view of who is doing what, by when.
domains.business_logic: Cross-project resource leveling and capacity calculations; critical-path and dependency scheduling on linked tasks; OKR-to-task progress rollup with weighted contribution; recurring-task generation rules; AI-assisted task summarization, status drafting, and risk flagging.

domains.description: Persistent channel-based messaging, threaded conversations, voice/video huddles, and external collaboration. Distinct from KMS (knowledge artifacts).
domains.catalog_tagline: Bring your teams into shared channels where conversation, calls, and files stay in one place.
domains.catalog_description: Give everyone a persistent home for work conversations. Organize discussion into channels and threads so context never gets lost in a crowded inbox, and let people drop into a voice or video huddle the moment a chat needs a face-to-face. Share files, react, and follow only the conversations that matter to you. When work spans company lines, invite external partners and guests into the right channels with access you control and can revoke at any time. The result is faster decisions, fewer meetings, and a searchable record of how the work actually happened.
domains.business_logic: Message delivery, presence, and search — infrastructure-level, but the application surface (channels, threads, files) is straightforward CRUD.

dataObjects.catalog_description: Outputs of document-type classification, capturing the classified type, confidence, model version, and timestamp.

dataObjects.description: A computed delivery-performance benchmark (deployment frequency, lead time for changes, change failure rate, time to restore) for a value stream.
dataObjects.catalog_description: Delivery-performance benchmarks for a value stream: deployment frequency, lead time, change failure rate, and time to restore.

dataObjects.description: Litigation data request (internal or from external counsel): matter reference, scope (custodians, date range, keywords), requested record types, production timeline, chain-of-custody.
dataObjects.catalog_description: Litigation data requests with matter reference, scope, requested record types, production timeline, and chain of custody.

dataObjects.description: An occupational risk assessment such as a job hazard analysis or job safety analysis that scores the likelihood and consequence of identified hazards and assigns controls.
dataObjects.catalog_description: Occupational risk assessments that score the likelihood and consequence of identified hazards and assign controls.

dataObjects.description: Physical fact of Scope 1, 2, or 3 GHG emissions from a facility, activity, or supply-chain tier; CO2-equivalents with timestamp and source.
dataObjects.catalog_description: Recorded greenhouse gas emissions from a facility, activity, or supply-chain tier, in carbon-dioxide equivalents with timestamp and source.

dataObjects.description: Status-history entries tracking an order as it moves through ordered, pending, in progress, completed, and disputed states over time.

Revision records on an engineering part (rev A, B, C). Each released revision is a frozen snapshot of the part's attributes, BOM, and CAD references; engineering change orders are the only mechanism that mints a new released revision.
dataObjects.catalog_description: Released revisions of an engineering part, each a frozen snapshot of attributes, BOM, and CAD references minted only by a change order.

dataObjects.description: RSU, option, or PSU award tied to a vesting schedule. Carries grant date, type, share count, strike (if option), vesting cadence, performance metrics, and forfeiture rules. Integrates with external equity-administration platforms.
dataObjects.catalog_description: Equity awards such as restricted stock units, options, and performance units, with grant terms, vesting schedule, and forfeiture rules.

dataObjects.description: Per-employee portal account in the equity-administration product. Embedded_masters equity_grants for portal visibility.
dataObjects.catalog_description: Per-employee portal accounts in the equity-administration system, giving each employee visibility into their equity grants.

dataObjects.description: Single resolved employee identity across HCM/Payroll/IGA/T&A sources.
dataObjects.catalog_description: Single resolved employee identity reconciled across HR, payroll, identity, and time-and-attendance sources.

dataObjects.description: The engineering item master: every distinct part number, assembly, or purchased component the engineering organization recognizes. Anchors revisions, BOMs, CAD files, and the downstream item-master feed to ERP and MES.
dataObjects.catalog_description: Distinct parts, assemblies, and components the organization recognizes, anchoring revisions, BOMs, and CAD files.

dataObjects.description: Invitations sent to a candidate to start their portion of a screening order, tracking sent, opened, and completed engagement.

Detected degradation affecting SaaS consumption: slow boot, app crash, unresponsive login, network disconnect, proxy/firewall block, VPN drop, USB mount failure. Source agent telemetry, severity, affected user count, business-app association.
dataObjects.catalog_description: Detected degradations affecting app usage, such as slow boot, crashes, login failures, network drops, or VPN issues, with severity and affected users.

dataObjects.description: Workflow records gating discount authority: approver (manager / finance / sales-ops), accept/reject.
dataObjects.catalog_description: Workflow records gating discount authority, capturing the approver and the accept or reject decision.

A discovery job execution: scope (subnet, cloud account, k8s cluster, AD forest), credentials used, start/end timestamps, candidates emitted, errors encountered.
dataObjects.catalog_description: Records of a discovery job run, covering scope, credentials used, start and end times, candidates emitted, and errors encountered.

dataObjects.description: Data-protection-officer training acknowledgment record (GDPR Art. 39).
dataObjects.catalog_description: Records confirming that data protection officers completed required training, evidencing GDPR compliance.

dataObjects.description: Contractual thresholds: max % null, max duplicate rate, max rule-breach count per day, incident response time.
dataObjects.catalog_description: Agreed data quality thresholds, such as maximum null rate, duplicate rate, and incident response time.

dataObjects.description: Pre-employment drug test or occupational health screening ordered as a check distinct from the criminal and employment background check.
