dataObjects.catalog_description: Pre-employment drug tests and occupational health screenings, tracking the order, provider, result, and any adverse-finding review. Holds sensitive medical data subject to legal restrictions.

dataObjects.description: A request to launch a dry-stacked vessel for use and return it to its rack, scheduled against forklift capacity.
dataObjects.catalog_description: Requests to launch a dry-stacked vessel for use and return it to its rack, scheduled against forklift capacity.

dataObjects.description: ML-derived behavioral deviation on a device: CPU spike during login, memory leak, unexpected network egress, certificate validation failure, impossible-travel pattern. Scored, triaged, feeds InfoSec dashboards.
dataObjects.catalog_description: Behavioral deviations on a device flagged by analytics, such as unexpected network egress or impossible-travel patterns, scored and triaged.

dataObjects.description: Formal engagement letter or proposal between professional-services firm and client: scope of work, fee structure, retention period, e-signature evidence, retainer-payment receipt. Used by legal, accounting, and consulting practices.
dataObjects.catalog_description: Formal engagement letters or proposals between a services firm and a client, covering scope, fees, retention, and e-signature evidence.

dataObjects.description: Employee engagement, pulse, and sentiment survey responses. Mastered by PA (or by a specialized engagement-platform when used). Drives segment-level engagement scoring and intervention triggers.
dataObjects.catalog_description: Employee engagement, pulse, and sentiment survey responses, used to score engagement and trigger interventions.

dataObjects.description: Engineering Change Order (ECO) master. Captures the proposed change, impact analysis (where-used traversal), CAB approval routing, effective date, and the set of affected parts / BOMs / drawings. Frozen on submission; only the CAB can override after that.
dataObjects.catalog_description: Engineering change orders capturing a proposed change, impact analysis, approval routing, effective date, and the affected parts, BOMs, and drawings.

dataObjects.description: System, software, and hardware requirements with parent-child decomposition (system → subsystem → component requirements). Carries verification method (test / inspection / analysis / demonstration), allocated subsystem, and traceability links to test cases (via the existing requirements_to_test_traceability junction).
dataObjects.catalog_description: System, software, and hardware requirements with parent-child decomposition, verification method, allocated subsystem, and links to test cases.

dataObjects.description: Timeline view of features grouped by release, product, or theme. Marquee PROD-MGMT capability.
dataObjects.catalog_description: Timeline views of planned features grouped by release, product, or theme.

dataObjects.description: File pinned or shared at channel level (not per-message): file_id, channel_id, shared_by_user, shared_at, expiry_policy, access_permissions. Distinct from KMS authored knowledge.
dataObjects.catalog_description: Files pinned or shared at the channel level rather than on an individual message, with who shared them, access permissions, and expiry.

dataObjects.description: Federated external-user/cross-workspace access invitation: inviting_user, invited_email_or_tenant, status (pending / accepted / revoked), expiry, scope.
dataObjects.catalog_description: Invitations granting external users or other workspaces federated access, with invitee, status, expiry, and scope.
Physical or organizational locations referenced across the system, used to place and group other records.

dataObjects.description: Configurable eligibility rule sets that map screening results to pass, fail, or review outcomes so the same standard applies to every candidate.
Written consents a candidate signs authorizing a consumer report before any screening is ordered, as FCRA requires.

Canonical record of a customer — account (B2B) or end-customer (B2C). Carries identity, segmentation, lifecycle stage, account hierarchy, and pointers to opportunities, cases, subscriptions, and unified profile. The flagship customer-facing entity and the catalog's most multi-mastered row: CRM masters the sales view, CSM the service view, SUB-MGMT the financial view, CDP the unified resolved profile. The structural twin of `employees` on the customer side.
dataObjects.catalog_description: Canonical records of customers, whether business accounts or end consumers, carrying identity, segmentation, lifecycle stage, and account hierarchy.

dataObjects.description: Canonical record of a person currently or formerly employed by the organization. Carries identity (legal name, contact, IDs), employment metadata (start date, end date, employment type, country), and pointers to position, job profile, org unit, manager, and life-event history. The most multi-mastered data object in the catalog: HCM masters the core HR slice, Payroll masters the comp/withholding slice, and IGA masters the identity/access slice. Onboarding, PA, and Talent Management consume or contribute.
dataObjects.catalog_description: Canonical records of people currently or formerly employed, carrying identity, employment metadata, and links to position, manager, and org unit.

dataObjects.description: Zero-touch provisioning credential: token string, QR code, validity window, device-assignment batch, redemption count, expiry. Distributed for device onboarding.
dataObjects.catalog_description: Zero-touch provisioning credentials for device onboarding: token, QR code, validity window, assignment batch, and redemption count.

dataObjects.description: Analytics on actual office occupancy/usage: peak-hour patterns, underutilization zones, utilization rates. Drives real-estate optimization. Distinct from REAL-EST `occupancy_records` (operational).
dataObjects.catalog_description: Reports on actual office occupancy and usage, covering peak patterns, underutilized zones, and utilization rates to guide space optimization.

dataObjects.description: Projected need for specific roles derived from the capacity model: which positions, when, where, at what level. Feeds the requisition pipeline — approved demand becomes an authorized requisition in ATS via the headcount.approved handoff.
dataObjects.catalog_description: Projected need for specific roles derived from the capacity model: which positions, when, where, and at what level, feeding the requisition pipeline.

dataObjects.description: Employee survey/feedback on office experience: comfort, amenities, satisfaction. Informs workplace strategy and EX improvements.
dataObjects.catalog_description: Employee survey feedback on office experience, covering comfort, amenities, and satisfaction, informing workplace strategy.

dataObjects.description: Connection metadata to downstream targets: auth, batch/stream mode, upsert keys, schema enforcement rules.
dataObjects.catalog_description: Connection metadata for downstream data targets: authentication, batch or stream mode, upsert keys, and schema enforcement rules.

dataObjects.description: EEOC Green-factor assessments weighing the nature of an offense, time elapsed, and job relevance before a record disqualifies a candidate.
Jurisdiction-aware fair-chance checks that enforce when and how criminal history may be considered under state and local ban-the-box laws.

The merchandising-master record for a sellable SKU as PIM models it: a hub of attributes, descriptions, variants, categorizations, translations, digital assets, and channel-specific overrides. Distinct from B2C-COMM commerce_products (storefront runtime view) and PLM engineering_parts (engineering record). Authoritative for marketing / catalog content; consumed by commerce, inventory, CPQ, and marketplaces.
dataObjects.catalog_description: Merchandising master records for sellable products, hubs of attributes, descriptions, variants, categories, translations, and assets consumed across channels.

dataObjects.description: Specific size / color / locale / pack-size variant of a parent PIM product. Each variant has its own SKU, can have its own publish state, and inherits attribute defaults from the parent.
dataObjects.catalog_description: Specific size, color, or pack-size variants of a parent product, each with its own SKU and publish state, inheriting attribute defaults from the parent.

dataObjects.description: An e-signature transaction wrapping one or more signature requests against a contract or document. Lifecycle: created → sent → in_progress → completed (or declined / voided / expired). Distinct from CLM's signature_records (the legal-side authoritative record of signed agreements); ESIGN's envelopes capture the e-sign-platform lifecycle while CLM consumes the completed result.
dataObjects.catalog_description: E-signature transactions wrapping one or more signature requests against a document, tracked from created through completed, declined, or voided.

dataObjects.description: E-signature envelope: signing audit trail, IP addresses, external e-signature provider envelope and document reference IDs, and the signed PDF artifact. Distinct from contracts, one contract may have many signature events (counterpart, amendment, renewal).
dataObjects.catalog_description: E-signature envelopes with signing audit trail, IP addresses, provider references, and the signed document, one contract may have many.

dataObjects.description: Discrete billing trigger inside a project: milestone definition, amount, trigger condition, status. Drives revenue recognition and customer invoicing on fixed-fee engagements.
dataObjects.catalog_description: Discrete billing triggers within a project, with amount, trigger condition, and status, driving revenue recognition and invoicing on fixed-fee work.

dataObjects.description: Verifications that a candidate is who they claim to be, validating identity documents and biographic data before and during the engagement.
Client-facing engagement: scope, contract, start/end, billing type (T&M / fixed_fee / milestone / retainer), revenue recognition method, project manager, billing entity.
dataObjects.catalog_description: Client-facing engagements with scope, contract, dates, billing type, revenue-recognition method, and assigned project manager.

dataObjects.description: Taxonomy of HR ask types (Pay, Benefits, Leave, Policy, Time, Compensation, Performance, Employee Relations, Compliance). Drives routing, SLA, knowledge-article lookup, and trend analytics.
dataObjects.catalog_description: Taxonomy of HR request types such as pay, benefits, leave, and policy, driving routing, SLAs, knowledge lookup, and trend analytics.

dataObjects.description: Canonical contract record: counterparty / supplier, contract type (MSA, SOW, NDA, DPA, subscription, lease), effective and expiry dates, total value, governing law, status (draft, in-negotiation, signed, active, expired, terminated). The most multi-mastered SaaS-related object — CLM owns the document, S2P and SMP contribute context.
dataObjects.catalog_description: Contracts with counterparties or suppliers, covering type, value, key dates, governing law, and lifecycle from draft to terminated.

dataObjects.description: Ongoing subscriptions that keep a worker under post-hire monitoring so new records surface as alerts instead of waiting for the next rescreen.
Worker-to-project allocation with role, bill rate, cost rate, planned hours, period. Drives utilization and resource-availability reporting.
dataObjects.catalog_description: Allocations of a worker to a project, with role, bill rate, cost rate, planned hours, and period, driving utilization and availability reporting.

dataObjects.description: Alerts raised against a monitoring subscription when a new criminal record surfaces for a monitored worker, queued for review and adjudication.
Periodic re-runs of a screening package for an existing worker to refresh clearance on a schedule the role or policy sets.
Screenings of candidates and records outside the United States, handling country-specific sources, consent, and lawful-basis requirements.

Individual business application in the enterprise portfolio (custom-built, on-prem, SaaS, hybrid) with owner, criticality, lifecycle state, vendor/platform, strategic value. Distinct from ATS `applications` (job-submission). APM's flagship entity.
dataObjects.catalog_description: Business applications in the enterprise portfolio, with owner, criticality, lifecycle state, hosting model, and strategic value.

dataObjects.description: Record of paperwork collected from a new hire as part of the journey: I-9, NDA, handbook acknowledgment, direct-deposit form, country-specific tax forms, country-specific work-permit evidence. Captures signature state, external e-signature envelope reference ids, and audit metadata. Distinct from the canonical document templates, which would be mastered by a Document Management domain (not yet in catalog).
dataObjects.catalog_description: Paperwork collected from a new hire during onboarding, such as tax and eligibility forms, with signature state and e-signature envelope references.

dataObjects.description: KPI tracked over time per product (adoption %, NPS, DAU, feature usage, churn risk).
dataObjects.catalog_description: Product key performance indicators tracked over time, such as adoption, retention, usage, and churn risk.

dataObjects.description: Rolling forecast records (typically monthly or quarterly refresh): updated view of expected revenue, cost, and headcount given current actuals. Distinct from the static budget. Refreshing forecasts upstream of SWP triggers workforce plan re-alignment.
dataObjects.catalog_description: Rolling forecasts that refresh the expected revenue, cost, and headcount view given current actuals, distinct from the static budget.

dataObjects.description: A single publish run of a product (or batch) to a syndication channel. Carries queue position, run status, per-record validation results, and rejection reasons from the destination.
dataObjects.catalog_description: Publish runs that send a product or batch to a syndication channel, with queue position, status, validation results, and rejection reasons.

dataObjects.description: Business-role / entitlement template provisioned into downstream systems — distinct from Semantius platform roles.
dataObjects.catalog_description: Business-role and entitlement templates provisioned into downstream systems.

dataObjects.description: Hierarchical taxonomy node used to classify PIM products. Multiple parallel taxonomies coexist (merchandising tree, channel-specific trees, ERP category tree); each one's tree lives in this table with a parent_category_id self-reference.
dataObjects.catalog_description: Hierarchical taxonomy nodes used to classify products, supporting multiple parallel category trees through a parent self-reference.

dataObjects.description: Capitalized property/plant/equipment record: acquisition date, cost basis, useful life, depreciation method, location, status. Distinct from operational hardware_assets (CMDB/HAM).
dataObjects.catalog_description: Capitalized property, plant, and equipment records, with acquisition date, cost basis, useful life, depreciation method, and location.

dataObjects.description: Locale-keyed string variant of an attribute or description on a PIM product or attribute. Drives multi-language publishing; can be machine-generated, human-translated, or a hybrid pipeline.
dataObjects.catalog_description: Locale-keyed translations of a product attribute or description, driving multi-language publishing through machine, human, or hybrid pipelines.

dataObjects.description: Image, video, 3D model, or document asset tied to one or more PIM products. Carries rights metadata, renditions / derivatives, and CDN-delivery URLs. The DAM slice that lives inside PIM in v1; can be split out to a DAM domain when warranted.
dataObjects.catalog_description: Image, video, 3D model, and document assets tied to products, with rights metadata, renditions, and delivery URLs.

dataObjects.description: Recorded sales call: audio/video, transcript, participants, talk-track / topic / sentiment metadata. Conversation-intelligence tooling attaches this to deals and feeds conversation_intelligence_records downstream.
dataObjects.catalog_description: Recorded sales calls with audio or video, transcript, participants, and topic and sentiment metadata, attached to deals for review.

dataObjects.description: A targeted announcement sent to a frontline audience, with optional mandatory-read requirement, scheduled or supervisor-cascade delivery, and read/acknowledgment tracking.
dataObjects.catalog_description: Targeted announcements sent to frontline audiences, with optional mandatory-read, scheduled delivery, and acknowledgment tracking.

dataObjects.description: External verification result for a candidate (criminal, employment history, education, credit, identity). Status and findings typically returned by an external screening provider.
dataObjects.catalog_description: External verification results for a candidate (criminal, employment, education, credit, identity), with status and findings from a screening provider.

dataObjects.description: Hierarchical taxonomy for catalog browsing and reporting.
dataObjects.catalog_description: Hierarchical taxonomy for browsing and reporting on the course catalog.

dataObjects.description: Hierarchical containment for documents (folders, libraries, nested collections).
dataObjects.catalog_description: Folders, libraries, and nested collections that organize documents into a hierarchy.

dataObjects.description: Customer-owned equipment that the service organization installs and maintains. Carries identity (manufacturer, model, serial), placement (customer_site), and lifecycle state (active, out_of_service, decommissioned). The asset register that work orders are performed against and service contracts cover.
dataObjects.catalog_description: Customer-owned equipment that the service organization installs and maintains, with identity, placement, and lifecycle state, covered by work orders and contracts.

dataObjects.description: Controlled-vocabulary record for a name, subject, organization, or uniform title used as a heading in bibliographic records, supporting consistent retrieval and disambiguation.
dataObjects.catalog_description: Controlled-vocabulary records for names, subjects, organizations, or titles used as headings, supporting consistent retrieval and disambiguation.

dataObjects.description: DXP-local audience cluster for personalization (distinct from CDP `audience_segments` which are behavioral cross-channel).
dataObjects.catalog_description: Audience clusters defined within a digital experience platform for on-site personalization.

dataObjects.description: Monetary charge against a patron account for overdue, lost, or damaged library items, including assessment, payment, and waiver workflow.
dataObjects.catalog_description: Charges against a patron account for overdue, lost, or damaged items, with assessment, payment, and waiver workflow.

dataObjects.description: User-defined container for a no-code-database deployment: a self-contained namespace for tables, views, automations, and access.
dataObjects.catalog_description: User-defined containers for a no-code deployment: a self-contained namespace for tables, views, automations, and access.

dataObjects.description: Style/tone deviation from brand guidelines detected by AI/pattern-matching (unauthorized terminology, off-brand phrasing, regulatory language drift): violation type, recommended fix, detected date.
dataObjects.catalog_description: Deviations from brand guidelines detected automatically, such as off-brand phrasing or unauthorized terms, with violation type and recommended fix.

dataObjects.description: Core app record: name, slug, region, buildpack/runtime, git repo, environment variables, domain bindings.
dataObjects.catalog_description: Core application records on the platform, with name, region, runtime, git repository, environment variables, and domain bindings.

dataObjects.description: Summary of which copies of a bibliographic record exist at a given location, including coverage statements for serials and shelf-location information.
dataObjects.catalog_description: Summaries of which copies of a title exist at a given location, including serial coverage statements and shelf-location information.

dataObjects.description: Physical or digital copy of a work held by the library. One bibliographic record may have many items, each with its own barcode, location, status, and circulation history.
dataObjects.catalog_description: Physical or digital copies of a work held by the library, each with its own barcode, location, status, and circulation history.

dataObjects.description: Circulation transaction recording the loan of a library item to a patron, including due date, renewal history, and return status.
dataObjects.catalog_description: Circulation transactions recording the loan of an item to a patron, with due date, renewal history, and return status.

dataObjects.description: Medium-neutral catalog description of an intellectual work or expression, encoded in MARC21 or BIBFRAME. Covers books, ebooks, periodicals, serials, audio recordings, video, maps, manuscripts, datasets, and any other library material regardless of format.
dataObjects.catalog_description: Catalog descriptions of intellectual works across all formats, from books and periodicals to audio, video, maps, and datasets, encoded in library standards.

dataObjects.description: Cloud object-storage bucket or container holding unstructured data. Lens distinct from CMDB configuration_items (security-posture vs IT-ops topology).
dataObjects.catalog_description: Cloud object-storage buckets or containers holding unstructured data, tracked for security posture.

dataObjects.description: GDPR lawful-basis consent records captured from a candidate before a background screening is run on a non-US (EU/UK) data subject. Distinct from learner-training consent.
dataObjects.catalog_description: GDPR consent records for background screening of non-US candidates, capturing lawful basis, scope, and withdrawal.

dataObjects.description: Partner library or consortium member with which this library participates in resource sharing, including agreement terms, default lending policies, and contact endpoints.
dataObjects.catalog_description: Partner libraries or consortium members for resource sharing, with agreement terms, default lending policies, and contact endpoints.

dataObjects.description: Per-asset or per-asset-class preventive-maintenance template: trigger basis (runtime hours / cycle count / calendar time / meter threshold), task list, frequency, due-date generation rules. Drives EAM `eam_work_orders`. Distinct from FLEET-MAINT `preventive_maintenance_schedules` (vehicle-specific: mileage / engine hours / DTC).
dataObjects.catalog_description: Preventive-maintenance templates per asset or asset class, defining the trigger basis, task list, frequency, and due-date rules that generate work orders.

dataObjects.description: Commitment goal (SBTi, Net Zero, reduction %): target year, baseline year, scope coverage, approval status. Tracked vs actuals.
dataObjects.catalog_description: Sustainability commitment goals, such as net-zero or reduction targets, with target year, baseline, scope coverage, and progress against actuals.

dataObjects.description: Per-shareholder proceeds calculation under an exit_scenario, respecting liquidation preferences, participation rights, conversion economics.
dataObjects.catalog_description: Per-shareholder proceeds calculations under an exit scenario, respecting liquidation preferences, participation rights, and conversion economics.

dataObjects.description: Preventive or corrective maintenance task on a building, facility, or workplace asset (HVAC, lighting, doors, plumbing, janitorial, grounds). REAL-EST-mastered; FSM consumes/contributes via handoff. Distinct from EAM `eam_work_orders` (industrial plant/equipment) and FLEET-MAINT `vehicle_work_orders` (fleet vehicles).
dataObjects.catalog_description: Preventive or corrective maintenance tasks on buildings and workplace assets, such as HVAC, lighting, plumbing, and grounds.

dataObjects.description: Candidate acknowledgment of receipt of the FCRA Summary of Consumer Rights at consent time, prior to a background check. Required by 15 U.S.C. §1681g(c). Captured separately from the consent itself so the disclosure copy and acknowledgment timestamp persist for audit.
dataObjects.catalog_description: Candidate acknowledgments of receiving the summary of consumer rights at consent time, captured separately so the copy and timestamp persist for audit.

dataObjects.description: Per-group TMR (total mixed ration) formulation: ingredients, inclusion %, mixing log; income-over-feed-cost calculation.
dataObjects.catalog_description: Per-group total mixed ration formulations, listing ingredients, inclusion percentages, and mixing logs for feed-cost analysis.

dataObjects.description: Continuous-feedback artifact: kudos, 1-on-1 notes, requested feedback, peer comments. Independent of formal cycle structure; aggregated into performance_reviews summaries.
dataObjects.catalog_description: Continuous feedback such as kudos, one-on-one notes, requested feedback, and peer comments, independent of formal review cycles.

dataObjects.description: Umbrella entity for financial planning artifacts: annual budget, rolling forecast, long-range plan (LRP). Carries planning period, version, approval state, and pointers to the line-item budgets, forecasts, and variances that compose it. Consumes workforce_cost_projections from SWP for the people-cost line.
dataObjects.catalog_description: Umbrella records for financial planning artifacts: annual budget, rolling forecast, and long-range plan, with period, version, and approval state.

dataObjects.description: A reusable template of ordered task items (opening, closing, audit, compliance) instantiated against a location and shift for frontline execution.
dataObjects.catalog_description: Reusable templates of ordered task items (opening, closing, audit, compliance) run against a location and shift by frontline workers.

dataObjects.description: Accounting close cycles for the fund (monthly, quarterly, annual). Drives PCAP statement generation and audit packaging.
dataObjects.catalog_description: Accounting close cycles for a fund (monthly, quarterly, annual) that drive statement generation and audit packaging.

dataObjects.description: End-to-end fund-vehicle setup record: entity formation filings, EIN application, banking onboarding, templated LPA. Unique to emerging-manager bundled platforms.
dataObjects.catalog_description: End-to-end fund-vehicle setup records, covering entity formation filings, tax-ID application, banking onboarding, and partnership agreement.

dataObjects.description: GDPR Article 6 / 7 consent capture for learner training data: purpose, lawful basis, granted timestamp, withdrawal timestamp.
dataObjects.catalog_description: Consent records for learner training data under GDPR, capturing purpose, lawful basis, and grant and withdrawal timestamps.

dataObjects.description: Continuous vehicle location stream (timestamp, lat, lon, speed, heading) — powers heat maps + geofence checks.
dataObjects.catalog_description: Continuous vehicle location stream of timestamp, latitude, longitude, speed, and heading, powering maps and geofence checks.

dataObjects.description: External parties the organization depends on and risk-manages: the broad umbrella inventory record covering suppliers, service providers, processors, and partners, whether or not each is an invoiced supplier.
A manager override applied to a submitted forecast, capturing the changed number and the rationale for the adjustment.
dataObjects.catalog_description: Manager overrides applied to submitted forecasts, capturing the changed number and the reason for the adjustment.

dataObjects.description: GP-side accounting entries against the fund vehicle (contributions, expenses, fee accruals, gain/loss recognitions) with GAAP/IFRS conformance.
dataObjects.catalog_description: General-partner accounting entries against a fund vehicle: contributions, expenses, fee accruals, and gain or loss recognitions.

dataObjects.description: Private-capital fund vehicle (LP/GP partnership structure) with vintage, strategy, target size, and current AUM. The structural backbone every other fund-admin module references.
dataObjects.catalog_description: Private-capital fund vehicles in a partnership structure, with vintage, strategy, target size, and current assets under management.

dataObjects.description: Master record from first notice of loss through adjudication and settlement; P&C and life insurance scope. Carries claim type, loss date, reported date, claimant, adjuster, status (open / in-investigation / settled / closed / litigated), gross/net liability. Scope-qualified to avoid collision with HR claims, warranty claims, healthcare claims.
dataObjects.catalog_description: Insurance claim records from first notice of loss through adjudication and settlement, with claim type, dates, claimant, adjuster, status, and liability.

dataObjects.description: People in the firm's external network: founders, executives, co-investors, advisors, LP-side contacts. Distinct from CRM's customer-side `contacts`. The minimum-embedded-shape is the GDPR-relevant subset every module embedding this record must support.
dataObjects.catalog_description: People in the firm's external network: founders, executives, co-investors, advisors, and limited-partner contacts.

dataObjects.description: Published, candidate-facing version of a requisition on a career site or job board. One requisition can have many postings (per board, language, or region).
dataObjects.catalog_description: Published, candidate-facing versions of a requisition on a career site or job board, one requisition possibly having many postings.

dataObjects.description: Syndication of a job_posting to an external board (LinkedIn, Indeed, ZipRecruiter, Glassdoor, internal mobility portal). Carries board name, post timestamp, expiry, cost, applicant attribution.
dataObjects.catalog_description: Syndications of a job posting to external boards, with board name, post and expiry times, cost, and applicant attribution.

dataObjects.description: Formal employment offer extended to a candidate. Carries compensation components, start date, terms, approval chain, and status (draft / approved / sent / accepted / declined / rescinded).
dataObjects.catalog_description: Formal employment offers extended to candidates, with compensation, start date, terms, approval chain, and status.

dataObjects.catalog_description: Fully-loaded workforce cost forecasts per period by org unit, role, location, and level, built from headcount, compensation bands, and loading factors.

dataObjects.catalog_description: Employee requests for workspace changes such as desk relocation, accommodation needs, or floor reassignment, routed to facilities.

dataObjects.description: Timestamped record of all visitor state transitions (registration / check-in / badge / check-out / escalations): compliance audit trail.
dataObjects.catalog_description: Timestamped audit trail of visitor state transitions such as registration, check-in, badging, and check-out, for compliance.

dataObjects.description: Workflow tasks and to-dos assigned across the supplier-management lifecycle, with assignee, due date, and status.
dataObjects.catalog_description: Tasks and to-dos assigned across the supplier-management lifecycle, with assignee, due date, and status.

dataObjects.catalog_description: Real-time rosters of visitors on-site, correlated with spaces and emergency zones for evacuation and accountability.

dataObjects.description: A scoped, point-in-time assessment or remediation campaign over an asset population, grouping vulnerabilities for a posture snapshot, audit window, or program milestone. Carries scope, time window, and an aggregate posture summary.
dataObjects.catalog_description: Scoped, point-in-time assessments or remediation campaigns over an asset population, grouping vulnerabilities into a posture snapshot with scope, window, and summary.

dataObjects.description: Per-page tracking record across web properties: URL/slug, status (published / draft / retired), last-modified, owner, publish date, review cadence, lifecycle stage. CMS-agnostic counterpart to HCMS `content_entries`.
dataObjects.catalog_description: Per-page tracking records across web properties, with URL, status, last-modified, owner, publish date, review cadence, and lifecycle stage.

dataObjects.description: Email, video, push notification, or SMS sent to a new hire during the journey — pre-boarding nudges, Day-1 schedule, post-Day-1 check-ins, cohort announcements. Carries channel, template, scheduled send time, delivery state, and engagement metrics.
dataObjects.catalog_description: Email, video, push, or SMS messages sent to a new hire during onboarding, with channel, template, scheduled send time, delivery state, and engagement metrics.

dataObjects.description: B2B order from chef / restaurant / co-op / food-hub buyer; per-line pricing tier, packing-list reference, net-30 invoicing.
dataObjects.catalog_description: B2B orders from chef, restaurant, co-op, or food-hub buyers, with per-line pricing tiers, packing-list reference, and net-30 invoicing.

dataObjects.description: A signed liability release and assumption-of-risk agreement tied to a booking and participant, capturing the template, electronic signature, signer (or guardian for a minor), timestamp, and IP, and locking once signed.
dataObjects.catalog_description: Signed liability releases tied to a booking and participant, capturing template, signature, signer, and timestamp.

dataObjects.description: A reusable waiver document definition with custom clauses, questions, and acknowledgements an operator requires for an activity, published for guests to sign.
dataObjects.catalog_description: Reusable waiver definitions with custom clauses, questions, and acknowledgements an operator requires for an activity.

dataObjects.description: The mapping of an activity product to an external online travel agency or reseller channel, holding channel-specific content, the pushed availability, and the commission terms.
dataObjects.catalog_description: Mappings of activity products to online travel agency or reseller channels, with channel content and availability.

dataObjects.description: An online travel agency, agent, or reseller that distributes an operator's products, with contact, payout details, and the marketplace they represent.
dataObjects.catalog_description: Online travel agencies, agents, and resellers that distribute an operator's products, with payout and contact details.

dataObjects.description: The negotiated commercial agreement with a reseller partner: commission or net-rate terms, which products are distributed, and payment settlement rules.
dataObjects.catalog_description: Negotiated agreements with reseller partners, covering commission or net-rate terms and which products are distributed.

modules.description: Distributes products and availability to online travel agencies and reseller marketplaces, manages reseller partners and commission agreements, and syncs channel bookings back to the operator calendar. Optional: many operators sell direct only, so its masters are optional-necessity.
modules.catalog_tagline: List your activities on online travel agencies and reseller marketplaces, and keep availability in sync.
modules.catalog_description: Reach more customers by selling through online travel agencies and reseller partners. Push your products and live availability out to the channels you choose, manage reseller agreements and commission rates, and pull channel bookings back into one calendar so availability stays accurate everywhere. Run it only when you want to grow beyond direct bookings.

modules.description: The core booking engine: products, departures, rate options, bookings, participants, add-ons, promo codes, gift cards, payments, refunds, customers, manifests, notifications, reviews, and reports. Deployable standalone for simple operators; embeds guide/resource assignments and waiver status when those modules are present.
modules.catalog_tagline: Take and manage bookings online and at the counter, with real-time availability, payments, gift cards, and guest messaging.
modules.catalog_description: The heart of your booking operation. Publish products and departures, show live availability, and capture bookings from your website, the phone, or a walk-up counter. Collect payments, sell gift cards, apply promo codes, and process refunds and cancellations. Keep a roster for every departure, message guests automatically, and see how the business is performing. Works on its own for simple operators and pairs with scheduling and waivers when you need them.

modules.description: Schedules the people and equipment behind each departure: bookable resources, guide assignments, equipment rentals, lodging units, and trip itineraries. The adventure and multi-day differentiator; separable so general day-tour operators can run the core without it.
modules.catalog_tagline: Assign guides, equipment, vehicles, and lodging to every trip, and prevent double-booking your resources.
modules.catalog_description: Schedule the people and gear behind each departure. Track guide availability and certifications, auto-assign or hand-pick guides for each trip, and confirm them by text. Manage rentable equipment, vehicles, and rooms as bookable resources so you never double-book a raft, a van, or a bunk. Built for multi-day and guided-adventure operators who sell an experience, not just a seat.

modules.description: Captures and stores signed liability releases tied to bookings and participants, with custom waiver templates, electronic signature, and guardian signing for minors. A clean regulated boundary, often a separately licensed integration in this market.
modules.catalog_tagline: Send, collect, and store signed liability waivers tied to every booking and participant.
modules.catalog_description: Capture the legal paperwork every guest needs to sign before they take part. Build custom waivers with the questions and acknowledgements your activity requires, send them ahead of time, and let guests sign on any device. Handle minors with guardian signatures, and keep every signed release stored against the right booking and participant so it is there if you ever need it.

modules.description: Account-based programmatic advertising: ad targeting, audiences, creatives, placements, spend, and content syndication.
modules.catalog_tagline: Put your ads in front of the buying committee at your target accounts, and prove the spend works.
modules.catalog_description: Run advertising that targets accounts, not cookies. Build ad campaign targets and audiences from your account list, manage creatives and placements across display, social, and content syndication, and allocate spend by account tier. See which accounts you reached and how it moved engagement, so the ad budget goes where the pipeline is, not where the clicks are cheapest.

modules.description: Multichannel orchestration: campaigns, account journeys, playbooks, and engagement audiences. Consumes the ICP and target lists authored in GTM-PLAN.
modules.catalog_tagline: Run the right play for every account, across every channel, from one orchestration brain.
modules.catalog_description: Coordinate the whole account-based motion: build campaigns, define the journey stages accounts move through, run orchestration playbooks, and assemble the audiences each play targets. Pull in the ICP and target account lists your planning team authored and engage against them across ads, web, and outreach. Stop running disconnected campaigns and give every account a coherent, measured journey.

modules.description: Intent capture, account identification, and engagement scoring, plus the consent governance over contact-level signal processing. The signal-ingestion-and-scoring layer vendors lead with.
modules.catalog_tagline: See who is in-market: capture intent, resolve accounts, and score engagement, with consent built in.
modules.catalog_description: Find demand before it raises its hand. Capture first- and third-party intent signals, resolve anonymous traffic to real accounts, and score engagement so sales and marketing know exactly which accounts are heating up. Govern it all with consent records and data-subject requests so contact-level signals are processed lawfully. This is the intelligence layer the rest of your account-based motion runs on.

modules.description: 1:1 account and visitor web personalization: rules, dynamic experiences, and the visitor-to-account resolution that drives them. Carries its own contact-level PII exposure.
modules.catalog_tagline: Show every named account a website built for them, the moment they land.
modules.catalog_description: Make the website speak to each account by name. Resolve who is visiting, then serve personalized experiences, dynamic content, tailored CTAs, and account-specific landing pages, driven by personalization rules tied to firmographics and intent. Turn anonymous traffic from your target accounts into recognized, relevant visits that convert, instead of a one-size-fits-all homepage.

modules.domain_module_name: Client Portal and Time and Billing
modules.description: Secure client portal for document upload and e-signature with client-task-list tracking, plus timekeeper time-entry per engagement, value-billing and hourly options, WIP and AR reporting, and fee-quote-to-invoice workflow. The client-facing surface and the monetization surface of the practice.
modules.catalog_tagline: Give clients a portal and bill for the time your team logs.
modules.catalog_description: Turn logged time entries into client billing and keep clients informed through a secure portal.

modules.description: Per-engagement workflow templates and task assignment across service lines, sign-off checkpoints and partner-review routing, tax-calendar-driven recurring deadlines, and engagement-letter and proposal management with recurring annual re-engagement. Owns the engagement record as the workflow envelope that scopes the work.
modules.catalog_tagline: Scope, staff, and run client engagements from proposal to close.
modules.catalog_description: Open and track every client engagement through its lifecycle, scope the tax returns each engagement covers, and keep the right people notified as work moves forward.

modules.domain_module_name: Tax Return Preparation and Document Retention
modules.description: Tax-return preparation and filing lifecycle (in-prep, review, ready-for-signature, filed, accepted, rejected) and client-folder document storage with preparer retention rules, prior-year carryforward, and classification by year and form type. Publishes return-state transitions to downstream compliance and billing consumers.
modules.catalog_tagline: Prepare, sign, file, and track tax returns to acceptance.
modules.catalog_description: Take returns from preparation through review, e-signature, and filing, then track acceptance or rejection from the taxing authority and manage amendments, with documents retained per retention rules.

modules.description: Creative production lifecycle from the initiating brief through deliverable authoring and multi-stakeholder proofing: brief origination and client approval, deliverable version history, annotated review and approval routing, and final-version registration to the asset library.
modules.catalog_tagline: Take creative from brief to approved deliverable with versioned, annotated proofing and clean asset hand-off.
modules.catalog_description: Originate creative briefs, get them approved by the client, and author deliverables with full version history. Route each version through annotated, multi-stakeholder review and approval so feedback lands in one place instead of scattered email threads. When a deliverable is signed off, register the final version to your asset library so the approved work is always the version that ships.

modules.description: System-of-record for the agency book of business: client jobs with traffic state and deliverable rollup, time capture against client rate cards, retainer agreements with live burn-down, pre-engagement estimating with change orders, cost-plus / markup billing logic, and per-job and per-client profitability rollups.
modules.catalog_tagline: Run every client job from estimate to invoice, with live retainer burn-down and per-job profitability.
modules.catalog_description: Manage your agency's book of business in one place. Open client jobs, track their traffic state and deliverables, and capture time against client rate cards. Build estimates and change orders before work starts, watch retainers draw down in real time, and apply your markup and cost-plus billing rules automatically. See profitability per job and per client the moment time and costs post, then issue invoices without re-keying a thing.

modules.domain_module_name: Media Plan and Insertion Order Management
modules.description: Per-campaign media planning broken down by outlet, channel, daypart, audience, and budget; conversion of approved plans into insertion orders committing budget to media outlets at negotiated rates with commission terms and make-good provisions; reconciliation of orders against media-outlet invoices.
modules.catalog_tagline: Plan campaigns by outlet and channel, commit budget through insertion orders, and reconcile against publisher invoices.
modules.catalog_description: Build media plans broken out by outlet, channel, daypart, audience, and budget, then turn approved plans into insertion orders that commit spend at negotiated rates with commission and make-good terms. When publisher invoices arrive, reconcile them against the orders so posted media costs flow straight to finance. Keep every campaign's planned-versus-actual spend in view from first plan to final reconciliation.

modules.description: The real-time signal-reduction half of AIOps. Ingests high-volume events, alerts, metrics, and traces from the monitoring estate, detects anomalies against learned baselines, correlates and deduplicates related signals into single incidents, and applies suppression rules (including planned-change windows) to cut alert noise. Masters event_correlations, anomaly_detections, and alert_suppression_rules; consumes monitoring_events, monitoring_alerts, distributed_traces, and configuration_items owned by OBS / RMM / CMDB. Used standalone by ops teams that only need noise reduction, or alongside Predictive Intelligence for the full closed loop.
modules.catalog_tagline: Turn a flood of raw events and alerts into a short, correlated, low-noise list of incidents your on-call teams can actually act on.
modules.catalog_description:
Event Correlation sits across the events, alerts, metrics, and traces your IT estate produces every second and uses machine learning to find the few patterns that matter. It detects anomalies against learned baselines, groups related signals into a single correlated incident, and deduplicates the rest so a storm of alerts becomes one clear issue.

Noise reduction is built in: suppression rules silence flapping alerts and mute the estate during planned changes, and those suppression decisions flow straight back to the monitoring layer so the whole operational loop stays in sync. The result is fewer pages, less triage, and an on-call experience focused on real problems instead of alert fatigue.

modules.description: The analytical, forward-looking half of AIOps. Forecasts incidents and capacity problems, elevates predictive signals above action thresholds, infers probable root cause for correlated incidents, and runs the ML training lifecycle (including drift detection) that keeps the detection and prediction models trustworthy. Masters predictive_signals, incident_predictions, root_cause_analyses, and ml_model_training_records; consumes data_pipelines and configuration_items owned by DATA-AI-PLAT / CMDB. Typically deployed alongside Event Correlation, which supplies the correlated incidents that root-cause and prediction reason over.
modules.catalog_tagline: Forecast outages before they hit, surface the probable root cause, and keep the models behind it all trained and trustworthy.
modules.catalog_description:
Predictive Intelligence is the part of AIOps that looks ahead. It detects leading indicators of trouble, elevates high-confidence predictive signals, and forecasts incidents and capacity exhaustion while there is still time to act, opening proactive tickets before users feel the impact.

When an incident does land, it infers the probable root cause from topology, change, and signal evidence so responders start from an answer. Behind the scenes, detection and prediction models are continuously retrained and watched for drift, and completed root-cause findings flow into incident and problem workflows. The result is faster mean time to resolution and a forward-looking view of service health rather than a purely reactive one.

modules.description: The inventory backbone. Masters enterprise_applications, application_interfaces, technology_platforms and business_capability_maps. The first thing a buyer installs: the structured catalog of what's in the application landscape.
modules.catalog_tagline: Keep one reliable inventory of your applications, interfaces, and platforms, with the capabilities they support.
modules.catalog_description:
Capture every application, the interfaces that connect it, and the technology platforms it runs on, then link each one to the business capabilities it supports. Record owners, lifecycle stage, and technical detail so anyone can answer what you run and why.

Drive each application and platform through a clear lifecycle, from planned and emerging to operating, sunsetting, and retired, with the right approvals at each gate. The result is a single source of truth your teams can plan, govern, and report against.

modules.description: The analyst seat. Masters application_costs, application_value_scores and technology_fit_assessments. Once the registry is populated, this module scores it (TIME), bridges to FINOPS for cost, and drives invest/migrate/eliminate decisions.
modules.catalog_tagline: Score your applications on cost, value, and technical fit so you know what to invest in, migrate, or eliminate.
modules.catalog_description:
Turn your application inventory into decisions. Assess each application on what it costs, the business value it delivers, and how well it fits your technology direction, then rank the whole portfolio on a consistent scale.

Use the scores to find redundant, low-value, or aging applications, justify migrations and retirements, and bring a clear, evidence-based recommendation to every portfolio review. Cost and value signals stay current so your invest, migrate, and eliminate calls hold up to scrutiny.

modules.description: Pre-employment background-check orchestration with adverse-action workflow. Coordinates external vendor handoffs and gates offer-to-firm conversion on clearance. Requires an external `send_email` tool for FCRA adverse-action notices.
modules.catalog_tagline: Run compliant background screening with the adverse-action flow built in.
modules.catalog_description:
Order screening packages, track each component to completion, and adjudicate results in one place. The full FCRA flow (disclosures, summary-of-rights acknowledgments, pre-adverse and adverse-action notices, and dispute handling) is modeled as part of the workflow.

Screening is necessity-scoped, so deployments outside FCRA jurisdictions enable only what applies to them.

modules.description: The candidate-relationship backbone of an ATS, masters candidates (including the `prospect` lifecycle state), recruitment sources, agencies, and events. Structurally the same shape as standalone candidate-CRM products. Folds the AI-RECRUIT capability (resume parsing, ML matching, screening assistants) since those tools operate on `candidates` and are tightly bound to candidate workflows.
modules.catalog_tagline: Build and nurture a pipeline of candidates long before a role opens.
modules.catalog_description:
Capture every candidate, source, and recruiter touchpoint in one place. Run nurture campaigns, log interactions, and keep warm relationships ready so you can fill roles from people who already know you.

Consent and data-subject requests are tracked alongside each profile, so candidate privacy is handled as part of the workflow rather than bolted on.

modules.description: Interview scheduling, panel coordination, scorecards, and structured assessments. Realizes INTERVIEW-MGMT. Realizes the `interviewing` lifecycle state on `job_applications` (state pruned when this module is not installed).
modules.catalog_tagline: Run consistent, structured interviews and collect comparable feedback.
modules.catalog_description: Schedule interviews against panel availability, equip interviewers with kits and question banks, and gather scorecards and assessments in a single structured record. Consistent inputs make hiring decisions easier to defend and faster to reach.

modules.description: Offer drafting, approval, extension, signature, and acceptance. Realizes OFFER-MGMT. Realizes the `offer_extended` state on `job_applications`. Requires an external `sign_document` tool, drops module Semantius coverage to ~83%.
modules.catalog_tagline: Generate, approve, and send offers without losing a version.
modules.catalog_description: Draft offers from templates, route them through approval chains, and track every version until acceptance. Generated offer letters stay linked to the offer record, so what was approved is exactly what was sent.

modules.description: The bridge between offer-accepted and start-date: ATS owns the pre-employee lifecycle stage (paperwork in flight, pre-boarding tasks open, background check pending). Realizes the `hired` state on `job_applications`. Publishes the `pre_employee.activated` event that hands the canonical reconciliation to HCM-mastered `employees`. Formerly NEW-HIRE-HANDOFF, renamed per §7.1 because HCM canonically masters `employees`.
modules.catalog_tagline: Hold the new hire's record between offer acceptance and day one.
modules.catalog_description: Once a candidate accepts, the pre-employee record carries their details through the gap before onboarding starts. It is the clean handoff point to onboarding and your HRIS, so a new hire's first day never starts from a blank page.

modules.description: Requisitions → postings → applications with pipeline-stage lifecycle. Realizes REQ-MGMT and CANDIDATE-EXP (application flow slice). Embedded-masters `candidates`, optionally `hcm_positions` and `org_units` for canonical position/org context.
modules.catalog_tagline: Move applicants from requisition to decision on a structured, auditable pipeline.
modules.catalog_description:
Open and approve requisitions, distribute postings, collect applications, and advance candidates through configurable stages, with screening questions, stage transitions, and hiring-team assignments captured as you go.

Applicant-flow and disposition records are built in, so equal-opportunity reporting is a by-product of normal work rather than a separate project.

modules.description: Employee-driven candidate sourcing with referral-bonus tracking (`candidate_referrals`). Embedded-masters `candidates`. Cross-domain handoffs to PAYROLL (bonus payout) and EMP-EXP (engagement signal).
modules.catalog_tagline: Turn your employees into your best sourcing channel.
modules.catalog_description: Let employees submit referrals, track each one through the pipeline, and pay out rewards automatically when a hire sticks. Campaigns and reward tiers keep participation high without manual bookkeeping.

modules.description: Curated candidate groupings for nurture and pipeline-building (`talent_pools`). Embedded-masters `candidates`; deployed alone, materializes a thin candidate shell. Mirrors standalone talent-acquisition CRM products.
modules.catalog_tagline: Group and segment candidates so the right shortlist is one search away.
modules.catalog_description: Organize candidates into pools and segments, tag them by skill or stage, and save the searches you run most. When a requisition opens, your shortlist is already assembled instead of rebuilt from scratch.

modules.description: Sellable-product catalog, storefront presentation, faceted search and discovery, and the promotion / coupon rules engine. Owns the merchandised catalog and the channel storefronts a shopper browses.
modules.catalog_tagline: Build your product catalog and run the storefront that shoppers browse and buy from.
modules.catalog_description: Create and publish products, organize them into a storefront customers can browse, and launch the promotions that move them. Set up catalog content, configure how products appear across your sites, and run coupons and discount campaigns from one place. Keep the catalog accurate and the storefront ready to sell.

modules.description: Fulfillment instruction groups derived from order lines and the shipments that carry them to the customer, including carrier tracking, delivery status, and returns. Hands off to OMS / ERP for distributed fulfillment.
modules.catalog_tagline: Get paid orders picked, packed, and out the door to your customers.
modules.catalog_description: Take confirmed orders through fulfillment and shipping. Create fulfillments from order lines, assign them to a location, and generate shipments with carrier and tracking so customers know their package is on the way. Keep delivery status current from pick to doorstep.

modules.description: Cart persistence, multi-step checkout, order placement and validation, order lines, and payment authorization. Includes headless commerce APIs and B2B purchasing flows (account hierarchies, quote-to-order, requisition lists). The transactional spine from cart to placed order.
modules.catalog_tagline: Turn carts into paid orders and keep every checkout moving.
modules.catalog_description: Guide shoppers from cart to confirmed order: capture the cart, run checkout, take payment, and create the order with its line items. Track each order through its lifecycle, handle refunds when they are needed, and keep payment status in view. Reads the shared customer record so every order ties back to the right shopper.

modules.description: 1094-C / 1095-C reporting, affordability tracking, and ACA penalty avoidance. Consumes benefit_enrollments, employees, and legal_entities to produce IRS-bound filings and monthly affordability snapshots.
modules.catalog_tagline: Stay ahead of ACA reporting and affordability obligations.
modules.catalog_description: Track monthly affordability and coverage offers, generate 1094-C and 1095-C filings, and produce the audit trail that keeps the organization clear of ACA penalties. Pull enrollment, employee, and legal-entity data together so year-end reporting is a confirmation step, not a fire drill.

modules.description: EDI / API connectivity to insurance carriers, 401(k) record-keepers, and equity providers. Masters benefit_carriers and carrier_feeds (834 EDI, custom API, file-drop). Owns the identity-reconciliation problem between per-carrier member IDs and the HRIS employee_id.
modules.catalog_tagline: Keep carriers and record-keepers in sync automatically.
modules.catalog_description: Connect to insurance carriers, retirement record-keepers, and equity providers over EDI, API, or file feeds. Transmit enrollment changes, reconcile carrier acknowledgments, and resolve member-identity mismatches so coverage on file always matches what employees elected.

modules.description: The employee-facing workflow surface: elections, dependents, life-event handling, and decision-support tooling. Masters benefit_enrollments, benefit_dependents, life_events; embeds employees for the benefit-eligibility slice (coverage tier, dependent linkage, beneficiary designation).
modules.catalog_tagline: Guide employees through elections, dependents, and life events.
modules.catalog_description: Give employees a guided path to elect coverage, add and verify dependents, and report qualifying life events such as marriage, a new child, or a move. Benefits teams review and approve changes, lock records once verified, and keep every election accurate from onboarding through termination.

modules.description: The catalog backbone of benefits administration: masters benefit_plans and benefit_open_enrollments, defines deduction codes used by PAYROLL, and scopes plan offerings by legal_entity.
modules.catalog_tagline: Build your plan catalog and set up each enrollment window.
modules.catalog_description: Define the medical, dental, vision, retirement, and voluntary plans you offer, set eligibility and pricing, map payroll deductions, and scope offerings by legal entity. Schedule and configure each open enrollment window so employees see the right choices when the window opens.

modules.description: The screening decision and the FCRA/EEOC paperwork chain: adjudication against the eligibility matrix, FCRA disclosures, candidate authorizations, pre-adverse and adverse action notices, summary-of-rights acknowledgements, disputes, individualized assessments, and ban-the-box assessments. Regulation-driven entities that must exist even where a vendor hides them in the order UI.
modules.catalog_tagline: Decide each result against your matrix and walk the FCRA adverse-action chain by the book.
modules.catalog_description: Adjudicate every screening result against a configurable eligibility matrix so the same rule applies to every candidate. When a result is disqualifying, walk the full compliance chain: deliver the disclosure and summary of rights, capture the candidate authorization, send the pre-adverse notice with the report copy, honor the waiting period, and issue the adverse-action notice, with disputes and EEOC individualized assessments handled in line. Keep a defensible, auditable record behind every screening decision.

modules.description: The post-hire and standalone-identity surface: continuous monitoring subscriptions, the criminal-records monitoring alert stream, periodic rescreenings, identity verification, right-to-work / I-9 / E-Verify, international screening, and GDPR consent for non-US data subjects. Every flagship sells this as a separately-priced product distinct from the pre-hire order.
modules.catalog_tagline: Keep cleared workers cleared with continuous monitoring, rescreening, and identity checks.
modules.catalog_description: Stop treating the background check as a one-time event. Subscribe workers to continuous monitoring and get an alert the moment a new criminal record surfaces, schedule periodic rescreenings for sensitive roles, and verify identity and right to work up front and over time. Handle international screening and the consent and lawful-basis records non-US data subjects require, so a clearance keeps its meaning long after the hire.

modules.description: The screening order itself, the candidate subject, the orderable package catalog, the concrete component searches (criminal, employment, education, MVR, drug, watchlist, healthcare exclusion), order status history, and candidate-facing invitation and portal engagement. The point-in-time transaction every screening product sells first.
modules.catalog_tagline: Order a background check, build the package, and run every search from one screen.
modules.catalog_description: Order an employment background check, choose a package, and let it expand into the concrete searches it needs: criminal records, employment and education verification, driving records, drug and health screening, and global watchlist checks. Invite the candidate to a portal to give consent and fill in what only they can supply, then track every component to completion with a clear status on the order. One order, one subject, every search in one place.

modules.description: Hierarchical business capability maps with maturity, investment, and strategic-fit heatmaps, plus pre-loaded reference framework content that can be imported, synced, and extended with organization-specific content.
modules.catalog_tagline: See what your business can do, and where to invest next.
modules.catalog_description: Build capability maps that show what your organization does, independent of how it is structured today. Anchor them to reference frameworks, keep them current as the business evolves, and publish a shared view that planning, architecture, and leadership can align around.

modules.description: Central repository for design-time process models with BPMN authoring, version graphs, check-in/check-out, lifecycle states, review and approval workflows, and stakeholder publication portals. The authoring backbone of the domain.
modules.catalog_tagline: Author, review, and publish your process models from one repository.
modules.catalog_description: Build and maintain a governed library of business process models. Draft new versions, route them for review, and publish the approved model so every team works from the same picture. Notify stakeholders automatically when a process is published.

modules.description: End-to-end value stream maps with lead time, process time, value-add ratio, and waste categorization, together with discrete-event and Monte Carlo simulation of process scenarios for bottleneck identification and scenario comparison.
modules.catalog_tagline: Model your value streams and test changes before you make them.
modules.catalog_description: Map how value flows to your customers, spot the bottlenecks that slow delivery, and model improvements with simulation before you roll them out. Run what-if scenarios, compare outcomes, and share the results with the teams that act on them.

modules.description: Employee-facing portal for grant acceptance, vesting visibility, exercise workflows, and tax-document access. Distinct from board-side grant administration (which lives in CAP-TABLE-GRANTS).
modules.catalog_tagline: Give employees a clear, self-service view of their equity and vesting.
modules.catalog_description: Let employees see their grants, vested and unvested shares, and current value in one place. They can accept new grants, follow their vesting schedule, and start an exercise without back-and-forth emails, while every action stays reconciled with the grant records and the ledger.

modules.description: Scenario modeling for exit proceeds distribution with multiple preferred-class participation rights, liquidation preferences, and conversion economics.
modules.catalog_tagline: Model acquisitions and IPOs to see exactly what each shareholder takes home.
modules.catalog_description: Build exit scenarios at any valuation and watch the waterfall distribute proceeds through liquidation preferences, participation, and common shares. Compare outcomes for founders, investors, and option holders, commit the scenario the board approves, and apply the result back to the ledger when the exit closes.

modules.description: Option pool tracking (size, available headroom), RSU/option grant issuance with board approval, grant acceptance, vesting-schedule administration. Multi-masters equity_grants alongside COMP-MGMT (which holds the compensation-policy slice).
modules.catalog_tagline: Issue, approve, and manage stock and option grants with the option pool always in view.
modules.catalog_description: Propose and approve equity grants, set strike prices against the current 409A, and apply vesting schedules. Manage your option pool so you always know what's reserved, granted, and available, and refresh it when the board approves more. Handle exercises and forfeitures, and keep grants in sync with the ledger and the employee portal throughout their life.

modules.description: Authoritative record of equity holders, security classes (common, preferred, SAFE), and the historical transaction log for the issuing company.
modules.catalog_tagline: Maintain an accurate, always-current shareholder ledger across every security class.
modules.catalog_description: Track every shareholder, share class, and certificate in one authoritative ledger. Record issuances, transfers, and ownership changes as your company evolves, and see fully-diluted ownership at a glance. The ledger stays consistent with grants, valuations, and exit scenarios so the numbers always reconcile.

modules.description: Tender offers, employee liquidity programs, and shareholder-initiated secondary transfers with board-approval workflow.
modules.catalog_tagline: Process secondary share transfers between holders with the right approvals.
modules.catalog_description: Handle the sale or transfer of shares between existing holders and new buyers, from drafting the transaction through approval, execution, and settlement. Enforce right-of-first-refusal and approval gates, then move the shares cleanly in the ledger and adjust affected grants once the transfer settles.

modules.description: IRS 409A fair-market-value determination per methodology (income, market, asset, OPM backsolve), and ASC 718 stock-based compensation expense recognition with Black-Scholes or lattice models.
modules.catalog_tagline: Order 409A valuations and run ASC 718 stock-based compensation expense.
modules.catalog_description: Capture and finalize 409A fair-market-value determinations that set the strike price for new grants, with a clear review-and-approval trail. Calculate stock-based compensation expense across reporting periods under ASC 718 so finance can book the right numbers and close each period with confidence.

modules.description: The live interaction workspace. Owns the support session as the unit of agent work, the contact record captured for every interaction, and agent_states that track presence and availability. Realizes the agent-desktop and workforce-engagement/adherence capabilities. Consumes WFM schedules to compare actual state against plan rather than mastering scheduling here.
modules.catalog_tagline: Give agents one screen to handle every interaction, with full context and clean wrap-up.
modules.catalog_description:
Agents see the customer's cross-channel history the moment an interaction connects, and handle it with hold, transfer, conference, and consult from a single workspace. Each contact ends with a clear disposition code that feeds reporting and follow-up.

Presence and availability are tracked continuously, so routing always knows who can take the next interaction and supervisors can see who is on, off, or in wrap. Time spent in each state is compared against the plan to flag adherence and auxiliary-time issues as they happen.

modules.description: Post-interaction quality and reporting. Owns call recordings as the captured evidence of each interaction, interaction_evaluations as supervisor scoring against forms, and evaluation_forms as the reusable scorecard catalog. Realizes the recording, quality-management/coaching, and analytics capabilities. Consumes contact_records and support_sessions as the interactions under review and SLA definitions for breach reporting.
modules.catalog_tagline: Record, score, and report on every interaction to keep quality and service levels on target.
modules.catalog_description:
Capture voice and transcript for every interaction, with consent handling and pause/resume so sensitive data stays out of the recording. Recordings are available for quality review, dispute resolution, and compliance retention.

Supervisors score interactions against evaluation forms, calibrate across reviewers, and assign coaching to close the gaps. Real-time dashboards and historical reports break performance down by queue, agent, skill, and disposition so you can act before service levels slip.

modules.description: The ACD and flow engine. Owns omnichannel ingestion, skills-based queueing, and the IVR/self-service flow runtime that places each interaction into the right queue. Realizes routing and IVR capabilities. Masters queue_statistics as the computed view of queue health and disposition_codes as the catalog of outcome codes applied downstream. Consumes CRM customers and KMS knowledge as routing and self-service context.
modules.catalog_tagline: Route every call, chat, and message to the right agent, and let self-service handle the rest.
modules.catalog_description:
Bring voice and every digital channel into one set of queues and route each interaction to the agent best suited to handle it, by skill, priority, and customer tier. Self-service menus and callback offers deflect and speed up the simple requests before they ever reach a queue.

Watch queue health in one place: wait times, abandon rates, and service levels update live, and threshold alerts fire before service slips. Outcome codes captured at the desk roll up here so you can see why customers are calling and tune routing accordingly.

modules.description: Real-time and batch collection of behavioral, transactional, and identifier data from sources, plus deterministic and probabilistic stitching of disparate identifiers into a unified entity graph. Houses the raw event firehose and the identity-resolution overlay that turns anonymous interactions into resolved profiles.
modules.catalog_tagline: Collect every signal and resolve it to one identity.
modules.catalog_description: Stream behavioral, transactional, and identifier data from any source, then stitch anonymous and known identifiers into a single unified profile with deterministic and probabilistic matching.

modules.description: Observed multi-channel journey progression (the inbound view of how a customer moved through touchpoints over time) reconciled into a single queryable customer view across transactional, marketing, and operational systems. Descriptive journey history rather than orchestrated outbound sequences.
modules.catalog_tagline: See the whole customer journey in one view.
modules.catalog_description: Reconcile observed multi-channel journey progression into a single queryable customer view across transactional, marketing, and operational systems for a complete 360-degree picture.

modules.description: Visual rule building for static and dynamic audiences over profile attributes and behavioral events, plus pushing those audiences and traits to ad platforms, marketing tools, CRM, and ad-server destinations via reverse-ETL or native connectors, including warehouse-native zero-copy operation. Authors and activates segments outbound.
modules.catalog_tagline: Build audiences and push them everywhere they're needed.
modules.catalog_description: Compose static and dynamic audiences from profile attributes and behavioral events, then activate them to ad platforms, marketing tools, and CRM, including warehouse-native zero-copy delivery.

modules.domain_module_name: Unified Profile, Attributes, and Predictive Scoring
modules.description: Persistent golden-record profile spanning attributes, computed traits, consent flags, and lifetime engagement history, with a derived scoring layer (LTV, RFM, churn risk, propensity) and consent and privacy state on the resolved profile. The materialized profile that downstream segments and personalization read from.
modules.catalog_tagline: One golden profile, enriched and scored.
modules.catalog_description: Maintain a persistent profile spanning attributes, computed traits, consent state, and engagement history, with predictive scores for lifetime value, churn risk, and propensity that downstream teams read from.

modules.description: Template-driven contract drafting with the approved clause library. Masters contract_templates and contract_clauses; produces draft legal_contracts that flow into CLM-NEGOTIATION. Realizes CLM-CONTRACT-AUTHORING and CLM-CLAUSE-LIBRARY-MGMT.
modules.catalog_tagline: Assemble new contracts fast from a library of approved clauses and templates.
modules.catalog_description:
Build new agreements from pre-approved language instead of starting from a blank page. Pull clauses and templates from a maintained library, assemble a draft, and route it through legal and business review with a clear approval trail.

Versioning and approval states keep the clause and template library trustworthy, so every new contract starts from terms the organization has already agreed it can stand behind.

modules.description: Track-changes negotiation with counterparty exchange, version comparison, and clause-risk detection. Consumes legal_contracts and contract_clauses; gates the in_negotiation -> approved lifecycle transition. Requires sign_document for signature workflow; coverage drops below 100% on the sign_document leg.
modules.catalog_tagline: Redline counterparty terms and reach agreement without losing track of changes.
modules.catalog_description:
Work through counterparty markups in a structured negotiation, comparing proposed language against approved positions and capturing each round of changes. Surface the terms that need legal attention and route them for sign-off.

When both sides agree, the negotiated contract moves cleanly into approval and execution, with a record of how the final language was reached.

modules.description: Register, tracking, and alerting for contract obligations (deliverables, SLA milestones, payment terms). Masters contract_obligations. Publishes obligation.due and obligation.breached events that fan out to OP-RES / GRC.
modules.catalog_tagline: Track every commitment a contract creates and act before a deadline slips.
modules.catalog_description:
Turn the promises buried in a signed contract into tracked obligations with owners, due dates, and status. Watch performance, payment, delivery, reporting, and compliance commitments move from open to satisfied, and catch the ones at risk of breach.

Clear ownership and visible due dates mean obligations are met on time, and the moment one is breached or waived, the right people know.

modules.description: Date-based renewal alerting, auto-renewal-clause detection, and renewal execution. Consumes legal_contracts; publishes renewal.30_day_warning and legal_contract.renewed. Distinct from amendments which run through CLM-REPOSITORY.
modules.catalog_tagline: Get ahead of every expiry and renewal so no contract lapses by accident.
modules.catalog_description:
Know which contracts are coming up for renewal well before they expire, and decide deliberately whether to renew, renegotiate, or let them end. Renewal countdowns and early warnings turn a reactive scramble into a planned workflow.

Capture each renewal against the original agreement so the repository always reflects the live commitment, and value is never lost to a missed deadline.

modules.description: Executed-contract index. Masters legal_contracts (post-signature) and signature_records. Contributes terms to saas_subscriptions and software_licenses (the buyer-side records that consume contract terms). The system of record for the active, expired, renewed, and terminated lifecycle states.
modules.catalog_tagline: Store every executed contract in one searchable, always-current system of record.
modules.catalog_description:
