Keep every signed agreement in a single repository with the counterparty, contract type, key dates, value, and governing terms captured as structured data. Find any contract in seconds and see its full history, including amendments and renewals.

The repository is the authoritative record of what the organization has signed, ready to answer questions for finance, legal, audit, and the teams that depend on each agreement.

modules.description: Captures pre-change CI baseline snapshots and continuously compares live state against them, raising drift events for change-management investigation.
modules.catalog_tagline: Capture configuration baselines and catch unauthorized drift before it becomes an incident.
modules.catalog_description:
Take point-in-time snapshots of how your configuration items are set up, then compare live state against those approved baselines on an ongoing basis. When something changes outside the approved path, you see the deviation early and can act on it.

Validated baselines give change and compliance teams a defensible record of what good looks like, so drift is surfaced, reviewed, and resolved rather than left to surface as an outage or an audit finding.

modules.description: The authoritative configuration item record, its class definitions, and the relationships between CIs. Houses discovery ingestion, reconciliation, stewardship, and the canonical CI lifecycle.
modules.catalog_tagline: Maintain the authoritative inventory of every configuration item and the relationships that connect them.
modules.catalog_description:
Register, classify, and govern every configuration item in one place, from servers and databases to applications and the dependencies that link them. Bring in records from across the environment, organize them under a class model you control, and move each item through its lifecycle from first sighting to retirement.

With ownership and access controls on the records that matter, the inventory stays trustworthy: people see what depends on what, changes are reasoned about against real relationships, and the rest of your IT operation works from a single source of truth.

modules.description: Business-service-to-CI topology projection. Maps applications and business services onto the underlying CI graph so ITSM impact analysis and AIOPS correlation have a runtime-accurate model.
modules.catalog_tagline: Map infrastructure and applications up into the business services they support.
modules.catalog_description:
Turn a flat list of components into a living map of the services your business actually runs on. Connect applications, hosts, and dependencies into service views, publish them for the teams that rely on them, and keep them current as the underlying estate shifts.

When an incident hits or a change is planned, you can see the affected service end to end and who it touches, so impact is understood before work begins instead of discovered afterward.

modules.description: Market data ingestion, salary band maintenance, and pay-equity analysis. Masters salary_bands and compensation_benchmarks; surfaces compa-ratio and pay-gap analytics consumed by planning and people analytics.
modules.catalog_tagline: Benchmark pay to the market and build salary bands you can defend.
modules.catalog_description: Bring in market pay data, match your roles to it, and build salary bands and ranges that keep offers and increases competitive. Surface pay gaps against the market and across your workforce so you can close them before they become a risk. Give your compensation team the evidence to set, justify, and update pay structures with confidence.

modules.description: Bonus, commission, and long-term equity plan administration. Masters equity_grants and folds INCENTIVE-MGMT + EQUITY-MGMT capabilities (grant lifecycle, vesting, exercise, expense tracking).
modules.catalog_tagline: Grant equity and incentive awards, then track them from proposal through vesting.
modules.catalog_description: Propose equity and incentive awards as part of total rewards, approve them, and follow each grant through vesting, exercise, forfeiture, and expiration. Keep award terms, schedules, and statuses in one place so finance, payroll, and your people all see the same numbers. Give your team a clean record of every long-term incentive you have promised.

modules.description: Annual merit, bonus, and equity cycles. Masters merit_cycles, merit_recommendations, and compensation_plans. Drives manager workflows, calibration, approvals, and posting of effective-dated pay changes.
modules.catalog_tagline: Plan merit and bonus cycles, calibrate awards to budget, and route them for approval.
modules.catalog_description: Open a compensation cycle, set merit and bonus guidelines, and let managers propose increases for their teams. Calibrate recommendations against your budget and pay-equity targets, then route them through review and approval before they post. Give your compensation partners a controlled, transparent way to turn budget into fair, defensible pay decisions.

modules.description: Personalized total-rewards statement assembly, delivery, and acknowledgment. Masters compensation_statements; consumes merit_cycle outputs and equity_grant events to compose worker-visible statements.
modules.catalog_tagline: Generate total-rewards statements and deliver them to every employee.
modules.catalog_description: Pull base pay, bonus, equity, and benefits into a single total-rewards statement, generate it for each employee, and deliver it for them to review and acknowledge. Show people the full value of what they earn, not just their paycheck, in a clear and personal format. Give your team a repeatable way to communicate rewards and capture that employees have seen them.

modules.description: Discount-approval workflows and contract-draft handoff to CLM. Captures the multi-tier sign-off path that gates high-discount or non-standard quotes from advancing to execution.
modules.catalog_tagline: Route discounts and non-standard terms through the right approvers, then hand a clean draft to contracting.
modules.catalog_description: This module runs the sign-off path that protects your margins. When a quote carries a deep discount or off-standard terms, it moves through a tiered approval chain with a clear record of who approved what and when. Once it clears, an approved contract draft is generated and handed to your contract lifecycle process, so nothing advances to signature until the deal has passed review. The result is faster, auditable approvals and a clean handoff into execution.

modules.description: Configurable product definitions, product bundles, and pricing rules. The reference data CPQ quote-building reads from. Includes AI price-optimization and subscription-pricing variants.
modules.catalog_tagline: Keep every product, bundle, and pricing rule in one place so quotes are always built on correct, current data.
modules.catalog_description: This is the reference layer your quotes are built from: configurable products, reusable bundles, and the pricing rules that decide what each customer pays. Define options and constraints once and every seller inherits them, so no one quotes an invalid configuration or an out-of-date price. Volume tiers, seat-based and duration-based pricing, and segment overrides all live here, ready to drive consistent, defensible numbers across the whole sales team.

modules.description: Sales-quote authoring workflow: quote header, line items, discount application, guided-selling navigation, and quote-document generation. The seller-facing CPQ surface.
modules.catalog_tagline: Assemble quotes line by line with guided selling, live pricing, and discounts that stay inside policy.
modules.catalog_description: This is where sellers actually build the deal: add line items, follow guided-selling prompts to the right configuration, and watch totals update as they go. Discounts apply at the line or quote level and surface for approval the moment they cross a threshold, so reps move quickly without giving away margin. Finished quotes generate a clean, professional document ready to send, and accepted quotes flow straight downstream with no rekeying.

modules.description: Masters customer accounts and their associated contacts. The structural backbone of the CRM market: every other CRM module hangs off the account/contact graph. Folds the cross-cutting Customer 360 capability because the unified-customer-view is anchored on the account/contact records this module owns.
modules.catalog_tagline: One trusted record for every customer and contact, with the full account history in one view.
modules.catalog_description:
Account and Contact Management is the system of record for who you sell to. Maintain a clean, deduplicated record of every account and the people inside it, with segmentation, account tier, and the relationships between parent companies and their divisions.

Give everyone who touches the customer a single, current view: the contacts and their roles, the open and won deals, the activity history, and the signals coming back from service, billing, and product. Keep that record accurate as customers sign up, change tier, and grow, so every team works from the same truth.

modules.description: Masters the sales activity log (calls, emails, meetings, demos, tasks) and the touchpoint history on accounts, contacts, leads, and opportunities. Includes the mobile and offline access surface for field sales: the activity-log mobile app is the canonical mobile CRM use case.
modules.catalog_tagline: Log every call, email, and meeting against the right account so the full conversation is never lost.
modules.catalog_description:
Activity Management captures the day-to-day work of selling: calls, emails, meetings, demos, and content views, each tied to the contact and opportunity it belongs to. Reps see exactly what has happened on an account and what is due next, and managers see real engagement instead of guesswork.

Tracked emails and scheduled meetings become part of the account's permanent history, and completed activities feed pipeline and forecast signals automatically. The team stays coordinated, follow-ups happen on time, and no customer interaction goes unrecorded.

modules.domain_module_name: AI Sales Copilot and Workflow Automation
modules.description: AI-assisted sales workflows: generative copilot, intelligent next-best-action suggestions, automated approval routing, and process automation across CRM. A standalone module because AI copilots and workflow engines are increasingly packaged as a separate paid tier on top of core CRM.
modules.catalog_tagline: An AI assistant that drafts outreach, summarizes accounts, and recommends the next best move on every deal.
modules.catalog_description:
AI Copilot works on top of your live customer, contact, lead, opportunity, and activity records to take the busywork out of selling. Ask it to summarize an account before a call, draft a personalized follow-up email, or explain why a deal is at risk, and it answers from the data already in your CRM.

It recommends the next best action, surfaces signals a rep might miss, and turns long histories into a quick brief, so sellers spend their time in conversations and decisions rather than searching and typing. The assistant reads and acts on the canonical records the rest of CRM maintains, so its guidance always reflects the current state of the relationship.

modules.description: Captures inbound and prospected leads, scores and routes them, and converts qualified leads to contacts and opportunities. The top-of-funnel module: a CRM deployment without lead management is viable for pure account-management shops, which is why this is a separate module rather than folded into Account Management.
modules.catalog_tagline: Capture, score, and qualify every lead, then convert the best into accounts and live deals.
modules.catalog_description:
Lead Management captures inbound interest from marketing, partners, web forms, and outbound prospecting into one routed queue. Score each lead, work it through a clear qualification status, and assign it to the right rep with rules that keep response times fast.

When a lead is ready, convert it cleanly into a contact, an account, and an opportunity so no context is lost in the handoff. The result is a predictable top of funnel where good leads move forward quickly and weak ones are filtered before they waste selling time.

modules.description: Masters opportunities, the pipeline-stage definitions that opportunities progress through, and the forecasting roll-ups computed from weighted pipeline. The revenue-execution module: where deal management, sales forecasting, and pipeline health analytics live.
modules.catalog_tagline: Run every deal through a pipeline you control, from first touch to close, with forecast you can trust.
modules.catalog_description:
Pipeline Management is where deals get worked and won. Define your sales stages, exit criteria, and default probabilities, then move each opportunity through them with full visibility into amount, products, competitors, and close date.

Managers see the whole pipeline at once, spot stalled or at-risk deals early, and forecast the period with confidence. Stage changes trigger the right downstream motions, from generating a quote to alerting the teams that take over on close, so winning a deal flows straight into delivering it.

modules.description: CSA-only subscription management for farms operating a single direct-to-member channel. Embedded shells for memberships, share packs, customers, and pickup locations support membership lifecycle, weekly share fulfillment, pickup-site coordination, and member billing. Upgrade by installing the matching full modules (FDS-CSA-MGMT, FDS-ONLINE-STORE, FDS-HARVEST-PLANNING, FDS-DELIVERY-OPS, FDS-WHOLESALE, FDS-MARKET-POS) as the operation expands into storefront, harvest forecasting, routed delivery, wholesale, or market-day channels.
modules.catalog_tagline: Start a CSA in a day: memberships, weekly shares, pickups, and member billing in one lightweight kit.
modules.catalog_description: Run a single direct-to-member CSA channel without standing up the full platform. Enroll members, compose and fulfill weekly shares, coordinate pickup sites, and bill subscribers, all from a compact starter. When the operation grows into a storefront, routed delivery, wholesale, market days, or harvest forecasting, install the matching full modules and keep your data.

modules.description: Customer-facing case capture, triage, routing, resolution, and CSAT close-out. Masters customer_cases and csat_responses. The execution backbone of the CSM category.
modules.catalog_tagline: One queue for every customer case, from omnichannel capture through triage to resolution and CSAT.
modules.catalog_description:
Case Management is the working surface for your support team. Capture cases from any channel into a single queue, classify and route them with AI-assisted triage, and give agents the customer and interaction history they need to resolve on first contact.

Drive cases through a clear lifecycle to resolved and closed, with workflow gates that protect each step. Capture satisfaction on close-out so you can see how every interaction landed and feed health signals to the teams that own the account.

modules.description: Service entitlements, support tiers, SLA tracking, and contractual support hours. Masters customer_entitlements. Consumes subscription and contract context to bind eligibility and SLA targets.
modules.catalog_tagline: Bind support to what the customer has paid for, with service tiers and SLA clocks that reflect real commitments.
modules.catalog_description:
Entitlements and SLA Management defines what support each customer can use: service tier, included channels, support hours, named contacts, and response and resolution targets. Activate entitlements directly from the customer's subscription and contract so eligibility is always current.

Tie SLA clocks to those commitments so agents and supervisors see what is owed on every case, catch breaches before they happen, and prove that contractual service levels were met.

modules.description: Customer-facing knowledge base presentation and authoring. Contributes audience-filtered edits to the cross-cutting knowledge_articles entity mastered by ITSM-KNOWLEDGE; consumes case data so article authoring is informed by support patterns.
modules.catalog_tagline: A customer-facing knowledge surface that speeds resolution and turns proven fixes into self-service.
modules.catalog_description:
Customer Knowledge Surface puts the right answers in front of agents as they work a case and lets them publish audience-filtered articles for customers to find on their own. Authoring is informed by real support patterns, so the knowledge base grows around the questions customers actually ask.

The result is faster resolution, fewer repeat cases, and a self-service experience that deflects routine inquiries before they ever become a case.

modules.description: Capture and approve contingent timesheets against assignments, then compute and reconcile supplier invoices from approved hours and rate cards for downstream three-way match and payment.
modules.catalog_tagline: Capture and approve contingent timesheets, then reconcile supplier invoices to approved hours and rates.
modules.catalog_description: Collect contingent-worker timesheets against their assignments and move them through submit, approve, and bill. Compute supplier invoices from approved hours and the published rate cards, then reconcile each invoice through three-way match before it is released for payment. Approved hours and matched invoices flow on to payroll, project accounting, and the general ledger automatically.

modules.description: Raise staffing requisitions, distribute them to tiered staffing suppliers, govern pre-agreed rate cards, and onboard contingent workers with a typed classification basis. Procurement governs the supplier panel and rate cards; HR governs worker classification.
modules.catalog_tagline: Source contingent workers through approved staffing suppliers and govern the rate cards they bill against.
modules.catalog_description: Raise staffing requisitions and distribute them to a tiered panel of approved suppliers, then track candidates through to active worker assignments. Approve rate cards by role and region so every engagement bills against a governed rate, and classify each worker so tenure and co-employment risk stay visible. Procurement runs the supplier panel and rates; HR owns worker classification.

modules.description: Feed rationing and total-mixed-ration management: per-group ration formulation, feed inventory and shrink tracking, feed-mixer integration, and income-over-feed-cost computation per cow group.
modules.catalog_tagline: Formulate rations by group, log every mix, and tie feed cost back to milk income.
modules.catalog_description:
Build total-mixed rations the way the herd is actually fed: by group, with ingredients and inclusion percentages set for each pen's stage and production level. Each ration is formulated, put into use, and superseded when the recipe changes, so the current formulation is always clear.

Log what goes in the mixer, not just what was planned. Mixing records capture the real batch so feeding can be checked against the formulation.

Close the economic loop. Tie ration cost to milk income so income-over-feed-cost is a number you manage rather than estimate, and so a ration change can be weighed against its effect on production and margin.

modules.description: Individual-cow system of record spanning the full animal lifecycle (calving, lactation cycles, dry-off, culling), reproduction and breeding history, and herd-health events with treatment and withdrawal tracking. Holds the per-animal master and its lactation, breeding, and health event records.
modules.catalog_tagline: One record per cow, from calving through lactation, breeding, health, and the culling call.
modules.catalog_description:
Keep a living record for every animal in the herd. Track parity, current lactation status, and pen location, and move each cow through her lifecycle as she calves, peaks, dries off, and is eventually replaced.

Log the work that drives the herd forward. Record breeding events with the sire and technician, follow pregnancy checks to confirmation, and capture health incidents with their treatment and withdrawal period so a treated cow never ships milk too soon. Lactation records open with each calving and carry days-in-milk, peak yield, and the 305-day projection.

The result is a herd you can manage by exception: see which cows are open, which are due to dry off, which are under withdrawal, and which are candidates to cull, all from the same place.

modules.description: Milk-quality testing and records: somatic cell count, bacterial counts, butterfat and protein components, and antibiotic-residue screening at the bulk-tank and per-cow level, driving drug-residue and mastitis-management workflows.
modules.catalog_tagline: Test the milk that leaves the farm and hold what fails: SCC, bacteria, components, and residue in one place.
modules.catalog_description:
Test milk where it matters, at the bulk tank and the individual cow. Record somatic cell count, bacterial count, butterfat, protein, and antibiotic-residue screens, and follow each result from sampled through submitted to a pass, fail, or appeal.

Turn a failing result into action, not just a number. A failed test or an active treatment can gate a shipment so milk that should not leave the farm does not, protecting the load, the premium, and the buyer relationship.

Quality history rolls up so trends are visible over time, supporting DHIA testing standards and FDA Grade A obligations with the evidence already captured.

modules.description: Parlor and automatic-milking-system integration: captures per-cow per-session milking telemetry (yield, conductivity, duration) and aggregates it into outbound bulk-tank shipments to processors and cooperatives.
modules.catalog_tagline: Capture every milking from the parlor and turn finished milk into bulk shipments ready to leave the farm.
modules.catalog_description:
Bring parlor and robot output into one record. Capture per-cow, per-session milkings with yield, conductivity, and duration straight from parlor or automated-milking telemetry, and reconcile sessions so the day's production reconciles cow by cow.

Move milk off the farm with a clean trail. Build bulk tank shipments to the processor or cooperative with pickup time, volume, grade, and hauler, so every load that leaves is accounted for and ready for the next step in traceability.

The payoff is production you can trust at the cow level and at the tank level, with shipment records that line up against quality results before milk is dispatched.

modules.description: Foundation-model hosting and routing, embedding generation, vector search, retrieval-augmented generation, tool-use orchestration, agent runtimes, prompt versioning, evaluation harnesses, and gateway controls for cost, safety, and audit.
modules.catalog_tagline: Build, ground, and govern AI agents and assistants on top of your own trusted data.
modules.catalog_description:
Host and route the foundation models your assistants run on, generate embeddings, and stand up vector search so agents can retrieve the right context and answer from your real data instead of guessing. Orchestrate tool use and multi-step agent workflows, version and test your prompts, and check quality with evaluation harnesses before anything reaches users.

Keep cost, safety, and auditability under control with gateway-level guardrails, so you can scale generative features across the business while staying in command of what your agents do and what they spend. This gives you a dependable path from a working prototype to governed, production AI assistants grounded in your own knowledge.

modules.description: Unified analytics storage over open table formats with ACID transactions, schema evolution, and time travel, plus declarative and code-first batch and streaming pipelines with scheduling, dependency management, lineage capture, and run observability. Includes collaborative multi-language notebooks running against the lakehouse with shared compute and scheduled execution.
modules.catalog_tagline: Land all your data in one open, governed lakehouse and build the pipelines that keep it fresh.
modules.catalog_description:
Bring batch and streaming data together in a single analytics store you actually control, with reliable transactions, schema changes that do not break downstream work, and the ability to look back at how a table looked at any point in time. Build the ingestion and transformation pipelines that fill it, schedule them, see their dependencies at a glance, and get clear run-level visibility when something slows down or fails.

Work side by side in collaborative notebooks that run directly against your lakehouse, mixing languages and sharing compute, so analysts and engineers can explore, prototype, and ship on the same data without copying it around. The result is one trustworthy foundation that your reporting, governance, and machine learning all sit on.

modules.description: End-to-end machine-learning lifecycle: feature engineering and feature store, distributed training, experiment tracking, model registry, deployment to serving endpoints, drift monitoring, and continuous evaluation.
modules.catalog_tagline: Take models from first experiment to monitored production without losing track of anything.
modules.catalog_description:
Engineer and reuse the features your models depend on, train them at scale, and keep every experiment and result recorded so you can compare runs and reproduce the one that worked. Register your best models, promote them through clear stages, and deploy them to serving endpoints when they are ready.

Keep an eye on models after they go live with drift monitoring and continuous evaluation, so you find out early when accuracy slips or the data shifts underneath them. The whole lifecycle stays connected, from raw features to a live, watched model, so teams can ship confidently and act fast when something changes.

modules.domain_module_name: Semantic Layer, Governance, and Data Products
modules.description: Semantic and ontology modeling that maps physical tables to governed business concepts and reusable measures, a single-pane catalog with lineage, business glossary, and fine-grained access control across all platform assets, and published governed data products with explicit contracts. Includes operational data applications backed by the semantic and ontology layer with write-back to systems of record.
modules.catalog_tagline: Turn raw tables into governed business concepts, trusted metrics, and shareable data products.
modules.catalog_description:
Map your physical tables to the business concepts and reusable measures everyone agrees on, so a metric means the same thing in every report, dashboard, and AI answer. Give your teams a single place to find any data asset, trace where it came from, read its plain-language definition, and request the right level of access, all under fine-grained controls.

Package the data others depend on into governed data products with explicit contracts for schema, quality, and ownership, so consumers know exactly what they are getting and producers know who relies on them. Build lightweight operational apps on top of the same governed layer that can write changes back to your systems of record, closing the loop between insight and action.

modules.description: The policy and sensitivity layer: classifies assets (PII/PCI/PHI/confidential) through an approval workflow, authors data access policies, and routes access requests to a single accountable approver. Masters data_classifications and data_access_policies; embeds data_assets. Authors policy; enforcement is provisioned downstream (DLP/DSPM/IGA).
modules.catalog_tagline: Classify sensitive data and decide who can use it, by policy not by ticket.
modules.catalog_description: Detect and label sensitive data, run classifications through steward approval, and lock them once approved so access cannot quietly drift. Author access policies that say who can use which data under what conditions, and route every access request through one accountable approver. Access Governance is where the catalog stops being a map and starts being the control point for safe, compliant data use.

modules.description: The discovery and inventory surface: crawls and registers data assets, organizes them into subject-area data domains, and exposes search, browse, and metadata. Masters data_assets and data_domains. Deploys standalone as the catalog core or alongside the governance modules.
modules.catalog_tagline: Find and understand every dataset across your data estate from one searchable catalog.
modules.catalog_description: Automatically discover datasets, tables, files, and APIs across your sources and bring them into one searchable inventory. Organize assets into business subject areas, see ownership and technical detail at a glance, and give everyone a trusted starting point for finding the right data. The catalog is the home base that the lineage, glossary, stewardship, and governance modules build on.

modules.description: The publishing and marketplace surface: packages governed data products with explicit contracts, surfaces certified metric definitions, and tracks usage and popularity. Masters data_usage_metrics; embeds data_products (canonical DATA-AI-PLAT) and metric_definitions (canonical METRICS-LAYER).
modules.catalog_tagline: Publish governed data products and metrics consumers can find, trust, and reuse.
modules.catalog_description: Turn raw datasets into governed data products with explicit contracts: schema, SLA, owner, access policy, and intended consumers. Publish certified metric definitions so everyone calculates Revenue the same way, and track usage and popularity to see what is actually valuable and what has gone stale. This is the marketplace where producers ship trusted data and consumers shop for it within the rules.

modules.description: The shared business-language layer: authors, reviews, publishes, and deprecates glossary terms and links them to physical assets. Masters glossary_terms; embeds ontologies as an optional formal-model shell. Runs a draft-review-publish-deprecate workflow.
modules.catalog_tagline: Give the whole organization one agreed definition for every business term.
modules.catalog_description: Build a shared vocabulary so Revenue, Active Customer, and Churn mean the same thing everywhere. Propose terms, route them through steward review, publish the approved definition, and link each term to the real data assets behind it. Optional ontology authoring adds formal relationships between concepts. A governed glossary is what lets self-service data consumers trust what they find.

modules.description: Captures and presents flow edges between data assets with column-level mapping and transformation logic, and runs impact analysis when a source changes. Masters data_lineage_relationships; carries an embedded shell of data_assets so it deploys standalone.
modules.catalog_tagline: Trace where data comes from and what breaks when it changes, end to end.
modules.catalog_description: See how data flows from source to report across every pipeline and transformation, down to the column level. When a schema or upstream source changes, run impact analysis to know exactly which downstream assets, dashboards, and consumers are affected before anything breaks. Lineage turns the catalog from a static inventory into a living map of how your data actually moves.

modules.description: The accountability layer: assigns stewards and owners to assets and terms, tracks responsibility, runs escalation, and manages the certification attestation by which an owner declares an asset production-ready. Masters data_stewardship_assignments and data_certifications; embeds data_assets.
modules.catalog_tagline: Put a named owner behind every important dataset and certify what is fit to use.
modules.catalog_description: Assign stewards and owners to the data that matters, make responsibility visible, and escalate when stewardship gaps appear. When an owner attests that an asset meets quality and compliance bars, certify it so consumers can tell trusted data from the rest at a glance, with validity periods and revocation when things change. Clear ownership is what turns a catalog into governed data people can rely on.

modules.description: Owns the physical-asset register and the space hierarchy: sites, rooms, rows, cabinets, racks, and rack-unit occupancy, plus the moves/adds/changes workflow that keeps the live model aligned with what is physically installed. This module is the system of record for where every piece of equipment sits and how much rack and floor space remains.
modules.catalog_tagline: Know exactly what is installed in every rack and how much space is left, with a live floor plan instead of a stale spreadsheet.
modules.catalog_description:
Asset and Space Management gives facilities and IT infrastructure teams an authoritative model of the physical estate. Map every site, room, row, cabinet, and rack, then place equipment unit by unit so you always know what is installed and where.

Rack-unit occupancy, weight, and depth are tracked against each cabinet, so planners can see headroom at a glance and avoid the surprise of a full rack. Every install, decommission, and relocation flows through a moves-adds-changes workflow, keeping the register accurate and producing a clean audit trail for the configuration database and downstream operations.

modules.description: Combines forward-looking capacity planning for power, cooling, space, and bandwidth with the physical connectivity map of ports and cables. Capacity plans roll up utilization and growth forecasts per site and zone (handed off to SPM for build-out decisions), while the port and cable register feeds the configuration database and is cross-validated by NPMD.
modules.catalog_tagline: Plan power, cooling, space, and bandwidth headroom with confidence, and map every port and cable so nothing is a mystery.
modules.catalog_description:
Capacity and Connectivity Planning turns the live asset and telemetry layer into a forward-looking plan. Project power, cooling, space, and bandwidth headroom per site and zone, run what-if scenarios for new equipment, and use the headroom view to schedule growth, justify build-outs, and negotiate colocation.

Underneath sits the physical connectivity map: every port and every cable, including patch panels and trunk runs, documented end to end. When a connection is added or changed, the configuration database picks up the new physical topology and network operations can cross-validate logical paths against the wiring that actually exists.

modules.description: Models the full power chain from incoming circuit through PDUs and uninterruptible supplies to the outlet, the cooling estate that keeps equipment in range, and the environmental sensor telemetry that triggers alarms. This module realizes the power, thermal, and environmental capabilities and emits the failure, overload, failover, and threshold-breach events the catalog already hands off to ITSM, ITOM, and AIOPS.
modules.catalog_tagline: Trace power from the circuit to the outlet, keep every cabinet in its thermal envelope, and catch environmental problems before they cause an outage.
modules.catalog_description:
Power and Environmental Monitoring tracks the chain that keeps a data center alive. Follow power from the incoming circuit through distribution units and uninterruptible supplies down to the individual outlet, with phase balance, redundancy, and draw measured against rated capacity at each link.

Cooling units and thermal zones are modeled alongside cabinet-level temperature and humidity, so equipment stays inside its operating range. Sensors stream temperature, humidity, smoke, water-leak, and airflow readings, and when a circuit overloads, a UPS fails over, a cooling unit fails, or a threshold is breached, the event is captured and routed to the teams and systems that need to act.

modules.description: Runtime detection and enforcement at the egress point across email, endpoint, network, web, and cloud SaaS channels. Captures exfiltration attempts, raises and triages incidents, holds blocked artifacts in quarantine pending review, and records a forensic user-activity trail for investigation and remediation.
modules.catalog_tagline: Catch data leaving across every channel and run each incident to a clean close.
modules.catalog_description:
Watch email, web, endpoints, cloud apps, and chat for sensitive data on the move, and act the instant a rule fires: block, quarantine, or alert. Every exfiltration attempt and policy violation becomes a tracked incident your team can triage, investigate, and remediate.

Hold risky artifacts in quarantine until someone reviews them, release or destroy them on decision, and keep a per-user activity trail so investigators can see the full story. Built to turn raw detection signal into a response workflow that closes the loop.

modules.description: Authoring surface for data-protection policies, classification and labeling rules, content fingerprints, and time-limited policy exceptions. Defines what counts as sensitive and which actions (block, quarantine, redact, mask, watermark, alert) apply, then governs the exception lifecycle that relaxes those rules under business justification.
modules.catalog_tagline: Decide what counts as sensitive and the rules that protect it, all in one policy workspace.
modules.catalog_description:
Build the policy layer that powers data loss prevention. Classify your data, author detection rules tied to those classifications, and tune severity and enforcement actions per channel and audience.

Manage the full lifecycle of every policy from draft through review and approval to retirement, and handle the exceptions that real work demands: review requests, approve time-boxed waivers, and keep them from quietly becoming permanent. The result is a clear, reviewable set of controls your enforcement points can act on with confidence.

modules.description: Enumerates identity principals and their effective permissions on data stores, detects over-privilege and toxic combinations (sensitive data plus over-permissive policy), and combines sensitivity, access breadth and exposure vector into per-asset risk scores that prioritize the remediation queue.
modules.catalog_tagline: Know who can reach your sensitive data and fix the access that should not exist.
modules.catalog_description: Map every identity and the permissions it actually has on each data store, then surface over-privilege and toxic combinations where sensitive data meets an over-permissive policy. Sensitivity, access breadth, and exposure are combined into a single risk score per asset, so your team works the highest-risk findings first instead of chasing noise. Policies that fail review are flagged and routed for correction, and risk scores recompute as the picture changes. You get a prioritized, defensible queue of access problems and a clear path to closing each one.

modules.description: Enumerates cloud data stores (object storage, managed databases, warehouses, SaaS instances), classifies the sensitivity of the data they hold, traces lineage and flow across pipelines, and surfaces shadow or unmanaged stores absent from the official inventory. This is the at-rest discovery and sensitivity surface that feeds the access and risk engine.
modules.catalog_tagline: See every cloud data store and know exactly how sensitive the data inside it is.
modules.catalog_description: Continuously find the object stores, managed databases, warehouses, and SaaS instances that hold your data, including the shadow stores no one put on the official inventory. Each store is scanned and its contents classified by sensitivity, so you always know where regulated and high-value data actually lives. Lineage tracing shows how that data flows across pipelines, and unmanaged or newly discovered findings are queued for an owner to review. The result is a trustworthy, always-current map of your data estate that feeds every access, risk, and incident decision downstream.

modules.description: Triages detected sensitive-data incidents (over-privilege, toxic combinations, unauthorized access, shadow-data exposure) through investigation and containment, and drives templated and custom policy enforcement for IAM corrections, bucket-policy updates, and entitlement reviews.
modules.catalog_tagline: Turn a sensitive-data exposure into a contained, resolved incident with a clear audit trail.
modules.catalog_description: Triage detected incidents such as over-privilege, toxic combinations, unauthorized access, and shadow-data exposure, then drive each one through investigation, containment, and resolution. Templated and custom enforcement applies the fix directly, whether that is an IAM correction, a bucket-policy update, or an entitlement review, and the right people are notified at each step. Every transition is recorded, so you can show how an exposure was caught, contained, and closed. The outcome is faster response, less standing risk, and the evidence to prove it.

modules.description: Page-level and component authoring, content modeling, publishing, and centralized management of multiple sites, brands, and locales for branded customer-facing web experiences.
modules.catalog_tagline: Author web pages and reusable content once, then publish across every site and brand you run.
modules.catalog_description:
Create and edit web pages and reusable content components in a structured draft, review, and approval flow. Assemble experiences from shared building blocks so a change in one place updates everywhere it is used.

Publish to many sites and brands from a single workspace, control when content goes live or comes down, and refresh delivery caches so visitors always see the current version.

modules.description: Rule-based and audience-targeted personalization of content and journeys, plus A/B and multivariate experimentation across variants with statistical reporting.
modules.catalog_tagline: Show the right experience to the right audience and prove what works with built-in experimentation.
modules.catalog_description:
Define visitor segments and target them with personalization rules that tailor pages, offers, and content in real time. Activate, pause, and retire rules as your audiences and goals change.

Run A/B and multivariate tests to measure which variations perform best, then roll the winner out with confidence. Publish segments once and reuse them across personalization and testing.

modules.description: Authenticated customer and partner portal experiences with self-service, plus form authoring, progressive profiling, and multi-step journey orchestration integrated with content and personalization.
modules.catalog_tagline: Guide visitors through multi-step journeys and self-service portals that respond to who they are.
modules.catalog_description:
Design guided journeys and portal flows step by step, deciding what each visitor sees next based on their profile and behavior. Track who enters, completes, or drops off so you can refine each path.

React to live audience updates from your customer data so journeys and portal experiences stay relevant as visitor segments change.

modules.description: Manages the portfolio-to-delivery backlog hierarchy (epics to features), agile roadmaps and release plans, lean-portfolio funding linkage, and OKR-to-delivery alignment.
modules.catalog_tagline: Connect portfolio strategy to the agile backlog teams actually deliver.
modules.catalog_description: Keep strategy and delivery in sync. Manage the backlog hierarchy from portfolio epics down to features, plan agile roadmaps and releases, link lean-portfolio funding to the work it pays for, and align OKRs to the delivery that achieves them. Gives delivery leaders a current, honest picture of what is planned and how it ladders up to portfolio outcomes.

modules.description: Coordinates release trains and program increments: PI planning, PI objectives, and cross-team dependency mapping and resolution, with flow and velocity analytics across the train.
modules.catalog_tagline: Run PI planning and keep your release trains moving without cross-team surprises.
modules.catalog_description: Plan and execute program increments with your teams. Stand up release trains, run PI planning, commit PI objectives, and map cross-team dependencies so they get resolved before they block delivery. Built-in flow and velocity analytics show how each train is progressing so release-train engineers can steer the program in real time.

modules.description: Retention schedules, legal holds, defensible disposition, policy authoring, and immutable compliance audit trails of access, change, share, and disposition events across the unstructured-content estate.
modules.catalog_tagline: Keep what you must, dispose of what you can, and prove it whenever you are asked.
modules.catalog_description:
Define retention schedules once and let every document inherit the right keep-or-dispose rule automatically, so nothing lingers past its time and nothing important is deleted too soon. When a matter requires it, place a legal hold and freeze disposition until the hold lifts.

When records reach the end of their retention period, run defensible disposition with a clear, recorded decision. An immutable trail of who accessed, changed, shared, and disposed of each document gives auditors and regulators the evidence they ask for, without a last-minute scramble.

modules.description: Metadata-driven document repository with check-in / check-out, version history, hierarchical folders, full-text indexing, scan / OCR capture, and manual plus ML-driven classification of inbound unstructured content.
modules.catalog_tagline: Capture every document, find it instantly, and keep one trusted version under control.
modules.catalog_description:
Bring scanned, uploaded, and emailed files into one organized repository where every document carries rich metadata and lives in a folder structure your team actually understands. Full-text search and saved views turn a pile of files into something you can find in seconds.

Check documents out to edit them safely, publish new versions without losing the old ones, and let automatic classification flag what is confidential, restricted, or public the moment it arrives. Your people stop guessing which copy is current and start trusting the one source of truth.

modules.description: Routing, approval, and content-centric process automation tied to documents and their versions, with auditable transitions for contracts, claims, invoices, and case files.
modules.catalog_tagline: Route documents to the right people and capture every approval on the record.
modules.catalog_description:
Turn document handling into repeatable, auditable processes. Send contracts, claims, invoices, and case files to the right reviewers in the right order, with clear steps, due dates, and a record of every decision along the way.

Each transition is captured, so you always know where a document is, who has it, and what happens next. Approvals are no longer buried in inboxes; they are part of the document's history.

modules.description: Assurance module. Masters EHS inspections and management-system audits, contractor safety qualification records, and EHS training and competency records. Shares corrective actions with the safety module. Used to demonstrate conformance to ISO 45001 and ISO 14001 and to govern contractors and required training.
modules.catalog_tagline: Plan and run inspections and audits, qualify your contractors, and prove training is current.
modules.catalog_description: Schedule and conduct safety inspections, observations, and management-system audits against standards such as ISO 45001 and ISO 14001, and route every finding into a tracked corrective action. Prequalify and monitor contractors against safety criteria tied to site access and permit-to-work. Map required EHS training to roles and regulations, deliver it, and keep the competency and certification records that prove your program is working.

modules.description: Environmental side of the EHS program. Masters environmental permits and their conditions, and contributes emission and release records into corporate sustainability disclosure. Tracks aspect and impact obligations for ISO 14001 and statutory environmental reporting. Used by permitted and regulated sites.
modules.catalog_tagline: Stay on top of environmental permits, limits, and emissions reporting before deadlines slip.
modules.catalog_description: Track every environmental permit, its conditions and limits, and the monitoring and renewal obligations for air, water, and waste. Record emissions and releases against limits and feed the same data into corporate sustainability disclosure. Keep your environmental aspect and impact register current for ISO 14001, and never miss a regulatory reporting deadline.

modules.description: Occupational health and exposure module. Masters industrial-hygiene samples, occupational health records, and the chemical inventory and safety data sheets that drive hazard communication and exposure assessment. Used by manufacturing, process, and lab-heavy organizations where worker exposure is a primary risk.
modules.catalog_tagline: Monitor exposures, manage occupational health records, and keep chemicals and SDS under control.
modules.catalog_description: Plan and record industrial-hygiene sampling against occupational exposure limits for chemical, noise, and other agents, and link results back to the workers and tasks exposed. Maintain medical surveillance and exposure records, respirator fit tests, and audiometric results with the retention rules occupational health demands. Keep a current chemical inventory and safety data sheet library so hazard communication and exposure assessment stay accurate.

modules.description: Core safety system-of-record. Masters safety incidents, hazards, occupational risk assessments, and corrective actions, plus the statutory OSHA 300 and 301 injury logs. Used standalone as the entry point for any EHS program and alongside the inspection, hygiene, and environmental modules.
modules.catalog_tagline: Log every incident and near-miss, control your hazards, and close out corrective actions fast.
modules.catalog_description: Report injuries, illnesses, and near-misses from any device, then run a structured investigation to root cause and recordability. Build a living hazard register from job hazard analyses and risk assessments, and turn every finding into a tracked corrective or preventive action with owners and due dates. Keep your OSHA 300 and 301 logs accurate and ready for the annual summary and electronic submission.

modules.description: Basic shareholder ledger and grant tracking for the GP entity and portfolio cap-table awareness. Not the full ASC 718 / 409A / exit-waterfall machinery of standalone CAP-TABLE.
modules.catalog_tagline: Keep a clear record of who owns what across the vehicle, with allocations and positions in one view.
modules.catalog_description:
Track ownership across the fund or vehicle without a standalone equity platform. Record each holder's position, see allocations at a glance, and keep the cap table current as commitments fund and the vehicle evolves.

This is the lite shape: the ownership picture a solo or small-team manager needs to answer investor questions and prepare reporting, kept in step with formation and ongoing operations so the numbers always reconcile.

modules.description: End-to-end fund-vehicle setup: entity formation, EIN application, banking onboarding, and templated LPA.
modules.catalog_tagline: Form the legal vehicle, file with the state and IRS, open the bank account, and get subscription documents in front of investors.
modules.catalog_description:
Take a new fund or vehicle from idea to operational. Set up the entity, prepare and track the formation filings, apply for the tax identification number, and start the banking application, all in one checklist you can actually finish. Generate the limited partnership agreement and side letters from proven templates instead of paying for every document from scratch.

Keep every artifact in one record so nothing stalls. See which filings are pending, which are accepted, and what is blocking the vehicle from going live, then hand the operational vehicle off to the teams that run capital calls, cap table, and the investor portal.

modules.description: Simplified LP onboarding, capital calls, and LP portal for single-fund single-class structures. Deliberately less complex than the FUND-ADMIN equivalents; the simplification IS the value engineering.
modules.catalog_tagline: Run capital calls, onboard limited partners, and keep investors informed without a back-office team.
modules.catalog_description:
Handle the recurring work of running a live vehicle. Issue capital calls, track who has funded and who is late, and onboard new limited partners with the verification steps built in. Keep investor communications and documents in one place so the people who put money in always know where things stand.

The workflow is sized for a manager running lean: enough structure to stay compliant and organized, without the overhead of a full fund-administration platform. When the operation outgrows the lite shape, the records are ready to carry forward.

modules.description: Single-deal special-purpose-vehicle creation with templated docs and ongoing admin.
modules.catalog_tagline: Spin up a single-deal vehicle, collect investor subscriptions, run the verification checks, and close.
modules.catalog_description:
Raise deal by deal without standing up a whole fund. Create a special purpose vehicle for the opportunity, send subscription documents, and track each investor from draft through signed, funded, and confirmed. Run know-your-customer and anti-money-laundering checks per subscription so the close is clean.

Watch the raise fill in real time and see exactly who still needs to sign or wire. When the vehicle is active, the capital it gathers flows into the same operations and reporting your investors expect, so a one-off syndicate runs as smoothly as a full fund.

modules.description: Curates brand content into shareable items, organizes it into topic streams and time-boxed campaigns, broadcasts it to enrolled advocates with personalizable share copy, and records every employee share to their linked social accounts. Masters the advocacy program, content, share, advocate profile, and campaign records; consumes HCM employees and SMM social content; sends each advocate a personalized internal newsletter.
modules.catalog_tagline: Curate on-brand content and put one-click sharing in front of every employee, with copy they can make their own.
modules.catalog_description: Build a steady pipeline of approved content, sort it into the topics your people care about, and run focused sharing campaigns around launches and events. Employees enroll, link their LinkedIn, X, and Facebook accounts, and reshare in one click using suggested copy they can personalize. A weekly newsletter lands in each person's inbox with exactly what is worth sharing, so participation does not depend on chasing anyone. Every share is captured automatically, ready to be scored and measured.

modules.description: Incentivizes and measures employee advocacy. Awards points and badges for sharing, ranks advocates on leaderboards, runs a reward catalog with redemptions, scores each advocate's influence, and computes reach, earned media value, and share-to-revenue attribution. Masters the leaderboard, reward, points-ledger, advocate-score, and share-metric records; reads the shares produced by content distribution; hands reach and pipeline signals to Revenue Intelligence.
modules.catalog_tagline: Reward the people who show up, rank your top advocates, and prove the reach and pipeline their shares drive.
modules.catalog_description: Turn sharing into something people want to do: award points and badges, run challenges, and put a leaderboard front and center. Let advocates redeem points from a reward catalog, and surface who is genuinely moving the needle with an influence score per person. Then connect the dots to results: clicks, impressions, reach, and earned media value per share, rolled up to the program and tied to the leads and pipeline that employee shares influenced. Marketing finally gets a defensible number for what advocacy is worth.

modules.description: Survey-result-driven action plans owned by managers or HRBPs. Tracks driver-to-action linkage, completion, and downstream WORK-MGMT task spawn. Closes the listen-act loop for engagement programs.
modules.catalog_tagline: Turn survey results into manager-owned action plans and track them through to real change.
modules.catalog_description: Close the loop between listening and doing. When driver scores reveal where a team needs attention, managers and HR business partners create focused action plans tied directly to the result that prompted them. Track each commitment from creation through completion, spawn the supporting tasks that get the work done, and see whether follow-through actually lifted the next round of scores. Repeated inaction becomes its own signal, so accountability stays visible and engagement programs deliver outcomes rather than just reports.

modules.description: Engagement, pulse, and lifecycle surveys; question library; response collection; driver scoring. The ongoing voice-of-employee surface for continuous listening programs.
modules.catalog_tagline: Keep a steady pulse on engagement with surveys your people answer and scores leaders can act on.
modules.catalog_description: Design and run engagement, pulse, lifecycle, and 360 listening from a reusable question library. Set cadences, target the right audiences, and protect respondents with anonymity floors that keep candor high. As responses arrive, scores aggregate into engagement drivers at the team, department, and segment level, so you can spot strengths and trouble spots without combing through raw answers. This is the always-on voice-of-employee surface that feeds every downstream conversation about how the organization is doing.

modules.description: Maintains rolling forecasts that refresh the expected outlook against actuals, and what-if scenario models layered on a base plan (upside, downside, cost-cut, M and A cases). Forecasts and scenarios feed downstream re-alignment.
modules.catalog_tagline: Refresh the outlook with rolling forecasts and stress-test the plan with what-if scenarios.
modules.catalog_description:
Keep the outlook current. Refresh a rolling forecast each cycle so the expected landing point reflects the latest actuals and assumptions, and re-forecast quickly when the business changes instead of waiting for the next planning cycle.

Model the alternatives before you commit. Layer upside, downside, cost-reduction, and growth scenarios on top of the base plan, compare them side by side, and hand the chosen path back to planning. Forecasts and scenarios give leaders an early read on where the year is heading and the confidence to re-align spend in time.

modules.description: Authors the annual operating plan, long-range plan, and approved budgets. Owns the dollar plan and budget records, driver-based modeling inputs, and the workforce / headcount spend slice of the plan. The budget, once approved, drives downstream spend authorization.
modules.catalog_tagline: Build the annual operating plan and approve the budget that sets each team's spend for the year.
modules.catalog_description:
Plan the year top to bottom: shape the long-range plan, model the drivers that move revenue and cost, and turn the plan into an approved budget that each cost center spends against. Bring the people-cost line into the same place so headcount and compensation plans roll up with everything else.

Move a plan from draft through review to a locked, approved budget that downstream teams can trust. Once the budget is set it becomes the baseline that forecasts refresh against and that variance reporting measures actuals against, so the whole organization works from one agreed set of numbers.

modules.description: Produces actual-vs-plan variance reconciliations with root-cause commentary and management reporting. The operational analytic output consumed by org leaders and finance partners when variance is material.
modules.catalog_tagline: Reconcile actuals against plan, explain the variance, and report the results to leadership.
modules.catalog_description:
Close the loop on the plan. Pull period actuals against the approved budget and the latest forecast, surface where results diverge, and capture the root-cause commentary that explains why. Route material variances to the people accountable so nothing material goes unexplained.

Turn the reconciliation into management reporting that leaders and finance partners actually read. Cost-center owners and the finance team get a clear, repeatable view of performance against plan, with the context they need to decide what to do next.

modules.description: Receipt capture and expense entry, rules-based policy enforcement, time-card collection feeding expense entry, and the approval-to-reimbursement workflow over expense reports and their lines.
modules.catalog_tagline: Capture expenses, check them against policy, and route reports for approval without chasing paper.
modules.catalog_description: Submit, itemize, and report business expenses in one place. Add expense lines, attach receipts, and let each line check itself against your spending rules before it ever reaches an approver. Send completed reports up the chain for review, watch them move from draft to approved, and hand the approved amounts off cleanly for posting and reimbursement. Spend less time on data entry and reminders, and give finance a reliable, auditable record of every claim.

modules.description: Corporate card feeds, auto-matching of card transactions to expense lines, and reconciliation over the issued-card register and its transaction stream.
modules.catalog_tagline: Match corporate card charges to expenses and close the books on card spend with confidence.
modules.catalog_description: Bring every corporate card charge into one workspace and pair it with the expense it belongs to. Review posted transactions, match them to submitted expense lines, and surface the charges that still need a receipt or an explanation. Keep card programs and statements reconciled month after month, so finance can trust that recorded spend matches what actually hit the card.

modules.description: Travel-booking integration, itinerary capture, pre-trip approval, and post-trip expense reconciliation over imported travel bookings.
modules.catalog_tagline: Book and track business travel and per diem in step with your expense and approval rules.
modules.catalog_description: Plan, reserve, and track business trips alongside the expenses they generate. Move bookings from request to confirmed and completed, apply per diem and travel rules as you go, and keep travelers and approvers informed at each step. Connect trip details to the expenses they produce so travel spend stays visible, in policy, and ready to report.

modules.description: Cut-sheet templates, whole/half/quarter animal pre-orders, deposit and balance billing, processor coordination.
modules.catalog_tagline: Take whole, half, and quarter-animal pre-orders with deposits, cut sheets, and processor dates handled.
modules.catalog_description: Reserve animal shares, collect deposits and balances, and capture each customer's cut-sheet preferences before the animal goes to the processor. Coordinate the processing date and pickup, track every order from reserved through ready to delivered, and run whole-animal pre-sales without losing a deposit or a cut sheet in your inbox.

modules.description: CSA membership lifecycle, weekly share-pack composition, member self-service portal, dietary swaps and pauses, full-season pre-pay and installment billing.
modules.catalog_tagline: Run your CSA from signup to the last share of the season without the spreadsheet juggling.
modules.catalog_description: Enroll members, take full-season or installment payments, and let subscribers manage their own swaps, pauses, and dietary preferences from a self-service portal. Compose each week's share, track who gets what, and keep billing and pickup choices in sync so packing day runs clean and members stay enrolled season after season.

modules.description: Route optimization, driver manifests, ETA notifications, multi-stop sequencing for direct-to-consumer delivery.
modules.catalog_tagline: Plan tight delivery days that get every order to the door on time.
modules.catalog_description: Build optimized multi-stop routes for direct-to-consumer delivery, hand drivers a clear manifest, and send customers ETA notifications so they are home for the drop. Sequence stops to save fuel and hours, see which CSA shares, wholesale orders, and butcher pickups ride along on each route, and turn delivery from a daily scramble into a repeatable plan.

modules.description: Yield forecasting per crop and field, projected share availability, member-facing harvest previews.
modules.catalog_tagline: Forecast what the field will yield so you can sell shares and SKUs you can actually deliver.
modules.catalog_description: Project harvest by crop and field, translate yield into available shares and SKU planning, and publish member-facing previews of what is coming. Drive reserve lists and dynamic pricing from the forecast, revise as conditions change, and stop overselling or underplanting by matching demand across every channel to what the ground will produce.

modules.description: Stall-side POS for farmers market days, sale capture across markets, end-of-market reconciliation, multi-market reporting.
modules.catalog_tagline: Ring up market-day sales fast and reconcile the till before you pack the truck.
modules.catalog_description: Take card, cash, and EBT-SNAP at the stall, capture SKU-level sales across every market you work, and reconcile the day's tender mix on the spot. Roll multi-market performance into one view so you know which markets, products, and days actually pay, and close out each market day without a shoebox of receipts.

modules.description: Public-facing farm e-commerce storefront, on-farm farmstand POS and inventory, pickup-location management, delivery-window catalog.
modules.catalog_tagline: Open a branded farm store online and on the farm, with pickup and delivery windows built in.
modules.catalog_description: Stand up an e-commerce storefront with member-only pricing tiers and gift cards, sell at the farmstand, and let customers choose pickup locations or delivery windows at checkout. Keep on-farm inventory and online catalog aligned so you never oversell, and turn every visitor into a repeat buyer without paying for a generic shopping cart that does not understand how a farm sells.

modules.description: Wholesale catalog, B2B order capture (chefs, restaurants, food hubs), multi-farm aggregation, producer payout splits.
modules.catalog_tagline: Sell to chefs, restaurants, and food hubs with a wholesale catalog and clean order-to-invoice flow.
modules.catalog_description: Publish a wholesale catalog with buyer-specific pricing tiers, capture B2B orders, and move them from submitted to confirmed, fulfilled, and net-30 invoiced. Aggregate product across multiple farms and split producer payouts so a food hub can run on the same platform, giving the smallholder operator a wholesale channel that bills as cleanly as the storefront does.

modules.description: Bank-account management, cash transaction recording, receipt and disbursement handling, and reconciliation of cash movements against the ledger. The cash-side of receivables collection and payables disbursement.
modules.catalog_tagline: Reconcile cash and bank activity so your bank balances and your books always agree.
modules.catalog_description:
Bring in bank statements, post cash transactions, and match them against your records so nothing slips through. Maintain bank accounts across entities and currencies, and see your true cash position at any moment.

Work through unmatched items quickly, reconcile each statement, and clear exceptions before they reach the close. Clean reconciliations mean the cash on your books matches the cash in the bank, every period.

modules.description: Capitalization, depreciation, and disposal of fixed assets. Maintains the asset register and per-book depreciation schedules that feed the monthly depreciation journals.
modules.catalog_tagline: Capitalize, depreciate, and dispose of fixed assets with a clean tie-out to the ledger.
modules.catalog_description:
Track the full life of every capital asset, from acquisition and capitalization through in-service use, depreciation, and disposal. Set depreciation methods and schedules, run depreciation on a predictable cadence, and keep each asset tied to the entity that owns it.

When an asset is sold, retired, or impaired, record the event and let the resulting gains, losses, and adjustments flow into the close. Reconcile the asset ledger to the general ledger so capital balances always agree.

modules.description: The accounting system of record: chart of accounts, journal posting, cost-center and legal-entity dimensions, fiscal-period management, period-end close orchestration, intercompany postings, and multi-entity consolidation. Holds the ledger masters every other finance module posts into.
modules.catalog_tagline: Post journal entries, maintain your chart of accounts, and run a controlled close across every legal entity.
modules.catalog_description:
Keep your general ledger accurate and your close on schedule. Record and review journal entries, organize accounts and cost centers, and manage multiple legal entities and currencies from one place, with the controls that keep postings reliable.

When period end arrives, open, soft-close, and hard-close accounting periods in a controlled sequence, match intercompany activity between entities, and produce results you can hand to leadership and auditors with confidence. Reopen a period only when policy allows, and keep a clean trail of every change.

modules.description: ASC 606 / IFRS 15 revenue recognition: performance-obligation allocation, deferred-revenue schedules, and recognition timelines bridging contracts and the ledger.
modules.catalog_tagline: Recognize revenue accurately and on time, in line with current accounting standards.
modules.catalog_description:
Turn billing and delivery events into correctly recognized revenue. Track recognition records from pending through recognized and reversed, apply the right timing and schedules, and keep revenue aligned with the goods and services actually delivered.

Connect project and subscription activity to the ledger so recognized revenue posts cleanly into the close. When something changes, reverse and re-recognize with a clear trail, and give finance numbers that hold up under review.

modules.description: Parts and coverage module: parts master with cross-reference to vehicle make, model, and year; on-hand stock and reorder thresholds per location; parts consumption against work orders; OEM-warranty coverage tracking per VIN; eligible-claim identification on repair events; recall notification ingestion and recall-completion tracking across the fleet.
modules.catalog_tagline: Keep the right parts on hand and claim every warranty and recall dollar you are owed.
modules.catalog_description: Track parts stock and reorder points by location so a job never stalls waiting on a part, and tie every part used back to the work order that consumed it. Know which repairs are covered by an OEM warranty before you pay for them, and flag eligible claims as the work happens. Pull in recall notices and match them to your VINs, then track each recall through to completion across the whole fleet.

modules.description: Planning module: PM-schedule definition per vehicle class with triggers on mileage, engine hours, calendar time, or DTC codes; auto-generation of work orders ahead of due dates; deferred-maintenance tracking.
modules.catalog_tagline: Service every vehicle on time by mileage, hours, or calendar, and let the work orders write themselves.
modules.catalog_description: Set up a preventive maintenance plan for each vehicle class and let the right triggers fire it, whether that is miles driven, engine hours, time elapsed, or a fault code from the road. Work orders generate automatically ahead of each due date so nothing slips, and anything you choose to put off is tracked as deferred maintenance instead of being forgotten. Stay ahead of wear instead of reacting to breakdowns.

modules.description: Shop-floor execution module: work-order intake from inspection defect, telematics fault, or driver report; task-line composition with labor and parts; in-shop versus out-of-shop routing; mechanic and shop assignment; defect triage; completion sign-off and post-repair quality check.
modules.catalog_tagline: Turn every defect, fault, and driver report into a tracked repair from intake to sign-off.
modules.catalog_description: Open a work order the moment a problem shows up, whether it comes from a failed inspection, a telematics fault, or a driver's note. Build the job with labor and parts lines, assign it to the right mechanic and shop, and decide what stays in-house and what goes out. Triage incoming defects by severity, keep each repair moving through its stages, and close it out with a completion sign-off and a quality check so the vehicle goes back into service ready to run.

modules.description: Driver-and-operations module: maintains driver master records (license, medical card, training, HOS status), pre/post-trip inspection reports, and the time-bound assignment of vehicles to drivers, routes and jobs with daily dispatch boards and capacity matching.
modules.catalog_tagline: Match the right driver to the right vehicle, run the daily dispatch board, and keep every inspection on file.
modules.catalog_description: Maintain complete driver records, licenses, medical cards, training, and hours-of-service status, so you always know who is cleared to drive. Assign vehicles to drivers, routes, and jobs for set windows, and run a daily dispatch board that matches available capacity to the work in front of you. Capture pre-trip and post-trip inspection reports so defects surface early and nothing unsafe leaves the yard. Everything driver, assignment, and inspection lives together, ready when you need to prove it.

modules.description: Fuel-cost and regulatory-rollup module: ingests fuel-card and charging transactions, detects fueling exceptions and mpg trends, and produces DOT registration, IFTA fuel-tax, IRP apportioned registration and audit-evidence reporting.
modules.catalog_tagline: Track every fuel and charging dollar, flag the exceptions, and turn the data into your DOT and IFTA filings.
modules.catalog_description: Bring every fuel-card and charging transaction into one place, then spot fueling exceptions and mpg trends before they quietly drain the budget. Watch cost per mile and cost per gallon by vehicle and by driver, and act on the outliers. When filing season comes, turn your fuel and mileage data into DOT registration, IFTA fuel-tax, and IRP apportioned-registration reporting, with the audit evidence ready to hand. Spend less time chasing paperwork and more time keeping the fleet compliant.

modules.description: Vehicle-as-asset module: maintains the vehicle master from acquisition through in-service, reassignment, retirement and disposal, and runs utilization analytics (productive vs idle vs deadhead, cost-per-mile and cost-per-hour benchmarking, right-sizing).
modules.catalog_tagline: Manage every vehicle as an asset, from acquisition to resale, and know exactly what each one costs you to run.
modules.catalog_description: Keep a single, trusted record for every vehicle you own or lease, and follow it through its whole life: acquisition, putting it in service, reassigning it, retiring it, and selling it on. See utilization clearly, productive miles versus idle and deadhead time, and compare cost per mile and cost per hour across the fleet so you can right-size and replace at the right moment. Stop guessing about your assets and make purchase, hold, and disposal decisions on real numbers.

modules.description: GIS field and boundary mapping with seasonal crop planning and multi-year rotation modeling. Defines the spatial units of farm operations and the seasonal plan layered onto each field.
modules.catalog_tagline: Draw your fields once, then plan every season and rotation on top of accurate boundaries.
modules.catalog_description:
Map field and paddock boundaries from GPS, imagery, or existing records so every operation downstream is tied to the right acres. Adjust boundaries as fields split, merge, or change use, and keep one trusted set of spatial units for the whole operation.

Layer a crop plan onto each field for the coming season and model multi-year rotations to balance soil health, input cost, and market timing. Commit plans when they are ready so planting, spraying, and harvest teams all work from the same intended program.

modules.description: Per-pass operational record-keeping across the season: planting events, chemical and fertilizer applications, and harvest yield capture. The compliance and audit trail of what happened in each field.
modules.catalog_tagline: Log what actually happened in each field, pass by pass, with an audit trail you can stand behind.
modules.catalog_description:
Record planting events, chemical and fertilizer applications, and harvest yields as operations happen in the field, on a phone or in the cab. Capture the rate, product, timing, weather, and operator for each pass so nothing is reconstructed from memory at season end.

The result is a complete, time-stamped history of every field that supports re-entry and pre-harvest interval checks, proves what was applied and when, and feeds traceability and food-safety requests. When a buyer or auditor needs evidence, the record is already there.

modules.description: Ag-input stock tracking reconciled against application and purchase records, paired with multi-season yield and field-performance analytics for profitability-per-zone and return-on-input analysis.
modules.catalog_tagline: Know what input stock you have, what each field cost, and which acres returned the most.
modules.catalog_description:
Track seed, fertilizer, and chemical inventory and reconcile it against application and purchase records so on-hand quantities stay accurate and low stock is flagged before it stops an operation. Tie every input draw back to the field and pass that consumed it.

Pair that with multi-season yield and field-performance analytics to see profitability per zone and return on each input. Compare fields and seasons, find where money was made or lost, and carry those lessons into next year's plan.
