modules.description: Site-specific prescription authoring and machinery telemetry integration. Generates variable-rate application maps from yield zones and soil tests and ingests normalized equipment telemetry over CAN-bus, ISOBUS, and OEM machinery APIs.
modules.catalog_tagline: Turn field data into variable-rate maps and bring your machinery telemetry into the same system.
modules.catalog_description:
Author site-specific prescriptions that vary seed, fertilizer, and chemical rates by zone, built from yield history and soil tests, then publish them to your equipment for execution. Apply inputs where they pay off and pull back where they do not, instead of treating every acre the same.

Ingest normalized machinery telemetry from your fleet so as-applied and as-harvested data flows back automatically over standard equipment buses and OEM connections. Close the loop between the map you planned and the work the machines actually did.

modules.description: Initiate, track, and report on product recalls: identify affected lots from lot genealogy, notify downstream consignees, manage hold-and-segregate status, and file Reportable Food Registry submissions against the governing compliance obligations.
modules.catalog_tagline: Run a recall end to end: find affected lots, notify consignees, hold stock, and file with regulators.
modules.catalog_description:
Start a recall and immediately identify every affected lot using lot genealogy, then classify it by severity to set the right notification and filing path. Track who has been notified, what stock is on hold, and what has been recovered, all against a single recall record.

Keep a defensible communications log per recipient, file the required regulatory submissions, verify that the recall was effective, and close it out with a complete, audit-ready trail.

modules.description: Centralized vault for supplier certifications (GFSI, organic, kosher, halal, allergen, insurance) with expiry and renewal tracking, plus verification and tamper-evident anchoring of origin and provenance claims surfaced to downstream stakeholders.
modules.catalog_tagline: Keep supplier certifications and provenance claims current, verified, and ready for audit.
modules.catalog_description:
Hold supplier certifications in one vault with expiry and renewal tracking, so an out-of-date or revoked certificate is caught before it affects a shipment. Onboard new documents, validate them, and flag the ones that need attention.

Verify origin and provenance claims against the documents that back them, and surface trustworthy provenance to the people and partners who depend on it.

modules.description: Capture FSMA-204 critical tracking events and their key data elements against traceability lot codes, and traverse forward and backward lot genealogy from raw-material lots through transformation to finished SKUs. Generates the FDA-sortable KDE response used for 24-hour traceback.
modules.catalog_tagline: Record receive, transform, and ship events against lot codes and walk lot genealogy in both directions.
modules.catalog_description:
Log the critical tracking events and key data elements for every lot as it moves through receiving, transformation, and shipping. Each event is tied to a lot code so the full history of a product is always reconstructable.

Walk the genealogy graph forward from a raw-material lot through transformation to finished goods, or backward from a finished SKU to its sources, and produce the sortable record needed to answer a traceback request inside the required timeframe.

modules.description: The mobile-first reach and engagement surface. Masters frontline broadcasts and message channels; carries broadcast audiences, mandatory-read acknowledgments, and recognitions. Consumes the workforce's employees so messages and recognition target real people on the floor.
modules.catalog_tagline: Reach every frontline worker and prove they saw it.
modules.catalog_description: Send targeted announcements and let supervisors cascade them down to their teams across mobile, kiosk, and shared devices. Confirm who has read mandatory messages, recognize good work in the same feed, and deliver content in the language and policy rules each location needs.

modules.description: The do-the-work surface. Masters frontline tasks, checklists, shift-swap requests, and learning modules; carries task submissions and learning completions. Consumes shifts from Workforce Management and emits handoffs when a swap is approved or a task is completed.
modules.catalog_tagline: Push the work, get it done, and prove it from any phone.
modules.catalog_description: Send tasks and checklists to the floor and collect photo and form evidence as workers complete them. Let workers swap shifts and pick up open coverage on their own devices with one manager tap, finish short training between tasks, and hand approved swaps back to scheduling and completed work back to store and plant operations.

modules.description: Field-service operational core: work-order creation and lifecycle, technician assignment via dispatch records, field-visit execution, real-time route optimization, and truck-stock parts management. The module the dispatcher and field technicians both live in.
modules.catalog_tagline: Turn inbound service requests into scheduled, dispatched, and completed work orders with the right technician on the job.
modules.catalog_description: The dispatch operations module is the desk-and-truck heart of field service. It takes work orders from intake to close: scheduling the visit, assigning a technician, tracking the dispatch from en route to on site, and recording the field visit outcome. Dispatchers see capacity, skills, and travel at a glance so they commit only to jobs they can deliver, and technicians get a clear day plan. The payoff is fewer missed appointments, shorter drive time, and clean completion data that feeds billing and customer follow-up.

modules.description: Asset register of customer-owned equipment the service organization installs and maintains, plus the recurring preventive-maintenance schedules that drive proactive service. Tracks equipment from install through decommission, with PM cadence per unit.
modules.catalog_tagline: Keep a living record of every installed unit and its preventive-maintenance schedule across each customer site.
modules.catalog_description: The installed base module is the system of record for equipment in the field. Each unit is tracked from install through active service, maintenance, and eventual decommission or replacement, tied to the customer site where it lives. Preventive-maintenance schedules drive proactive visits before something breaks, and overdue work surfaces automatically. Service teams gain a complete asset history that shortens diagnosis on the next call, protects warranty and contract coverage, and turns reactive break-fix into planned, recurring service revenue.

modules.description: The technician-side field app: field-visit execution, offline sync, route-of-day, and proof-of-completion. Split out of dispatch operations to match the market shape (every flagship ships a distinct technician mobile app).
modules.catalog_tagline: Give technicians an offline-ready field app: their day's route, the job, and proof it got done.
modules.catalog_description: Put the work in the technician's hand. The mobile module runs the field visit from arrival to sign-off: the route of the day, the job details, parts used, and proof-of-completion, all working offline and syncing when signal returns. Technicians stop juggling paper and phone calls, and the office gets clean, timely completion data the moment the job closes. This is the truck half of field service, separate from the dispatcher's desk.

modules.description: Recurring service agreements between the service organization and customers, covering specific installed equipment under defined SLA terms. Drives entitlement checks on work orders, renewal workflows, and revenue recognition on the recurring stream.
modules.catalog_tagline: Manage service contracts and coverage so every visit is billed and every entitlement is honored.
modules.catalog_description: The service contracts module governs the agreements that sit behind field work. Contracts move from draft to active to renewal or expiry, and each one defines what coverage a customer is entitled to and how visits get priced and billed. Tying contracts to the installed equipment they cover means dispatch knows whether a job is in-scope, and finance knows what to invoice. Teams reduce revenue leakage from uncovered work, renew on time instead of letting coverage lapse, and give customers a clear picture of what their agreement includes.

modules.description: Prepare for GFSI-benchmarked certification audits, score and segment ingredient and packaging suppliers by safety and food-fraud risk, track supplier certifications and compliance obligations, and execute product recalls.
modules.catalog_tagline: Walk into every certification audit prepared and keep supplier risk in view.
modules.catalog_description:
Prepare for benchmarked certification audits with evidence binders, score forecasts, and a calendar that keeps nothing a surprise. Score and segment your ingredient and packaging suppliers by safety and food-fraud risk, and track the certifications and compliance obligations each one owes you.

When a recall is unavoidable, execute it with traceability and regulatory reporting built in, so you can act fast and show your work to customers and authorities.

modules.description: Author and maintain HACCP plans, define critical control points with critical limits, capture shift-frequency CCP monitoring readings, and drive deviation, hold-and-test, and corrective-action workflows from food-safety incidents.
modules.catalog_tagline: Build HACCP plans and catch every critical-limit deviation as it happens.
modules.catalog_description:
Author HACCP and preventive-control plans, define critical control points with their critical limits, and route each plan through review and approval before it takes effect. Capture monitoring readings at the line on every shift and flag deviations the moment a limit is crossed.

When a reading goes out of limit, trigger a product hold, open a food-safety incident, and work the corrective action through to closure, with a full record of who did what and when for your next audit.

modules.description: Run hygiene and contamination-control programs: per-product-line allergen maps and changeover validation, pathogen environmental-monitoring sampling plans with zone trend analytics, and per-shift sanitation completion and verification records.
modules.catalog_tagline: Run allergen, sanitation, and environmental monitoring without the spreadsheets.
modules.catalog_description:
Map allergens by product and line, validate changeovers, and review labels so the right warnings reach the right packaging. Plan environmental-monitoring swabs by zone, track results, and watch for trends before a single positive becomes a pattern.

Schedule master sanitation, confirm each cycle is completed and verified, and keep pre-operational inspection evidence ready. Every hygiene and contamination-control activity lands in one record set you can hand to an auditor on request.

modules.description: Capital-call notice generation, LP payment tracking, and call schedule management across funds. Requires approval workflow (GP sign-off, sometimes IC).
modules.catalog_tagline: Call capital from LPs and track the cash back: issue the call, allocate by commitment, and reconcile every response.
modules.catalog_description:
Capital calls turns the need for cash into a controlled drawdown. It allocates a call across LPs by their commitment percentages, issues the call, and tracks each LP's response, what was due, what was funded, and when, so the fund always knows its real cash position.

Handling the slow payers and the defaults is part of the workflow, not an afterthought. Funded responses flow straight back to the commitment record, advancing each LP's called-to-date balance without a second round of data entry.

modules.description: Distribution notice generation with European/American/hybrid waterfall calculations, catchup, clawback, and hurdle-rate handling.
modules.catalog_tagline: Return money to investors the right way: compute the waterfall, split preferred return, catch-up, and carry, then pay LPs.
modules.catalog_description:
Distributions is where the fund pays its investors and where the math has to be exactly right. It runs the distribution waterfall per the fund agreement, European, American, or hybrid, working through hurdle tests, GP catch-up, carried interest, and the return to each LP.

Because the calculation is the highest-stakes number the fund produces, the module treats it as a reviewed, approved step rather than a one-off spreadsheet. Approved distributions update each LP's distributed-to-date balance and post to the general ledger, keeping investor accounts and fund books in lockstep.

modules.description: Fund accounting: GP books for the fund vehicle, multi-currency support, GAAP/IFRS partnership accounting, and audit-support packaging. Masters funds, fund ledger entries, and close periods.
modules.catalog_tagline: The fund's general ledger: book every contribution, expense, fee, and gain, then close the period with confidence.
modules.catalog_description:
The fund ledger is the system of record for fund accounting. It captures every accounting entry against the fund vehicle, contributions, fees, expenses, and gain or loss recognitions, under GAAP or IFRS, and rolls them up through structured close periods.

Because the partner capital account statements and the audit pack are built directly from these entries, the close cycle becomes a controlled workflow rather than a quarter-end scramble. Teams get a faster, cleaner close and a defensible trail behind every reported figure.

modules.description: LP onboarding (KYC/AML + subscription document collection), PCAP (partner capital account) statement generation, and LP-facing portal for statement and document access.
modules.catalog_tagline: Onboard limited partners and hold the commitment book: subscriptions, KYC and AML, and the partner capital accounts LPs see.
modules.catalog_description:
LP commitments is where investors enter the fund and where their standing with the fund lives. It runs subscription intake with the KYC, AML, and accreditation checks onboarding requires, then maintains each LP's active commitment: committed, called to date, distributed to date, and current value.

It is also the home of the partner capital account statement, the quarterly document every LP reads. Driven from the commitment record and the fund ledger, the module keeps investor-facing balances accurate and gives the LP-relations team a single trustworthy view of who committed what and where they stand today.

modules.description: Sales-capacity modeling: coverage, ramp, productivity assumptions, headcount, and hiring plans against revenue targets.
modules.catalog_tagline: Model the capacity you need to hit the number: coverage, ramp, productivity, and hiring.
modules.catalog_description: Answer how many sellers, of what kind, by when. Model coverage and productivity assumptions, factor in ramp time, and build the hiring plan that closes the gap between capacity and the revenue target. See where you are short or over-built before the year starts, and give Finance and Recruiting a headcount plan grounded in real coverage math rather than a top-down guess.

modules.description: Plan approval, lock, and the downstream push: approvals, lock records, and handoff of the committed plan to CRM, SPM, Marketing, and Finance.
modules.catalog_tagline: Lock the plan and push it cleanly to Sales, Marketing, and Finance.
modules.catalog_description: Close the planning cycle with control. Route the plan for approval, lock it so it stops moving, and push the committed segments, territories, quotas, and capacity to the systems that execute: CRM and Sales Performance for territories and quotas, the ABM platform and Marketing for target accounts, and Finance for the capacity numbers. One source of truth for what was committed, and a clean handoff instead of a spreadsheet hand-off.

modules.description: The who-do-we-sell-to layer: market segmentation, ICP authoring, named target-account lists, planning-grade account scoring, and strategic channel-mix. The segmentation surface every planning vendor co-locates.
modules.catalog_tagline: Define who you sell to: segments, your ideal customer, named target accounts, and how you score them.
modules.catalog_description: Decide where to play before you spend a dollar. Build your market segments, define the ideal customer profile, and author the named target-account lists the whole revenue team works from, then score accounts so reps chase the right ones. Set the strategic channel mix that says which routes carry which segments. The output is a shared, governed view of your market that feeds territory design, sales engagement, and demand programs.

modules.description: What-if scenario modeling and plan versioning across segmentation, territory, capacity, and channel choices.
modules.catalog_tagline: Run the what-ifs and compare versions before you commit the plan.
modules.catalog_description: Stress-test the plan before you lock it. Model alternative scenarios across segments, territories, capacity, and channels, compare them side by side, and keep every version so you can see what changed and why. When the business asks what happens if we add ten reps or shift to a new segment, you answer with a modeled scenario, not a hunch, and you carry the winning version forward into the locked plan.

modules.description: Territory carving and quota allocation: balanced territory design and quota setting against coverage and capacity. The single most universal planner surface.
modules.catalog_tagline: Carve balanced territories and set quotas that hold up, against real coverage and capacity.
modules.catalog_description: Turn the plan into who-owns-what: design balanced territories, see coverage and white space, and allocate quotas that tie back to capacity and segment potential. Reps get fair, defensible patches and numbers, and leadership gets a territory and quota model that survives the year instead of being reworked every quarter. When the design locks, it pushes cleanly into Sales execution.

modules.description: Authoritative register of hardware assets and their reference models. Tracks discovery feeds, lifecycle states, financial attributes (purchase, depreciation), and ownership.
modules.catalog_tagline: One source of truth for every hardware asset and the models behind it.
modules.catalog_description: Capture devices the moment they are discovered, assign them to people and locations, and follow each one through its full lifecycle. Hold a clean catalog of the models you standardize on, track purchase and depreciation for finance, and see at a glance what is deployed, in repair, or ready to retire.

modules.description: Warranty registrations, end-of-life disposal records, and spare-parts inventory at warehouses and on technician trucks. Sits adjacent to the asset registry; feeds field-service operations.
modules.catalog_tagline: Warranties, spare parts, and clean end-of-life, all in one place.
modules.catalog_description: Register warranty coverage and get ahead of expirations before they cost you. Keep spare parts stocked across warehouses and field technicians so repairs do not stall, and run device disposal with sanitized media, certificates, and the evidence auditors and regulators expect.

modules.description: Core worker record: identity, employment lifecycle, contracts, and effective-dated employment events. The system-of-record layer for every employee.
modules.catalog_tagline: Maintain the authoritative worker record, employment contracts, and the personal data the rest of HR depends on.
modules.catalog_description:
The core worker module is where every employee profile lives: identity, status, manager, position, org unit, and the employment contracts that bind them. Capture each worker from pre-hire through active employment to termination, with personal-content fields protected by the access controls a workforce of record requires.

Keep contracts and core attributes current and let downstream systems read from a single trusted source. When a worker is hired, promoted, or leaves, this module is the event that triggers payroll, access provisioning, benefits, and asset recall, so the data here stays clean and the handoffs stay reliable.

modules.description: Employee and manager self-service portal coordinating cross-domain lifecycle: onboarding intake from ATS, lifecycle change requests, leave/absence visibility, and offboarding handoffs to ITSM/IGA/PAYROLL. Workflow surface on top of HCM-CORE-WORKER and HCM-ORG-POSITIONS, no masters of its own.
modules.catalog_tagline: Move people through the moments that matter: onboarding, job and leave changes, and a coordinated offboarding.
modules.catalog_description:
The lifecycle workflows module orchestrates the transitions in an employee's journey. Reconcile new hires arriving from recruiting into active workers, route everyday change requests like transfers and leaves of absence, and coordinate a clean offboarding across IT, identity, and payroll.

Employees and managers drive much of this themselves through self-service, while HR keeps oversight. Each step reads from and writes back to the authoritative worker record, so a completed onboarding, an approved leave, or a finished separation lands consistently everywhere it needs to without manual rekeying.

modules.description: Organization design: org units, positions, and job profiles. Effective-dated org structure with position approval workflow, job-profile authority, and the hierarchical backbone every downstream HR system reads. Foundation for workforce planning and span-of-control analytics.
modules.catalog_tagline: Design your organization: build the job catalog, define positions, and shape the org structure headcount planning runs on.
modules.catalog_description:
The org and positions module is where you model the shape of the organization rather than the people in it. Author and publish job profiles, approve and open positions against budgeted headcount, and maintain the org-unit hierarchy through creation, reorganization, merges, and closures.

This is the planning surface that recruiting, compensation, and workforce planning all consume. Publishing a job profile opens the door to a requisition; approving a position signals where to hire; reorganizing a unit cascades to access and reporting lines. Get the structure right here and every downstream people process inherits a clean foundation.

modules.description: Non-technical authoring of content entries with rich text, references, draft and publish, scheduling, role-based editorial workflows, multi-locale translations, inline and visual editing, version history, and content-bound media assets.
modules.catalog_tagline: Write, review, translate, and publish content without code
modules.catalog_description: Create and edit content entries in a friendly editor, then move them from draft to published through review steps that fit your team. Schedule entries to go live automatically, translate them into every locale you serve, and roll back to any prior version when you need to.

modules.description: Serve a single content source to many channels through cached, low-latency delivery APIs, coordinate scheduled content releases, and trigger downstream actions through outbound webhooks and integration hooks on content state changes.
modules.catalog_tagline: Deliver content everywhere and trigger downstream actions
modules.catalog_description: Serve one source of content to every channel through fast, cached delivery APIs built for any front end. Coordinate scheduled releases so related changes go live together, and fire webhooks to keep downstream systems in sync the moment content changes.

modules.description: Define content types, fields, references, and validation rules exposed automatically as REST and GraphQL endpoints, and manage isolated content environments (dev, staging, production) for safe schema and content migrations.
modules.catalog_tagline: Shape your content structure and ship schema changes safely
modules.catalog_description: Design reusable content types with fields, references, and validation rules that become ready-to-use APIs the moment you save them. Work across isolated environments so you can test schema and content changes before they reach production, and migrate with confidence.

modules.description: Entry-tier deployable for a basic hiring workflow: post jobs, capture applications, run interviews, generate offers. Embeds the canonical masters from the full ATS modules and inherits their lifecycle states. Ships three baseline permissions and one system skill; no workflow gates, no requisition approvals, no background-check orchestration, no pre-employee reconciliation. Upgrades to the full ATS surface without tenant data migration via the embedded-master demotion path.
modules.catalog_tagline: Everything a small team needs to hire, in one lightweight package.
modules.catalog_description: A starter bundle covering the core hiring path (postings, candidates, applications, interviews, and offers) without the breadth of the full module set. Stand up hiring quickly, then grow into the full modules as your volume increases; your data moves with you when you do.

modules.description: Core HR case management surface: HR cases, case taxonomy, triage, approval routing, and AI-assisted classification. Masters hr_cases and case_categories. The execution backbone of any HRSD deployment.
modules.catalog_tagline: Capture, triage, and resolve every employee HR request in one tracked queue.
modules.catalog_description:
Turn employee questions and requests into structured cases that move through a clear workflow: intake, triage, assignment, work, approval, and resolution. Each case lands with the right specialist, carries its full history, and closes against a service level everyone can see.

Route sensitive cases to the right owner, escalate to payroll, benefits, or access teams when a request crosses into their scope, and reopen a closed case cleanly when something changes. Managers get a real-time view of workload, aging, and approvals so HR support stays predictable instead of reactive.

modules.description: Employee self-service intake surface: catalog browse, request submission, knowledge search, and case status. Workflow layer on top of HRSD-CASE-MGMT, no masters of its own. Hands intake off to case-mgmt and can route IT-flavored requests through to ITSM.
modules.catalog_tagline: A single front door where employees ask, request, and self-serve HR needs.
modules.catalog_description:
Give employees one place to start anything HR-related. They search for answers first, raise a case when they need a person, and check the status of everything they have open without sending a follow-up email.

The portal connects to the same case workflow HR teams use, so a request submitted here arrives fully formed and ready to triage. Familiar self-service patterns reduce inbound volume and let employees resolve common needs on their own time.

modules.description: HR knowledge surface: HR-audience articles, FAQs, and policy explainers. Consumes the cross-cutting knowledge_articles entity (mastered by ITSM/KMS) and feeds back authoring suggestions when cases are resolved.
modules.catalog_tagline: Build and publish the HR knowledge that answers employees before they ask.
modules.catalog_description:
Maintain a living library of HR answers, policies, and how-to guidance that employees can find from the portal and that agents can attach to a case in seconds. Articles are organized by the same categories that classify cases, so the right answer surfaces in the right context.

Every resolved case is a candidate for new knowledge, so the library compounds over time, deflecting repeat questions and keeping guidance consistent across the whole employee population.

modules.description: Small-shop persona bundle for HVAC service businesses (5-30 technicians). Single-install deployable covering customer accounts and contacts (CRM), service dispatch and field execution (FSM-DISPATCH-OPS), installed equipment register and PM cadence (FSM-INSTALLED-BASE), recurring maintenance agreements (FSM-SERVICE-CONTRACTS), quote-to-invoice (CPQ + SUB-MGMT), and parts inventory (HAM). Larger organizations deploy the full modules and skip the starter.
modules.catalog_tagline: A ready-to-run home-services starter that takes an HVAC job from customer call to scheduled visit and invoice.
modules.catalog_description: This starter packages the field-service essentials a heating and cooling service business needs on day one. It bundles the customer and contact record, the installed equipment at each site, work orders and field visits, service contracts, and the quote-to-invoice path so a small team can book a call, schedule a technician, complete the job, and bill it without stitching tools together. It is a fast on-ramp to field service for trades operators who want the core workflow working immediately and can grow into the full modules later.

modules.description: Scheduled and ad-hoc access recertification campaigns. Reviewers attest or revoke; revoke decisions drive provisioning; campaign closure produces GRC evidence.
modules.catalog_tagline: Run access reviews on a schedule so reviewers confirm what people should keep and revoke the rest.
modules.catalog_description:
Access certification puts business owners in the driver's seat for periodic reviews. Campaigns are scheduled, scoped to the right population, and routed to the reviewers who actually know whether each grant still makes sense.

Reviewers approve or revoke line by line, and revocation decisions feed straight into provisioning so removals happen instead of sitting in a spreadsheet. Every campaign produces clean, timestamped evidence that auditors can trust, which turns recurring compliance reviews from a quarterly fire drill into a routine that runs itself.

modules.description: Joiner/mover/ad-hoc access request workflow: request submission, SoD pre-check, approval routing, provisioning handoff.
modules.catalog_tagline: Let people request the access they need and route it through the right approvals automatically.
modules.catalog_description:
Access requests turn a manual, email-driven scramble into a guided workflow. People pick what they need from a clear catalog, the request is checked for segregation-of-duties conflicts before anyone approves it, and it routes to the right approvers based on the entitlement and the requester.

Approvals are tracked end to end, and an approved request hands off straight to provisioning so the access actually shows up without a separate ticket. The result is faster time-to-access, fewer help-desk tickets, and a complete record of who asked for what, who approved it, and why.

modules.description: Connector framework + provisioning event log. Executes create/modify/suspend/delete actions in downstream systems on receipt of approved requests or JML events.
modules.catalog_tagline: Push approved access changes out to connected systems automatically and prove they landed.
modules.catalog_description:
Automated provisioning closes the loop between a governance decision and the systems that enforce it. When access is approved, certified, or revoked, connectors apply the change to the target systems without manual rework, and the result is captured as a tracked event.

Each provisioning run records whether it completed, failed, or rolled back, so there is always proof that the intended access state was actually achieved. That removes the gap between what was approved and what is real, cuts the standing risk of lingering access, and gives auditors hard evidence that decisions were carried out.

modules.description: Catalog of access primitives (roles, groups, permission sets, birthright bundles). Lightweight lifecycle: draft -> published -> deprecated -> retired.
modules.catalog_tagline: Maintain one authoritative catalog of what each entitlement means and who can request it.
modules.catalog_description:
The entitlement catalog is the single source of truth for the access an organization can grant. Each entitlement is defined once, with a clear owner, description, and lifecycle from draft to published to retired, so requesters and reviewers always see accurate, business-friendly choices instead of cryptic system permissions.

Published definitions feed the request and review workflows and keep segregation-of-duties rules anchored to real, current entitlements. Curating access centrally means fewer orphaned permissions, cleaner reviews, and a catalog that stays trustworthy as systems change.

modules.description: Toxic-combination ruleset, detection engine, triage workflow, mitigation tracking, accepted-risk register.
modules.catalog_tagline: Catch toxic access combinations before they become audit findings.
modules.catalog_description:
Segregation-of-duties management defines the access combinations that should never sit with one person and watches for them continuously. Rules are evaluated when access is requested and across the existing population, so conflicts surface at the moment of decision rather than at audit time.

Detected violations move through a clear remediation path: triage, mitigate, or formally accept the risk, with every step recorded. Owners get a defensible trail of how each conflict was handled, which keeps financial and regulatory controls intact without slowing the business down.

modules.description: The human investigation workflow. Masters insider-risk cases (full lifecycle), investigation evidence, and exit-risk assessments for departing users. Provides activity timelines and file-lineage forensics, and hands high-risk cases off to HR and Legal with defensible evidence packages.
modules.catalog_tagline: Investigate insider cases end to end and hand defensible evidence to HR and Legal.
modules.catalog_description: Work alerts into a structured case queue and investigate with a full activity timeline and file-lineage forensics. Collect and preserve evidence as you go, assess exit risk for departing employees during their highest-risk window, and package everything for HR and Legal review with a clear chain of custody. Close cases with a documented disposition that stands up to scrutiny.

modules.description: The always-on signal layer. Masters user risk scores, monitored activity, risk indicators, and the prioritized alert queue, plus the detection rules that generate them. Consumes egress events from DLP, sensitive-data context from DSPM, and identity context to baseline behavior and surface anomalies.
modules.catalog_tagline: Turn endpoint, email, file, and cloud signals into a ranked queue of risky users.
modules.catalog_description: Continuously score every user's behavior and watch for anomalous data movement across endpoints, email, cloud, and removable media. Tune detection rules to your risk tolerance, fold in egress and sensitive-data signals you already collect, and get a prioritized alert queue that puts the riskiest insiders at the top, so analysts triage real threats instead of chasing noise.

modules.description: Accountable ownership assignments, recertification attestations, and the improvement backlog.
modules.catalog_tagline: Put a name on every page and keep it accountable over time.
modules.catalog_description: Assign an accountable owner and review cadence to each piece of content, run recertification cycles so owners confirm what is current or flag what is stale, and turn the gaps into a prioritized improvement backlog. The accountability layer that keeps your intranet from decaying into a ghost town.

modules.description: Connector registry, cross-platform content inventory, content-type policy, and health scoring.
modules.catalog_tagline: See every piece of content across all your intranets in one map.
modules.catalog_description: Connect SharePoint, Viva, Staffbase, Simpplr, or WordPress and automatically build a living inventory of every page, hub, library, and form. Classify content by type, score its health and accessibility, and know exactly what exists before you decide what to fix.

modules.description: Items, balances, lot and serial tracking, stock movements, transfers, and cycle counts. The deployable base module of INV-MGMT.
modules.catalog_tagline: The accurate, auditable single source of truth for every item you hold.
modules.catalog_description: Establish the foundation of inventory control: items, locations, and live on-hand balances across every warehouse and bin. Capture each receipt, issue, adjustment, and transfer as a posted stock movement so balances are always defensible, and track lots and serial numbers for traceability, expiry, and recall. Run scheduled cycle counts to catch shrinkage early and reconcile variances before they reach the general ledger, giving operations and finance one trusted stock record they can both stand behind.

modules.description: The investment-opportunity pipeline backbone: deal sourcing through closure, deal-team collaboration, and IC investment memos. Structurally similar to standalone deal-flow products. Masters deals and investment memos.
modules.catalog_tagline: Run every investment from first meeting to signed term sheet with the diligence, memo, and committee approvals all in one pipeline.
modules.catalog_description:
Move each opportunity through a shared pipeline so the whole deal team sees where it stands. Capture a new deal the moment it is sourced, work it through diligence, and pull the supporting material together as you go. When it is ready for the committee, draft the investment memo, lock it for the vote, and record the decision.

Keep the approvals where they belong. The stages that matter, committee review, term sheet, and close, carry their own permission gates, so the right people sign off before a deal advances and a pass is logged just as clearly as a win. Per-deal roles keep accountability tied to the opportunity rather than to a static org chart.

The payoff is a pipeline leadership can trust, faster handoffs between sourcing and diligence, and an auditable trail of how each investment decision was actually made.

modules.description: Fundraising-side CRM for LP outreach, meetings, and capital-commitment pipeline. Also lightweight portfolio-company awareness for deal-team consumption (full portfolio monitoring lives in PORT-MONIT).
modules.catalog_tagline: Manage limited partners from first research through soft circle to a firm commitment, then hand the relationship cleanly to fund administration.
modules.catalog_description:
Run your fundraise as a relationship pipeline, not a spreadsheet. Track each prospective limited partner from initial research through outreach, meetings, and a soft circle to a signed commitment, with the people leading the relationship clearly assigned. See at a glance who is in motion, who is stalled, and where the next conversation needs to happen.

Keep the capital side connected to the rest of the firm. When an LP commits, hand the relationship to fund administration so the commitment is recorded without re-keying, and surface capital-call and fund activity back into the relationship record so the people who back you always feel looked after.

The payoff is a fundraise you can forecast, warmer long-term investor relationships, and a clean boundary between the courtship of an LP and the administration of the fund they join.

modules.description: Auto-inferred relationship graph from email/calendar metadata with warm-introduction path computation across the firm's network. Identity reconciliation of founders, executives, and co-investors across deal stages.
modules.catalog_tagline: Map who in your firm knows whom, surface the warmest path to any target, and route introductions to the colleague best placed to make them.
modules.catalog_description:
Build a relationship graph from the signals your team already produces. The system reads email and calendar metadata to infer who is connected to whom and how strong each tie is, then keeps that map current as relationships grow or go quiet. Founders, executives, co-investors, board members, and advisors all sit in one network directory.

Use the graph to open doors. When you want to reach a person or an organization, see the shortest warm path in and ask the colleague who actually holds that relationship to make the introduction. Track the request through to a yes or a no so nothing stalls in someone's inbox.

The payoff is more introductions that land, less guessing about who can reach a target, and a network that becomes a shared firm asset instead of a set of private address books.

modules.description: Kit definitions, kit explosion at order or production time, and finished-kit on-hand maintenance. Add-on for sellers with bundled-SKU or light-manufacturing flows.
modules.catalog_tagline: Sell bundles and build assemblies without losing track of components.
modules.catalog_description: Define kits and bundles once, then let component stock deplete automatically as kits are assembled or sold. Maintain finished-kit on-hand alongside raw components, explode bills of materials at order or production time, and post the resulting component-consumption movements straight into your stock record. Ideal for sellers shipping bundled SKUs and shops running light manufacturing, so bundle availability stays accurate and component counts never drift.

modules.description: Reorder rules, ABC-XYZ classification, and available-to-promise calculation. Layered on top of Core Stock to drive automated replenishment.
modules.catalog_tagline: Stop guessing what to buy. Let reorder rules and demand signals decide.
modules.catalog_description: Turn stock data into buying decisions. Set reorder points, safety stock, and supplier preferences per item and location, then let the system flag what to replenish the moment on-hand falls below threshold. Classify items by value and demand variability with ABC and XYZ analysis so attention goes where it matters, and surface accurate available-to-promise figures so sales commits dates it can keep. The result is fewer stockouts, less cash tied up in dead inventory, and replenishment that runs on rules instead of firefighting.

modules.description: Cross-domain starter kit for small and mid-sized IT teams. Embeds lightweight shells of the records a small IT shop manages: the helpdesk (optional), the hardware register, the SaaS application and renewal tracker, and the contract register. The renewal/contract spine (asset_contracts + saas_subscriptions) is required; hardware, SaaS apps, helpdesk, and on-prem licenses are optional. domain_id NULL; hosts ITSM, HAM, SMP, ITAM, SAM. Replaces the helpdesk-plus-spreadsheets reality; budget stays in the general ledger.
modules.catalog_tagline: Run your whole IT shop from one place: tickets, devices, SaaS renewals, and contracts, without the spreadsheets.
modules.catalog_description: One place to manage IT for a small team. Track the hardware you own and who has it, every SaaS app and when its subscription renews, and the contracts behind them, so nothing slips through a spreadsheet and no renewal catches you off guard. Add a lightweight helpdesk for tickets and requests if you do not already run one, or keep the one you have. Start with the renewal and contract essentials and turn on the device, SaaS, and helpdesk pieces as you need them. Built for IT teams that have outgrown spreadsheets but do not need a full enterprise IT suite.
modules.specification_requirements:
Cost fields on the embedded shells. For the standalone renewal-and-cost view to resolve, two embedded masters each need a flat cost figure plus a currency code:

- `asset_contracts`: a flat `renewal_cost` (or `annual_value`) numeric field.
- `saas_subscriptions`: a flat `annual_spend` (or MRR/ARR) numeric field.

Coexistence: these flat fields are a standalone-only denormalization. They are not needed when the full asset-management and SaaS-management modules are already installed (those carry cost on their own spend entities); when such a full module is added later, the flat field must be deduplicated and reconciled against the canonical source so cost is not double-counted.

modules.description: Unified contract management for agreements spanning multiple asset types. Masters asset_contracts at the umbrella layer because a single contract often covers hardware leases plus software licenses plus SaaS bundles plus cloud commitments.
modules.catalog_tagline: Keep every lease, warranty, and support agreement tied to the assets it covers.
modules.catalog_description: Track the contracts that govern your assets, from leases and maintenance to warranties and support, in one connected record. See which assets each agreement covers, when it activates, renews, or expires, and act before a deadline catches you off guard. Stay ahead of renewals, avoid lapses in coverage, and keep procurement and finance aligned on what is committed and when.

modules.description: Cross-asset event log capturing acquisition, assignment, transfer, and retirement across all asset types. Masters asset_lifecycle_events as the single source of truth for the asset audit trail.
modules.catalog_tagline: Follow every asset from procurement to disposal in one audit-ready timeline.
modules.catalog_description: Record every step in an asset's life, procurement, deployment, transfer, retirement, and disposal, as a single connected history that spans hardware, software, and SaaS. Capture events as they happen, including the ones triggered elsewhere such as an incident, a provisioning request, or an employee leaving, so the record is always complete. When you need to prove what happened to an asset and when, the timeline is already there.

modules.description: Cross-asset reference-data layer: model recognition, software-title normalization, SaaS app catalog, and identity reconciliation across HAM, SAM, SMP, and FINOPS. The substrate that turns disparate asset feeds into a unified portfolio. No own masters in v1; reference data lives in third-party taxonomies. Computed/reconciliation layer over HAM/SAM/SMP/FINOPS/EAM masters; intentionally has no own data_objects.
modules.catalog_tagline: Turn messy, inconsistent asset feeds into one clean, trusted inventory.
modules.catalog_description: Every discovery source names the same hardware and software a little differently, leaving you with duplicate and mismatched records. This module reconciles those feeds into a single normalized catalog, so one model means one entry no matter where it was found. Keep your reference data current and let the rest of your asset management work from inventory you can trust.

modules.description: Total cost of ownership and portfolio-level reporting rolling up HAM, SAM, SMP, FINOPS, and EAM. Derived module: no own masters, consumes from every sub-domain and the cross-cutting umbrella modules.
modules.catalog_tagline: See total cost and portfolio position across your whole technology estate.
modules.catalog_description: Roll your assets, contracts, and lifecycle activity into total-cost-of-ownership and portfolio-position reporting that the whole organization can use. Spot redundant spend, plan refreshes, and answer finance, procurement, and leadership with numbers you trust. Turn a scattered estate into clear decisions about what to keep, renew, consolidate, or retire.

modules.description: Trend analysis, forecasting, and what-if modeling of compute, storage, network, and license consumption from periodic resource utilization snapshots, supporting proactive scaling and cost allocation.
modules.catalog_tagline: See where capacity is running out and forecast the upgrade before it becomes an outage.
modules.catalog_description: Track how much of each resource you are actually using over time and turn that history into a forward view. Capture utilization datapoints across the estate, establish baselines for normal load, and project when CPU, memory, storage, or throughput will hit its ceiling. Planners spot the resources trending toward exhaustion, justify upgrades with evidence instead of guesswork, and avoid both the cost of overprovisioning and the risk of running out. Capacity decisions become a scheduled, data-backed routine rather than a reaction to the last incident.

modules.description: Server, network, storage, hypervisor, and container monitoring with metric collection, threshold policies, log aggregation, and topology-aware alerting. Ingests, normalizes, de-duplicates, and correlates the raw event stream into human-relevant alerts that page or ticket.
modules.catalog_tagline: Turn a flood of infrastructure signals into a short list of alerts that matter, each tied to the service it affects.
modules.catalog_description:
The monitoring and event core of IT operations. Ingest events from across servers, networks, and services, then let the policies you author decide what is normal, what is a warning, and what is a real problem. Correlate related events so one underlying fault raises one actionable alert instead of a hundred, and route each alert to the team that owns the affected service.

Operators get a single live view of infrastructure health, acknowledge and resolve alerts on a clear workflow, and hand off to incident management automatically when an alert needs a ticket. Tuning your monitoring policies over time means less noise, faster detection, and fewer surprises in production.

modules.description: Codified operational runbooks executed with approval gates for common incidents and maintenance tasks, plus enterprise job scheduling, batch automation, and dependency-aware cross-platform workload orchestration triggered by operational alerts.
modules.catalog_tagline: Automate the routine recovery steps and scheduled work so the team is not paged for problems a runbook can fix.
modules.catalog_description: Take the repeatable operational work off people's plates. When an alert fires, trigger the runbook that restarts the service, clears the queue, or scales the resource, and let a human step in only when the automation cannot resolve it. Schedule the recurring jobs and workloads that keep the estate healthy, and tie automated actions back to the alerts that prompted them so every run is traceable. The result is faster recovery, fewer after-hours pages, and consistent execution of the steps an experienced operator would take anyway.

modules.description: Unified agent experience: workspace, walk-up support, virtual agent / conversational ITSM, and continuous-improvement reporting.
modules.catalog_tagline: Give agents one workspace and leaders the reporting to run the service desk.
modules.catalog_description:
Agent Workspace and Reporting brings the agent's queue, context, and tools into a single view so they can work tickets without hunting across screens. Everything needed to understand and act on the next item is in one place.

For team leads, built-in reporting turns daily activity into the trends, volumes, and service metrics that drive staffing and improvement decisions. A productive agent and an informed manager together raise the whole desk's performance.

modules.description: Change request capture, CAB workflow, approval routing, release planning, and standard-change catalog.
modules.catalog_tagline: Ship changes to production with the right approvals and a clear rollback path.
modules.catalog_description:
Change and Release Management governs how work reaches your live environment. Every change is proposed, assessed for risk, approved by the right authority, and scheduled so it lands without colliding with other work or breaking dependent services.

Approval gates, submission controls, and a full change history give you the assurance to move fast without inviting the next outage. The payoff is a higher rate of successful changes and far fewer self-inflicted incidents.

modules.description: Reactive event filtering, deduplication, and routing into the incident workflow. Bridge between observability platforms and ITSM.
modules.catalog_tagline: Turn the flood of monitoring alerts into the few incidents that actually matter.
modules.catalog_description:
Event and Alert Handling sits between your monitoring tools and your service desk, taking in the constant stream of alerts and deciding what deserves a human response. Noise is filtered, related signals are grouped, and only meaningful events become tracked incidents.

By promoting the right alerts automatically and suppressing the rest, the team spends its attention on real problems rather than chasing false alarms. Faster detection of genuine issues shortens the time to restore service.

modules.description: Capture, triage, route, and resolve service-disrupting incidents. Includes major-incident command, AI-assisted classification, and skill-based assignment.
modules.catalog_tagline: Capture, prioritize, and resolve outages and disruptions before they spread.
modules.catalog_description:
Incident Management turns every report of something broken into a tracked ticket with an owner, a priority, and a clock. Agents triage incoming issues, route them to the right team, and drive each one from new to resolved while keeping the requester informed.

Built-in prioritization, assignment, and resolution gates keep major incidents from slipping through the cracks, and a clean audit trail shows exactly how each disruption was handled. The faster you restore service, the less an outage costs you.

modules.description: Authoring, review, publication, and consumption of knowledge articles supporting ITSM agents and self-service portals.
modules.catalog_tagline: Capture what your team knows and put it to work for agents and self-service.
modules.catalog_description:
Knowledge Management gives experts a place to write, review, and publish the articles that resolve issues faster. Content moves through a clear authoring and review lifecycle so what reaches your users is accurate and current.

Published articles power both agent-assisted resolution and self-service deflection, so common questions get answered without a ticket. Every reuse of a good article is time your team gets back.

modules.description: Root-cause analysis, known-error tracking, and corrective action for recurring or major incidents.
modules.catalog_tagline: Find the root cause behind recurring incidents and stop them coming back.
modules.catalog_description:
Problem Management connects the dots across repeated incidents to surface the underlying fault, document the known error, and drive a permanent fix. Instead of firefighting the same outage week after week, your team works the cause once.

A structured path from identification through analysis to resolution keeps investigations disciplined, and a shared record of known errors speeds up every future diagnosis. Fewer repeat incidents means a calmer service desk and lower operating cost.

modules.description: End-user-driven request workflow, including catalog authoring, request routing, approvals, and self-service portal.
modules.catalog_tagline: Let employees order the services they need and fulfill each one with confidence.
modules.catalog_description:
Service Request Fulfillment gives your workforce a single front door for the everyday things they need from IT: access, equipment, software, and standard changes. Each request follows a defined path through submission, approval, and fulfillment so nothing stalls in someone's inbox.

Approval routing and fulfillment tracking make the experience predictable for the requester and measurable for the team. Repeatable requests become catalog-driven, freeing agents to focus on the work that genuinely needs a human.

modules.description: SLA / OLA definitions, breach tracking, escalation rules, service-cost tracking, and chargeback to consuming business units.
modules.catalog_tagline: Set service-level targets, track them in real time, and account for the cost.
modules.catalog_description:
SLA and Chargeback Management defines the response and resolution commitments your service desk operates to, then measures every ticket against them so breaches are caught before they become escalations. Targets are explicit and performance is visible.

Linking service consumption back to cost lets you show what IT delivers and what it costs to deliver, turning the service desk from a black box into an accountable function the business can plan around.

modules.description: Single-domain starter kit for a small IT team that wants a lightweight service desk without the full ITSM suite or any asset estate. Embeds lightweight shells of ITSM's own records: incidents and service requests (the required helpdesk core), plus an optional request catalog, knowledge base, and SLA clocks. Problem, change, release, and event handling stay in the full itsm-* modules you turn on when you outgrow the desk; assets are out of scope (IT-OPS-STARTER and HAM). The embedded shells demote to the canonical itsm-* masters when those modules install alongside. The narrow, single-domain complement to IT-OPS-STARTER.
modules.catalog_tagline: Stand up a lightweight IT help desk in a day: log tickets, take requests, and answer the same questions once.
modules.catalog_description: A simple service desk for a small IT team. Log incidents when something breaks, take service requests from a catalog or by free text, and move each ticket from new to resolved to closed without a heavyweight tool. Turn on a knowledge base so common answers get written once and reused, a request catalog so people ask for the right things, and SLA clocks so nothing sits too long, each when you are ready. Start with just tickets and grow into the rest as your team and your process mature. Built for IT teams that want ticketing and self-service without standing up a full enterprise service-management suite.

modules.description: Hot-desking, hoteling, and desk-booking flows for hybrid-work programs. Masters `desk_bookings` and `workplace_experience_feedback`. The canonical entry-point module for return-to-office buyers.
modules.catalog_tagline: Self-service desk booking that makes return-to-office actually work.
modules.catalog_description: Give employees a frictionless way to reserve a desk for the days they come in and give workplace teams the demand signal they need. Handle hoteling and hot-desking with date, time, and work-mode selection, drive check-in and no-show recapture so reserved space is real space, and capture workplace experience feedback to keep improving the office. The result is higher confidence that a seat will be there and cleaner data on how the workplace is actually used.

modules.description: Foundational location registry for an IWMS deployment. Canonically masters `locations` (sites, offices, branches, buildings, floors). Embedded-masters lease and property metadata where the IWMS holds the integrated record. Read by every other IWMS module as the spatial anchor.
modules.catalog_tagline: One trusted registry of every site, building, and floor.
modules.catalog_description: Establish the spatial backbone the rest of the workplace runs on. Maintain the canonical record of sites, offices, buildings, and floors, attach lease and property metadata where the workplace team holds the integrated record, and let every reservation, service, and analytics flow read the same location anchor. The value is consistent space data across the portfolio so no two systems disagree about what exists or where it sits.

modules.description: Conference room booking with calendar integration, room equipment (AV) tracking, no-show recapture, and check-in flows. Masters `room_reservations`. Often deployed alongside desk-reservation but has a distinct booking model (durations, attendees, recurring).
modules.catalog_tagline: Meeting rooms that are booked, checked into, and never sit empty.
modules.catalog_description: Make conference and collaboration space easy to find and hard to waste. Reserve rooms with calendar integration, attendee and capacity matching, and the equipment a meeting needs, then enforce check-in and reclaim no-shows so booked rooms get used. The payoff is fewer ghost reservations, less hunting for an open room, and reliable data on which spaces earn their footprint.

modules.description: Occupancy measurement, space-utilization reporting, stack diagrams, and scenario modeling for portfolio rationalization. Masters `space_utilization_reports`. Reads desk_bookings + room_reservations + sensor data; publishes utilization signals to REAL-EST and ESG.
modules.catalog_tagline: Turn occupancy signals into the case for right-sizing real estate.
modules.catalog_description: Convert badge swipes, bookings, and sensor data into a clear picture of how space is really used. Measure occupancy, surface peak patterns and underutilized zones, model scenarios with stack diagrams, and publish utilization signals to real-estate and sustainability teams. The payoff is an evidence-based footprint decision: keep, consolidate, or redesign space on data rather than anecdote.

modules.description: Facility ticket flow: light-bulb out, temperature complaint, broken chair, spill cleanup. Masters `workplace_service_requests`. Distinct from ITSM (workplace-scoped, often dispatched to in-house facilities staff or building management) and from EAM/FSM (no equipment-asset orientation).
modules.catalog_tagline: A workplace ticket flow built for facilities, not IT.
modules.catalog_description: Turn every burned-out bulb, broken chair, temperature complaint, and spill into a tracked request that reaches the right hands. Capture the issue, triage and route it to in-house facilities staff or building management, and drive it to resolution with a clear audit trail. The value is a responsive workplace where employees know problems get fixed and facilities leaders can see where time and money are going.

modules.description: Queries the unified graph, federates across remote and virtual sources without ETL, and grounds AI agents and operational apps in typed, lineage-tracked facts. Runs federated graph queries with named-graph access control, exposes relational and API sources as native graph data on demand, joins symbolic queries with vector search for retrieval, and lets code-first or low-code apps read and write back to the underlying graph entities.
modules.catalog_tagline: Query one unified graph across every source, and ground your apps and AI agents in trusted, connected facts.
modules.catalog_description:
Ask questions across your entire knowledge graph and federate to remote and virtual sources without moving or copying data first. Named-graph access control keeps each team scoped to what it is allowed to see.

Expose relational, document, and API sources as native graph data on demand, and combine symbolic queries with vector search so retrieval returns precise, explainable results instead of guesses. Every answer carries the lineage that shows where it came from.

Code-first and low-code applications read and write back to the same graph entities, and AI agents get typed, connected context they can reason over. Reconcile and merge duplicate records so the graph stays clean as it grows.

modules.description: Models the business domain as a formal ontology and stores it on a purpose-built graph engine that infers facts the team never asserted by hand. Authors and version-controls ontology classes, properties, and constraint shapes; runs the reasoning tier that materializes entailed relationships; and persists everything on a native graph store with transactions, replication, and backup.
modules.catalog_tagline: Model your business as a living ontology and let the graph infer the facts you never wrote down.
modules.catalog_description:
Capture your domain as a formal ontology: define the classes, properties, and constraints that describe how your business really works, and version every change so you can trust what gets published.

A built-in reasoning tier turns those definitions into answers, materializing relationships and entailed facts your team never had to assert by hand. Everything lives on a native graph store with transactions, replication, and backup, so the model that powers your apps and agents is durable and auditable.

Validate before you publish, promote a reviewed version when it is ready, and keep earlier versions for lineage. Downstream queries, applications, and AI agents all read from one shared, governed source of meaning.

modules.description: Managed execution of built applications: process and workflow orchestration on a vendor-operated runtime, environment promotion across dev/test/prod, versioning, rollback, and observability. The run-side governance layer that keeps deployed apps enterprise-credible.

Design-time authoring surface for low-code applications: visual page composition, custom business-object schema, bound external data sources, and AI-assisted generation. The build-side of the platform that produces deployable application artifacts.

The ASC 842 / IFRS 16 accounting kernel. Masters the right-of-use assets, lease liabilities, classifications, payment and amortization schedules, modifications, disclosures, and the journal entries that post lease activity to the general ledger. This is the certification-grade financial-compliance core owned by the controller's team; it is not part of any real-estate domain.
modules.catalog_tagline: Recognize, measure, and disclose every lease on the balance sheet.
modules.catalog_description: Run the lease subledger your auditors trust. Calculate right-of-use assets and lease liabilities, generate amortization and interest schedules, classify finance versus operating under ASC 842 or run the IFRS 16 single model, and post clean journal entries to the general ledger. Handle modifications and remeasurements without rebuilding the math, and produce the weighted-average rate, maturity-analysis, and lease-cost disclosures your footnotes require, all on an immutable audit trail.

modules.description: The lease record and obligation-management layer that sources the accounting. Masters lease agreements (the accounting-subledger view of the contract), critical dates and alerts, renewals and terminations, payment terms, and the lease documents. Overlaps the real-estate and commercial-real-estate domains on lease records; scoped here to the lessee accounting feed, not workplace occupancy or landlord operations.
modules.catalog_tagline: Track lease records, critical dates, and documents that feed the books.
modules.catalog_description: Keep every lease and its obligations in one organized record. Capture lease agreements and their components, store the source documents, and never miss a renewal, option, or termination deadline with critical-date alerts. Manage payment terms and the changes that flow straight into your lease accounting, so the numbers always tie back to the contract.

modules.description: Court filing capture and submission, jurisdiction-specific deadline rule application, statute-of-limitations and key-date alerting, service-of-process tracking, and electronic court filing (ECF) integration.
modules.catalog_tagline: Calendar court deadlines from jurisdiction rules so filing dates and statutes of limitations are never left to memory.
modules.catalog_description:
Capture and submit court filings, then let jurisdiction-specific rules calculate the deadlines that follow so the calendar fills itself instead of relying on someone remembering. Track statute-of-limitations and other key dates with alerts well ahead of time.

Follow service of process and connect to electronic court filing so submissions and confirmations flow into the matter file without manual re-entry.

modules.description: Intake forms, conflict-of-interest graph search across existing matters and adversaries, conflict-waiver and ethics-wall tracking, engagement-letter drafting from templates, retainer-payment collection, and intake-to-matter conversion.
modules.catalog_tagline: Clear conflicts, sign the engagement letter, and collect the retainer before a new client ever becomes a matter.
modules.catalog_description:
Capture new-client details through intake forms, then run a conflict-of-interest search across your existing matters and adversaries so you can decline, clear, or waive before you commit. Record conflict waivers and ethics-wall arrangements as part of the file.

Draft engagement letters from templates, send them for signature, and collect the opening retainer, then convert a cleared intake into a live matter without rekeying anything.

modules.description: Central matter lifecycle: intake-to-active-to-closed-to-archived, parties (clients, opposing, co-counsel, courts), key-date and statute-of-limitations alerting, matter status reporting, and matter-scoped document storage. The hub every other legal-practice module attaches to.
modules.catalog_tagline: Open, run, and close every matter with the parties, key dates, and documents that belong to it in one organized file.
modules.catalog_description:
Move each matter cleanly from intake to active to closed and archived, with the status of every case visible at a glance. Keep the clients, opposing parties, co-counsel, and courts attached to each matter so everyone knows who is involved.

Track the deadlines and statute-of-limitations dates that carry the most risk, store the documents tied to each case alongside the work, and give every other part of the practice a single matter record to build on.

modules.description: Timekeeper time-entry capture against ABA UTBMS task and expense codes, hourly versus flat-fee versus contingency versus alternative-fee-arrangement billing, prebill review and partner approval, e-bill submission in LEDES 1998B and 2000 formats, and AR aging on client invoices.
modules.catalog_tagline: Capture every billable minute, review prebills, and send client-ready invoices in the formats your clients demand.
modules.catalog_description:
Record time against standardized legal task and expense codes whether you bill by the hour, a flat fee, contingency, or an alternative fee arrangement. Roll entries into prebills your partners can review and adjust before anything reaches the client.

Issue invoices, submit them in the electronic-billing formats large clients require, and follow outstanding balances through accounts-receivable aging so the firm gets paid on time.

modules.description: Separated IOLTA trust-account ledger per client and matter, three-way reconciliation (bank versus ledger versus client-balance), state-specific retention rules, retainer-to-trust deposit and trust-to-operating transfer on earned fees, and state-bar reporting on exceptions.
modules.catalog_tagline: Hold client money safely in separated trust ledgers with three-way reconciliation and the exception reporting your bar expects.
modules.catalog_description:
Keep every client and matter balance in a dedicated trust ledger that stays separate from operating funds, and reconcile bank, ledger, and client balances three ways so the books always agree.

Deposit retainers into trust, transfer earned fees out to the operating account only when they are actually earned, apply the retention rules your state imposes, and surface reconciliation exceptions for review before they become a compliance problem.

modules.description: Ordering and receiving of physical materials, serials subscription management, and electronic resource license management.
modules.catalog_tagline: Acquire print and digital materials and keep licenses current.
modules.catalog_description: Order, receive, and pay for library materials in one acquisitions workflow. Place orders with vendors, track partial and full receipts, reconcile invoices, and manage budgets. Renew serial subscriptions on schedule and keep e-resource licenses active, renewed, or cleanly terminated so access never lapses unexpectedly.

modules.description: Authoring and maintenance of bibliographic, authority, and holdings records for all library materials regardless of medium. Owns the catalog substrate every other library module reads from.
modules.catalog_tagline: Describe every title once, find it everywhere.
modules.catalog_description: Create and maintain bibliographic records, authority headings, and holdings so every title is described consistently and surfaces reliably in search. Catalog physical and electronic materials, control headings against external authority files, and keep item and holdings data accurate from receipt through withdrawal.

modules.description: Daily circulation activity: check-out, check-in, renewals, holds, fines, and circulation policy administration. The most patron-facing operations module.
modules.catalog_tagline: Check out, check in, and keep the queue moving.
modules.catalog_description: Run the daily circulation desk. Loan and return items, renew loans, place holds and trap them when copies become available, and manage the pickup queue. Apply loan rules by patron and item type, accrue and collect fines, and handle lost and claimed-returned items without losing the thread.

modules.description: Public-facing catalog search and browse interface, faceted search over bibliographic and holdings data, saved searches, and reading lists.
modules.catalog_tagline: Let patrons find what the library holds, on their own.
modules.catalog_description: Give patrons a public catalog and search experience over the library's collection. Expose titles, availability, and holdings for self-service discovery, let patrons save searches and place holds, and connect search results straight to circulation and request workflows.

modules.description: Borrowing and lending workflows between libraries, request routing, and resource sharing partner management.
modules.catalog_tagline: Borrow what you do not own, lend what others need.
modules.catalog_description: Fill requests for materials the library does not hold and supply materials to partner libraries. Route, accept, ship, and track interlibrary loan requests end to end, manage resource-sharing partners, and keep borrowers informed from request through return.

modules.description: Library member registration, profile maintenance, patron category administration, and card issuance.
modules.catalog_tagline: Register, organize, and support every patron.
modules.catalog_description: Manage the patron community from registration to renewal. Create patron accounts, sort them into categories that drive borrowing privileges, issue and renew cards, and suspend or archive accounts when needed. Keep contact and eligibility data current so circulation and discovery work the way each patron expects.

modules.description: The pasture and grazing-planning system of record: paddocks, pasture allocations, and rotational grazing plans with rest periods, stocking rate, and carrying capacity. Used standalone by a grazing-focused operation or alongside the herd module to drive mob movements.
modules.catalog_tagline: Plan your rotations: allocate pasture, set rest periods, and match stocking rate to carrying capacity.
modules.catalog_description: Map your paddocks and plan how mobs graze them. Allocate pasture, schedule rotations with the rest periods each paddock needs, and keep stocking rate matched to carrying capacity so feed lasts and paddocks recover. Build grazing plans you can follow through the season and adjust as conditions change.

modules.description: The animal-centric system of record: individual-animal records, mobs and groups, mob movements, weigh sessions with average daily gain, breeding and calving records, treatment and medicine records with withholding periods, sale and purchase records, and the electronic-identifier traceability layer. Used standalone by a records-keeping operation or alongside the grazing module.
modules.catalog_tagline: Keep a record for every animal and every mob: weights, breeding, treatments, movements, and sales.
modules.catalog_description: Give every animal and mob a living record. Capture weigh sessions in the yard and watch average daily gains, log breeding and calving, and record every treatment with its withholding period so you never sell or send an animal too early. Move mobs between paddocks and properties, register sales and purchases, and keep electronic ear-tag identifiers and traceability movements in order for your region's scheme.

modules.description: Horizontal automation surface across LMS deployment: dynamic audience segments, automated training assignment rules, reusable notification templates, learner notification log, manager-directed nudges for overdue training, and escalation policies. Cuts across LMS-COURSE-DELIVERY, LMS-COMPLIANCE-TRAINING, LMS-PATHS, and LMS-CREDENTIALS.
modules.catalog_tagline: Automate enrollments, reminders, and escalations so the right training reaches the right people on time.
modules.catalog_description: Put routine learning administration on autopilot. Enroll people automatically based on role, team, or hire date, send reminders and nudges before deadlines, and escalate when training slips. Set the cadence once and let the rules keep learners on track.

modules.description: Mandatory regulatory training assignment, tracking, and certification: sexual harassment training (CA SB-1343), HIPAA, OSHA, anti-bribery, SOX, GDPR, AML. Masters `compliance_assignments` and `learner_certifications`. Realizes COMPLIANCE-TRAIN and CERT-MGMT. Distinct from general LMS course delivery: assignments are mandatory and time-bound, lifecycle includes `overdue`/`waived`/`expired` states with regulator-evidence retention, and ownership typically sits with GRC/Compliance, not L&D.
modules.catalog_tagline: Assign mandatory training, chase overdue learners automatically, and capture the evidence regulators ask for.
modules.catalog_description: Run regulatory and policy training as repeatable campaigns. Assign required courses to the right people, track completion against deadlines, and escalate overdue assignments without manual chasing. Capture signed training evidence, manage recertification, and produce the filings and audit records compliance reviewers expect.

modules.description: The core LMS workflow: course authoring, content delivery, enrollment, completion tracking, and transcript posting. Masters `courses`, `course_enrollments`, `learning_records`. Realizes COURSE-AUTHOR and CONTENT-DELIVERY capabilities. The backbone module every LMS deployment installs first; the other LMS modules embedded_master courses to reference content.
modules.catalog_tagline: Build, publish, and deliver online courses, then track every enrollment through to completion.
modules.catalog_description: Create courses from lessons, content assets, and assessments, and publish new versions when material changes. Enroll learners, deliver self-paced training in the browser, and grade quizzes and exams as they go. Watch progress and completion in real time, and keep a clean record of who finished what.

modules.description: Catalog and lifecycle for certifications, micro-credential badges, and continuing-education credits.
