Masters learner_certifications (re-mastered from LMS-COMPLIANCE-TRAINING) since professional development, FINRA CE, internal product certifications, and Open-Badges micro-credentials all live here, not just compliance training. Compliance training embeds learner_certifications for the regulated-training certification workflow.
modules.catalog_tagline: Issue certifications and digital badges, then manage renewals and let others verify them.
modules.catalog_description: Define certifications and badges, issue them when learners qualify, and track expiry and renewal across the workforce. Let learners share verifiable credentials and let third parties confirm them, so a qualification is easy to prove long after the course is done.

modules.description: Learner data privacy substrate that compliance training depends on: GDPR Article 6/7 consent capture, Article 15 subject access requests, and Article 17 right-to-erasure processing for training data. Carved out from LMS-COMPLIANCE-TRAINING because privacy obligations apply across the LMS even where statutory training is out of scope.
modules.catalog_tagline: Handle learner data-subject requests, consent, and retention so training data stays privacy-compliant.
modules.catalog_description: Give learners control over their training data. Capture and track consent, process data-subject access and deletion requests, and enforce retention policies that remove records when they should expire. Keep a defensible trail of how learner data is handled.

modules.description: Scheduled course delivery: offerings and sessions, instructor assignments, attendance capture (OSHA evidence substrate), waitlist management, virtual-classroom integration, and per-session resources. Structurally distinct from evergreen e-learning in LMS-COURSE-DELIVERY because it carries its own cardinality (course -> many offerings -> many sessions), its own roles (instructors are not learners), and its own per-session compliance footprint.
modules.catalog_tagline: Run instructor-led and virtual classroom training: schedule sessions, book rooms, and track attendance.
modules.catalog_description: Plan classroom and virtual instructor-led training from one place. Schedule offerings and sessions, reserve rooms and resources, and manage rosters, waitlists, and cancellations. Record attendance and completion so classroom learning lands in the same record as everything else.

modules.description: Authors and assigns sequenced learning paths inside the LMS. Masters learning_paths; consumes skill_profiles (mastered by SKILLS-MGMT after migration) to recommend paths against skill gaps.
modules.catalog_tagline: Guide learners along structured paths that build the skills each role needs.
modules.catalog_description: Sequence courses into curricula and learning paths so learners always know what comes next. Tie each step to the skills and proficiency a role requires, recommend the next best course, and roll individual development into longer-term career plans. Track progress across the whole path, not just one course at a time.

modules.description: Member-facing engagement surface. Runs time-bound bonus and multiplier promotions and gamified challenges, manages multi-brand coalition and partner-issued-points programs, and powers the branded self-service portal and mobile app.
modules.catalog_tagline: Run bonus campaigns, partner offers, and a self-service member portal that keeps people coming back.
modules.catalog_description:
Keep members active between purchases. Launch bonus-point promotions and limited-time offers that nudge the behavior you want, and extend reach through partner coalitions so members earn and redeem across a wider network.

Give members a portal where they can see their status, explore offers, and engage with the program on their own terms. Steady engagement turns occasional buyers into loyal regulars and gives your team a direct channel to the people who matter most.

modules.description: Double-entry points ledger and rewards fulfillment. Records accrual, redemption, adjustment, and expiry events with an auditable per-member balance, and runs the redeemable rewards catalog and redemption settlement.
modules.catalog_tagline: Track every point earned and spent, and let members redeem rewards from a catalog you control.
modules.catalog_description:
Run the engine that powers your rewards. Record every point a member earns or spends in a clear ledger, apply your accrual rules automatically, and keep balances accurate as activity posts, reverses, or expires.

Publish a catalog of rewards members can choose from and manage each one through its full life, from draft to live to retired. When a member redeems, walk the request through fulfillment to delivery so people get what they earned and you keep a complete record of every redemption.

modules.description: Member enrollment, profile, and program/tier design. Configures points-earn rules, tier thresholds, qualification windows, and retention logic, and links each member identity to the canonical customer record.
modules.catalog_tagline: Enroll members, keep their profiles current, and move them up tiers as they engage.
modules.catalog_description:
Stand up your loyalty program and bring members in. Capture each member's profile, track the activity that counts toward their status, and manage enrollment from sign-up through every change to their account.

Design the tier structure that fits your program: set the thresholds members reach, define what each tier unlocks, and let members climb (or slip) automatically as their engagement changes. Your most engaged customers see the recognition and perks that keep them coming back.

modules.description: The single front door to Legal: business users submit requests, which are triaged and routed or converted into matters. Hosts the request intake, triage, and self-service surface.
modules.catalog_tagline: Give the business one front door to Legal and turn every request into tracked, routed work.
modules.catalog_description: Take in legal requests from anywhere in the business through a single intake portal, then triage each one and either resolve it, route it, or open it as a matter. Requesters see status without chasing email, and the legal team works from one prioritized queue instead of scattered inboxes. The result is faster response, clear ownership from the first touch, and a complete record of what the business asked Legal to do.

modules.description: Legal holds and ediscovery: issuing and releasing holds, acknowledgment tracking, and the collect-process-review-produce ediscovery workflow. Consumes content documents under hold from ECM.
modules.catalog_tagline: Issue holds, track acknowledgments, and run ediscovery from collection to production.
modules.catalog_description: Preserve evidence the moment a matter requires it: issue legal holds, track custodian acknowledgments, and release holds cleanly when they lapse. Run ediscovery end to end, from collection through processing, review, and production, with a defensible trail at every step. Keep the business out of spoliation risk and give counsel confidence that what should be preserved actually is.

modules.description: Running matters end to end: matter records, legal advice records, and case dockets. The operational core where in-house counsel manages active legal work.
modules.catalog_tagline: Run every matter from open to close, with advice and docket activity captured in one place.
modules.catalog_description: Manage each legal matter through its whole life: open it, work it, put it on hold, and close it, with every piece of advice and docket entry attached. In-house counsel keeps a single trusted record of what was asked, what was advised, and what happened, so nothing falls through the cracks and history is always at hand. Spend less time reconstructing context and more time moving the work forward.

modules.description: Outside-counsel engagements: proposing, engaging, and completing external-counsel relationships, with scope and accrual handoffs downstream to spend, contract, and conflict-check systems.
modules.catalog_tagline: Engage and manage outside counsel, and keep scope, spend, and conflicts connected.
modules.catalog_description: Propose, engage, and close out external-counsel relationships from one place, with scope and the engagement letter captured up front. As engagements start, the right downstream teams see them: spend tracking accrues the budget, contract management holds the engagement letter, and risk runs its conflict checks. Stop losing track of who is engaged on what, and keep outside-counsel spend and obligations under control.

modules.description: Regulator and agency inquiries: receiving, acknowledging, responding to, and closing regulatory inquiries as an in-house workflow distinct from enterprise GRC.
modules.catalog_tagline: Take in regulator inquiries and drive each one to an on-time, documented response.
modules.catalog_description: Handle inquiries from regulators and agencies as a managed workflow: log each one, acknowledge it on time, assemble and send the response, and close it with a complete record. Deadlines stay visible, ownership is clear, and the full response history is auditable when it matters. Keep the organization responsive and defensible without running regulator inquiries out of email threads.

modules.description: Authors marketing campaigns and email content, runs the send pipeline, performs A/B and send-time optimization, applies generative content assistance, and measures multi-touch attribution against engagement.
modules.catalog_tagline: Build, send, and optimize marketing email campaigns from one workspace.
modules.catalog_description: Create marketing campaigns and design the emails that go with them, then schedule and send to your audience. Compose content, run A/B variant tests, and let your campaigns reach the right people at the right time. Track how each send performs so you can refine the next one and keep improving results across every campaign you run.

modules.description: Designs and runs multi-step, multi-channel nurture journeys spanning email, mobile push, in-app, and SMS, with branching, wait conditions, and frequency capping.
modules.catalog_tagline: Guide every contact through multi-step nurture journeys across email, push, in-app, and SMS.
modules.catalog_description: Design automated journeys that move each contact through the right sequence of touches, from a first welcome to a re-engagement nudge. Reach people on whichever channel fits the moment, whether that is email, push, in-app, or SMS, and branch the path based on how they respond. Keep every journey running on its own without manual follow-up, so the right message arrives at the right step for each person.

modules.description: Builds hosted landing pages and embeddable lead-capture forms with progressive profiling, conditional logic, and post-submit routing into scoring and nurture.
modules.catalog_tagline: Capture leads with hosted landing pages and forms that grow richer over time.
modules.catalog_description: Publish landing pages and lead-capture forms without waiting on a developer, and start collecting interest right away. Use progressive profiling to ask for a little more each visit, so a contact record fills in over time instead of all at once. Turn every submission into a known lead, ready to score, nurture, and route to the rest of your marketing workflow.

modules.description: Computes behavioral and demographic lead scores from explicit and implicit signals, applies grading and decay rules, and triggers nurture enrollment and qualified-lead routing.
modules.catalog_tagline: Score and prioritize leads automatically, and trigger nurture the moment they are ready.
modules.catalog_description: Rank your leads with scores that combine what they do with who they are, so your team always knows who to focus on first. Set the signals that matter and let scores update as behavior changes. When a lead crosses the threshold you set, kick off the right nurture automatically and hand the best leads to sales at exactly the right moment.

modules.description: Masters seasonal and annual slip contracts, recurring charges, house accounts, dockage invoices, and metered electric and water utilities. Rolls reservation and contract activity into boater billing. Embeds slip, boater, and reservation shells.
modules.catalog_tagline: Put boaters on recurring contracts, meter their electric and water, and bill it all accurately every cycle.
modules.catalog_description: Place boaters on seasonal or annual slip contracts with recurring charges and house accounts, and turn submetered electric and water readings into accurate utility lines. Generate dockage invoices for contracts, transient stays, and yard work, collect payments, and keep each boater's account balance clear.

modules.description: Masters boaters and vessels with insurance and registration documents. The shared customer-and-asset record other modules embed. Deployable standalone as a boater directory.
modules.catalog_tagline: Keep every boater and vessel on file, with insurance and registration current and at hand.
modules.catalog_description: Maintain a clean directory of boaters and their vessels, with contact details, vessel particulars, and the documents you are required to keep: certificates of insurance and state or federal registrations. Expiring paperwork is easy to spot, so you keep coverage current across the marina.

modules.description: Masters fuel sales, fuel tanks, fuel-inventory reconciliation logs, and ship-store point-of-sale transactions. Embeds the boater shell so sales post to accounts. Deployable standalone for a fuel dock and store.
modules.catalog_tagline: Run the fuel dock and ship store, post sales to boater accounts, and keep fuel inventory reconciled.
modules.catalog_description: Sell marine fuel and ship-store retail, charge it to a boater's house account or take payment on the spot, and keep fuel-tank inventory reconciled against deliveries and pump totals so your records stand up to a storage-tank inspection.

modules.description: Masters the physical estate: marinas, docks, slips, moorings, dry-stack racks, and storage units, plus slip-size classes and vessel-to-slip assignment. Deployable standalone for a facility that only needs to lay out and assign space.
modules.catalog_tagline: Map every dock, slip, mooring, and rack, then assign each vessel to the right space by fit.
modules.catalog_description: Build a visual layout of your marina: docks, slips, moorings, dry-stack racks, and land storage, each with dimensions, utilities, and a size class. Assign vessels to spaces by length, beam, and draft, and keep a clear picture of what is open, occupied, or out of service across the whole facility.

modules.description: Masters reservations, transient and seasonal bookings, and the slip waitlist. Captures demand against the inventory, runs check-in and check-out, and offers freed space to waitlisted boaters. Embeds slip, boater, and vessel shells.
modules.catalog_tagline: Take transient and seasonal bookings, check boats in and out, and offer freed slips to your waitlist.
modules.catalog_description: Capture reservations and transient bookings against your available space, confirm them, and run check-in and check-out as boats arrive and leave. When a slip frees up, offer it to the next boater on the waitlist automatically, so you fill space and keep guests moving.

modules.description: Masters boatyard work orders, service estimates, haul-out jobs, dry-stack launch requests, and Clean Vessel Act pump-out logs. Embeds vessel and slip shells. Deployable standalone for a service yard.
modules.catalog_tagline: Quote and run boatyard work, schedule haul-outs and launches, and log every pump-out.
modules.catalog_description: Estimate and approve boatyard jobs, open work orders, and track them from request through completion and billing. Schedule haul-outs, splashes, and dry-stack launches against your lift and forklift capacity, and keep the pump-out logs the Clean Vessel Act and your grants require.

modules.description: The execution tier that resolves the semantic model against physical sources and accelerates reads. Plans federated joins and pushes computation down to each backend across warehouses, relational databases, object storage, and APIs, then serves cached and pre-aggregated rollups from columnar storage with query rewriting and automatic invalidation. Captures an executed-query audit trail linking every metric read back to source tables, transformations, and the requesting identity.
modules.catalog_tagline: Federate queries, cache the heavy ones, and keep full lineage for every metric.
modules.catalog_description:
Schedule and run materializations so common metric queries return instantly instead of scanning the warehouse every time, and refresh them on demand when freshness matters. Stale and failed refreshes are surfaced so you can act before consumers notice.

Capture column-level lineage for every query the layer runs, so you can always trace a number back to the tables and definitions it came from, and estimate query cost before a heavy request runs.

modules.description: Canonical registry where business metrics and the logical dimensional model are authored once and reused everywhere. Captures numerator, denominator, filters, dimensions, time grain, ownership, certification status, and lineage to physical sources, plus entity, hierarchy, conformed-dimension, and slowly-changing-dimension structure decoupled from physical tables. Governs metric and model changes through approval, certification, deprecation, and impact analysis on downstream consumers.
modules.catalog_tagline: Define metrics and dimensional models once, then certify the version everyone trusts.
modules.catalog_description:
Author each metric and the dimensional model behind it in one place, with a draft-to-certified workflow so consumers only ever see the trusted definition. Reviewers certify the version that becomes the single source of truth, and deprecate or retire old ones cleanly.

Compile and validate metrics before they ship, and translate plain-language questions into the right metric, dimension, and filter combination. When a definition changes, every downstream dashboard, report, and agent picks up the same update at once.

modules.description: Exposes the governed semantic model through many consumption surfaces at once: SQL for analytics tools, REST and GraphQL for applications, MDX for spreadsheet and legacy clients, and JDBC and ODBC for enterprise integration, alongside natural-language and tool-use access for AI agents grounded on certified metrics. Enforces row-level and metric-level access policy at the semantic-definition tier so every consumer reads the same governed numbers under the same rules.
modules.catalog_tagline: Serve governed metrics over SQL, REST, and AI interfaces with access control built in.
modules.catalog_description:
Deliver the same certified metrics to dashboards, web apps, and AI agents through SQL, JDBC, REST, and GraphQL, so every consumer asks for a metric by name and gets one consistent answer.

Control who can see which metrics, and at what row or cell grain, with access policies you author, activate, and supersede over time. Policy changes take effect on the next query, with no consumer rewrite required.

modules.description: Masters marketing budgets, plan-line budget allocations, spend records, and plan-level performance metrics. Provides top-down allocation, committed-and-actual spend capture, spend-to-plan reconciliation, and marketing-ROI measurement. The defensible MRM kernel that no work-management or asset domain owns.
modules.catalog_tagline: Allocate marketing budget top-down and reconcile every dollar of spend back to the plan.
modules.catalog_description: Set marketing budgets and allocate them top-down across plans, plan lines, campaigns, and channels. Capture committed and actual spend, reconcile it against each allocation to reveal remaining budget and variance, and route allocations and spend through approval. Measure plan-level performance and marketing ROI so you can tie results and pipeline contribution back to what funded them.

modules.description: Masters the marketing plan hierarchy (plans and plan lines) and the shared marketing calendar. Coordinates the planned program across teams, channels, and time, and references work-management tasks/projects and marketing-execution campaigns rather than re-implementing them. Deployed alongside the budget module for a full planning-plus-budget kernel, or standalone for plan and calendar coordination.
modules.catalog_tagline: Lay out the whole marketing program as a plan hierarchy on one shared calendar.
modules.catalog_description: Author the annual and quarterly marketing plan as a hierarchy of plan lines, each with an owner, objective, and time window, and see the entire program on a shared campaign and content calendar. Link plan lines to the campaigns your execution tools run and the tasks your teams own, so the plan stays connected to the work without duplicating it.

modules.domain_module_name: MSP Client Roster and Service Contracts
modules.description: MSP client roster and master service agreements with consumption tracking (block-hour decrement, value-tier pricing), renewal-window alerting, and contract-lifecycle gates for activation, suspension, and termination.
modules.catalog_tagline: Manage customer accounts and the recurring service agreements that drive your revenue.
modules.catalog_description: Keep a clean roster of the customers you manage and the contracts that define their service, from draft through activation, suspension, and renewal. Contracts set the pricing model, block-hour entitlements, and SLA terms that the rest of the service delivery and billing work reads from, and renewal timing surfaces well before agreements lapse.

modules.description: Technician scheduling and dispatch board, skill-and-availability matching, on-site versus remote work routing, and load balancing across the technician roster.
modules.catalog_tagline: Schedule and assign the right technician to the right job at the right time.
modules.catalog_description: Coordinate technician workload across open tickets, matching skills and availability to the jobs that need attention and keeping scheduled work and on-site visits organized. Dispatch decisions feed straight into ticket handling and time capture so assignment, execution, and billing stay connected.

modules.description: Multi-tenant service-ticket queue across customer estates, with per-customer SLA timers that pause and resume on hold, a customer portal for self-service ticket submission, and CSAT capture on resolution.
modules.catalog_tagline: Take in, triage, and resolve customer tickets against the SLAs you committed to.
modules.catalog_description: Capture issues from any channel, route them to the right technician, and work them through to resolution while the SLA clock tracks response and fix targets and pauses when a ticket is on hold. Every ticket ties back to the customer it belongs to and the time spent on it, so support effort stays visible and billable.

modules.domain_module_name: MSP Time Tracking and Customer Billing
modules.description: Technician time-entry capture against tickets and contracts, time-approval routing, recurring billing per contract terms, and customer-side invoice issuance with AR-side aging from the MSP's perspective.
modules.catalog_tagline: Turn logged technician time into approved, billed, and paid invoices.
modules.catalog_description: Capture time against tickets and contracts, route it through approval, and roll approved effort plus contracted charges into invoices. Track each invoice from draft to issued, paid, overdue, or written off, so the work your team delivers is consistently and accurately billed.

modules.description: The no-code operations layer: record-triggered workflows, scheduled jobs, and outbound API calls, together with live or scheduled bidirectional synchronization to external systems of record so the database becomes a working surface over canonical data rather than a static copy.
modules.catalog_tagline: Automate the busywork and keep your tables in sync with the systems you already run on.
modules.catalog_description:
Replace manual follow-up with automations that run themselves. Trigger actions when a record is created or changes, or on a schedule you set, then notify the right people, update records, and call out to other services as part of the flow. The repetitive steps your team does by hand become reliable, hands-off workflows.

Keep your database connected to your systems of record. Sync data in or out, live or on a schedule, so your tables stay current with the canonical source instead of drifting into a stale copy. Your workspace becomes a working surface over real data, not a snapshot that someone has to keep refreshing.

modules.description: The core data-modeling surface: a self-contained namespace holding user-defined tables, rich field types, linked-record relationships across tables, formula and rollup columns, and the runtime schema that downstream views, forms, and automations bind to. The reason the platform is bought: model structured data without a developer.
modules.catalog_tagline: Model your data without code: design tables, pick the right field types, and link records across them.
modules.catalog_description:
Create the data model behind your tools without writing a line of code. Add your own tables, choose from rich field types for text, numbers, dates, attachments, single and multi-select, and more, and connect related records across tables so a customer, a project, or an order pulls in everything tied to it.

Go beyond plain storage with formula and rollup columns that calculate and summarize automatically as records change. The schema you build here becomes the foundation the rest of your workspace reads from, so the views, forms, and automations your team uses all stay in step with one source of truth.

modules.description: The presentation and intake surface over the data model: switchable grid, gallery, kanban, calendar, and timeline views that each filter, sort, group, and share independently, plus public or authenticated forms that write directly into a table. The everyday working surface for non-database users who read and contribute structured data.
modules.catalog_tagline: See your data your way and collect new records through forms that write straight into your tables.
modules.catalog_description:
Give every person the right window onto the same data. Switch between grid, gallery, kanban, calendar, and timeline views, and filter, sort, and group each one independently so a planner, a reviewer, and an executive each see exactly what they need. Share a view with a teammate or a stakeholder without handing over the whole table.

Capture clean information at the source with forms that write directly into your tables. Publish a form for public or authenticated submissions, and every response lands as a structured record ready to work with, no copying or re-keying. It is the everyday working surface for people who read and contribute data without ever touching the underlying schema.

modules.description: Collection and validation of new-hire paperwork (I-9, tax, NDA, direct-deposit), with handoff to HCM/Payroll on completion.
modules.catalog_tagline: Collect, validate, and route every new-hire document without the paper chase.
modules.catalog_description: A focused workspace for new-hire paperwork. Gather and verify the documents a hire must complete, including eligibility, tax, agreements, and direct-deposit forms, with a clear submission, review, and approval flow that locks records once they are filed. Approved collections hand off automatically to the systems that depend on them so worker records and payroll activate without re-keying. Built-in status tracking and an auditable trail keep compliance teams confident that every required form was collected, reviewed, and retained correctly.

modules.description: Plan templates, journey instances, stages, tasks, and cohorts. The core orchestration surface for new-hire onboarding programs.
modules.catalog_tagline: Design onboarding journeys once and run them for every new hire automatically.
modules.catalog_description: The orchestration core of onboarding. Build reusable plan templates, then spin up a journey instance for each new hire that sequences stages, tasks, and cohort programs from pre-boarding through the 30/60/90 milestones. Tasks are generated conditionally by role, location, and employment type and routed to the teams that own them, so IT provisioning, workspace setup, access requests, and training enrollments all kick off from one journey without manual chasing. Coordinators and program managers track progress in real time, catch stalled steps before day one, and prove that every new hire was ready to work on schedule.

modules.description: Pre-boarding communications, day-one welcome cadences, buddy pairing, and intro meeting coordination.
modules.catalog_tagline: Make every new hire feel expected, connected, and supported from day one.
modules.catalog_description: The human side of onboarding. Schedule pre-boarding and day-one welcome communications, pair each new hire with a buddy or mentor, and coordinate the introductions that turn a start date into a sense of belonging. Welcome cadences are timed to the journey and routed through the channel each workplace prefers, while buddy assignments are tracked from pairing through completion. Stronger first impressions lift early engagement, speed up ramp time, and improve new-hire retention through the critical first weeks.

modules.description: Representation analytics, pay-equity analysis, DEI dashboards, skill-gap signaling. No native master entities (computes over HCM, COMP-MGMT, and PA-WORKFORCE-METRICS data).
modules.catalog_tagline: Measure representation and pay equity, and close diversity gaps with evidence.
modules.catalog_description:
DEI Analytics measures representation across the workforce and analyzes pay equity by comparing compensation across comparable groups. Surface diversity gaps, detect pay-equity issues before they escalate, and give leaders the dashboards they need to set and track inclusion goals.

It computes over your workforce, compensation, and metric data to support regulatory reporting and diversity strategy, turning fairness from an aspiration into something you can measure and improve.

modules.description: Pulse and engagement-survey campaigns, driver-score computation, sentiment aggregation. Masters engagement_surveys; consumes survey_responses from EMP-EXP.
modules.catalog_tagline: Run pulse and engagement surveys, then turn responses into driver scores and action.
modules.catalog_description:
Engagement Surveys lets you design and launch pulse and engagement campaigns, collect responses, and compute the driver scores that explain how employees feel and why. Aggregate sentiment across teams and time, spot where engagement is slipping, and route the signal to the people who can act.

Close the loop by tracking action plans and feeding engagement trends into broader people analytics, so survey results drive change instead of sitting in a slide deck.

modules.description: Attrition-risk, flight-risk, succession-readiness, hire-success ML models. Masters attrition_forecasts and predictive_models; emits scored populations to TALENT-MGMT, HCM, and SWP.
modules.catalog_tagline: Score flight risk and future outcomes with predictive people models.
modules.catalog_description:
Predictive Models brings machine learning to your people data: attrition and flight-risk scoring, succession readiness, and hire-success prediction. Train models on historical patterns, validate them, deploy the ones that earn trust, and retire the ones that drift.

Publish scored populations and attrition forecasts to the teams that act on them, so retention, succession, and planning decisions start from a forward-looking signal rather than a rear-view report.

modules.description: Headcount, attrition snapshots, span-of-control, workforce composition, and people-KPI scorecards. Masters people_kpis and workforce_segments. Entry-point module for People Analytics deployments.
modules.catalog_tagline: Track headcount, attrition, and workforce composition with people-KPI scorecards.
modules.catalog_description:
Workforce Metrics gives you the core people numbers: headcount, hires and exits, attrition snapshots, span of control, and workforce composition by org unit, tenure, and performance band. Define the KPIs that matter, snapshot them on a schedule, and publish scorecards leaders can trust.

Segment the workforce into the cohorts you care about and feed those segments into planning, predictive, and diversity work. This is the entry point for People Analytics, the metric layer everything else builds on.

modules.description: Catalog of earning codes, deduction codes, and court/agency garnishment orders that drive payroll calculation. Masters earning_codes, deduction_codes, garnishment_orders.
modules.catalog_tagline: Define the earning and deduction codes that shape every paycheck, and process garnishments correctly.
modules.catalog_description: Maintain the catalog of earning and deduction codes that drive how pay is calculated: pre-tax and post-tax deductions, recurring and one-time earnings, and the rules behind each. Take in court-ordered wage garnishments, apply them to the right runs within legal limits, and track each order from receipt to release.

modules.description: Generation, publishing, and employee self-service of pay slips, W2/1099/equivalent year-end statements. Masters pay_slips; reads from pay_runs.
modules.catalog_tagline: Publish accurate pay statements and give every employee on-demand access to their pay history.
modules.catalog_description: Generate a clear pay statement for every employee each cycle, showing earnings, deductions, taxes, and net pay. Publish statements on schedule, handle amendments and reissues when corrections happen, and keep an accessible archive so employees can retrieve their pay history whenever they need it.

modules.description: Core pay-cycle execution: opens runs, ingests inputs (time, comp, benefits, expenses), performs gross-to-net calculation, books payroll journal entries, and triggers disbursement. Masters pay_runs and payroll_journal_entries.
modules.catalog_tagline: Take each pay cycle from open to disbursed, with gross-to-net calculated for every employee.
modules.catalog_description: Open a pay run, gather the earnings and deductions that apply, and calculate gross-to-net pay for everyone in the cycle. Route the run for approval, disburse net pay, and post the results so the next cycle starts clean. Track every run through its lifecycle and keep the full calculation trail for audit.

modules.description: Tax authority configuration, periodic statutory filings, year-end forms, and multi-jurisdiction tax rate management. Masters tax_authorities and tax_filings; consumes pay_runs for filing inputs.
modules.catalog_tagline: Calculate, file, and track every statutory payroll tax return to acceptance.
modules.catalog_description: Determine which taxing authorities apply to each pay run, calculate the taxes owed, and prepare the statutory filings each jurisdiction requires. Submit returns, track acceptance or rejection, and manage amendments and corrections, with a clean record of what was filed and when.

modules.description: Image, video, 3D model, and document assets tied to products: ingestion, rights metadata, renditions, CDN distribution, and asset-to-product linking. Lives inside PIM in v1; can be split into its own DAM domain when warranted.
modules.catalog_tagline: Manage the images, video, and rich media that bring products to life.
modules.catalog_description: Keep every image, video, 3D model, and document tied to the products they depict, with rights and usage metadata so you always know what you can publish where. Upload, review, and approve assets through a clear workflow, generate the renditions each channel needs, and deliver them from one managed source. No more hunting through shared folders for the latest hero shot or publishing an asset you do not have the rights to use.

modules.description: Core merchandising master: products, attributes, variants, categories, translations, supplier onboarding, compliance attributes, and the review-and-approve workflow before publish. The deploy entry-point for any PIM rollout.
modules.catalog_tagline: Author, enrich, and approve rich product content in one workspace.
modules.catalog_description: Build complete, accurate product records and keep them that way. Define the attributes and validation rules each product type needs, organize items into the taxonomies your channels expect, and manage size, color, and pack variants under a single parent. Take every product through a structured enrichment workflow, from draft through enrichment, review, and approval, so only complete, on-brand content moves forward. Manage translations for every market in step with the source content, so a product launches in all of its languages at once instead of trickling out market by market.

modules.description: Per-channel feed shaping and publish orchestration: marketplace seller feeds, search-engine merchant feeds, commerce-platform catalogs, retailer feeds, GDSN datapools. Validation against destination schemas; syndication-job state machine; rejected-listing remediation queue.
modules.catalog_tagline: Publish approved products to every channel and fix rejections fast.
modules.catalog_description: Define each destination once: marketplaces, storefronts, retailer feeds, and datapools, with the field mapping and rules each one requires. Push approved products and their assets out on demand or on a schedule, then watch each publish run from queued through running to succeeded, partial, or failed. When a channel rejects a listing, see the exact reason and remediate it in one queue, so products stay live and sellable across every place you do business instead of silently dropping off a feed.

modules.description: Product Data Management module: vaulting, check-in / check-out, version control, and viewable generation for CAD files. Integrates with mechanical and electronic CAD authoring tools.
modules.catalog_tagline: Vault, version, and release your CAD models and drawings.
modules.catalog_description: Give design teams a managed vault for CAD models and drawings with check-in, check-out, and revision history so the latest controlled geometry is never in doubt. Tie each model and drawing to its engineering part and release it as the controlled artifact that manufacturing and field service rely on, ending the lost-file and wrong-version problems of shared folders.

modules.description: Substance tracking and reporting for product regulations: RoHS, REACH, conflict minerals, PFAS. Captures supplier material declarations and generates compliance evidence per shipment / market.
modules.catalog_tagline: Prove material and substance compliance for every market.
modules.catalog_description: Collect supplier material declarations, track regulated substances, and roll the results up into product compliance declarations that show each part meets the rules for the regions you sell into. Manage declaration validity and expiry, re-flag affected parts when a declaration lapses, and keep an auditable record for regulators instead of scrambling for evidence after the fact.

modules.description: The foundational PLM module: part and item master, engineering BOM, revision control, and engineering change workflow. Every PLM rollout starts here.
modules.catalog_tagline: Own the part master, BOM, and engineering change control.
modules.catalog_description: Author and release engineering parts, revisions, and bills of material, then govern every change through a structured change-order workflow: open the change, run a where-used impact assessment, take it through review and approval, and release the controlled result. Keep one authoritative item master that the rest of the product record extends, so a released part means the same thing to engineering, manufacturing, and procurement.

modules.description: Bridges engineering release to the shop floor: mBOM authoring, manufacturing routing, work instructions, and configuration / variant resolution at order time.
modules.catalog_tagline: Turn the engineering BOM into a buildable manufacturing process.
modules.catalog_description: Translate the as-designed engineering BOM into a manufacturing BOM and routing the shop floor can actually build, and resolve configurable products into concrete variants at order time. Release the manufacturing process as a controlled output so production execution and ERP pick up a consistent, costed, change-aware definition instead of a hand-reconciled copy.

modules.description: Requirements capture, decomposition, and traceability from customer / regulatory inputs through design, test, and validation. Used heavily in aerospace, automotive, and medical-device.
modules.catalog_tagline: Trace requirements from definition through verification.
modules.catalog_description: Capture and decompose product requirements, link them to the parts and changes that satisfy them, and build a traceability matrix that shows what is covered, reviewed, approved, and verified. Catch unmet or orphaned requirements before release so the product you ship is the product that was actually specified.

modules.description: Captures customer feedback and feature ideas, triages them, and prioritizes the backlog that feeds the roadmap. Covers feedback aggregation, opportunity and idea management, and feature prioritization (RICE, value-vs-effort, weighted scoring).
modules.catalog_tagline: Collect feedback and feature requests, then triage them into a clear, prioritized backlog.
modules.catalog_description: Bring every customer signal into one place, from raw feedback to explicit feature requests. Classify and link incoming input, weigh demand against effort, and triage requests through to an accept-or-reject decision. Accepted work flows straight into roadmap planning, so nothing gets lost between listening and building.

modules.description: Manages the product roadmap, plans and ships releases, runs beta programs, and tracks product metrics against strategy and OKRs. Bridges prioritized opportunities to delivered features and measured outcomes.
modules.catalog_tagline: Plan releases, publish your roadmap, and run beta programs from one delivery workspace.
modules.catalog_description: Shape accepted features into a release plan and a roadmap your teams and customers can rely on. Manage product lines across their lifecycle, coordinate releases through ship and rollback, and validate with beta cohorts before general availability. Watch adoption and product metrics so you know which bets paid off.

modules.description: Competitor tracking, intelligence records, battlecards, and win/loss programs. The competitive-enablement core bought from Klue and Crayon.
modules.catalog_tagline: Track every competitor and put a battlecard in your sellers' hands the moment they need it.
modules.catalog_description: Keep a living record of every competitor: their moves, their pricing, their pitch, and your counter. Turn that intel into battlecards your sellers reach for in the deal, and run structured win/loss interviews to learn why you actually win and lose. Stop letting competitive knowledge live in one person's head and arm the whole revenue team with what works.

modules.description: Go-to-market launch planning and coordination: launch plans, product launches, milestones, readiness gating, and cross-functional activities. The launch-marketing surface relocated from GTM-PLAN and anchored on Aha! Roadmaps Create.
modules.catalog_tagline: Plan and coordinate every launch from kickoff to GA, with readiness gates nothing ships past.
modules.catalog_description: Run launches as a managed motion, not a scramble: build the launch plan, set milestones, and gate go-live on a readiness checklist every function signs off. Track each product launch through its tiers and dates, coordinate the activities across marketing, sales, and product, and keep one calendar of what is shipping when. Fewer missed dates, fewer half-ready launches, and a clear record of how each one went.

modules.description: Messaging frameworks, positioning, personas, and value propositions. The positioning-craft surface that keeps the company telling one story.
modules.catalog_tagline: Define the message once, and keep the whole company telling the same story.
modules.catalog_description: Build the messaging framework, positioning, and value propositions in one place, grounded in real buyer personas, and put them through review and approval so nothing goes out half-baked. When marketing, sales, and product all pull from the same messaging house, the story stays consistent from the website to the sales call to the launch. Stop reinventing the pitch in every deck.

modules.description: Sales-enablement content production, collections, trainings, and engagement analytics. The enablement-platform surface bought from Highspot and Seismic.
modules.catalog_tagline: Produce the content sellers actually use, and see what moves deals.
modules.catalog_description: Create, organize, and ship the sales-enablement content your reps need, group it into collections by stage and persona, and back it with enablement training so sellers know how to use it. Track which content gets opened, shared, and tied to won deals, and double down on what works. Turn enablement from a content dump into a measured driver of sales productivity.

modules.description: Time-weighted IRR/MOIC/TVPI/DPI computation across multi-vintage funds with PME benchmarking and J-curve normalization. Aggregate dashboards over portfolio holdings.
modules.catalog_tagline: Compute fund and position returns across vintages with benchmarking and J-curve normalization.
modules.catalog_description: Roll holdings up into the performance numbers that define a fund: time-weighted IRR, MOIC, TVPI, and DPI at both the position and fund level. Normalize for the J-curve on early-stage vintages and benchmark against public market equivalents so results are comparable and credible. Give the team aggregate dashboards over the whole portfolio instead of a maze of disconnected return calculations.

modules.description: Quarterly LP-facing performance reports with fund and individual position metrics. Distinct from FUND-ADMIN's PCAP statements (which are accounting-side capital-account ledgers); these are performance narratives.
modules.catalog_tagline: Package quarterly LP performance reports that tie every fund number back to the marks behind it.
modules.catalog_description: Assemble the quarterly story LPs read: position-level marks, fund-level performance metrics, GP commentary, and portfolio highlights in one report per fund. Move each report through draft, review, and publication, and lock it once distributed so the version LPs receive is the version of record. Turn the latest valuations and returns into a polished, defensible LP narrative without rebuilding it by hand every quarter.

modules.description: KPI collection from portfolio companies via portal upload, email parsing, or accounting connectors. Also ESG and diversity metric collection for LP disclosure and SFDR compliance. Masters portfolio companies and the KPI / ESG record streams.
modules.catalog_tagline: Collect KPI, ESG, and diversity data from every portfolio company on a predictable reporting cadence.
modules.catalog_description: Stand up a reliable pipeline for the numbers behind every holding. Request and capture KPI submissions per portfolio company each period, gather ESG and diversity metrics for LP disclosure, and review and accept what comes in before it flows downstream. Keep a clean, period-by-period record of revenue, runway, headcount, margins, and sustainability indicators so analysts stop chasing data and start comparing it across the portfolio.

modules.description: Fair-value marks per ASC 820 with methodology-tagged audit trail across reporting cycles. Distinct from CAP-TABLE's 409A valuations (which are issuer-side IRS valuations); these are LP-side fair-value marks.
modules.catalog_tagline: Mark holdings to fair value each cycle with a methodology trail you can defend in an audit.
modules.catalog_description: Produce quarter-end fair-value marks per portfolio company with the valuation methodology recorded alongside every number. Move each mark through proposal, review, and approval, lock it once final, and keep the rationale attached so the audit trail is complete. Built for the fair-value reporting that LPs and auditors expect, with a single-approver gate where it matters.

modules.description: The human and decision layer on top of the engine. Masters human tasks (the work-item inbox with assignment and escalation), case records (flexible non-sequential case handling), and decision tables with their runtime evaluations under DMN. Where automated orchestration meets people and business rules.
modules.catalog_tagline: Route work to the right people and evaluate your business rules in real time.
modules.catalog_description: Bring people and decisions into your processes. Human steps become work items that land in the right person's inbox, with claiming, reassignment, due dates, and escalation when they stall. For knowledge work that does not follow a fixed path, open a case file and let workers add activities and close milestones as the situation demands. And keep your business rules out of code: author decision tables once, then have running processes evaluate them in real time, with every evaluation recorded for audit.

modules.description: The durable execution kernel. Masters deployed process definitions and their running instances, advances each instance through its activities, records every state change as a process event, holds runtime variables, and surfaces incidents on failed jobs. The runtime substrate every other module builds on.
modules.catalog_tagline: Deploy a process once and run thousands of resilient instances that recover from any failure.
modules.catalog_description: The engine room. Register an executable process definition, then start an instance for each real-world case and let the engine drive it through its steps. Instances survive crashes and restarts, retry failed work automatically, wait on timers and incoming events, and run branches in parallel. When something cannot proceed, an incident is raised so an operator can inspect the variables, fix the cause, and resume. Every transition is written to an immutable event history, so you can always see what ran, replay it, and feed the stream into analytics.

modules.description: Engagement scoping, project structure, tasks, milestones, deliverables, SLAs. The master of service_projects and project_tasks; consumes opportunities, contracts, and external work projects to ground the engagement.
modules.catalog_tagline: Scope, structure, and deliver client engagements on time.
modules.catalog_description: Stand up a new engagement from an approved opportunity or signed contract, break it into tasks and milestones, and drive it to completion. Track scope, schedule, and delivery status in one place, see when a project needs staffing, and close out the work cleanly when it is done. Keep delivery teams aligned on what is committed and what is at risk so nothing falls through the cracks.

modules.description: Project budgets, billing-rate cards, invoice generation against milestones and time, revenue recognition tied to performance obligations. Masters project_billing_milestones; contributes to revenue_recognition_records ahead of the ERP GL post.
modules.catalog_tagline: Bill accurately and recognize project revenue with confidence.
modules.catalog_description: Manage project budgets and rate cards, generate invoices against reached milestones and approved time, and recognize revenue using percentage-of-completion or milestone methods. Track billing status from planned to paid, flag slipped or written-off milestones, and keep recognized revenue tied to delivered work. Hand finance a clean, auditable bridge from project delivery to the general ledger.

modules.description: Resource pool, skills, demand-supply matching, project assignments and resource allocations, utilization forecasting. Masters project_assignments, resource_skill_inventories, project_resource_allocations.
modules.catalog_tagline: Match the right people to the right work, and keep them utilized.
modules.catalog_description: See who is available, what they are skilled in, and where demand is going, then commit and confirm assignments against it. Plan resource allocations ahead of need, fill staffing requests as projects ramp, and release people back to the bench when work wraps. Forecast utilization, surface skill gaps early, and keep your billable workforce productive without overbooking or idle time.

modules.description: Timesheet capture, expense reporting, approval workflows for project work. Consumes time_entries and expense_reports owned by WFM and EXPENSE respectively; produces approved data for billing and cost posting.
modules.catalog_tagline: Capture time and expenses against projects and get them approved fast.
modules.catalog_description: Let consultants log billable and non-billable time and submit expenses against the projects and tasks they are working, then route everything through the right approvals. Clean, approved time and cost flow straight into billing and project accounting, so invoices are accurate and margin is real. Cut the chase at period close and give delivery and finance trustworthy actuals.

modules.description: Agent-facing workflow from lead capture through closing. Lead nurture (writes back into CRM contributor flow), listing creation and MLS syndication, tour scheduling and execution, transaction management (offer to escrow to contingencies to close), and buyer/seller disclosure handling. The deployable unit for solo agents and small firms; agents in larger brokerages work here while broker oversight runs in BROKERAGE-OPS.
modules.catalog_tagline: Work every deal from lead to close in one place.
modules.catalog_description: Capture leads and turn them into listings, syndicate to the MLS, and schedule showings with access windows and follow-ups. Drive each transaction from accepted offer through inspection, financing, and contingencies to a clean close, with buyer and seller disclosures tracked at every step. The deployable unit for solo agents and small firms.

modules.description: Broker-level oversight on top of agent operations. Multi-agent commission-split engine with franchise overrides and per-agent caps, broker compliance review of transactions and disclosures, trust-account / escrow oversight, broker-level MLS conformance review. Only deployed when the brokerage has grown past informal-broker-supervision scale (typically 10+ agents).
modules.catalog_tagline: Give the broker oversight of money and compliance.
modules.catalog_description: Run multi-agent commission splits with franchise overrides and per-agent caps, review transactions and disclosures for compliance before close, and keep trust and escrow accounts reconciled. Add broker-level MLS conformance review so the brokerage scales past informal supervision without losing control of the deal.

modules.description: Annual reconciliation of common-area-maintenance expense pools across tenants with gross-up to occupancy and audit caps, plus CPI-indexed, stepped, fixed-percent, and percentage-rent escalation calculations against breakpoints.
Manage CRE deals from prospect through letter-of-intent to executed lease, including lease-clause negotiation, sublease grants, and commercial-tenant credit underwriting that gates leasing decisions.

Visualize building stacking plans by floor and suite, track vacant, leased, and expiring space, benchmark lease and sale comparables by submarket, manage commercial-tenant relations, and maintain property certifications that support underwriting and tenant appeal.
Partnership accounting for real-estate funds: maintain partner capital accounts, fee and carry schedules, and the mechanics of capital calls and waterfall distributions across GP and LP tiers.
modules.catalog_tagline: Keep the books for your real estate funds, from capital calls and distributions to management fees and net asset value.
modules.catalog_description: Run day-to-day fund accounting for every real estate fund you manage. Issue capital calls and track them through to funded, declare and pay distributions, and accrue asset management fees on a schedule you control. Maintain each fund's capital accounts and net asset value as activity flows in, so your numbers stay current between reporting cycles. When a call goes out or a distribution is declared, your limited partners are notified automatically, and the resulting entries are ready to post downstream to your general ledger.

modules.description: Quarterly statements, capital-account roll-forwards, and tax forms delivered to limited partners through an investor-facing portal, drawing on lease income, capital calls, and distribution records.
modules.catalog_tagline: Give your limited partners clear statements, live balances, and a portal they can log into any time.
modules.catalog_description: Deliver a professional reporting experience to every investor in your funds. Produce capital account statements, distribution notices, and tax documents, and publish them to a self-service portal where limited partners can see their commitments, contributions, and balances on demand. Notify investors the moment a statement, capital call, or distribution is ready, and keep their records in sync with the underlying fund activity. The result is fewer one-off investor requests and a reporting cycle you can run on time, every period.

modules.description: Property and portfolio valuation via cap rate, DCF, and direct comparison; acquisition underwriting with pro-forma cash flows and sponsor returns; net operating income and net asset value rollups across assets and funds.
modules.catalog_tagline: Value your properties, refresh fund NAV, and underwrite new acquisitions from one portfolio view.
modules.catalog_description: Track the value of every property across your portfolio and keep fund net asset value current. Schedule and record valuations, capture the inputs behind each one, and roll the results up so a quarterly NAV reflects the latest marks. Underwrite prospective acquisitions against the same data your existing holdings sit on, comparing assumptions and returns before you commit. With valuation and underwriting in one place, your investment team works from a single, trusted picture of the portfolio.

modules.description: Tenant rent collection and per-property accounting. Processes recurring and one-time rent payments across ACH, card, and cash, assesses late fees per lease terms, and maintains a per-property general ledger with portfolio rollup, owner statements, trust-account separation, and 1099 reporting.
modules.catalog_tagline: Collect rent, chase late balances, and keep the books straight for every property.
modules.catalog_description: Run the money side of the portfolio. Bill recurring rent and charges, take payments, and apply prorations, late fees, and deposits automatically. Track each payment from due through received, late, delinquent, and collections, and keep a per-property general ledger that feeds owner statements, distributions, and investor reporting. Vendor bills paid through accounts payable reconcile back to the property they belong to.

modules.description: Vacancy marketing, applicant screening, and lease execution for residential units. Advertises open units, syndicates listings, converts leads into applications, screens prospective tenants on credit, criminal, and eviction history, and drives the application-to-signed-lease workflow with move-in scheduling.
modules.catalog_tagline: Turn vacant units into signed leases: market listings, screen applicants, and sign tenants in one pipeline.
modules.catalog_description: Move every prospect from first inquiry to move-in. Publish vacant units to listing sites, capture applications, and screen applicants against credit, criminal, and eviction history with the required adverse-action steps. Draft, send, and sign leases, then track each tenant from prospective through current, notice given, and move-out. Fair-housing-aware inquiry handling and FCRA-compliant screening are built into the flow.

modules.description: Rental-unit inventory of record plus the tenant-facing maintenance request portal. Tracks each lettable unit's amenities, occupancy, and current rent, and runs tenant-submitted maintenance tickets from intake through urgency triage, vendor dispatch, and resolution with tenant status updates.
modules.catalog_tagline: Keep the portfolio running: track every unit's status and resolve maintenance requests end to end.
modules.catalog_description: Manage the physical side of the portfolio. Hold the source-of-truth record for every rental unit and its availability, from vacant and listed through occupied and vacating. Take in maintenance requests from residents, triage and assign them, dispatch in-house or vendor crews, and follow each work order through to resolved and closed so nothing slips through the cracks.

modules.description: Building improvements, renovations, and expansions. Plans budgets, tracks timelines, and records completion status for capital work on the portfolio.

Preventive and corrective maintenance on buildings and workplace assets, plus electricity, water, gas, and waste metering. Tracks technician dispatch, asset history, cost allocation, and emissions activity data.

Owned and leased property portfolio with building records, floor plans, and lease agreements. Covers acquisition and disposal lifecycle plus lease dates, renewals, rent calculations, and ASC 842 / IFRS 16 amortization.
Desk, room, and parking allocation with real-time occupancy tracking. Drives utilization heatmaps, badge-in rates, hybrid-work patterns, and occupancy forecasting across the workplace.

modules.domain_module_name: Real Estate Agent (solo / small firm bundle)
modules.description: Solo-agent and small-firm persona bundle. Single-install deployable for individual real estate agents covering lead capture and contact relationships (CRM-LEAD-MGT, CRM-ACCT-MGT), listing creation and MLS syndication, tour scheduling, transaction execution, disclosure handling (RE-BROK-AGENT-OPS), and contract reference (CLM-REPOSITORY). One module to install; larger brokerages deploy the underlying full modules and skip the starter.
modules.catalog_tagline: A working surface for the real-estate agent.
modules.catalog_description: Bring contacts, listings, and the documents behind each deal into one agent-facing workspace. Move leads forward, keep listing and transaction paperwork organized, and stay on top of every active deal from a single view that travels with the agent across the systems they already use.

modules.description: Capture, store, and govern session recordings and audit logs from remote-control sessions: full-session video, keystroke and command audit, tamper-evident retention, redaction state, and downstream compliance evidence. Owns the recording artifact with its own lifecycle distinct from the parent session.
modules.catalog_tagline: Capture, store, and retain a tamper-evident record of every remote session, ready for any audit.
modules.catalog_description:
Record full-session video alongside a keystroke and command audit trail for every remote-control session, then keep it safe and unaltered for as long as your retention policy or regulator requires.

Find the recording behind any session in seconds, control who can view it, redact sensitive content where needed, and release the evidence to your compliance and governance teams when they need proof of exactly what happened.

modules.description: Establish and operate attended and unattended remote-control sessions over workstations and servers: code or agent based connection, NAT-traversal relay, in-session file transfer and clipboard sharing, and just-in-time privilege elevation. Owns the remote session as the unit of work and reads the operational agent liveness view plus the linked service incident.
modules.catalog_tagline: Run live attended and unattended remote-control sessions on any endpoint, with file transfer and just-in-time privilege elevation built in.
modules.catalog_description:
Establish a remote-control session to a workstation or server, whether a technician is invited in by the end user or you reach an unattended device on your own schedule. Work across firewalls and NAT without opening inbound ports, move files in both directions, share the clipboard, and step up to administrator rights only for the task at hand.

See live device health while you work, link the session to the open service ticket, and close it cleanly so downstream teams pick up exactly where you left off.

modules.description: Automatically captures emails, meetings, and calls and attributes them to opportunities and accounts, removing the manual CRM data-entry burden. The activity data foundation: captured-activity records, configurable attribution rules, and per-account and per-rep engagement rollups that feed deal scoring, forecasting, and pipeline inspection.
modules.catalog_tagline: Capture every email, call, and meeting automatically and attach it to the right deal, no manual CRM entry required.
modules.catalog_description: Activity Capture removes the data-entry tax on reps by automatically logging emails, calls, and meetings and attributing them to the right opportunity and account. The result is a clean, complete activity record that powers deal scoring, engagement metrics, and forecasting, without anyone updating the CRM by hand.

modules.description: Anchors 1-on-1 coaching to recorded calls: session scheduling, scorecard evaluation against talk-track rubrics, timestamped call-review comments, and playbook-compliance tracking. The enablement-facing review workflow over the conversation corpus, kept distinct from the per-deal scoring engine.
modules.catalog_tagline: Coach reps on real calls: replay the conversation, score it against your playbook, and track improvement over time.
modules.catalog_description: Coaching turns recorded calls into a structured development loop. Managers and enablement run 1-on-1 sessions anchored to a specific call, score it against a rubric, and leave timestamped comments reps can revisit. Patterns across the team surface what to train next, closing the loop between what happens on calls and how the team improves.

modules.description: Transcribes and analyzes recorded sales conversations, extracting topics, action items, competitor mentions, and market signals from the call corpus. The analytics layer over the call-recording substrate: it turns raw conversations into structured insight records, topic and objection tags, and competitive-signal feeds consumed by deal scoring and coaching.
modules.catalog_tagline: Turn every recorded call into searchable insight: topics, competitor mentions, objections, and follow-ups, captured automatically.
modules.catalog_description: Conversation Intelligence transcribes and analyzes your team's calls and meetings, surfacing what was discussed: pricing pushback, competitor names, next-step commitments, and risk signals. Reps stop taking notes and managers stop guessing what happened on a call. Extracted topics and action items flow straight into deal scoring and coaching, so the signal in every conversation reaches the people who need it.

modules.description: Computes per-opportunity risk scores and named deal warnings from activity, conversation, and CRM signals, then rolls them up into the manager-grade pipeline inspection surface. Per-deal scoring and the portfolio review of those scores are two grains of one engine: the score primitive plus the pipeline-health diagnostics, deal-coverage views, and stage-progression analytics built on it.
modules.catalog_tagline: Know which deals will close and which are slipping, with an AI risk score and named warnings on every opportunity.
modules.catalog_description: Deal Intelligence scores each open opportunity for risk using the activity, conversation, and CRM signals your team already generates, then flags the specific problems behind a low score: no decision-maker, no next step, single-threaded. Managers inspect the pipeline by risk instead of by gut feel, and reps see exactly what to fix on each deal before the forecast call.

modules.description: Produces period revenue forecasts by segment and roll-up, captures the rep-and-manager submission cycle, and scores forecast accuracy against actuals over time. The finance-grade forecasting surface: forecast snapshots, category calls (commit, best-case, pipeline), submission and adjustment history, and the accuracy records that train the forecasting models.
modules.catalog_tagline: Submit, roll up, and stress-test your revenue forecast, with accuracy tracked every period so the number gets better over time.
modules.catalog_description: Forecasting replaces the spreadsheet scramble with a structured submission and roll-up cycle. Reps submit their call, managers adjust and lock the team number, and an AI-generated baseline gives leadership a second opinion. Every period's submitted forecast is measured against actuals, so forecast accuracy is a metric you manage, not a mystery.

modules.description: Deploys, tracks, and governs the installed agent fleet across multi-tenant endpoint estates: agent liveness and health, hardware and software inventory, network discovery of unmanaged hosts, and per-customer logical isolation of the managed estate.
modules.catalog_tagline: Roll out monitoring agents, watch every device stay online, and retire them cleanly when hardware leaves service.
modules.catalog_description: Deploy a lightweight agent to each endpoint and server, then track its check-in, version, and health at a glance. As agents come online they surface the hardware, software, and devices they find, so your inventory stays current without manual audits. When a machine goes quiet you know right away, and when an asset is retired the agent is removed without leaving loose ends.

modules.description: Authors, versions, schedules, and executes scripts against managed endpoints from a reusable script library, with secure parameter passing and per-target execution history. The remediation and bulk-operation engine driven by alerts and patch outcomes.
modules.catalog_tagline: Run trusted scripts across your whole fleet to fix issues and automate routine work, safely and on demand.
modules.catalog_description: Build a library of reusable scripts with version history and parameters, approve the ones cleared for production, and run them against one device or thousands. Automate the repetitive fixes that used to eat an afternoon, respond to alerts with remediation that runs itself, and keep a record of what ran where and how it turned out. Approval gates keep risky changes from reaching endpoints before a human has signed off.

modules.description: Collects real-time telemetry from managed endpoints, evaluates it against thresholds and policies, generates de-duplicated alerts with notification routing, and applies AI assistance for triage, root-cause hints, and natural-language operations queries. Reads the alert and policy masters owned by the broader IT operations monitoring layer.
modules.catalog_tagline: Catch problems on managed devices the moment they start, and route the right alert to the right person.
modules.catalog_description: Define what to watch on each device and the thresholds that matter, then let incoming telemetry be checked continuously against those policies. When a condition crosses the line, an alert is raised, deduplicated, and sent to whoever needs it. Acknowledge, resolve, or suppress alerts to keep the noise down, and hand off anything that needs a ticket to your service desk automatically.

modules.description: Discovers, approves, schedules, and deploys OS and third-party patches across endpoint groups within maintenance windows, with per-endpoint execution status and rollback on failure. Emits change records into the service-change pipeline.
modules.catalog_tagline: Patch operating systems and third-party software on schedule, within maintenance windows, with a safety net.
modules.catalog_description: Plan patch jobs against the exact set of devices you choose and run them inside approved maintenance windows so users are not interrupted. Track each deployment as it runs, see per-device success and failure, and roll back when a patch causes trouble. Keep machines current against known fixes without standing over them, and feed the change record straight into your change-management process.

modules.description: Multi-step outbound sequencing engine. Reps and automation enroll prospects into cadences that combine email, call, social, and video touches with timing and branching rules. Includes power and click-to-call dialing and third-party intent and buyer-signal scoring that triggers enrollment.
modules.catalog_tagline: Put every prospect into a consistent, multi-channel outreach motion and dial through your list without losing the thread.
modules.catalog_description:
Design multi-step sequences that combine email, calls, social touches, and manual tasks, then enroll prospects in bulk or one at a time. Timing and branching rules advance each prospect automatically, so reps always know exactly who to contact next and never let a follow-up go cold.

Work your call list faster with built-in dialing and let buyer-intent and engagement signals push the warmest prospects to the top of the queue, so your team spends its time where the interest already is.

modules.description: Call and meeting recording, transcription, and AI-extracted talk ratios, objections, commitments, and next steps. Feeds scorecard-driven coaching workflows, cadence A/B comparison, and manager one-to-one preparation.
modules.catalog_tagline: Turn every recorded call and meeting into clear next steps and repeatable coaching that ramps the whole team.
modules.catalog_description:
Record and transcribe sales calls and meetings automatically, then get the highlights without listening to the whole thing: talk ratios, objections raised, commitments made, and the next steps that were agreed.

Use those insights to coach with evidence. Score conversations against your playbook, compare what's working across reps and cadences, and prep managers for one-on-ones so new reps ramp faster and your best techniques spread across the team.

modules.description: One-to-one sales email with open, click, and reply tracking, reusable templates and snippets, and AI-assisted drafting and reply suggestions from prospect context. Includes prospect-facing booking links with availability, round-robin routing, and qualifier forms.
modules.catalog_tagline: Send personal, trackable sales email and let prospects book time with you in a couple of clicks.
modules.catalog_description:
Write one-to-one email that still scales, with reusable templates and snippets, and see who opened, clicked, and replied so you can follow up at the right moment. AI-assisted drafting and reply suggestions help reps respond faster and in the prospect's context.

Skip the scheduling back-and-forth with prospect-facing booking links that show real availability, route meetings to the right rep, and qualify attendees up front so the calendar fills with the meetings that matter.

modules.description: Collects deployment and usage evidence, attests compliance, and assembles reporting packages tailored to publisher audit demands and internal true-up reviews. Masters the audit/true-up record.
modules.catalog_tagline: Walk into any software audit with the evidence already assembled and your response ready to send.
modules.catalog_description: Turn a publisher audit from a panic into a routine. This module gathers the deployment and usage evidence you need, organizes it into a complete response package, and tracks each finding from first request through negotiation to resolution. Reviewers and counsel can sign off on the response before it goes out, and every submission is captured so nothing is lost or contradicted later. Whether you are facing a formal vendor audit or running an internal true-up review, you respond on your terms with documented proof, protecting the organization from surprise compliance bills and unbudgeted true-up costs.

modules.description: Maintains the normalized publisher/product software catalog and the agent-based and agent-less inventory of installed software across endpoints. Masters the canonical software product catalog and the discovered-installation record, overlaying configuration-item and org-unit context.
modules.catalog_tagline: See exactly what software is installed across your fleet, all normalized into one clean product catalog.
modules.catalog_description: Stop guessing what is running on your endpoints. This module pulls installation signals from your inventory and discovery feeds, then cleans up the raw data into a single, normalized catalog of real software products, editions, and versions. You get one trustworthy list of what you actually have deployed, with the noise of duplicate entries and cryptic install names removed. Use it as the foundation for every license and compliance decision: when you know precisely what is installed and where, reconciling entitlements and answering auditor questions becomes a lookup instead of a fire drill.

modules.description: Reconciles installed and used software against purchased entitlements, meters per-application usage to drive reclamation of unused licenses, and manages renewal dates, true-up windows, and co-termination decisions. Masters the license entitlement record.
modules.catalog_tagline: Match what you have deployed against what you have paid for, and never get caught short at renewal.
modules.catalog_description: Know your true license position at a glance. This module reconciles installed and actively used software against the entitlements you have purchased, so you can see where you are over-deployed and exposed, and where you are paying for licenses nobody touches. Reclaim and reassign unused seats to cut spend, and stay ahead of every renewal, true-up window, and co-termination date instead of scrambling when a deadline lands. The result is a defensible, always-current picture of compliance and cost that lets you renew with confidence and negotiate from real numbers.

modules.description: Strategic initiative registers, progress capture, traceability between execution work and strategic intent, and investment-alignment views.
modules.catalog_tagline: Keep every initiative tied to the strategy it serves.
modules.catalog_description: Maintain a register of strategic initiatives, capture progress as work moves, and trace execution back to the objectives it advances. Investment-alignment views show where effort and spend are landing, so leaders can spot stalled programs and reallocate early.
