modules.description: Operating-cadence orchestration (QBR / MBR / weekly business reviews), agenda templates, structured commentary capture, action-item and decision tracking.
modules.catalog_tagline: Run reviews that drive decisions, not just status updates.
modules.catalog_description: Orchestrate the operating cadence of quarterly, monthly, and weekly business reviews with agenda templates and structured commentary. Capture action items and decisions in one place, and lock each review as the durable record of what was agreed.

modules.description: Authoring of strategic objectives, strategy maps, and the cascading hierarchy from corporate strategy down to team-level OKRs.
modules.catalog_tagline: Author your strategy once and cascade it everywhere.
modules.catalog_description: Capture strategic objectives, build strategy maps across financial, customer, process, and learning perspectives, and cascade the hierarchy from corporate strategy down to team OKRs. Everyone sees how their goals ladder up, so the plan stays aligned as priorities shift.

modules.description: Maintains per-worker skill profiles, runs the inference pipeline, captures assessments and validations, and produces gap and inventory analytics.
modules.catalog_tagline: Keep an accurate, up-to-date skill profile for every worker, blending inference, assessment, and endorsement.
modules.catalog_description:
Maintain a living profile for each person. Combine inferred skills, self-ratings, formal assessments, and peer endorsements into one profile that reflects what someone can actually do.

Let evidence build the picture. Run inference against incoming signals, capture assessments and validations, and record endorsements so proficiency reflects real activity rather than a one-time survey.

Find and close the gaps. Compare profiles to role requirements, produce gap and inventory analytics, and hand clean signals to learning, mobility, and planning so development effort lands where it matters.

modules.description: Authors the skill ontology, the role-to-skill competency bundles, and the source-of-truth references that other modules consume.
modules.catalog_tagline: Curate the shared skills ontology and the role-to-skill competency frameworks the rest of the business reads from.
modules.catalog_description:
Own the language of skills. Define and organize skills, relationships, and proficiency scales in one curated ontology so every team is talking about the same thing.

Tie skills to roles. Build competency frameworks that say what each role needs, and publish versions cleanly so downstream profiles and gap analysis always assess against the current standard.

Govern change with confidence. Move taxonomies and competency models through draft, active, and deprecated states, and signal each change so profiles and inferences re-key against the new substrate.

modules.description: Unified inbox for inbound comments, mentions, direct messages, and reviews on brand-owned accounts, with team assignment, SLA tracking, canned responses, and per-contact conversation history.

Discovery, vetting, contracting, briefing, content review, payment, and measurement of influencer and creator partnerships, including audience-overlap analysis, fraud detection, and user-generated-content campaigns.

Saved monitoring queries that watch brand mentions, keywords, competitors, hashtags, and sentiment across networks, news, blogs, forums, and review sites, with topic clustering and alerting on off-channel buzz.

Authoring, scheduling, and publishing posts across connected social accounts from a unified queue and editorial calendar, with per-channel variants, approval workflow, bulk upload, an asset library, employee-advocacy content distribution, and cross-channel performance reporting.
Declarative automation workflows, workflow run history, and employee-facing self-service app-access requests. The automation surface of an SMP deployment.
modules.catalog_tagline: Automate the busywork of granting, moving, and removing app access.
modules.catalog_description: Build declarative workflows that provision and deprovision SaaS access automatically, track every run, and give employees a self-service way to request the apps they need with manager and IT approval built in. Less manual ticket-pushing, faster access, cleaner offboarding.

modules.description: Discovery of sanctioned and shadow SaaS, app inventory, ownership, integrations, lifecycle staging, catalog publication, and operational signal/alerts. The discovery substrate of an SMP deployment.
modules.catalog_tagline: Find every SaaS app in use, including the ones nobody told you about.
modules.catalog_description: Automatically discover sanctioned and shadow SaaS across your org, assign an owner to each app, and connect the integrations that feed usage and spend data. Publish a clean app catalog, stage each application through its portfolio lifecycle, and get alerted the moment something needs attention.

modules.description: Usage analytics, license rightsizing, reclamation actions, per-app cost benchmarks, and optimization recommendations. The cost-and-utilization substrate of an SMP deployment.
modules.catalog_tagline: Stop paying for licenses nobody uses.
modules.catalog_description: Track real usage for every SaaS seat, surface rightsizing and savings recommendations, and reclaim idle or duplicate licenses with a safe grace period. Benchmark your cost-per-seat against peers so you know where you are overspending and act on it.

modules.description: Renewal pipeline tracking, vendor relationship management, contract coordination with procurement and legal, spend allocation, and per-SaaS vendor-risk attestation. The commercial layer of an SMP deployment.
modules.catalog_tagline: Run every SaaS renewal on your terms, not the vendor's deadline.
modules.catalog_description: Track every upcoming renewal, assign renewal tasks, and manage vendor negotiations from first outreach to signed agreement. Allocate spend across cost centers, coordinate contracts with procurement and legal, and keep a per-vendor risk and attestation record so renewals are decisions, not surprises.

modules.description: Owns the paid-social campaign structure and live operations: social ad accounts, campaigns, ad sets, ads, audiences, bid strategies, budget allocations, conversion events, and the performance-metric record. Carries the campaign lifecycle and the auto budget-reallocation loop. Used standalone for in-housed paid social and alongside the creative-optimization module when creative versioning is in scope.
modules.catalog_tagline: Structure, launch, and steer paid social campaigns across every ad platform from one control plane.
modules.catalog_description: Build campaigns, ad sets, and ads against your connected social ad accounts and run them across Meta, TikTok, LinkedIn, and more. Attach audiences and bid strategies, set budgets, and let auto budget reallocation move spend toward the ad sets that are pacing and returning. Ingest conversion events through server-side APIs and watch per-ad performance in real time so the whole paid social estate is managed in one place instead of five native ad managers.

modules.description: Owns social ad creative as versioned assets and the dynamic creative optimization loop: creatives, creative variants, creative assets, DCO rules, and product feeds. Generates and tests variant combinations, weights delivery to winners, and keeps a versioned, auditable creative trail. Deploys alongside Campaign Orchestration, which consumes the winning creatives.
modules.catalog_tagline: Version your ad creative and let dynamic creative optimization find and scale the winning combinations.
modules.catalog_description: Manage creative as versioned assets with named variants, approval state, and platform-specific renditions. Assemble creatives from modular headlines, bodies, images, and product feeds, then let dynamic creative optimization generate and test the combinations and weight delivery toward the best performers. Iterate, roll back, and audit every creative change, and hand the winning variants straight to live campaigns.

modules.description: Direct payment of vendor bills via ACH, wire, card, or check without a sourcing or purchase-order match. Routes each vendor payment authorization through an approval chain, enriches bank details, batches disbursements into payment runs, and reconciles to the ledger.
modules.catalog_tagline: Approve vendor bills and route every payment by the right method, then release it on the next run.
modules.catalog_description:
Approve what you owe each vendor, choose how to pay (ACH, wire, virtual card, or check), and route every payment through the right sign-off chain before it goes out. Approved authorizations queue for the next payment run and release automatically when a matching invoice clears.

Keep vendor invoices, payment runs, and supplier records in one view so bill pay stays in step with accounts payable and the general ledger.

modules.description: Issuance and lifecycle of physical and virtual corporate cards plus real-time network-side authorization decisioning. Evaluates each authorization request against per-card limits, merchant category, vendor, amount, time, and geography, declining out-of-policy transactions before settlement. Covers multi-currency card spend with bank-grade FX.
modules.catalog_tagline: Issue corporate cards with spending limits and approve or decline every charge against your rules in real time.
modules.catalog_description:
Open and manage corporate card accounts, set per-card and per-category limits, and freeze or close cards the moment you need to. Every swipe is checked against your spending rules and approved or declined in real time, so out-of-policy charges never post.

Review authorizations as they happen, escalate high-value charges for an extra look, and keep multi-currency spend in view. Posted transactions flow on to expense and accounting so reconciliation is a check, not a chase.

modules.description: Proactive employee requests for spend authorization before any transaction, evaluated against a versioned policy library and an approval workflow. The approval becomes the enforceable commitment used at card-authorization and bill-pay time. Covers out-of-pocket reimbursement requests, receipt capture, and aggregated spend analytics with anomaly detection.
modules.catalog_tagline: Request spend, check it against policy, and get the right approval before any money is committed.
modules.catalog_description:
Stop overspend before it starts. Employees submit a request, the system checks it against your spending policy, and it routes to the right approver based on amount, category, and team. Nothing is committed until it clears.

Maintain one policy library that drives approvals across cards, bill pay, and reimbursement, and watch requested versus committed spend so budget owners always know what is in the pipeline before it lands on the ledger.

modules.description: Captures incoming demand (ideas, requests, project proposals), screens it, and scores each candidate on business value, cost, risk, and strategic alignment. The output is a prioritized, value-assessed funnel that feeds Portfolio Planning. Deployable standalone as a lightweight intake-and-scoring layer.
modules.catalog_tagline: Take in every request, score it on business value, and let the strongest ideas rise to the top.
modules.catalog_description:
Demand and Value Management is the front door to your portfolio. Ideas, requests, and project proposals come in through one standardized intake, get screened by an intake board, and are scored on business value, cost, risk, and strategic fit.

A published value assessment freezes so funding and prioritization decisions can rely on it. Approved demand graduates into funded initiatives, ready for portfolio planning, so you spend your capacity on the work that matters most.

modules.description: The heart of SPM: groups funded initiatives into strategic portfolios, schedules roadmap items with their dependencies, maps dependency chains that threaten delivery, and tracks benefits against each investment's business case. Embeds strategic_initiatives from SEM (local shell when SEM is absent, defers to SEM's canonical master when co-deployed).
modules.catalog_tagline: Group initiatives into portfolios, schedule the roadmap, and follow the benefits to realization.
modules.catalog_description:
Portfolio Planning turns funded initiatives into a defensible plan. Structure portfolios that roll up to corporate strategy, sequence roadmap items with their dependencies in view, and surface the dependency chains that put delivery at risk.

After the plan is set, keep it honest: track benefits against the case that justified each investment, flag the ones falling behind, and rebalance the portfolio when priorities shift.

modules.description: Commits people, budget, and capacity to initiatives against available supply, detects allocation conflicts, and models what-if scenarios before a commitment is made. Consumes workforce_scenarios (SWP), financial_scenarios (EPM), position_demand_forecasts (SWP), work_items (WORK-MGMT), and service_projects (PSA) to ground capacity decisions.
modules.catalog_tagline: Match people and budget to the work, spot conflicts early, and model the trade-offs before you commit.
modules.catalog_description:
Resource and Capacity Planning is the engine that makes the portfolio real. Every initiative competes for the same people, budget, and time, so allocations are committed against actual capacity and conflicts are caught before they bite.

Model what-if scenarios side by side, freeze each evaluated plan as a stable snapshot for comparison, and commit with confidence using a single resource-committee sign-off.

modules.description: Supplier performance scorecards, KPIs, reviews, and corrective actions. Measures and improves supplier delivery, quality, and service.
modules.catalog_tagline: Score supplier performance and drive improvement where it slips.
modules.catalog_description: Measure suppliers against delivery, quality, responsiveness, and savings targets, and roll the results into weighted scorecards your category managers and finance teams share. Spot underperformers early, open corrective actions, and track them to closure so supplier performance improves cycle over cycle.

modules.description: Supplier risk assessment, certifications, sanctions and compliance screening, and ESG. Operational, qualification-gated supplier risk, distinct from deep third-party due diligence (TPRM).
modules.catalog_tagline: Assess supplier risk and prove compliance before and after you sign.
modules.catalog_description: Score each supplier for financial, operational, cyber, and ESG risk, and keep certifications and insurance current with automatic expiry alerts. Screen suppliers for sanctions and compliance gaps, escalate elevated risk to governance and procurement, and keep a defensible record of every check behind each supplier decision.

modules.description: Supplier master data, onboarding, registration, and qualification. The intake and master-record spine of supplier management.
modules.catalog_tagline: Onboard, qualify, and maintain every supplier on one trusted master record.
modules.catalog_description: Run supplier onboarding from invitation through registration, document collection, and approval. Qualify new suppliers against your standards before they go active, and keep the supplier master, contacts, and documents current as the relationship evolves. One clean record per supplier that procurement, finance, and compliance all work from.

modules.description: Masters rental listings, channel connections, and rate plans. Sets up properties, distributes them across booking channels and OTAs, and runs dynamic nightly pricing. Deployable standalone for a host who only needs distribution and pricing.
modules.catalog_tagline: Set up your listings once and sync them, with the right nightly price, to every booking channel.
modules.catalog_description: Build rich listings with amenities, photos, and house rules, then publish them across the major booking channels from one calendar. Channel sync keeps rates and availability aligned so you never double-book, and dynamic pricing adjusts nightly rates to demand and season.

modules.description: Masters housekeeping and turnover tasks scheduled off reservation checkouts. Embeds listing and reservation shells. Deployable standalone for cleaning/ops teams.
modules.catalog_tagline: Schedule, assign, and verify every turnover clean so the next guest walks into a spotless unit.
modules.catalog_description: Turn each checkout into a scheduled turnover task, assign it to the right cleaner or team, and track it through completion and inspection. Operations stays in sync with the booking calendar so cleans land in the gap between guests, every time.

modules.description: Masters reservations, guests, guest messages, and reviews. Captures bookings from every channel, runs a unified guest inbox, and manages reviews. Embeds the listing shell.
modules.catalog_tagline: Take bookings from every channel and talk to guests in one inbox, from inquiry through review.
modules.catalog_description: Capture reservations from all your channels into one place, with check-in and check-out tracking and payment status at a glance. A unified inbox consolidates guest messages across channels with templates and automation, and review management helps you collect and respond to feedback that builds your reputation.

modules.description: Masters property owners, owner statements, and (jurisdiction-conditional) lodging-tax records and short-term-rental permits. Embeds listing and reservation shells; rolls up booking revenue into commission-based statements.
modules.catalog_tagline: Pay your owners accurately every cycle and stay on top of lodging taxes and local permits.
modules.catalog_description: Roll booking revenue and pass-through expenses into commission-based owner statements, finalize them, and pay out. For regulated markets, collect and remit occupancy and lodging taxes and keep local short-term-rental permits and registrations current.

modules.description: Invoice generation, payment processing, tax calculation, and dunning workflows for failed-payment recovery. Sits downstream of the subscription lifecycle.
modules.catalog_tagline: Issue recurring invoices and recover the payments that slip.
modules.catalog_description: Generate, issue, and track invoices across the billing cycle, then catch and work past-due balances through structured dunning. Gives finance and collections teams a clear view of what was billed, what was paid, and what needs follow-up, with every invoice state change recorded for audit.

modules.description: Subscription record lifecycle (active, paused, canceled, churned), usage metering and rating, revenue recognition under ASC 606 / IFRS 15, entitlement management, and SaaS churn analytics. The recurring-revenue substrate.
modules.catalog_tagline: Manage the subscription lifecycle and the usage that drives it.
modules.catalog_description: Take subscriptions from trial to active, handle upgrades, downgrades, renewals, cancellations, and reactivations, and capture metered usage as it happens. Keeps subscription state and usage in one place so billing, revenue, and customer teams always work from the same source of truth.

modules.description: The pre-delivery surface: author the statement of work, take in services proposals, stand up the engagement against the supplier and the contract, and amend scope through change orders. Masters the SOW, the engagement, the proposal, and the change order; consumes the supplier, the contract, and rate cards from their owning domains.
modules.catalog_tagline: Author the SOW, take in proposals, and stand up the engagement before the work begins.
modules.catalog_description: Turn an awarded services deal into a working engagement. Author the statement of work that scopes what the firm will deliver, take in the proposals or bids attached to it, and stand up the engagement against the supplier and the signed contract. When the work shifts, raise a change order and keep the SOW current instead of letting scope drift. The services firm stays your supplier and the SOW stays your contract; this module is where you shape the engagement they hang off of.

modules.description: The delivery and settlement surface: break the engagement into milestones and deliverables, track each to acceptance, and settle on what was delivered through milestone-based invoices. Masters the milestone, the deliverable, the milestone invoice, and the acceptance record.
modules.catalog_tagline: Track milestones and deliverables to acceptance, then pay on what was actually delivered.
modules.catalog_description: Run the delivery half of a services engagement. Break the statement of work into milestones and the deliverables that close them, then track each one to formal acceptance so payment follows delivered outcomes, not elapsed time. Raise milestone-based invoices against accepted work and keep a clear, auditable record of who accepted what and when. Outcome-based settlement that ties every payment back to a milestone the buyer signed off.

modules.description: Workforce cost projections, cost-of-plan, and the EPM handoff. Masters workforce_cost_projections (the boundary-object SWP authors and EPM consumes into the consolidated budget). Contributor on financial_plans for the labor-cost slice. Consumes salary_bands, merit_cycles, cost_centers, employees, and hcm_positions to size the loaded-comp envelope.
modules.catalog_tagline: Project the fully loaded cost of every workforce plan and hand it to finance for the budget.
modules.catalog_description:
Cost Projections puts a number on the plan. Project the fully loaded compensation expense of any workforce plan or scenario by period, org, geography, and level, so the cost of growth, reduction, or restructure is clear before the decision is made.

Approved cost projections roll straight into enterprise budgeting, keeping the people-cost line connected to the workforce plan instead of drifting in a separate spreadsheet. This is the module that lets finance and workforce planning speak the same language.

modules.description: Headcount and position demand modeling. Masters headcount_plans, position_demand_forecasts, and skills_gap_analyses. Publishes the canonical hiring-demand signal that ATS, HCM, and LMS subscribe to. Contributor on the requisition slice of job_requisitions (the authorization-to-hire layer that ATS then executes).
modules.catalog_tagline: Forecast the headcount and skills you will need, role by role, and authorize hiring against the plan.
modules.catalog_description:
Demand Forecast turns business targets into a concrete picture of future hiring need. Build headcount plans by org unit and period, forecast position demand role by role, and run a skills-gap analysis that compares the capabilities you will need to the ones you have.

When a plan is approved it becomes the authorization to hire: the canonical hiring-demand signal that recruiting, HR, and learning teams subscribe to. This is where workforce planning meets execution, the layer that tells the rest of the organization who to hire and what skills to build.

modules.description: What-if workforce scenarios, org-design alternatives, labor-market intelligence, and M&A or transformation models. Masters workforce_plans, workforce_scenarios, org_designs, and labor_market_benchmarks. Adopted scenarios cascade into HCM org changes, EPM financial-plan assumptions, and downstream cost projections.
modules.catalog_tagline: Compare growth, reduction, and restructure scenarios, design the org, and overlay labor-market data.
modules.catalog_description:
Scenario Modeling is the what-if workbench of workforce planning. Build and compare scenarios for growth, reduction, restructure, geography shift, skill pivot, and cost optimization, and see how each one reshapes headcount, skills, and cost before you commit.

Design the future org structure, publish the approved design into position changes, and overlay external labor-market benchmarks so assumptions about pay, availability, and skills reflect the real market. This is where leadership tests the hard choices and lands on the plan worth executing.

modules.description: Talent supply, internal-mobility forecasts, retirement curves, and gap reconciliation. Consumes employees, hcm_positions, org_units, job_profiles, attrition_forecasts, and skills_gap_analyses to build the supply side of the workforce plan. No unique master entities today; supply artifacts are derived from consumed sources and feed back into demand-vs-supply reconciliation inside the planning cycle.
modules.catalog_tagline: Model the workforce you already have and where attrition, mobility, and pipeline will leave you.
modules.catalog_description:
Supply Planning models the workforce you have today and how it will change. Project supply forward by factoring in attrition forecasts, internal mobility, and the talent pipeline, then reconcile that supply against the demand the plan calls for.

See where shortfalls and surpluses will appear by role, location, and skill, and feed the reconciled view back into planning so demand and supply stay in step. This is the half of workforce planning that keeps the plan honest about the people you can actually count on.

modules.description: Continuous feedback, 1-on-1 notes, peer recognition / praise / kudos, and 360-degree feedback collection. The lightweight always-on companion to the annual review cycle. Often the first module customers adopt before a full review cycle.
modules.catalog_tagline: Keep feedback flowing all year with kudos, one-on-one notes, and requested feedback that feed straight into reviews.
modules.catalog_description:
Make recognition and coaching part of everyday work. Capture kudos, one-on-one notes, peer comments, and requested feedback as they happen, independent of the formal review calendar.

Share feedback with the right timing and the right people. Move each record from draft to shared to acknowledged so feedback lands clearly and is confirmed by the recipient.

Connect continuous feedback to formal performance. Aggregate the year's feedback into review summaries so managers walk into every review with the full picture.

modules.description: Annual / semi-annual / continuous performance review cycles plus goal-setting (OKRs, KPIs) and rating calibration. The foundation module of any talent-management deployment; review cycles produce the calibrated rating that COMP-MGMT consumes for merit cycles and that downstream succession planning relies on.
modules.catalog_tagline: Set goals, run reviews, and calibrate ratings so performance management stays fair, consistent, and tied to results.
modules.catalog_description:
Give every employee clear goals and a structured review. Define individual goals and OKRs with metrics and weights, then track progress through the year and roll outcomes into the review cycle.

Run reviews the way your business works. Move each review through self-assessment, manager assessment, submission, and publishing, with the right people gated into each step.

Remove rater bias with calibration. Bring managers together to normalize ratings across teams, lock the calibrated outcomes, and publish results that downstream merit, succession, and 9-box decisions can trust.

modules.description: Succession planning, 9-box talent grid, and employee career aspirations / development planning. Layered on top of Performance Management because it consumes calibrated ratings and goal-completion outcomes. Used standalone in large enterprises with formal succession programs.
modules.catalog_tagline: Build the bench for critical roles and give people a clear path forward with succession plans, 9-box placement, and career aspirations.
modules.catalog_description:
Protect the business from key-person risk. Build succession plans for critical positions, identify ready successors with readiness ratings, and capture risk-of-loss so you always know where the gaps are.

See talent at a glance. Place people on a performance-by-potential grid to focus development and investment where it pays off, and feed confirmed placements straight back into succession planning.

Make career growth a two-way conversation. Record each person's target roles and mobility preferences so you can match them to internal opportunities and keep your best people moving forward.

modules.description: The regulated and safety-facing surface: electronic hours-of-service logs, video-telematics incident capture, driver-behavior event detection, and composite safety scoring. Hosts the FMCSA hours-of-service compliance leg and the video-and-coaching workflow that turns risky-event triggers into driver safety outcomes.
modules.catalog_tagline: Keep drivers safe and audits painless with hours-of-service logs, video events, and safety scores in one place.
modules.catalog_description:
Capture electronic hours-of-service logs automatically and certify them without paper, so drivers stay legal and audits stop being a fire drill. When a driver brakes hard, speeds, or has a near-miss, the event and its video land in one queue ready for review and coaching.

Per-driver safety scorecards turn those events into a clear, trend-able measure of risk, so you can coach the right people, reward the safest, and show insurers and regulators that your fleet is getting safer over time. Fewer incidents, lower premiums, and a defensible record when you need one.

modules.description: Continuous vehicle-location and movement telemetry: GPS waypoint streaming, trip segmentation, idle detection, geofence crossings, and engine-diagnostic ingestion. The position-and-utilization data layer feeding live maps, route playback, and downstream fleet analytics.
modules.catalog_tagline: Track every vehicle in real time and turn raw GPS, trips, and idling into decisions you can act on.
modules.catalog_description:
Watch your whole fleet move on a live map and replay any trip after the fact. Every vehicle reports its position continuously, so you always know who is where, which routes ran long, and where time is being lost to idling or out-of-area driving.

Geofences alert you the moment a vehicle enters or leaves a site, and trip-level summaries roll the raw waypoints up into mileage, stops, and utilization you can report on. The result is tighter routing, less wasted fuel, and answers to dispatch and customer questions in seconds instead of phone calls.

modules.description: Org-level skills heatmaps, gap and supply analytics for HR leaders.
modules.catalog_tagline: Give HR leaders org-wide skills heatmaps and gap analytics to see where talent is strong and where it is thin.
modules.catalog_description:
See your workforce's capabilities at a glance. Roll individual skills and inferences up into org-level heatmaps that show concentration, depth, and coverage across teams.

Find the gaps before they bite. Compare the skills you have against the skills you need and pinpoint where to hire, develop, or redeploy.

Feed strategic workforce planning. Hand clean supply-and-gap signals to planning so capability decisions line up with where the business is headed.

modules.description: Operates the internal opportunity marketplace: posting, matching, and applying across gigs, projects, full-time internal moves, and mentorships.
modules.catalog_tagline: Run an internal talent marketplace where employees discover and apply to gigs, projects, mentorships, and internal roles.
modules.catalog_description:
Give your people one place to grow without leaving. Post internal opportunities of every shape, gigs, projects, stretch assignments, mentorships, and full-time moves, and let employees browse and apply.

Move applications through a clear flow. Track each expression of interest from submitted through review to accepted or rejected, with the right approvers gated into each step.

Connect people to mentors. Match mentors and mentees, set goals and a cadence, and follow each engagement through to completion so development happens in the open.

modules.description: AI recommendations, fit scores, succession ranking, career-path projection, and skills-based hiring assist.
modules.catalog_tagline: Surface AI fit scores, mobility recommendations, and career paths that guide every employee toward their next best move.
modules.catalog_description:
Turn skills data into next steps. Compute fit scores between people and roles, generate mobility recommendations with clear rationale, and project career paths from where someone is to where they want to go.

Support skills-based hiring and succession. Rank candidates by fit for open roles and successor slots so managers make faster, fairer talent decisions grounded in evidence.

Keep recommendations fresh and explainable. Each match run records its inputs, model version, and outputs, so every score and suggestion can be traced and trusted.

modules.description: Post-contract watching: recompute the internal risk rating per third party and engagement, ingest external security ratings, and triage breach, sanctions, and financial signals to drive the re-assessment cadence.
modules.catalog_tagline: Keep watching after you sign, with ratings, signals, and a live risk score.
modules.catalog_description: Stop treating diligence as a one-time gate. Recompute each third party's risk rating on a cadence set by its tier, pull in external security ratings as they change, and triage breach, sanctions, and financial-distress signals as they surface. When a third party drifts into higher risk, the score moves and the right reviewers see it in time to act, so a clearance keeps its meaning long after the contract goes live.

modules.description: The deep, engagement and contract-gated diligence that distinguishes third-party risk from operational supplier qualification: questionnaires, document collection, certification and attestation checks, regulatory agreements, and the pre-contract go or no-go.
modules.catalog_tagline: Run the questionnaires, collect the evidence, and decide go or no-go before you sign.
modules.catalog_description: Send each third party the diligence its tier demands and grade what comes back. Build assessments from a library of security questionnaires, collect every answer and its supporting evidence, and gather the certifications, audit reports, and attestations that prove the controls are real. Track the regulatory agreements a relationship requires, run periodic re-assessment campaigns, and reach a clear, defensible go or no-go before the contract is signed. The deep diligence that decides whether it is safe to do business.

modules.description: Register the broad third party, scope the per-service engagement, capture the vendor-side contacts, and classify criticality before any diligence begins. The intake spine: business-sponsor requests in, the third-party master and its tier out, plus offboarding and exit due diligence.
modules.catalog_tagline: Register every third party, scope the engagement, and tier it before diligence starts.
modules.catalog_description: Bring every external party you depend on into one inventory, not just the suppliers you invoice. Take in a business sponsor's request, register the third party and the specific service engagement, capture who to contact on the vendor side, and classify how critical the relationship is so the right depth of diligence kicks in. Flag the engagements that are critical or important to the business, and run a clean exit when a relationship ends. One trusted record per third party that procurement, security, and risk all work from.

modules.description: Turn findings raised from assessment and monitoring into tracked, time-boxed remediation that closes before renewal, and record risk acceptances with an expiry when a finding will not be fixed. Consumes audit findings handed off from the audit domain.
modules.catalog_tagline: Turn findings into tracked remediation that closes before the next renewal.
modules.catalog_description: Raise an issue the moment an assessment or a monitoring signal surfaces a problem, and drive it to closure. Open vendor-scoped remediation plans time-boxed to the next review cycle or contract renewal, assign owners, and track them to done. When a finding will not be fixed, record a risk acceptance with a clear owner and an expiry date so nothing stays accepted forever. A defensible trail of every issue raised against a third party and how it was resolved.

modules.description: Visibility beyond the direct third party: subcontractor and fourth-party edges, concentration risk across shared providers, and the regulatory registers and subcontracting-chain disclosures that resilience frameworks require.
modules.catalog_tagline: See past the direct vendor into the subcontractors and concentration risk behind it.
modules.catalog_description: Your risk does not stop at the companies you contract with directly. Map the subcontractors and fourth parties your providers depend on, spot where many of your critical services trace back to the same handful of providers, and maintain the registers and subcontracting-chain disclosures that operational-resilience rules require. Add supply-chain attestations where standards demand them, so you can answer for the whole chain, not just the first link.

modules.description: Deployable starter kit for small and mid-market organizations that outsource training delivery to external vendors (EasyLlama, Traliant, Ethena, NAVEX, KnowBe4) and need to retain audit-ready evidence in their own catalog. Embeds compliance assignments, training evidence records, learner certifications, signature records, and per-regulation training records from the full LMS-COMPLIANCE-TRAINING and LMS-CREDENTIALS modules; deploys standalone without requiring the full LMS substrate. Buyer persona: HR Director or Compliance Officer at a 50 to 500 person organization. When the org later adopts the full LMS, embedded shells deterministically demote to consumer.
modules.catalog_tagline: A lightweight way to assign training and keep completion records, ready to deploy on day one.
modules.catalog_description: Start small without standing up the full learning suite. Assign training, record completions, and keep the essential evidence a small or first-time team needs. Upgrade to the full modules later without losing any of the records you have already captured.

modules.description: Sources bookable travel content across GDS, NDC, and direct suppliers, runs policy-aware shopping, and creates and manages air, hotel, rail, and car reservations. Masters the search results, the reservations, and the unused-ticket credits. Used standalone for a self-booking program and alongside the policy, profile, and duty-of-care modules for a managed program.
modules.catalog_tagline: Shop in-policy travel across every source and book it in seconds.
modules.catalog_description: Search flights, hotels, rail, and cars from one place, with policy-fit and price shown up front so travelers pick the right option fast. Hold, change, and cancel reservations cleanly, and never lose prepaid value: unused tickets and credits are tracked and reapplied to the next trip automatically.

modules.domain_module_name: Duty of Care and Traveler Risk
modules.description: Monitors traveler location against destination risk intelligence, raises alerts on emerging threats, and supports locating and assisting travelers during disruptions. Masters the duty-of-care alerts. Reads traveler profiles and trip itineraries to know who is where.
modules.catalog_tagline: Know where your travelers are and keep them safe on the road.
modules.catalog_description: See where every traveler is at a glance, match their trips against live destination risk, and get alerted the moment something threatens them. When disruption hits, locate affected travelers fast and act on your duty-of-care obligation instead of scrambling.

modules.description: Maintains per-traveler profiles (preferences, loyalty, documents, emergency contacts) and the travel policy plus pre-trip approval workflow. Masters traveler profiles, travel policies, and trip approvals. Drives policy-aware shopping in the booking module and feeds traveler identity into duty-of-care.
modules.catalog_tagline: Personalize booking with traveler profiles and keep trips within policy.
modules.catalog_description: Give every traveler a profile with their loyalty numbers, document details, preferences, and emergency contacts, so booking is fast and compliant. Set travel policy once and route out-of-policy or high-cost trips for pre-trip approval, capturing exceptions and sign-offs along the way.

modules.description: Assembles booked segments into a single trip the traveler can view, change, and track, keeping the itinerary synchronized through additions, modifications, and disruptions. Masters the trip container and the itinerary. The seam where the trip record and its charges hand off to the expense and spend domains.
modules.catalog_tagline: Keep the whole trip in one itinerary, always up to date.
modules.catalog_description: Every booked segment rolls up into one trip your traveler can see and change, and stays in sync when plans shift or flights are disrupted. The complete trip record flows straight to expense and spend, so finance reconciles charges without chasing anyone for details.

modules.description: Define endpoint compliance baselines and evaluate device posture on a recurring cadence. Covers OS-version floors, encryption and password enforcement, jailbreak and root detection, and the per-device scan results that drive conditional-access decisions and remediation.

Author and deploy OS-level configuration profiles and distribute managed applications to endpoint cohorts. Covers Wi-Fi, VPN, certificate, restriction, and encryption settings templates alongside the app catalog, silent install and update, and per-device app assignment tracking.

Enroll, onboard, and retire managed endpoints across Windows, Apple, Android, and ChromeOS. Covers zero-touch provisioning, enrollment-token issuance and redemption, and the deployment-result log that records each onboarding and policy push outcome per device.

Animal-patient clinical record: species/breed/weight/microchip master, examination history, vaccination protocols, lab-results integration with reference labs and in-house analyzers, and preventive-care reminder management driving recall outreach.
modules.catalog_tagline: Keep every animal patient's clinical record, vaccinations, and lab results in one place, and never miss a preventive-care recall.
modules.catalog_description:
Manage the full clinical picture for every animal patient. Capture species, breed, weight, and microchip details, record examinations over time, and run vaccination protocols that fit each patient.

Order diagnostics, review results as they come back, and flag critical findings for fast follow-up. Built-in preventive-care reminders drive recall outreach so patients return on schedule and nothing falls through the cracks.

modules.description: Pet-owner client relationship master with contact, communication preferences, and balance history, plus appointment scheduling with species/exam-type fit and waitlist handling, and services/product/lab/drug invoicing with in-clinic point-of-sale and payer integration.
modules.catalog_tagline: Manage client relationships, book the right appointments, and bill for visits and products from one front desk.
modules.catalog_description:
Give your front office one place to manage every pet owner: contact details, communication preferences, and account balances. Reach clients the way they prefer to keep them informed and engaged.

Schedule appointments that match the patient and exam type, handle waitlists with ease, and invoice for services, products, lab work, and medications. In-clinic point-of-sale and payment handling close the loop from booking to payment.

modules.description: Drug inventory with lot tracking and automated reorder thresholds, plus the DEA-required controlled-substance receipt, dispensation, and disposal ledger with Schedule II to V reconciliation evidence.
modules.catalog_tagline: Track drug inventory and keep a defensible controlled-substance ledger ready for inspection.
modules.catalog_description:
Stay on top of your pharmacy. Track drug inventory by lot, set automated reorder thresholds, and avoid running short on what your patients need.

Maintain a complete controlled-substance ledger covering receipt, dispensation, and disposal, with reconciliation evidence for Schedule II through V. Every entry is captured and attributable, so you can demonstrate compliance with confidence.

modules.description: Connects the delivery toolchain and models value streams: tool connections, value-stream definitions, flow-metric definitions, and the mirrored work items that flow through each stream.
modules.catalog_tagline: Connect your delivery tools and map the value streams work flows through.
modules.catalog_description: Lay the foundation for measuring delivery. Connect your planning, source, CI/CD, and service tools, define your value streams, and let the platform mirror the work items moving through them. Configure which flow metrics matter and how they are computed, so the rest of the platform can measure delivery against a model you control, across tools you did not build.

modules.description: Computes flow metrics, surfaces bottlenecks, benchmarks DORA performance, and analyzes investment mix and delivery-to-outcome alignment over the mirrored value-stream data.
modules.catalog_tagline: Measure flow, find bottlenecks, and tie delivery to business outcomes.
modules.catalog_description: Turn mirrored delivery data into decisions. Measure flow velocity, time, load, efficiency, and distribution across your value streams, surface the bottlenecks slowing delivery, and benchmark performance with DORA metrics. Analyze whether effort is going to new value, defects, or debt, and tie delivery outcomes back to business investment so leaders can act on what the flow data shows.

modules.description: Owns the discovery-to-finding pipeline: scan jobs run against an asset population, results are matched to the vulnerability knowledge base, and per-asset findings are created and deduplicated into the vulnerability lifecycle. Consumes asset masters from ITAM/CMDB and software inventory from SAM rather than mastering them.
modules.catalog_tagline: Scan everything you own continuously and turn raw scan output into deduplicated, tracked findings.
modules.catalog_description:
Discover what you own, then scan it on a continuous cadence so new exposures surface within hours instead of at the next quarterly review. Network, host, web, container, and cloud scans run against your asset population and produce findings tied to a specific asset and a specific vulnerability definition.

Each finding is matched against a maintained knowledge base of known vulnerabilities, deduplicated, and tracked through its own lifecycle so a weakness opened today is the same record you confirm, remediate, and verify weeks later. The knowledge base keeps CVE metadata, advisories, and check definitions current so detection stays accurate as the threat surface moves.

modules.description: Owns the closed loop after prioritization: remediation work with ownership and due dates, governed exceptions and risk acceptances, verification re-scans, and compliance evidence. Remediation records are mastered here as the security-side workflow; where an org routes fixes through a service desk, these hand off to ITSM change/incident records rather than duplicating them.
modules.catalog_tagline: Route fixes to the right owner, govern the exceptions, verify the close, and hand auditors the evidence.
modules.catalog_description:
Route prioritized findings to the team that owns the fix as remediation work with due dates, ownership, SLAs, and patch or configuration guidance. Give the business a governed path to formally accept and time-box the risks it chooses not to fix yet, with approver sign-off and expiry-driven re-review.

Close the loop and keep it auditable. Re-scan to confirm fixes actually landed, reopen anything that regresses, and watch mean-time-to-remediate trend down by asset group, business unit, and severity. Hand auditors defensible evidence that scanning cadence, remediation timelines, and exception approvals meet the obligations that frameworks such as PCI-DSS, FedRAMP, and NIS2 expect.

modules.description: Owns the ranking layer and the point-in-time assessment lens. Computes risk-based priority over open vulnerabilities using exploit intel, asset criticality, and exposure, and groups vulnerabilities into scoped assessments or campaigns for posture snapshots and audit windows. Consumes exploit and known-exploited intelligence from THREAT-INTEL.
modules.catalog_tagline: Fix the weaknesses an attacker would actually use first, and prove your posture over time.
modules.catalog_description:
Not every finding deserves the same urgency. Layer exploit-prediction signals, known-exploited and actively-attacked intelligence, asset criticality, and exposure on top of base severity to produce a ranked queue that answers the only question that matters at scale: what do we fix this week.

Scope assessments and remediation campaigns over an asset population to capture a point-in-time posture snapshot for an audit window or program milestone, and watch the ranked queue shrink as the right fixes land. Exploit and active-attack signals are consumed from a dedicated threat-intelligence source so prioritization always reflects the current threat landscape.

modules.description: Crawl-based inventory and scheduled audit of web content across one or more sites. Surfaces page-level metadata, ownership, freshness, health scoring, and orphaned-page detection so the web team can govern the full content estate.
modules.catalog_tagline: See every page you publish, and how healthy it is.
modules.catalog_description: Crawl your sites to build a living inventory of every page, then run scheduled audits that score freshness, ownership, and health. Spot orphaned pages, stale content, and gaps before your visitors do. Give the web team a single, trustworthy map of the whole content estate so nothing slips through unmanaged.

modules.description: Editorial calendar, briefs, assignments, and draft / review / approval workflow over web content production, plus content-lifecycle governance: review cadence, refresh frequency, retirement, and successor planning across campaigns, channels, audiences, and personas.
modules.catalog_tagline: Plan, assign, and refresh content on a calendar everyone can see.
modules.catalog_description: Manage content production from brief through draft, review, and approval, and govern what happens after publish. Set review cadences, schedule refreshes, plan retirements, and line up successors so pages never go stale unnoticed. Keep editorial work and lifecycle planning organized across campaigns, channels, audiences, and personas in one shared view.

modules.description: Automated scanning of web content for accessibility conformance, brand voice and style adherence, readability, and policy compliance, with prioritized remediation queues, severity scoring, and evidence reporting for legal and procurement.
modules.catalog_tagline: Catch accessibility and brand-voice problems before your visitors do.
modules.catalog_description: Scan your web content automatically for accessibility conformance, brand voice and style, readability, and policy compliance. Triage findings by severity, route them to the right owner, and track remediation from detected through resolved or verified. Produce the evidence reports legal and procurement need to show your site meets its accessibility obligations.

modules.description: Continuous monitoring of crawlability, indexation, canonical and structured-data health, and broken internal / external links across large web estates, with owner notification and remediation tracking into editorial workflow.
modules.catalog_tagline: Keep your site crawlable, indexed, and free of broken links.
modules.catalog_description: Continuously monitor crawlability, indexation, canonical and structured-data health, and broken internal and external links across large web estates. Surface technical SEO issues and dead links, notify the owners who can fix them, and track each finding to resolution. Protect search visibility and visitor experience without manual spot checks.

modules.description: Manages time-off requests, statutory and discretionary leave, accrual and entitlement policies, and per-worker leave balances tracked against those policies.
modules.catalog_tagline: Manage time-off requests, leave policies, and balances in one place.
modules.catalog_description: Let workers request time off and check their balances, route requests for fast approval, and apply your accrual and entitlement rules automatically. Track every type of leave against the policies you define, so balances stay accurate and approvals stay consistent. Give your team a clear, self-service view of the time off they have earned.

modules.description: Builds demand-driven shift schedules and rosters, assigns shifts with skill matching and dispatch, supports swaps and self-scheduling, and reconciles budgeted-versus-actual labor hours from labor-demand forecasts.
modules.catalog_tagline: Build demand-driven schedules, fill every shift, and keep labor on budget.
modules.catalog_description: Plan rosters from forecasted demand, assign shifts by skill and availability, and let workers pick up, swap, or self-schedule open shifts. Track scheduled hours against your labor budget so you can adjust before costs run over. Give managers a faster way to cover every shift and give workers more say over when they work.

modules.description: Captures clock-in / clock-out and break events, runs time-card collection and approval, and enforces break-and-meal labor-law compliance. Approved time becomes the payroll handoff payload.
modules.catalog_tagline: Capture hours worked, approve time cards, and stay compliant with break and meal rules.
modules.catalog_description: Record clock-in and clock-out events, breaks, and meal periods, then collect them into time cards your managers review and approve. Built-in break and meal rules flag missed or short breaks before they become a liability, so approved time is clean and ready to pay. Give your team an accurate, audit-ready record of every hour worked.

modules.description: Team-execution OKR tracking surface: objectives with key results that link to work items for automatic progress rollup, weekly check-in cadences, scoring, and closure. Deploys alongside the task-execution module for full integration, or standalone with a thin embedded work-item shell for KR linking.
modules.catalog_tagline: Set objectives, score key results, and see progress roll up from the work behind them.
modules.catalog_description:
Define objectives and measurable key results for the quarter or year, assign owners, and keep them current with regular check-ins. Link objectives to the tasks and projects that drive them so progress updates as work gets done instead of being re-entered by hand.

Commit objectives once agreed, track them through the cycle, and score them at close so the team learns what worked.

modules.description: Structured request-intake surface: form definitions, form submissions, routing rules. Pre-task surface that converts a submission into a work_item in the target TASK-EXEC project. Backs the WORK-INTAKE-FORMS capability with entities. Vendor reference: Asana Forms, Monday Forms, ClickUp Forms, Workfront Request Queues, Smartsheet Forms.
modules.catalog_tagline: Capture work requests through structured forms and route them straight into the right project.
modules.catalog_description:
Replace ad-hoc requests with structured intake forms that collect exactly what the team needs to start. Submissions are triaged and converted into work items in the right project, with the requester's details captured along the way.

Standardized intake means no lost requests in chat or email, a consistent starting point for every piece of work, and a clear record of what was asked and what happened next.

modules.description: Cross-functional task and project execution surface: work items with owners, due dates, dependencies, statuses, and assignments; project containers with timelines, dashboards, and board views; user-authored automation rules that fire on item state changes. The deployable substrate every team-based work-management product orbits.
modules.catalog_tagline: Plan projects, assign tasks, and track them from kickoff to done.
modules.catalog_description:
Organize work into projects and sections, then assign tasks with owners, due dates, priorities, and dependencies. Track everything on boards, lists, and timelines, and keep work moving with approval steps, milestones, and automations that handle routine status changes and notifications.

Standardize recurring work with reusable project and task templates, tailor records with custom fields, and use workload views to spot who is over or under capacity before deadlines slip.

modules.description: The core conversational surface of a workstream collaboration platform: persistent channels, messages, threads, channel membership, file attachments, and presence. Hosts the search/retention and chat-to-work-escalation features that live at the channel/message layer.
modules.catalog_tagline: Channels, threads, and messages that keep every conversation organized and searchable.
modules.catalog_description: Create channels for teams, projects, and topics so the right people see the right discussion. Reply in threads to keep side conversations tidy, post messages with rich formatting and attachments, and search back through everything when you need an answer. Archive channels that have run their course and keep the history that goes with them.

modules.description: External guest invitations, scoped access into channels for partners and vendors, and access-revocation workflow on guest offboarding.
modules.catalog_tagline: Work with partners and guests in shared channels without losing control of access.
modules.catalog_description: Invite people from outside your organization into the specific channels where they need to collaborate, and nowhere else. Set the scope of what each guest can see, watch invitations move from sent to accepted, and revoke access the moment a project ends or someone moves on. Collaborate across company lines with the confidence that access stays exactly where you put it.

modules.description: Voice and video huddles anchored to channels or DMs; ad-hoc and scheduled forms.
modules.catalog_tagline: Jump into a voice or video huddle straight from any conversation.
modules.catalog_description: Turn a back-and-forth into a quick call without scheduling a meeting. Start a voice or video huddle from any channel or direct message, pull in the people already in the conversation, and pick up recordings and transcripts afterward so anyone who missed it can catch up. It is the fastest way to settle something that chat alone cannot.

handoffs.description: Building certifications logged for compliance audit trail.

handoffs.description: Regulatory inquiries trigger audit coordination on evidence collection and reporting.

handoffs.description: Closed matters may be referenced in internal-audit work; legal counsel manually shares the relevant outcome and remediation summary.

trigger_events.description: An in-house legal matter has been resolved or formally closed. ECM archives the matter file; AUDIT may need the closure record as part of an evidence package.

handoffs.description: ESG initiative recorded for assurance scope.

trigger_events.description: ESG initiative kicked off; stakeholders notified.

handoffs.description: Manual overrides are a SOX-relevant control event captured for audit evidence.

handoffs.description: Disclosure handed to AUDIT; tight Q deadline; no ack/retry on missed submissions.

trigger_events.description: A general-ledger journal entry has been posted to the books, becoming part of the period's authoritative record. Downstream effects: audit log capture, anomaly detection, intercompany matching.

handoffs.description: Obligation past due → AUDIT escalation as non-conformance risk.

trigger_events.description: Obligation completion date passes without evidence.

handoffs.description: Retention-expiry events and disposition outcomes are streamed to AUDIT so destruction evidence is preserved.

trigger_events.description: A document has reached the end of its retention period under policy. ECM proposes disposition; LSD intervenes for any holds; AUDIT receives the disposition evidence.

handoffs.description: Critical risks feed BCM business-continuity-scenario planning.

trigger_events.description: Risk assessment finalized; updates enterprise risk register.

handoffs.description: Enterprise risk assessment → OP-RES for operational-resilience planning.

trigger_events.description: Risk assessment finalized; updates enterprise risk register.

handoffs.description: Third-party audit findings flow to TPRM for vendor-risk score update.

trigger_events.description: Remediation evidence uploaded; finding closed.

handoffs.description: Score → TPRM risk model; no feedback loop on TPRM action.

trigger_events.description: ESG score recalculated on refresh.

handoffs.description: Nightly batch export of PII/GDPR blocks for privacy-incident tracking.
